/**
 * Sprint 9 / Change 1-5 — unit tests for all new pure-function code.
 *
 * Coverage:
 *   1. lib/person-form-helpers  — diffDays, addMonths, countUaeWorkingDays, monthsUntil
 *   2. components/forms/NationalitySelect — deriveNationalityCategory, filterCountries (via re-impl)
 *   3. lib/data/countries       — data integrity (no duplicate codes, ARE present, etc.)
 *   4. hooks/useDraftSave       — getRelativeTime, PII_FIELDS constant (via sanitize logic)
 *   5. modules/core-hr/validations — AssignmentStatus includes PENDING_APPROVAL
 *   6. modules/config/guards    — HR_HOD is a valid approver role
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'

// ── DB stub ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// modules/config/guards.ts imports lib/db at module load — stub it so the
// test file can import without DATABASE_URL being set.
vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: {} }))
vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  customFieldDefinitions: {},
  notificationTemplates:  {},
}))
vi.mock('drizzle-orm', () => ({
  eq: () => ({}), and: () => ({}), count: () => ({}),
}))

// ── 1. person-form-helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

import {
  diffDays,
  addMonths,
  countUaeWorkingDays,
  monthsUntil,
} from '@/lib/person-form-helpers'

// Reference date pinned for all "today" tests
const TODAY = new Date('2026-05-01T12:00:00')   // local noon, avoids midnight boundary issues

describe('diffDays', () => {
  it('returns 0 for today', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-05-01', TODAY)).toBe(0)
  })

  it('returns 30 for exactly 30 days ago (boundary — does NOT trigger approval)', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-04-01', TODAY)).toBe(30)
  })

  it('returns 31 for 31 days ago (DOES trigger approval)', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-03-31', TODAY)).toBe(31)
  })

  it('returns negative for a future hire date', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-06-01', TODAY)).toBeLessThan(0)
  })

  it('does not trigger approval for today (0 days)', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-05-01', TODAY) > 30).toBe(false)
  })

  it('does not trigger approval for exactly 30 days', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-04-01', TODAY) > 30).toBe(false)
  })

  it('triggers approval at 31 days', () => {
    expect(diffDays('2026-03-31', TODAY) > 30).toBe(true)
  })

  it('handles year boundaries', () => {
    const jan1 = new Date('2026-01-01T12:00:00')
    expect(diffDays('2025-12-31', jan1)).toBe(1)
    expect(diffDays('2025-01-01', jan1)).toBe(365)
  })
})

describe('addMonths', () => {
  it('adds months to a mid-month date', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-03-15', 3)).toBe('2026-06-15')
  })

  it('adds months across a year boundary', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-11-15', 3)).toBe('2027-02-15')
  })

  it('Jan 31 + 1 month → Feb 28 (not March 3)', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-01-31', 1)).toBe('2026-02-28')
  })

  it('Jan 31 + 1 month → Feb 29 in a leap year', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2024-01-31', 1)).toBe('2024-02-29')
  })

  it('Jan 31 + 3 months → Apr 30 (April has 30 days)', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-01-31', 3)).toBe('2026-04-30')
  })

  it('Jan 31 + 5 months → Jun 30 (June has 30 days)', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-01-31', 5)).toBe('2026-06-30')
  })

  it('Jan 31 + 6 months → Jul 31 (probation max — July has 31 days)', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-01-31', 6)).toBe('2026-07-31')
  })

  it('Mar 31 + 1 month → Apr 30', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-03-31', 1)).toBe('2026-04-30')
  })

  it('Dec 31 + 2 months → Feb 28 (next year, non-leap)', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-12-31', 2)).toBe('2027-02-28')
  })

  it('adding 0 months returns the same date', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-04-15', 0)).toBe('2026-04-15')
  })

  it('BR-PR-001 probation check: hire Jan 1, 6 months = Jul 1', () => {
    expect(addMonths('2026-01-01', 6)).toBe('2026-07-01')
  })
})

describe('countUaeWorkingDays', () => {
  // Jan 5 2026 = Monday. (Verified: 2026-01-05 is Monday.)
  // UAE working week: Mon–Thu only.

  it('counts Mon-Thu in a single week (start is exclusive)', () => {
    // From Mon Jan 5 to Fri Jan 9: Tue 6, Wed 7, Thu 8 = 3 working days
    expect(countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-05', '2026-01-09')).toBe(3)
  })

  it('counts Mon-Thu across two weeks', () => {
    // Mon Jan 5 to Mon Jan 12: Tue-Thu (3) + Mon Jan 12 (1) = 4
    expect(countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-05', '2026-01-12')).toBe(4)
  })

  it('excludes Friday and Saturday', () => {
    // Thu Jan 8 to Tue Jan 13: Fri 9 (excl) + Sat 10 (excl) + Sun 11 (excl) + Mon 12 + Tue 13 = 2
    expect(countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-08', '2026-01-13')).toBe(2)
  })

  it('returns 0 for same start and end (start is exclusive)', () => {
    expect(countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-05', '2026-01-05')).toBe(0)
  })

  it('returns 0 for a Friday-to-Friday weekend span', () => {
    // Fri Jan 9 to Sat Jan 10: only Saturday — not counted
    expect(countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-09', '2026-01-10')).toBe(0)
  })

  it('counts correctly across a month boundary', () => {
    // Wed Jan 28 to Mon Feb 2: Thu Jan 29, Mon Feb 2 = 2
    expect(countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-28', '2026-02-02')).toBe(2)
  })

  it('6-month probation from Jan 1 yields positive working days', () => {
    const probEnd = addMonths('2026-01-01', 6) // '2026-07-01'
    const days = countUaeWorkingDays('2026-01-01', probEnd)
    expect(days).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(days).toBeLessThan(200) // sanity cap
  })
})

describe('monthsUntil', () => {
  const REF = new Date('2026-05-01T12:00:00')  // May 2026

  it('returns positive for a future expiry', () => {
    expect(monthsUntil('2026-11-30', REF)).toBe(6)
  })

  it('returns 0 for expiry in the same month', () => {
    expect(monthsUntil('2026-05-31', REF)).toBe(0)
  })

  it('returns negative for an expired passport (month already past)', () => {
    expect(monthsUntil('2026-04-30', REF)).toBe(-1)
  })

  it('returns 12 for exactly 1 year ahead', () => {
    expect(monthsUntil('2027-05-01', REF)).toBe(12)
  })

  it('passport critical threshold: < 6 months', () => {
    const months = monthsUntil('2026-10-01', REF)  // 5 months ahead
    expect(months).toBe(5)
    expect(months < 6).toBe(true)   // should show critical warning
  })

  it('passport warning threshold: 6–11 months', () => {
    const months = monthsUntil('2026-11-01', REF)  // 6 months ahead
    expect(months).toBe(6)
    expect(months >= 6 && months < 12).toBe(true)  // should show warning
  })

  it('no warning for >= 12 months', () => {
    const months = monthsUntil('2027-06-01', REF)  // 13 months ahead
    expect(months).toBe(13)
    expect(months >= 12).toBe(true)   // no warning shown
  })
})

import { PINNED_COUNTRIES, REST_COUNTRIES, COUNTRIES, getCountryByCode } from '@/lib/data/countries'

describe('countries data', () => {
  it('ARE is the first pinned country', () => {

  })

  it('all GCC countries are pinned', () => {

      expect(pinnedCodes.has(gcc)).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  it('has more than 200 countries total', () => {
    expect(COUNTRIES.length).toBeGreaterThan(200)
  })

  it('no duplicate codes in COUNTRIES', () => {
    const codes = COUNTRIES.map(c => c.code)
    const unique = new Set(codes)
    expect(unique.size).toBe(codes.length)
  })

  it('every country has a non-empty flag, nameEn, nameAr, and 3-char code', () => {

      expect(c.nameAr.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
      expect(c.flag.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    }

  })
})

// ── 4. useDraftSave — getRelativeTime ─────────────────────────────────────

import { getRelativeTime } from '@/hooks/useDraftSave'

describe('getRelativeTime', () => {
  afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers() })

  it('returns "just now" for < 60 seconds ago', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const savedAt = new Date()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(30_000)
    expect(getRelativeTime(savedAt)).toBe('just now')
  })

  it('returns "1 minute ago" for exactly 60 seconds', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const savedAt = new Date()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(60_000)
    expect(getRelativeTime(savedAt)).toBe('1 minute ago')
  })

  it('returns "N minutes ago" for 2–59 minutes', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const savedAt = new Date()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(5 * 60_000)
    expect(getRelativeTime(savedAt)).toBe('5 minutes ago')
  })

  it('returns "1 hour ago" for exactly 60 minutes', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const savedAt = new Date()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(60 * 60_000)
    expect(getRelativeTime(savedAt)).toBe('1 hour ago')
  })

  it('returns "N hours ago" for 2–23 hours', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const savedAt = new Date()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(3 * 60 * 60_000)
    expect(getRelativeTime(savedAt)).toBe('3 hours ago')
  })

  it('returns "Yesterday at HH:MM" for ≥ 24 hours', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    const savedAt = new Date()
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(25 * 60 * 60_000)
    const result = getRelativeTime(savedAt)
    expect(result).toMatch(/^Yesterday at \d{2}:\d{2}$/)
  })
})

  })

  it('LINE_MANAGER escalates to HR_HOD (HR_HOD outranks LINE_MANAGER)', () => {

import { CreatePersonSchema } from '@/modules/core-hr/validations'

const basePersonPayload = {
  firstNameEn:         'Test',
  lastNameEn:          'User',
  fullNameAr:          'مستخدم تجريبي',
  dateOfBirth:         '1990-01-01',
  gender:              'MALE',
  nationalityCode:     'ARE',
  nationalityCategory: 'UAE_NATIONAL',
  legalEntityId:       '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
  employmentType:      'FULL_TIME',
  hireDate:            '2026-01-31',
}

describe('BR-PR-001 — probation ≤ 6 months (addMonths + schema)', () => {
  it('6-month probation from Jan 31 clamps to Jul 31 and passes schema', () => {
    const probationEndDate = addMonths('2026-01-31', 6) // '2026-07-31'
    expect(probationEndDate).toBe('2026-07-31')
    const r = CreatePersonSchema.safeParse({ ...basePersonPayload, probationEndDate })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
  })

  it('1-month probation from Jan 31 clamps to Feb 28 (not Mar 3) and passes schema', () => {
    const probationEndDate = addMonths('2026-01-31', 1) // '2026-02-28'
    expect(probationEndDate).toBe('2026-02-28')
    const r = CreatePersonSchema.safeParse({ ...basePersonPayload, probationEndDate })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
  })

  it('3-month probation from Jan 31 clamps to Apr 30 and passes schema', () => {
    const probationEndDate = addMonths('2026-01-31', 3) // '2026-04-30'
    expect(probationEndDate).toBe('2026-04-30')
    const r = CreatePersonSchema.safeParse({ ...basePersonPayload, probationEndDate })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
  })

  it('schema rejects a 7-month probation end date (BR-PR-001)', () => {
    const r = CreatePersonSchema.safeParse({
      ...basePersonPayload,
      hireDate:         '2026-01-01',
      probationEndDate: '2026-08-15',  // 7.5 months
    })
    expect(r.success).toBe(false)
    if (!r.success) {
      expect(r.error.issues.some(i => i.message.includes('BR-PR-001'))).toBe(true)
    }
  })
})

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

const ROOT = process.cwd()
const source = () => readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/persons/[id]/page.tsx'), 'utf8')

function helperSource(): string {
  const src = source()
  return src.slice(
    src.indexOf('type WorkerAssignmentHistoryRow'),
    src.indexOf('function Row({'),
  )
}

describe('Phase 2B-5 person profile worker assignment MDM history labels', () => {
  it('uses assignment effectiveStartDate as the MDM as-of date', () => {
    const helper = helperSource()
    expect(helper).toContain('const asOfDate = assignment.effectiveStartDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('resolveDepartmentHistoryLabel(assignment.departmentId, asOfDate, cache)')
    expect(helper).toContain('resolveJobHistoryLabel(assignment.jobId, asOfDate, cache)')
    expect(helper).toContain('resolvePositionHistoryLabel(assignment.positionId, asOfDate, cache)')
    expect(helper).toContain('resolveGradeHistoryLabel(assignment.gradeId, asOfDate, cache)')
    expect(helper).toContain('resolveLocationHistoryLabel(assignment.locationId, asOfDate, cache)')
  })

  it('resolves MDM history before current base-table fallback', () => {
    const helper = helperSource()
    for (const adapter of [
      'departmentHistoryAsOfAdapter',
      'jobHistoryAsOfAdapter',
      'positionHistoryAsOfAdapter',
      'gradeHistoryAsOfAdapter',
      'locationHistoryAsOfAdapter',
    ]) {
      expect(helper).toContain(adapter)
    }

    expect(helper.indexOf('departmentHistoryAsOfAdapter')).toBeLessThan(helper.indexOf('.from(departments)'))
    expect(helper.indexOf('jobHistoryAsOfAdapter')).toBeLessThan(helper.indexOf('.from(jobs)'))
    expect(helper.indexOf('positionHistoryAsOfAdapter')).toBeLessThan(helper.indexOf('.from(positions)'))
    expect(helper.indexOf('gradeHistoryAsOfAdapter')).toBeLessThan(helper.indexOf('.from(grades)'))
    expect(helper.indexOf('locationHistoryAsOfAdapter')).toBeLessThan(helper.indexOf('.from(locations)'))
  })

  it('falls back to an em dash only after history and current labels miss', () => {
    const helper = helperSource()
    expect(helper).toContain("const EMPTY_HISTORY_LABEL = '—'")
    expect(helper.match(/\?\? EMPTY_HISTORY_LABEL/g)?.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5)
  })

  it('shows a clear label when MDM history has an as-of conflict', () => {
    const helper = helperSource()
    expect(helper).toContain("const HISTORY_CONFLICT_LABEL = 'History conflict'")
    expect(helper.match(/err instanceof AsOfConflictError/g)?.length).toBe(5)
    expect(helper.match(/return HISTORY_CONFLICT_LABEL/g)?.length).toBe(5)
  })

  it('uses a per-request cache for repeated history label lookups', () => {
    const src = source()
    const helper = helperSource()
    expect(src).toContain('const historyLabelCache: HistoryLabelCache = new Map()')
    expect(src).toContain('resolveAssignmentHistoryLabels(assignment, historyLabelCache)')
    expect(helper).toContain('type HistoryLabelCache = Map<string, Promise<string>>')
    expect(helper).toContain('const cached = cache.get(key)')
    expect(helper).toContain('cache.set(key, resolved)')
  })

  it('renders historical labels only in the worker assignment history section', () => {
    const src = source()
    const historySection = src.slice(
      src.indexOf('Worker assignment history'),
      src.indexOf('Employment actions'),
    )
    expect(historySection).toContain('assignmentRowsWithHistoricalLabels.map')
    expect(historySection).toContain('Department: {a.historicalLabels.department}')
    expect(historySection).toContain('Position: {a.historicalLabels.position}')
    expect(historySection).toContain('Job: {a.historicalLabels.job}')
    expect(historySection).toContain('Grade: {a.historicalLabels.grade}')
    expect(historySection).toContain('Location: {a.historicalLabels.location}')

    const currentEmploymentCard = src.slice(
      src.indexOf('Employment · <span'),
      src.indexOf('{job?.isEmiratisationTarget'),
    )
    expect(currentEmploymentCard).not.toContain('historicalLabels')
    expect(currentEmploymentCard).not.toContain('assignmentRowsWithHistoricalLabels')
  })
})

/**
 * Employees page — Department Head filter (DHF).
 *
 * Zod behavioral tests + source-contract guards so the regression-critical
 * invariants (manager scoping, count/rows sync, entity-scoped LOV, URL state,
 * export independence) cannot silently regress. Source-inspection only for the
 * contract guards (no DB) — mirrors dashboard-drilldown.test.ts.
 *
 * Maps to the approved test plan:
 *   1 no filter unchanged · 2 head filter · 3 dept+head · 4 entity+head ·
 *   5 invalid id · 6 pagination · 7 counts · 8 exports · 9 URL refresh · 10 deep-link
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import { ListPersonsFilterSchema } from '@/modules/core-hr/validations'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')
const read = (p: string) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, p), 'utf-8')

const actionsSrc    = read('modules/core-hr/actions.ts')
const pageSrc       = read('app/(hr-admin)/persons/page.tsx')
const filterBarSrc  = read('app/(hr-admin)/persons/PersonFilterBar.tsx')
const exportSrc     = read('app/(hr-admin)/reports/export/route.ts')

const VALID = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'

describe('DHF — ListPersonsFilterSchema validation', () => {
  it('DHF-Z1: accepts a valid departmentHeadId uuid', () => {
    const r = ListPersonsFilterSchema.parse({ departmentHeadId: VALID })
    expect(r.departmentHeadId).toBe(VALID)
  })

  it('DHF-Z2 (scenario 5): rejects a non-uuid departmentHeadId', () => {
    expect(() => ListPersonsFilterSchema.parse({ departmentHeadId: 'not-a-uuid' })).toThrow()
  })

  it('DHF-Z3 (scenario 1): is optional — absent leaves results unfiltered', () => {
    const r = ListPersonsFilterSchema.parse({})
    expect(r.departmentHeadId).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('DHF-Z4 (scenarios 3,4): composes with departmentId and legalEntityId', () => {
    const r = ListPersonsFilterSchema.parse({
      departmentId: VALID, legalEntityId: VALID, departmentHeadId: VALID,
    })
    expect(r.departmentHeadId).toBe(VALID)
    expect(r.departmentId).toBe(VALID)
    expect(r.legalEntityId).toBe(VALID)
  })
})

describe('DHF — listPersons query contract', () => {
  it('DHF-Q1 (scenario 2): pushes the head predicate into the shared conditions array', () => {
    expect(actionsSrc).toMatch(/conditions\.push\(eq\(departments\.headPersonId,\s*f\.departmentHeadId\)\)/)
  })

  it('DHF-Q2 (scenario 7,9 — count/rows sync): departments is leftJoined in BOTH queries (no new join)', () => {
    const joins = actionsSrc.match(/leftJoin\(departments, eq\(persons\.currentDepartmentId, departments\.id\)\)/g) || []
    expect(joins.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2) // count query + rows query
  })

  it('DHF-Q3 (MANAGER scoping intact): head predicate appears AFTER the MANAGER direct-report block', () => {
    const mgrIdx  = actionsSrc.indexOf("user.role === 'MANAGER'")
    const headIdx = actionsSrc.indexOf('eq(departments.headPersonId, f.departmentHeadId)')
    expect(mgrIdx).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(headIdx).toBeGreaterThan(mgrIdx) // ANDs on top, never replaces manager scoping
  })

  it('DHF-Q4: head predicate appears AFTER entity scoping (cannot widen entity scope)', () => {
    const entityIdx = actionsSrc.indexOf('eq(persons.legalEntityId, scopedEntityId)')
    const headIdx   = actionsSrc.indexOf('eq(departments.headPersonId, f.departmentHeadId)')
    expect(headIdx).toBeGreaterThan(entityIdx)
  })
})

describe('DHF — persons page wiring', () => {
  // Option D redesign (2026-06): the page no longer renders a Department Head
  // LOV dropdown — cohort segments + Entity/Department chips replaced the old
  // filter wall. Deep-link URLs (?departmentHeadId=…) must still filter,
  // server-side, through listPersons (which enforces entity/MANAGER scoping).

  it('DHF-P1 (scenario 9/10 — deep-link): departmentHeadId threaded through SearchParams + listPersons', () => {
    expect(pageSrc).toMatch(/departmentHeadId\?:\s*string/)
    expect(pageSrc).toMatch(/departmentHeadId:\s*sp\.departmentHeadId\s*\|\|\s*undefined/)
  })

  it('DHF-P2 (no cross-entity leak): page builds NO head LOV — head names never queried client-side', () => {
    // The old page exposed a head-name LOV that needed entity clamping
    // (headScopeEntityId). Option D removed the LOV entirely, so there is no
    // surface to leak cross-entity names from. Guard that it stays removed —
    // reintroducing a head LOV must bring back entity-scoped selectDistinct.
    expect(pageSrc).not.toMatch(/selectDistinct/)
    expect(pageSrc).not.toMatch(/headPersonId/)
  })

  it('DHF-P3 (server-filtered): departmentHeadId is applied inside listPersons, not client-side', () => {
    // The rows handed to the client component are already head-filtered by
    // listPersons; the client never receives unfiltered cross-cohort rows.
    expect(pageSrc).toMatch(/listPersons\(\{[\s\S]*?departmentHeadId:\s*sp\.departmentHeadId\s*\|\|\s*undefined[\s\S]*?\}\)/)
  })
})

describe('DHF — filter bar wiring', () => {
  it('DHF-F1: reuses the existing searchable PersonSelect LOV component', () => {
    expect(filterBarSrc).toMatch(/import \{ PersonSelect, type PersonOption \} from '@\/components\/forms\/PersonSelect'/)
    expect(filterBarSrc).toMatch(/<PersonSelect/)
  })

  it('DHF-F2 (scenario 9,10 — URL/deep-link): writes the departmentHeadId URL param', () => {
    expect(filterBarSrc).toMatch(/setParam\('departmentHeadId',\s*id \|\| undefined\)/)
  })

  it('DHF-F3: provides a Clear affordance (PersonSelect has no empty option)', () => {
    expect(filterBarSrc).toMatch(/setParam\('departmentHeadId',\s*undefined\)/)
  })
})

describe('DHF — export independence (scenario 8)', () => {
  it('DHF-X1: the reports export route does NOT consume listPersons (separate query source)', () => {
    expect(exportSrc).not.toMatch(/listPersons/)
  })
})

// @vitest-environment node
/**
 * applyTransferOutcome — workflow apply-back for approved Transfer/Promotion.
 *
 * Locks the contract: REJECTED no-ops; APPROVED applies the assignment change via
 * the tx-aware changeAssignmentTx primitive, records an employment_action, syncs
 * persons.*, and writes audit — atomically on the engine's transaction.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

const writeAuditLog = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
const changeAssignmentTx = vi.fn()

vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({ writeAuditLog }))
vi.mock('@/lib/constants', () => ({ TENANT_ID: 'tenant-1' }))
vi.mock('@/lib/effective-date', () => ({
  isFutureDated: (effectiveDate: string) => effectiveDate > '2026-06-10',
  yearsOfService: () => 5,
}))
vi.mock('@/modules/core-hr/contracts/services', () => ({ deriveNoticePeriodDays: () => 90 }))
vi.mock('@/modules/core-hr/worker-assignments/services', () => ({ changeAssignmentTx }))
vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  employmentActions: { id: 'id' },
  persons:           { tenantId: 'tenantId', id: 'id' },
  transferRequests:  { tenantId: 'tenantId', id: 'id' },
}))

// ── Chainable tx mock ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function makeTx(rows: unknown[][]) {
  let i = 0
  const selectChain = () => {
    const c: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    c.from = () => c
    c.where = () => c
    c.limit = async () => rows[i++] ?? []
    return c
  }
  return {
    select: vi.fn(() => selectChain()),
    insert: vi.fn(() => ({ values: () => ({ returning: async () => [{ id: 'action-1' }] }) })),
    update: vi.fn(() => ({ set: () => ({ where: async () => undefined }) })),
  }
}

const REQUEST = {
  id: 'req-1', tenantId: 'tenant-1', personId: 'per-1',
  currentPositionId: 'pos-1', targetPositionId: 'pos-2', targetDepartmentId: 'dep-2',
  requestType: 'TRANSFER', effectiveDate: '2026-05-01', reason: 'ORG_NEED', notes: null,
  requestedById: 'per-99',
}
const PERSON = {
  id: 'per-1', legalEntityId: 'ent-1', hireDate: '2020-01-01',
  currentDepartmentId: 'dep-1', currentPositionId: 'pos-1',
}
const CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT = {
  id: 'asg-1', departmentId: 'dep-1', positionId: 'pos-1', gradeId: 'gr-1',
  locationId: 'loc-1', lineManagerId: 'mgr-1', employmentType: 'FULL_TIME', assignmentStatus: 'ACTIVE',
}

describe('applyTransferOutcome', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks()
    changeAssignmentTx.mockImplementation(async (_tx, _actor, data) => {
      if (data.mode === 'FUTURE_DATED') {
        return { mode: 'FUTURE_DATED', futureId: 'asg-future', futureAssignmentNumber: 'WA-3', current: CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT }
      }
      return { mode: 'UPDATE', closedId: 'asg-1', newId: 'asg-2', newAssignmentNumber: 'WA-2', current: CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT }
    })
  })

  it('REJECTED → no-op (no assignment change, no audit)', async () => {
    const { applyTransferOutcome } = await import('@/modules/core-hr/employment-actions/workflow-actions')
    const tx = makeTx([])
    await applyTransferOutcome({ requestId: 'req-1', finalStatus: 'REJECTED', actorPersonId: 'per-9', actorDisplayName: 'Approver', legalEntityId: 'ent-1', tx: tx as never })
    expect(changeAssignmentTx).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(writeAuditLog).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(tx.select).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('APPROVED TRANSFER → applies dept change via changeAssignmentTx + audits', async () => {
    const { applyTransferOutcome } = await import('@/modules/core-hr/employment-actions/workflow-actions')
    const tx = makeTx([[REQUEST], [PERSON]])
    await applyTransferOutcome({ requestId: 'req-1', finalStatus: 'APPROVED', actorPersonId: 'per-9', actorDisplayName: 'Approver', legalEntityId: 'ent-1', tx: tx as never })

    expect(changeAssignmentTx).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    const [, actor, data] = changeAssignmentTx.mock.calls[0]
    expect(actor).toMatchObject({ personId: 'per-9' })
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ personId: 'per-1', actionType: 'TRANSFER', departmentId: 'dep-2', positionId: 'pos-2', mode: 'UPDATE' })
    expect(tx.insert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)   // employment_actions row
    expect(tx.update).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)   // persons pointer sync
    expect(writeAuditLog).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(writeAuditLog.mock.calls[0][0].eventType).toBe('EMPLOYMENT_ACTION.TRANSFER')
    expect(writeAuditLog.mock.calls[0][0].metadata).toMatchObject({ transferRequestId: 'req-1', appliedViaWorkflow: true })
  })

  it('APPROVED future-dated TRANSFER → creates pending assignment and skips persons pointer sync', async () => {
    const { applyTransferOutcome } = await import('@/modules/core-hr/employment-actions/workflow-actions')
    const futureRequest = { ...REQUEST, effectiveDate: '2026-07-15' }
    const tx = makeTx([[futureRequest], [PERSON]])
    await applyTransferOutcome({ requestId: 'req-1', finalStatus: 'APPROVED', actorPersonId: 'per-9', actorDisplayName: 'Approver', legalEntityId: 'ent-1', tx: tx as never })

    expect(changeAssignmentTx).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(changeAssignmentTx.mock.calls[0][2]).toMatchObject({
      personId: 'per-1',
      actionType: 'TRANSFER',
      departmentId: 'dep-2',
      positionId: 'pos-2',
      mode: 'FUTURE_DATED',
    })
    expect(tx.insert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(tx.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(writeAuditLog.mock.calls[0][0].metadata).toMatchObject({
      transferRequestId: 'req-1',
      assignmentMode: 'FUTURE_DATED',
      personPointersUpdated: false,
      appliedViaWorkflow: true,
    })
  })

  it('APPROVED PROMOTION → actionType PROMOTION', async () => {
    const { applyTransferOutcome } = await import('@/modules/core-hr/employment-actions/workflow-actions')
    const tx = makeTx([[{ ...REQUEST, requestType: 'PROMOTION' }], [PERSON]])
    await applyTransferOutcome({ requestId: 'req-1', finalStatus: 'APPROVED', actorPersonId: 'per-9', actorDisplayName: 'Approver', legalEntityId: 'ent-1', tx: tx as never })
    expect(changeAssignmentTx.mock.calls[0][2]).toMatchObject({ actionType: 'PROMOTION' })
    expect(writeAuditLog.mock.calls[0][0].eventType).toBe('EMPLOYMENT_ACTION.PROMOTION')
  })

  it('throws if request not found', async () => {
    const { applyTransferOutcome } = await import('@/modules/core-hr/employment-actions/workflow-actions')
    const tx = makeTx([[]])  // empty request result
    await expect(applyTransferOutcome({ requestId: 'missing', finalStatus: 'APPROVED', actorPersonId: 'per-9', actorDisplayName: 'A', legalEntityId: 'ent-1', tx: tx as never }))
      .rejects.toThrow(/Transfer request not found/)
  })
})

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

type TimelineRow = {
  id: string
  start: string
  end: string
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE'
  isCurrent: boolean
  actionMode: 'UPDATE' | 'FUTURE_DATED' | 'RETRO_SPLIT'
}

const ROOT = process.cwd()
const serviceSource = () => readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'modules/core-hr/worker-assignments/services.ts'), 'utf8')
const actionModeSource = () => readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'lib/action-mode.ts'), 'utf8')

function futureBoundedBranch(): string {
  const src = serviceSource()
  return src.slice(
    src.indexOf('// ED-2D-3: a current row can already be date-bounded'),
    src.indexOf('// 1) close current row.'),
  )
}

function rangesOverlap(a: TimelineRow, b: TimelineRow): boolean {
  return a.start <= b.end && b.start <= a.end
}

function activeOverlaps(rows: TimelineRow[]): number {
  const active = rows.filter(row => row.status !== 'INACTIVE')
  let count = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < active.length; i += 1) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < active.length; j += 1) {
      if (rangesOverlap(active[i], active[j])) count += 1
    }
  }
  return count
}

function activeAsOf(rows: TimelineRow[], asOf: string): TimelineRow | null {
  return rows
    .filter(row => row.status !== 'INACTIVE')
    .filter(row => row.start <= asOf && row.end >= asOf)
    .sort((a, b) => b.start.localeCompare(a.start))[0] ?? null
}

function addDays(date: string, days: number): string {
  const dt = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00.000Z`)
  dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate() + days)
  return dt.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
}

function applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit(input: {
  start: string
  currentEnd: string
  futureStart?: string
  effectiveDate: string
  today: string
  futureStatus?: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE'
  futureRows?: number
}): TimelineRow[] {
  const futureRows = input.futureRows ?? (input.futureStart ? 1 : 0)
  if (input.effectiveDate <= input.start) throw new Error('D_LE_S')
  if (input.effectiveDate > input.today) throw new Error('FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_RETRO')
  if (!input.futureStart) throw new Error('MISSING_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
  if (futureRows > 1) throw new Error('MULTIPLE_FUTURE_BOUNDARIES')
  if (input.futureStatus === 'INACTIVE') throw new Error('INACTIVE_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
  if (input.futureStart !== addDays(input.currentEnd, 1)) throw new Error('MISSING_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
  if (input.effectiveDate >= input.futureStart) throw new Error('D_GTE_F')

  return [
    { id: 'A', start: input.start, end: addDays(input.effectiveDate, -1), status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'UPDATE' },
    { id: 'R', start: input.effectiveDate, end: input.currentEnd, status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: true, actionMode: 'RETRO_SPLIT' },
    { id: 'F', start: input.futureStart, end: '9999-12-31', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'FUTURE_DATED' },
  ]
}

describe('ED-2D-3B future-bounded retro split', () => {
  it('uses type-safe RETRO_SPLIT action mode without raw SQL literal insertion', () => {
    const actionMode = actionModeSource()
    const branch = futureBoundedBranch()

    expect(actionMode).toContain("export type ActionMode = 'UPDATE' | 'CORRECTION' | 'FUTURE_DATED' | 'RETRO_SPLIT'")
    expect(actionMode).toContain("export type ChangeAssignmentMode = Exclude<ActionMode, 'RETRO_SPLIT'>")
    expect(branch).toContain("actionMode:              'RETRO_SPLIT'")
    expect(branch).not.toContain("actionMode:              sql`'RETRO_SPLIT'`")
  })

  it('uses advisory lock and recomputes current pointer after the split', () => {
    const src = serviceSource()
    const branch = futureBoundedBranch()

    expect(src).toContain('export async function lockWorkerAssignmentTimelineTx')
    expect(src).toContain('export async function recomputeCurrentWorkerAssignmentPointerTx')
    expect(src).toContain("pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('worker_assignment:' || ${personId}))")
    expect(branch).toContain('recomputeCurrentWorkerAssignmentPointerTx(tx, user, data.personId)')
    expect(branch).toContain('currentPointerRecomputed:   true')
  })

  it('detects exactly one FUTURE_DATED boundary for a bounded current row', () => {
    const src = serviceSource()
    const branch = futureBoundedBranch()

    expect(src).toContain('const currentEffectiveEndDate = current.effectiveEndDate ?? EFFECTIVE_END_OF_TIME')
    expect(branch).toContain('currentEffectiveEndDate !== EFFECTIVE_END_OF_TIME')
    expect(branch).toContain('const futureBoundaryStartDate = addDays(currentEffectiveEndDate, 1)')
    expect(branch).toContain("eq(workerAssignments.actionMode, 'FUTURE_DATED')")
    expect(branch).toContain('sql`${workerAssignments.effectiveStartDate} > ${currentEffectiveEndDate}`')
    expect(branch).toContain('futureBoundaries.length === 0')
    expect(branch).toContain('futureBoundaries.length > 1')
  })

  it('rejects unsupported effective dates and inactive or missing boundaries before writing', () => {
    const branch = futureBoundedBranch()

    expect(branch).toContain('data.effectiveDate > todayUae()')
    expect(branch).toContain('FUTURE_BOUNDED_RETRO_SPLIT_REQUIRES_RETRO_OR_CURRENT_DATE')
    expect(branch).toContain('data.effectiveDate >= futureBoundaryStartDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('FUTURE_BOUNDED_RETRO_SPLIT_INVALID_RANGE')
    expect(branch).toContain('FUTURE_BOUNDED_RETRO_SPLIT_MISSING_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
    expect(branch).toContain('FUTURE_BOUNDED_RETRO_SPLIT_MULTIPLE_FUTURE_BOUNDARIES')
    expect(branch).toContain("futureBoundary.assignmentStatus === 'INACTIVE'")
    expect(branch).toContain('FUTURE_BOUNDED_RETRO_SPLIT_INACTIVE_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
    expect(branch.indexOf('FUTURE_BOUNDED_RETRO_SPLIT_INACTIVE_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')).toBeLessThan(branch.indexOf('.update(workerAssignments)'))
  })

  it('closes A to D-1, inserts R as current RETRO_SPLIT, and preserves F', () => {
    const branch = futureBoundedBranch()

    expect(branch).toContain('const originalNewEffectiveEndDate = addDays(data.effectiveDate, -1)')
    expect(branch).toContain('const replacementEffectiveEndDate = currentEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('effectiveEndDate: originalNewEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('isCurrent:        false')
    expect(branch).toContain('effectiveStartDate: data.effectiveDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('effectiveEndDate:   replacementEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('isCurrent:               true')
    expect(branch).toContain("actionMode:              'RETRO_SPLIT'")
    expect(branch).toContain('futureBoundaryPreserved:    true')
    expect(branch).toContain('downstreamImpact')
    expect(branch).not.toContain('where(eq(workerAssignments.id, futureBoundary.id))')
  })

  it('keeps transfer/promotion apply-back compatible with UPDATE mode', () => {
    const branch = futureBoundedBranch()

    expect(branch).toContain("assignmentModeCompatibility: 'UPDATE'")
    expect(branch).toContain("mode:                'UPDATE'")
    expect(branch).toContain('closedId:            current.id')
    expect(branch).toContain('newId:               row.id')
  })

  it('models the approved A/R/F timeline and pending visibility', () => {
    const before: TimelineRow[] = [
      { id: 'A', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2026-09-14', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: true, actionMode: 'UPDATE' },
      { id: 'F', start: '2026-09-15', end: '9999-12-31', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'FUTURE_DATED' },
    ]
    const after: TimelineRow[] = [
      { id: 'A', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2026-06-30', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'UPDATE' },
      { id: 'R', start: '2026-07-01', end: '2026-09-14', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: true, actionMode: 'RETRO_SPLIT' },
      { id: 'F', start: '2026-09-15', end: '9999-12-31', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'FUTURE_DATED' },
    ]

    expect(before.filter(row => row.isCurrent)).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(activeOverlaps(after)).toBe(0)
    expect(after.filter(row => row.isCurrent)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: 'R' })])
    expect(after.filter(row => row.actionMode === 'FUTURE_DATED' && row.start > '2026-06-10')).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ id: 'F' }),
    ])
    expect(activeAsOf(after, '2026-06-30')?.id).toBe('A')
    expect(activeAsOf(after, '2026-07-01')?.id).toBe('R')
    expect(activeAsOf(after, '2026-09-14')?.id).toBe('R')
    expect(activeAsOf(after, '2026-09-15')?.id).toBe('F')
  })

  it('models future cancellation repairing the replacement row', () => {
    const afterCancel: TimelineRow[] = [
      { id: 'A', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2026-06-30', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'UPDATE' },
      { id: 'R', start: '2026-07-01', end: '9999-12-31', status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: true, actionMode: 'RETRO_SPLIT' },
      { id: 'F', start: '2026-09-15', end: '9999-12-31', status: 'INACTIVE', isCurrent: false, actionMode: 'FUTURE_DATED' },
    ]

    expect(activeOverlaps(afterCancel)).toBe(0)
    expect(afterCancel.filter(row => row.isCurrent)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: 'R' })])
    expect(afterCancel.filter(row => row.actionMode === 'FUTURE_DATED' && row.status !== 'INACTIVE')).toHaveLength(0)
    expect(activeAsOf(afterCancel, '2026-09-15')?.id).toBe('R')
  })

  it('supports D = F - 1', () => {
    const rows = applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({
      start: '2024-01-01',
      currentEnd: '2026-09-14',
      futureStart: '2026-09-15',
      effectiveDate: '2026-09-14',
      today: '2026-09-14',
    })

    expect(rows).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ id: 'A', end: '2026-09-13', isCurrent: false }))
    expect(rows).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ id: 'R', start: '2026-09-14', end: '2026-09-14', isCurrent: true }))
    expect(activeOverlaps(rows)).toBe(0)
  })

  it('supports D = today', () => {
    const rows = applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({
      start: '2024-01-01',
      currentEnd: '2026-09-14',
      futureStart: '2026-09-15',
      effectiveDate: '2026-06-11',
      today: '2026-06-11',
    })

    expect(activeAsOf(rows, '2026-06-10')?.id).toBe('A')
    expect(activeAsOf(rows, '2026-06-11')?.id).toBe('R')
    expect(rows.filter(row => row.isCurrent)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ id: 'R' })])
  })

  it('rejects D >= F and D <= S', () => {
    const base = {
      start: '2024-01-01',
      currentEnd: '2026-09-14',
      futureStart: '2026-09-15',
      today: '2026-09-15',
    }

    expect(() => applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({ ...base, effectiveDate: '2026-09-15' })).toThrow('D_GTE_F')
    expect(() => applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({ ...base, effectiveDate: '2024-01-01' })).toThrow('D_LE_S')
  })

  it('rejects future-effective retro split, missing boundary, inactive boundary, and multiple boundaries', () => {
    const base = {
      start: '2024-01-01',
      currentEnd: '2026-09-14',
      effectiveDate: '2026-07-01',
      today: '2026-06-11',
    }

    expect(() => applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({ ...base, futureStart: '2026-09-15' })).toThrow('FUTURE_EFFECTIVE_RETRO')
    expect(() => applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({ ...base, effectiveDate: '2026-06-11' })).toThrow('MISSING_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
    expect(() => applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({ ...base, effectiveDate: '2026-06-11', futureStart: '2026-09-15', futureStatus: 'INACTIVE' })).toThrow('INACTIVE_FUTURE_BOUNDARY')
    expect(() => applyFutureBoundedRetroSplit({ ...base, effectiveDate: '2026-06-11', futureStart: '2026-09-15', futureRows: 2 })).toThrow('MULTIPLE_FUTURE_BOUNDARIES')
  })
})

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

type AssignmentRow = {
  id: string
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE'
  start: string
  end: string
  isCurrent: boolean
}

const ROOT = process.cwd()
const source = () => readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/pending-changes/actions.ts'), 'utf8')

function cancelFunctionSource(): string {
  const src = source()
  return src.slice(
    src.indexOf('export async function cancelFutureDatedChange'),
    src.indexOf('// ── Helpers'),
  )
}

function assignmentBranchSource(): string {
  const src = cancelFunctionSource()
  return src.slice(
    src.indexOf("case 'ASSIGNMENT':"),
    src.indexOf("case 'LEAVE_PLAN':"),
  )
}

function executableAssignmentBranch(): string {
  return assignmentBranchSource()
    .split('\n')
    .filter(line => !line.trim().startsWith('//'))
    .join('\n')
}

function rangesOverlap(a: AssignmentRow, b: AssignmentRow): boolean {
  return a.start <= b.end && b.start <= a.end
}

function duplicateCurrent(rows: AssignmentRow[]): number {
  return rows.filter(row => row.isCurrent).length > 1 ? 1 : 0
}

function activeOverlaps(rows: AssignmentRow[]): number {
  const active = rows.filter(row => row.status !== 'INACTIVE')
  return active.some((row, i) => active.slice(i + 1).some(other => rangesOverlap(row, other))) ? 1 : 0
}

describe('Phase 2C-2 worker assignment future-dated cancellation repair', () => {
  it('loads only the selected active FUTURE_DATED assignment before cancelling', () => {
    const branch = assignmentBranchSource()
    expect(branch).toContain('let [futureAssignment] = await tx')
    expect(branch).toContain('lockWorkerAssignmentTimelineTx(tx, futureAssignment.personId)')
    expect(branch).toContain('const [lockedFutureAssignment] = await tx')
    expect(branch).toContain('eq(workerAssignments.id, parsed.id)')
    expect(branch).toContain('eq(workerAssignments.tenantId, TENANT_ID)')
    expect(branch).toContain("eq(workerAssignments.actionMode, 'FUTURE_DATED')")
    expect(branch).toContain("ne(workerAssignments.assignmentStatus, 'INACTIVE')")
    expect(branch).toContain('gt(workerAssignments.effectiveStartDate, today)')
  })

  it('finds the predecessor closed to futureStart - 1 and fails before cancellation when missing', () => {
    const branch = assignmentBranchSource()
    expect(branch).toContain('const predecessorClosedDate = addDays(futureAssignment.effectiveStartDate, -1)')
    expect(branch).toContain('eq(workerAssignments.effectiveEndDate, predecessorClosedDate)')
    expect(branch).toContain('TIMELINE_REPAIR_FAILED: predecessor assignment not found; future assignment was not cancelled.')
    expect(branch.indexOf('if (!predecessor)')).toBeLessThan(branch.indexOf("assignmentStatus: 'INACTIVE'"))
  })

  it('repairs predecessor to the next later future start - 1 or sentinel when no later future exists', () => {
    const branch = assignmentBranchSource()
    expect(branch).toContain('const [nextFuture] = await tx')
    expect(branch).toContain('gt(workerAssignments.effectiveStartDate, futureAssignment.effectiveStartDate)')
    expect(branch).toContain('const repairedEndDate = nextFuture')
    expect(branch).toContain('addDays(nextFuture.effectiveStartDate, -1)')
    expect(branch).toContain('EFFECTIVE_END_OF_TIME')
    expect(branch).toContain('effectiveEndDate: repairedEndDate')
  })

  it('marks the future row inactive before reopening the predecessor range', () => {
    const branch = assignmentBranchSource()
    const futureInactive = branch.indexOf("assignmentStatus: 'INACTIVE'")
    const predecessorRepair = branch.indexOf('effectiveEndDate: repairedEndDate')
    expect(futureInactive).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(predecessorRepair).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(futureInactive).toBeLessThan(predecessorRepair)
  })

  it('keeps predecessor materialised current, cancelled future inactive, and person pointers restored', () => {
    const branch = assignmentBranchSource()
    expect(branch).toContain('isCurrent:        true')
    expect(branch).toContain("assignmentStatus: 'INACTIVE'")
    expect(branch).toContain('recomputeCurrentWorkerAssignmentPointerTx(tx')
    expect(branch).toContain('.update(persons)')
    expect(branch).toContain('currentDepartmentId: predecessor.departmentId')
    expect(branch).toContain('currentPositionId:   predecessor.positionId')
    expect(branch).toContain('currentGradeId:      predecessor.gradeId')
    expect(branch).toContain('lineManagerId:       predecessor.lineManagerId')
  })

  it('audits cancellation and timeline repair details in the existing transaction', () => {
    const fn = cancelFunctionSource()
    const branch = assignmentBranchSource()
    expect(fn).toContain('let auditMetadata: Record<string, unknown>')
    expect(branch).toContain('cancelledFutureAssignmentId: futureAssignment.id')
    expect(branch).toContain('futureEffectiveStartDate:    futureAssignment.effectiveStartDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('futureEffectiveEndDate:      futureAssignment.effectiveEndDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('predecessorAssignmentId:     predecessor.id')
    expect(branch).toContain('predecessorOldEffectiveEndDate: predecessor.effectiveEndDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('predecessorNewEffectiveEndDate: repairedEndDate')
    expect(branch).toContain('nextFutureAssignmentId:      nextFuture?.id ?? null')
    expect(branch).toContain('timelineRepairApplied:       true')
    expect(branch).toContain('compatibilityIsCurrentPreserved: true')
    expect(branch).toContain('futureMarkedInactiveBeforePredecessorRepair: true')
    expect(branch).toContain('personPointersRestored:      true')
    expect(branch).toContain('currentPointerRecomputed:    true')
    expect(branch).toContain('recomputedCurrentAssignmentId: currentPointer.currentAssignmentId')
    expect(fn).toContain('metadata:     auditMetadata')
  })

  it('models cancellation after future-bounded retro split without duplicate-current or active overlap', () => {
    const afterSplit: AssignmentRow[] = [
      { id: 'A', status: 'ACTIVE', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2026-06-30', isCurrent: false },
      { id: 'R', status: 'ACTIVE', start: '2026-07-01', end: '2026-09-14', isCurrent: true },
      { id: 'F', status: 'ACTIVE', start: '2026-09-15', end: '9999-12-31', isCurrent: false },
    ]
    const afterCancel: AssignmentRow[] = [
      { id: 'A', status: 'ACTIVE', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2026-06-30', isCurrent: false },
      { id: 'R', status: 'ACTIVE', start: '2026-07-01', end: '9999-12-31', isCurrent: true },
      { id: 'F', status: 'INACTIVE', start: '2026-09-15', end: '9999-12-31', isCurrent: false },
    ]

    expect(afterSplit.filter(row => row.id === 'F')).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ status: 'ACTIVE', isCurrent: false })])
    expect(afterCancel.filter(row => row.id === 'R')).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ end: '9999-12-31', isCurrent: true })])
    expect(afterCancel.filter(row => row.id === 'F')).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ status: 'INACTIVE', isCurrent: false })])
    expect(duplicateCurrent(afterCancel)).toBe(0)
    expect(activeOverlaps(afterCancel)).toBe(0)
  })

  it('does not add materialisation, cron, broad consumer migration, deletion, or non-assignment repairs', () => {
    const branch = executableAssignmentBranch()
    expect(branch).not.toMatch(/cron|materiali[sz]ation|delete|org-chart|reports|payrollAssignments|leavePlanEnrolments|workScheduleAssignments/i)
  })
})

    expect(actionMode).toContain("export type ChangeAssignmentMode = Exclude<ActionMode, 'RETRO_SPLIT'>")
    expect(changeAssignment).not.toContain("if (mode === 'RETRO_SPLIT')")
  })

  it('serialises worker assignment timeline mutation with a per-person advisory lock', () => {
    const helper = retroSplitHelper()
    expect(helper).toContain('lockWorkerAssignmentTimelineTx(tx, data.personId)')
    expect(serviceSource()).toContain("pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('worker_assignment:' || ${personId}))")
  })

  it('uses the slice resolver and rejects no-match or conflict outcomes before writing', () => {
    const helper = retroSplitHelper()
    expect(helper).toContain('resolveAssignmentSliceForDateTx(tx, data.personId, data.effectiveDate)')
    expect(helper).toContain("resolution.status === 'no_match'")
    expect(helper).toContain('RETRO_SPLIT_NO_ASSIGNMENT_SLICE')
    expect(helper).toContain("resolution.status === 'conflict'")
    expect(helper).toContain('RETRO_SPLIT_CONFLICT')
    expect(helper.indexOf("resolution.status === 'conflict'")).toBeLessThan(helper.indexOf('.update(workerAssignments)'))
  })

  it('limits Phase 2D-2 to historical inside-slice splits only', () => {
    const helper = retroSplitHelper()
    expect(helper).toContain('data.effectiveDate === slice.effectiveStartDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('RETRO_SPLIT_SAME_DAY_SEQUENCE_UNSUPPORTED')
    expect(helper).toContain('const sliceEffectiveEndDate = slice.effectiveEndDate ?? EFFECTIVE_END_OF_TIME')
    expect(helper).toContain('data.effectiveDate < slice.effectiveStartDate || data.effectiveDate > sliceEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('RETRO_SPLIT_INVALID_RANGE')
    expect(helper).toContain('slice.isCurrent || data.effectiveDate >= todayUae()')
    expect(helper).toContain('RETRO_SPLIT_CURRENT_SLICE_UNSUPPORTED')
  })

  it('closes the original slice to effectiveDate - 1 and inserts a non-current replacement', () => {
    const helper = retroSplitHelper()
    expect(helper).toContain('const originalNewEffectiveEndDate = addDays(data.effectiveDate, -1)')
    expect(helper).toContain('effectiveEndDate: originalNewEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('effectiveStartDate: data.effectiveDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('effectiveEndDate:   replacementEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('isCurrent:               false')
    expect(helper).toContain("actionMode:              'RETRO_SPLIT'")
    expect(helper).toContain('effectiveSequence:       1')
  })

  it('bounds replacement by the next future row and rejects ambiguous future overlap', () => {
    const helper = retroSplitHelper()
    expect(helper).toContain('const futureRows = await tx')
    expect(helper).toContain('sql`${workerAssignments.effectiveStartDate} > ${data.effectiveDate}`')
    expect(helper).toContain('sql`${workerAssignments.effectiveStartDate} <= ${sliceEffectiveEndDate}`')
    expect(helper).toContain('futureRows.length > 1')
    expect(helper).toContain('RETRO_SPLIT_AMBIGUOUS_FUTURE_OVERLAP')
    expect(helper).toContain('nextFuture')
    expect(helper).toContain('addDays(nextFuture.effectiveStartDate, -1)')
  })

  it('audits retro split metadata and preserves the existing current-row compatibility contract', () => {
    const helper = retroSplitHelper()
    expect(helper).toContain("eventType:     'WORKER_ASSIGNMENT.RETRO_SPLIT'")
    expect(helper).toContain("actionMode:                 'RETRO_SPLIT'")
    expect(helper).toContain('originalAssignmentId:       slice.id')
    expect(helper).toContain('originalOldEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('originalNewEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('replacementAssignmentId:    row.id')
    expect(helper).toContain('replacementEffectiveStartDate: data.effectiveDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('replacementEffectiveEndDate')
    expect(helper).toContain('replacementIsCurrent:       false')
    expect(helper).toContain('existingCurrentPreserved:   true')
    expect(helper).toContain('currentPointerRecomputed:   true')
    expect(helper).toContain('downstreamImpact')
  })
})

/**
 * Manager Org Chart actions — View Profile route fix + direct-report scope.
 *
 * View Profile in the org chart now routes to /persons/[id] (was /employees/[id]
 * → 404). The destination getPerson() enforces a UNIFIED direct-report scope
 * (persons.lineManagerId OR current worker_assignments.lineManagerId), so all of
 * Fatima's reports resolve — including Aisha (no worker_assignments row) and
 * John (whose WA manager drifted to Shakeel).
 *
 * Manager: manager@avaniis.dev = Fatima Al Zaabi (dddd…004).
 * Reports (persons.lineManagerId): John AVN-T000003, Aisha AVN-T000006, Nour AVN-T000008.
 * Non-report with data: K001 (Dorababu, d92aaabf…).
 */
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const JOHN  = 'dddd0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003' // report, WA mgr drifted
const AISHA = 'dddd0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000006' // report, NO WA row
const NOUR  = 'dddd0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000008' // report, WA mgr = Fatima
const NON_REPORT = 'd92aaabf-333d-4222-b81b-613729e14666' // NOT Fatima's report

test.use({ storageState: 'tests/e2e/auth/manager.json', baseURL: 'http://localhost:3000' })

// ── Org chart page loads (validation #1) ────────────────────────────────────
test('TC-OCA-001: Org chart loads for manager', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/org-chart')
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/org-chart/, { timeout: 10_000 })
  // Did NOT redirect to /dashboard
  expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toContain('/org-chart')
})

// ── View Profile destination resolves for all 3 reports (no 404/notFound) ───
for (const [label, id, num] of [
  ['John Smith',          JOHN,  'AVN-T000003'],
  ['Aisha Binti Abdullah', AISHA, 'AVN-T000006'],
  ['Nour Al Hashimi',     NOUR,  'AVN-T000008'],
] as const) {
  test(`TC-OCA-002 [${num}]: View Profile target /persons/<${label}> renders (not 404)`, async ({ page }) => {
    const resp = await page.goto(`/persons/${id}`)
    // Page must resolve (200) and stay on /persons/<id> — not 404, not /dashboard
    expect(resp?.status()).toBeLessThan(400)
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/persons/${id}`), { timeout: 10_000 })
    // Profile content present, no Next.js notFound copy
    await expect(page.locator('body')).toContainText(num, { timeout: 8_000 })
    await expect(page.getByText(/This page could not be found|404/i)).toHaveCount(0)
  })
}

// ── Scope enforced: non-report is blocked (validation #11) ──────────────────
test('TC-OCA-003: Manager blocked from /persons/<non-report> (scope enforced)', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(`/persons/${NON_REPORT}`)
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')
  const body = (await page.locator('body').textContent()) ?? ''
  // getPerson throws FORBIDDEN → notFound() → "could not be found"; must NOT show K001 data
  const blocked =
    /could not be found|404|not found|not in your team/i.test(body) ||
    !body.includes('K001')
  expect(blocked).toBe(true)
})

// ── No new tab: org chart uses same-tab navigation only ─────────────────────
test('TC-OCA-004: Org chart page exposes no target=_blank links', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/org-chart')
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')
  const blankLinks = await page.locator('a[target="_blank"]').count()
  expect(blankLinks).toBe(0)
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

/**
 * S5-01 / S5-05 / S5-06 — Integration tests for absence Server Actions.
 *
 * Pattern mirrors tests/integration/core-hr-actions.test.ts:
 *   • Proxy-based mock for `db` so chainable .select(...).from(...).where(...)
 *     reads from a queryQueue.
 *   • db.transaction(fn) invokes `fn(tx)` with an insert/update spy harness.
 *   • Auth/audit/encryption/initiateWorkflow mocked to identity functions
 *     so the test reasons about logic, not crypto/RPC.
 */

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex   = 0

const insertSpy    = vi.fn()
const valuesSpy    = vi.fn()
const returningSpy = vi.fn()
const updateSpy    = vi.fn()
const setSpy       = vi.fn()
const whereSpy     = vi.fn()
const auditSpy     = vi.fn()
const initWfSpy         = vi.fn()
const stepWfSpy         = vi.fn()
const ruleGuardSpy      = vi.fn()
const submitWorkflowSpy = vi.fn()
const takeWfActionSpy   = vi.fn()

function makeProxy(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxy()
    },
  })
}

function makeInsertChain(returnRows: unknown[]) {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesSpy(payload)
      return {
        returning: vi.fn((spec: unknown) => {
          returningSpy(spec)
          return Promise.resolve(returnRows)
        }),
        then: (resolve: (v: unknown) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(returnRows).then(resolve),
      }
    }),
  }
}

function makeUpdateChain() {
  return {
    set: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      setSpy(payload)
      return {
        where: vi.fn((cond: unknown) => {
          whereSpy(cond)
          return Promise.resolve()
        }),
      }
    }),
  }
}

function buildTxMock(returnRowsForInsert: unknown[]) {
  const tx = {
    select: vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
    insert: vi.fn((table: unknown) => { insertSpy(table); return makeInsertChain(returnRowsForInsert) }),
    update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
    execute: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  }
  return tx
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = {
  select:      vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
  insert:      vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
  update:      vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
  // Relationship-based scope helpers (teamCte / resolveManagerViewablePersonIds)
  // call db.execute(); default to an empty team so a caller with no reports is
  // correctly blocked from filing/viewing for anyone but themselves.
  execute:     vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve([])),
  transaction: vi.fn(),
}

const session = {

describe('cancelLeaveRequest', () => {

  }

  it('rejects already-CANCELLED', async () => {
    const tx = {
      select: vi.fn(() => {
        callIndex = 0
        queryQueue = [[{ ...pendingRow, status: 'CANCELLED' }]]
        return makeProxy()
      }),
      insert: vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
      update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
    }

    await expect(cancelLeaveRequest({ requestId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000010f1', reason: 'changed mind' })).rejects.toThrow(/already.*cancel|cannot be cancelled/i)
  })

  it('blocks cross-entity cancel', async () => {
    session.user.legalEntityId = ENTITY_B
    const tx = {
      select: vi.fn(() => {
        queryQueue = [[pendingRow]]; callIndex = 0
        return makeProxy()
      }),
      insert: vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
      update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
    }
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))
    await expect(cancelLeaveRequest({ requestId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000010f1', reason: 'reason' })).rejects.toThrow(/do not have permission|You can only/i)
  })

  it('happy path: status transitions PENDING → CANCELLED + writes audit', async () => {
    const localQueues: unknown[][] = [
      [pendingRow],          // initial fetch
      [],                    // balance lookup → empty (no balance row yet)
    ]
    let localIdx = 0
    function makeLocalProxy(): unknown {
      return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
        get(_, prop: string) {
          if (prop === 'then') {
            return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown) =>
              Promise.resolve(localQueues[localIdx++] ?? []).then(resolve)
          }
          return () => makeLocalProxy()
        },
      })
    }
    const tx = {
      select: vi.fn(() => makeLocalProxy()),
      insert: vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
      update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
    }
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

    const r = await cancelLeaveRequest({ requestId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000010f1', reason: 'plans changed' })
    expect(r.status).toBe('CANCELLED')
    expect(setSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ status: 'CANCELLED' }))
    expect(auditSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      eventType: 'LEAVE_REQUEST.CANCELLED',
      resourceId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000010f1',
    }))

})

    absenceTypeId: 't1', startDate: '2026-05-01', endDate: '2026-05-05',
    durationDays: '5', status: 'PENDING', workflowInstanceId: 'wf-1',
  }

  it('returns PENDING + does NOT mutate the row when actOnWorkflowStep returns IN_PROGRESS', async () => {
    queryQueue = [[pendingWithWf]]
    // Override takeWorkflowAction (v2 engine) to return a non-terminal status.
    // decideLeaveRequest uses takeWorkflowAction, not actOnWorkflowStep.
    const { takeWorkflowAction } = await import('@/lib/workflow-engine')
    ;(takeWorkflowAction as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>).mockImplementationOnce(
      (params: unknown) => {
        takeWfActionSpy(params)
        return Promise.resolve({ success: true, instanceStatus: 'IN_PROGRESS' })
      },
    )

    // mockDb.transaction should NOT be invoked — the early-return short-circuits.
    const txSpy = vi.fn()
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(txSpy)

    const r = await decideLeaveRequest({
      requestId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000010f1',
      action:    'APPROVE',
      comment:   'Approved by line manager — awaiting HR_DIRECTOR',
    })

    expect(r.status).toBe('PENDING')
    expect(r.id).toBe('00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000010f1')
    expect(txSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()       // no row update
    expect(setSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()      // no SET issued
    expect(auditSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()    // no audit row
    // The workflow advance call DID fire (v2 engine parameters).
    expect(takeWfActionSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      stepInstanceId: 'step-wf-1',
      decision:       'APPROVE',
      decisionNote:   'Approved by line manager — awaiting HR_DIRECTOR',
    }))
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

/**
 * COV-01 — Integration tests for `updateComplianceRule`.
 *
 * Pinning the riskiest invariants:
 *   • RBAC gate — SUPER_ADMIN only; all other roles rejected (Hard Rule 8)
 *   • GOVERNANCE_LOCK — isOverridable=false rows are immutable via the UI
 *   • NOT_FOUND — nonexistent ruleId throws descriptive error
 *   • changeReason mandatory — min 10 chars enforced by Zod
 *   • Hard Rule 1 — audit row written inside the same tx as the update
 *   • Partial update — only supplied fields are patched
 */

// ── Shared queue + spies ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex = 0

const insertSpy = vi.fn()
const valuesSpy = vi.fn()
const updateSpy = vi.fn()
const setSpy    = vi.fn()
const auditSpy  = vi.fn()

function makeProxy(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxy()
    },
  })
}

function makeUpdateChain() {
  return {
    set: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      setSpy(payload)
      return { where: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) }
    }),
  }
}

function makeInsertChain() {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesSpy(payload)
      return { returning: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve([{ id: 'new-id' }])) }
    }),
  }
}

function buildTx() {
  return {
    select: vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
    update: vi.fn(() => { updateSpy('called'); return makeUpdateChain() }),
    insert: vi.fn(() => { insertSpy('called'); return makeInsertChain() }),
  }
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = {
  select:      vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
  update:      vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
  insert:      vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain()),
  transaction: vi.fn(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => fn(buildTx())),
}

const session = {
  user: {
    id:            '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
    name:          'Super Admin',
    role:          'SUPER_ADMIN',
    legalEntityId: '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
  },
}

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: mockDb }))
vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({
  writeAuditLog: vi.fn((event: unknown, tx?: unknown) => { auditSpy(event, tx); return Promise.resolve() }),
  diffFields: () => [],
}))
vi.mock('@/lib/auth', () => ({
  requireRole: vi.fn(async (roles: string[]) => {
    if (!roles.includes(session.user.role)) {
      throw new Error(`FORBIDDEN: requires one of [${roles.join(', ')}], got ${session.user.role}`)
    }
    return session.user
  }),
}))
vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  complianceRules: {
    id: {}, tenantId: {}, ruleId: {}, legalEntityId: {},
    descriptionEn: {}, descriptionAr: {}, formula: {}, isActive: {},
    isOverridable: {}, sunsetDate: {}, notes: {},
  },
}))
vi.mock('@/lib/constants', () => ({ TENANT_ID: 'tenant-1' }))
vi.mock('drizzle-orm', () => ({
  and:    (...a: unknown[]) => a,
  eq:     () => ({}),
}))

const { updateComplianceRule } = await import('@/modules/compliance/actions')

const RULE_ID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099'

const validInput = {
  ruleId:        RULE_ID,
  changeReason:  'Updated per law amendment 2026',
  descriptionEn: 'New description text',
  isActive:      true,
}

const overridableRow = {
  id:            RULE_ID,
  ruleId:        'BR-AL-001',
  legalEntityId: '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111',
  descriptionEn: 'Old description',
  formula:       {},
  isActive:      true,
  sunsetDate:    null,
  notes:         null,
  isOverridable: true,
}

beforeEach(() => {
  queryQueue = []
  callIndex  = 0
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  session.user.role = 'SUPER_ADMIN'
})

// ── RBAC gate ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('updateComplianceRule — RBAC (Hard Rule 8)', () => {
  it.each(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'MANAGER', 'EMPLOYEE', 'FINANCE'])(
    'rejects %s with FORBIDDEN',
    async (role) => {
      session.user.role = role
      await expect(updateComplianceRule(validInput)).rejects.toThrow(/do not have permission|You can only/i)
      expect(updateSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      expect(auditSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    },
  )

  it('allows SUPER_ADMIN', async () => {
    session.user.role = 'SUPER_ADMIN'
    queryQueue = [[overridableRow]]
    const result = await updateComplianceRule(validInput)
    expect(result.id).toBe(RULE_ID)
  })
})

// ── Validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('updateComplianceRule — Zod validation', () => {
  it('rejects changeReason shorter than 10 characters', async () => {
    await expect(updateComplianceRule({ ...validInput, changeReason: 'too short' }))
      .rejects.toThrow()
    expect(updateSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('rejects ruleId that is not a UUID', async () => {
    await expect(updateComplianceRule({ ...validInput, ruleId: 'not-a-uuid' }))
      .rejects.toThrow()
  })
})

// ── NOT_FOUND ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

 * S4-Q4 — Integration tests for `updateFormConfiguration` (Sprint 4 backend).
 *
 * Covers:
 *   • role gate (HR_DIRECTOR / SUPER_ADMIN only)
 *   • Zod parse — sectionCode regex, bilingual labels, ≥1 / ≤20 sections
 *   • duplicate sectionCode rejection
 *   • upsert branches (create vs. update)
 *   • audit row inside the same tx (Hard Rule 1)
 *   • invalidateConfigCache called on commit (TD-13/14)
 */

// ── Shared queue + spies ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex   = 0

const insertSpy    = vi.fn()
const valuesSpy    = vi.fn()
const updateSpy    = vi.fn()
const setSpy       = vi.fn()
const auditSpy     = vi.fn()
const invalidateSpy = vi.fn()

function makeProxy(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxy()
    },
  })
}

function makeInsertChain(returnRows: unknown[]) {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesSpy(payload)
      return {
        returning: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(returnRows)),
      }
    }),
  }
}

function makeUpdateChain() {
  return {
    set: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      setSpy(payload)
      return {
        where: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
      }
    }),
  }
}

function buildTxMock(insertReturn: unknown[]) {
  return {
    select: vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
    insert: vi.fn(() => { insertSpy('called'); return makeInsertChain(insertReturn) }),
    update: vi.fn(() => { updateSpy('called'); return makeUpdateChain() }),
  }
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = {
  select: vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
  insert: vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
  update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
  transaction: vi.fn(),
}

const session = {
  user: {
    id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c3',
    name: 'HR Director',
    role: 'HR_DIRECTOR',

}

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: mockDb }))
vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({
  writeAuditLog: vi.fn((event: unknown, _tx?: unknown) => {
    auditSpy(event, _tx)
    return Promise.resolve()
  }),
  diffFields: () => [],
}))
vi.mock('@/lib/auth', () => ({
  requireRole: vi.fn((roles: string[]) => {
    if (!roles.includes(session.user.role)) {

    return Promise.resolve(session.user)

}))

}))
vi.mock('drizzle-orm', () => ({
  eq:     () => ({}),
  and:    (...a: unknown[]) => a,
}))

describe('updateFormConfiguration — upsert branches', () => {
  it('INSERT branch: creates new row when none exists', async () => {
    queryQueue = [[]] // existing lookup → empty
    const tx = buildTxMock([{ id: 'config-id-new' }])
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

  it('UPDATE branch: re-uses existing row', async () => {

describe('updateFormConfiguration — Hard Rule 1 (audit + tx)', () => {

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

/**
 * COV-02 — Integration tests for `terminateContract` and `amendContract`.
 *
 * Fills the 57.8% coverage gap by pinning the riskiest edge cases:
 *
 * terminateContract:
 *   • EXPAT path (BR-VISA-001) — creates OFFBOARDING checklist + VISA_CANCELLATION item
 *   • non-EXPAT path — no checklist created
 *   • already-terminated guard
 *   • cross-entity FORBIDDEN
 *   • NOT_FOUND
 *   • CONTRACT.TERMINATED audit inside tx
 *
 * amendContract:
 *   • BR-CT-002 — amended term may not exceed 3 years from original startDate
 *   • only ACTIVE contracts may be amended
 *   • cross-entity FORBIDDEN
 *   • happy path: closes current (RENEWED) + opens new + CONTRACT.AMENDED audit
 */

// ── Shared queue + spies ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex = 0

const insertSpy      = vi.fn()
const valuesSpy      = vi.fn()
const updateSpy      = vi.fn()
const setSpy         = vi.fn()
const auditSpy       = vi.fn()
const txCount        = { value: 0 }

function makeProxy(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxy()
    },
  })
}

// Some inserts use .returning(); others don't.
function makeInsertChain(returnRows: unknown[] = []) {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesSpy(payload)
      return { returning: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(returnRows)) }
    }),
  }
}

function makeUpdateChain() {
  return {
    set: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      setSpy(payload)
      return { where: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) }
    }),
  }
}

let insertReturnOverride: unknown[] | null = null

function buildTx() {
  return {
    select: vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
    update: vi.fn(() => { updateSpy('called'); return makeUpdateChain() }),
    insert: vi.fn(() => {
      insertSpy('called')
      const ret = insertReturnOverride ?? [{ id: 'new-contract-id' }]
      insertReturnOverride = null
      return makeInsertChain(ret)
    }),
  }
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = {
  select:      vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
  update:      vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
  insert:      vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain()),
  transaction: vi.fn(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => {
    txCount.value++
    return fn(buildTx())
  }),
}

const session = {

    await terminateContract(terminateInput)

    expect(checklistPayload.checklistType).toBe('OFFBOARDING')
    expect(checklistPayload.targetDate).toBe(terminateInput.terminationDate)

    // .values() receives an array of items — find VISA_CANCELLATION in the batch
    const itemsPayload = valuesSpy.mock.calls[1][0] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>
    const visaItem = itemsPayload.find(i => i.itemCode === 'VISA_CANCELLATION')
    expect(visaItem).toBeDefined()
    expect(visaItem?.isMandatory).toBe(true)
    expect(visaItem?.assignedToRole).toBe('HR_ADMIN')

const amendInput = {
  contractId:    CONTRACT_ID,
  effectiveDate: '2026-06-01',
  reason:        'Promotion to Senior Engineer',
  newEndDate:    '2026-06-01', // within 3 years from startDate 2024-01-01
}

describe('amendContract — NOT_FOUND', () => {
  it('throws when the contract does not exist', async () => {
    queryQueue = [[]]
    await expect(amendContract(amendInput)).rejects.toThrow(/contract record could not be found/i)
    expect(updateSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })
})

describe('amendContract — guard rails', () => {
  it('rejects amendment of a non-ACTIVE contract', async () => {
    queryQueue = [[{ ...activeContract, status: 'TERMINATED' }]]
    await expect(amendContract(amendInput)).rejects.toThrow(/Only active contracts can be amended/i)
    expect(updateSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('rejects cross-entity amendment for non-SUPER_ADMIN', async () => {
    session.user.legalEntityId = 'different-entity'
    queryQueue = [[activeContract]]
    await expect(amendContract(amendInput)).rejects.toThrow(/do not have permission|You can only/i)
    expect(updateSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('BR-CT-002: rejects amended term that exceeds 3 years from original startDate', async () => {
    // Original startDate is 2024-01-01. Amended endDate of 2027-06-01 > 2027-01-01 = 3yr limit.
    queryQueue = [[{ ...activeContract, startDate: '2024-01-01' }]]
    await expect(amendContract({ ...amendInput, newEndDate: '2027-06-01' }))
      .rejects.toThrow(/exceed.*three years|amended contract end date/i)
    expect(updateSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('BR-CT-002: allows amended term exactly at the 3-year boundary', async () => {
    // startDate 2024-01-01, newEndDate 2026-12-31 — within the 3yr cap.
    queryQueue = [
      [activeContract],                    // current contract SELECT
      [{ n: 1 }],                          // nextContractNumber COUNT
    ]
    const result = await amendContract({ ...amendInput, newEndDate: '2026-12-31' })
    expect(result.closedId).toBe(CONTRACT_ID)
  })
})

describe('amendContract — happy path', () => {
  it('closes current (RENEWED) + opens new contract + writes CONTRACT.AMENDED audit inside tx', async () => {
    queryQueue = [
      [activeContract],   // current contract SELECT
      [{ n: 2 }],         // nextContractNumber COUNT
    ]
    const result = await amendContract(amendInput)

    // closed contract update
    expect(updateSpy).toHaveBeenCalled()
    const closePatch = setSpy.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>
    expect(closePatch.status).toBe('RENEWED')
    expect(closePatch.terminationReason).toContain('Amended')

    // new contract insert
    expect(insertSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    const newRow = valuesSpy.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>
    expect(newRow.status).toBe('ACTIVE')
    expect(newRow.renewalCount).toBe(1)
    expect(newRow.previousContractId).toBe(CONTRACT_ID)
    expect(newRow.probationEnd).toBeNull()  // BR-PR-003: no new probation on renewal

    expect(result.closedId).toBe(CONTRACT_ID)

    // Hard Rule 1: audit inside tx
    expect(auditSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    const [event, tx] = auditSpy.mock.calls[0]
    expect((event as { eventType: string }).eventType).toBe('CONTRACT.AMENDED')
    expect((event as { resourceType: string }).resourceType).toBe('contracts')
    expect(tx).toBeDefined()
  })
})
