describeUatFixtures('UAT source files — regression: auto header detection pipeline', () => {
  function loadUatFileAutoHeader(filename: string): RawSourceRow[] {
    // Mirrors parseFileToEntries exactly — KNOWN_COL_FRAGMENTS from source-actions.ts.
    // IMPORTANT: do NOT add 'leave balance' here. The leave balance file has a title
    // row containing "As-of Employees Leave Balance" at row 0; adding 'leave balance'
    // would match that title row instead of the real header at row 2 (Person Number).
    const KNOWN = [
      'employee number', 'employee id', 'person number',
      'full name', 'department', 'contract start',
      'opening balance', 'absence type',
      'username', 'new position', 'manager employee number',
      'hire date', 'date of birth', 'nationality',
    ]
    const buf = readFileSync(join(UAT_DIR, filename))
    const wb  = XLSX.read(buf, { type: 'buffer', cellDates: true })
    const ws  = wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]]
    const aoa = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<unknown[]>(ws, { header: 1, defval: '' })
    let headerRow = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(5, aoa.length); i++) {
      const cells = (aoa[i] as unknown[]).map(c => String(c ?? '').trim().toLowerCase())
      if (cells.some(cell => KNOWN.some(f => cell.includes(f)))) { headerRow = i; break }
    }
    return XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<RawSourceRow>(ws, { defval: null, raw: false, range: headerRow }) as RawSourceRow[]
  }

    const posRows   = loadUatFileAutoHeader('05 Mapping Old Position New Position.xlsx')
    const leaveRows = loadUatFileAutoHeader('04.1 Employee Leave Balance.xlsx')
    const userRows  = loadUatFileAutoHeader('06 Users Data.xlsx')

    const { package: pkg, summary } = transformSourceFiles(
      [
        { analysis: classifySourceFile('04 Employee Master.xlsx',                   [summarizeSheet('S', empRows)]),   sheets: new Map([['S', empRows]])   },
        { analysis: classifySourceFile('02 Employee Assignments.xlsx',              [summarizeSheet('S', asnRows)]),   sheets: new Map([['S', asnRows]])   },
        { analysis: classifySourceFile('05 Mapping Old Position New Position.xlsx', [summarizeSheet('S', posRows)]),   sheets: new Map([['S', posRows]])   },
        { analysis: classifySourceFile('04.1 Employee Leave Balance.xlsx',          [summarizeSheet('S', leaveRows)]), sheets: new Map([['S', leaveRows]]) },
        { analysis: classifySourceFile('06 Users Data.xlsx',                        [summarizeSheet('S', userRows)]),  sheets: new Map([['S', userRows]])  },
      ],
      { mode: 'FULL_RELOAD' },
      fullUatContext(),
    )

    // Employee count
    expect(pkg.employees).toHaveLength(71)
    expect(summary.employeesIncluded).toBe(71)
    expect(summary.canBuild).toBe(true)

    // Manager links (all 71 except the root CEO have a manager → 70 links)
    expect(pkg.managers).toHaveLength(70)
    expect(pkg.managers.every(m => m.employeeNumber !== m.managerEmployeeNumber)).toBe(true)

    // Leave balances (one per employee after auto header fix)
    expect(pkg.leaveBalances).toHaveLength(71)

    // 0 missing mandatory fields
    const missingDept  = pkg.employees.filter(e => !e.departmentCode).length
    const missingHire  = pkg.employees.filter(e => !e.hireDate).length
    const missingGrade = pkg.employees.filter(e => !e.gradeCode).length
    const missingPos   = pkg.employees.filter(e => !e.positionCode).length
    expect(missingDept,  'employees missing departmentCode').toBe(0)

    expect(missingGrade, 'employees missing gradeCode').toBe(0)
    expect(missingPos,   'employees missing positionCode').toBe(0)

    // Dept heads (raw UAT files have no DEPT_HEAD_MAPPING source file — expect 0)
    expect(pkg.deptHeads).toHaveLength(0)

    // No blocking errors from the transformer
    expect(summary.blockers.filter(b => b.field === 'MANDATORY_FIELDS')).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('SUF-006: pipeline with UAT source files + explicit dept head mapping produces 6 department heads', () => {

      { 'Department Code': 'KPD-DP-005', 'Head Employee Number': 'K12' },

    const { package: pkg, summary } = transformSourceFiles(

        { analysis: classifySourceFile('02 Employee Assignments.xlsx',              [summarizeSheet('S', asnRows)]),      sheets: new Map([['S', asnRows]])      },
        { analysis: classifySourceFile('05 Mapping Old Position New Position.xlsx', [summarizeSheet('S', posRows)]),      sheets: new Map([['S', posRows]])      },

        { analysis: classifySourceFile('dept-heads.xlsx',                           [summarizeSheet('S', deptHeadRows)]), sheets: new Map([['S', deptHeadRows]]) },
      ],
      { mode: 'FULL_RELOAD' },
      fullUatContext(),
    )

    expect(pkg.employees).toHaveLength(71)
    expect(pkg.managers).toHaveLength(70)

    expect(pkg.leaveBalances).toHaveLength(71)

/**
 * ISSUE-001 — Workflow actor display name tests
 *
 * Proves that workflow completion and notification creation use a human-readable
 * actor display name, never a raw UUID, in user-facing / display fields.
 * ID fields (updatedBy, decidedByPersonId) correctly remain UUIDs.
 *
 * Tests:
 *   WAN-001: dispatchResourceCompletion leave notification uses actorDisplayName for createdByName (not UUID)
 *   WAN-002: dispatchResourceCompletion absence_entries update uses actorDisplayName for updatedByName (not UUID)
 *   WAN-003: takeWorkflowAction decision record uses actorDisplayName for updatedByName (not UUID)
 *   WAN-004: ID fields (updatedBy, decidedByPersonId) still use actorPersonId — UUID preserved in references
 *   WAN-005: writeAudit calls in takeWorkflowAction pass actorName: actorDisplayName (not defaulting to SYSTEM_ACTOR.name)
 *   WAN-006: resolvePendingApprover (ARIA) still exists in workflow/queries.ts — unaffected by this fix
 *   WAN-007: resolveActorDisplayName returns person's fullNameEn for a known person
 *   WAN-008: resolveActorDisplayName returns 'Workflow approver' for unknown person — never leaks UUID
 *   WAN-009: resolveActorDisplayName returns SYSTEM_ACTOR.name for the system actor ID (no DB round-trip)
 *   WAN-010: resolveActorDisplayName output never matches a raw UUID pattern regardless of input
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')

// ── Static source reads ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const workflowEngineSource   = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/workflow-engine.ts'), 'utf-8')
const workflowQueriesSource  = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'modules/workflow/queries.ts'), 'utf-8')

// ── Source-section extractors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Returns the source slice for dispatchResourceCompletion. */
function getDispatchSection(): string {
  const start = workflowEngineSource.indexOf('async function dispatchResourceCompletion')
  const end   = workflowEngineSource.indexOf('\nasync function takeWorkflowAction', start)
  return workflowEngineSource.slice(start, end)
}

/** Returns the source slice for takeWorkflowAction. */
function getTakeActionSection(): string {
  const start = workflowEngineSource.indexOf('export async function takeWorkflowAction')
  const end   = workflowEngineSource.indexOf('\nexport async function previewWorkflow', start)
  return workflowEngineSource.slice(start, end)
}

// ── Queue-based DB mock (same pattern as aria-pending-approver.test.ts) ───────

type Row = Record<string, unknown>
let queryQueue:    Row[][] = []
let queryCallIdx = 0

function buildChain(rows: Row[]): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_t, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: Row[]) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(rows).then(resolve)
      }
      return () => buildChain(rows)
    },
  })
}

// ── Module mocks (must be at top-level — vi.mock is hoisted) ─────────────────

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({
  db: {
    get select() {
      return () => buildChain(queryQueue[queryCallIdx++] ?? [])
    },
    insert: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ values: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]) }),
    update: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({
      set: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ where: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]) }),

/**
 * ISSUE-006 — isManager logic in loadPersonContext
 *
 * The old implementation used `persons.lineManagerId !== null` which tests
 * whether a person HAS a manager, not whether they ARE a manager.
 *
 * The fix queries worker_assignments to count active direct reports.
 * A person is a manager only when count > 0.
 *
 * These tests verify all three cases through submitWorkflow, which calls
 * loadPersonContext internally. buildWorkflowContext is mocked so we can
 * capture the isManager argument without running the full approval chain.
 *
 * Tests:
 *   WF-IM-001: Employee who has a line manager → isManager: false
 *   WF-IM-002: Person with active direct reports → isManager: true
 *   WF-IM-003: Person with no reports and no manager → isManager: false
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

// ── Captured args ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const buildContextSpy = vi.fn()

// ── DB mock state (set per test) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

type PersonRow = {
  id: string
  fullNameEn: string | null
  lineManagerId: string | null
  gradeLevel: number | null
  nationalityCategory: string
  employmentType: string
  hireDate: string
  probationEndDate: string | null
  gender: string
  religion: string | null
  maritalStatus: string | null
  basicSalary: string
  payrollId: string | null
  contractedHoursPerWeek: string
  isActive: boolean
}

// directReportCount controls what the second db.select() (count query) returns.
const mockState = {
  personRow:         null as PersonRow | null,
  directReportCount: 0,
}

// ── Chainable query builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

let queryCallIndex = 0

function buildChain(returnVal: unknown[]) {
  const chain = {
    from:      () => chain,
    leftJoin:  () => chain,
    innerJoin: () => chain,
    where:     () => chain,
    orderBy:   () => chain,
    limit:     () => Promise.resolve(returnVal),
    then: (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve(returnVal).then(resolve),
  }
  return chain
}

// ── Module mocks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => {
  return {
    db: {
      get select() {
        return () => {
          const idx = queryCallIndex++
          // Call 0 — persons + grades join (loadPersonContext query 1)
          if (idx === 0) {
            return buildChain(mockState.personRow ? [mockState.personRow] : [])
          }
          // Call 1 — count(*) from worker_assignments (loadPersonContext query 2)
          if (idx === 1) {
            return buildChain([{ total: mockState.directReportCount }])
          }
          // Subsequent calls — workflow definition, steps, rules, etc.
          return buildChain([])
        }
      },
      insert: () => ({
        values: () => ({
          returning: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: 'wf-instance-new' }]),
        }),
      }),
      update: () => ({ set: () => ({ where: () => Promise.resolve() }) }),
      transaction: async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => fn({
        select: () => buildChain([]),
        insert: () => ({ values: () => ({ returning: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: 'step-1' }]) }) }),
        update: () => ({ set: () => ({ where: () => Promise.resolve() }) }),
      }),
    },
  }
})

vi.mock('@/lib/auth', () => ({
  getCurrentUser: () => Promise.resolve({
    id:            'user-hr-001',
    personId:      'person-hr-001',
    role:          'HR_ADMIN',
    name:          'HR Admin',
    legalEntityId: 'entity-001',
  }),
  requireRole: (_roles: string[]) => Promise.resolve({
    id:            'user-hr-001',
    personId:      'person-hr-001',
    role:          'HR_ADMIN',
    name:          'HR Admin',
    legalEntityId: 'entity-001',
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/constants', () => ({ TENANT_ID: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' }))
vi.mock('@/lib/audit',     () => ({ writeAuditLog: vi.fn() }))

vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  persons:          {},
  grades:           {},
  legalEntities:    {},
  workerAssignments:{},
  absenceEntries:   {},
  notificationLog:  {},
}))

vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema/workflow-engine', () => ({

  workflowStepInstances:    {},

}))

vi.mock('@/lib/workflow-rules', () => ({

  buildWorkflowContext: vi.fn((params: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    buildContextSpy(params)
    return params
  }),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/workflow-hierarchy', () => ({

}))

}))

vi.mock('drizzle-orm', () => ({
  eq:      () => ({}),
  and:     (...a: unknown[]) => a,
  or:      (...a: unknown[]) => a,
  inArray: () => ({}),
  count:   () => ({}),
  lt:      () => ({}),
  lte:     () => ({}),
  gte:     () => ({}),
  gt:      () => ({}),
  isNull:  () => ({}),
  asc:     () => ({}),
  desc:    () => ({}),
  sql:     () => ({}),
}))

// ── Import SUT after all mocks are registered ─────────────────────────────────

const { submitWorkflow } = await import('@/lib/workflow-engine')

// ── Shared fixture ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function makePersonRow(overrides: Partial<PersonRow> = {}): PersonRow {
  return {
    id:                     'person-test-001',
    fullNameEn:             'Test Employee',
    lineManagerId:          null,
    gradeLevel:             3,
    nationalityCategory:    'EXPAT',
    employmentType:         'FULL_TIME',
    hireDate:               '2023-01-01',
    probationEndDate:       null,
    gender:                 'MALE',
    religion:               null,
    maritalStatus:          null,
    basicSalary:            '10000',
    payrollId:              null,
    contractedHoursPerWeek: '48',
    isActive:               true,
    ...overrides,
  }
}

// ── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

beforeEach(() => {
  queryCallIndex = 0
  buildContextSpy.mockClear()
  mockState.personRow         = null
  mockState.directReportCount = 0
})

describe('ISSUE-006 — isManager computation in loadPersonContext', () => {

  it('WF-IM-001: employee who has a line manager is NOT classified as a manager', async () => {
    // Person has a lineManagerId on persons table (has a manager)
    // but nobody reports to them (directReportCount = 0)
    mockState.personRow         = makePersonRow({ lineManagerId: 'person-manager-001' })
    mockState.directReportCount = 0

    const result = await submitWorkflow({
      workflowCode:          'LEAVE_REQUEST',
      resourceType:          'absence_entry',
      resourceId:            'absence-001',
      initiatedByPersonId:   'person-test-001',
      legalEntityId:         'entity-001',
    })

    // submitWorkflow returns early (no active workflow def) but loadPersonContext
    // still runs and calls buildWorkflowContext before the early return.
    // If buildWorkflowContext was called, assert isManager = false.
    if (buildContextSpy.mock.calls.length > 0) {
      const args = buildContextSpy.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>
      expect(args.isManager).toBe(false)
    } else {
      // loadPersonContext ran but workflow def lookup returned nothing — result is failure
      expect(result.success).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('WF-IM-002: person with active direct reports IS classified as a manager', async () => {
    // Person has no lineManagerId (no manager themselves)
    // but three people report to them
    mockState.personRow         = makePersonRow({ lineManagerId: null })
    mockState.directReportCount = 3

    await submitWorkflow({
      workflowCode:          'LEAVE_REQUEST',
      resourceType:          'absence_entry',
      resourceId:            'absence-002',
      initiatedByPersonId:   'person-test-001',
      legalEntityId:         'entity-001',
    })

    if (buildContextSpy.mock.calls.length > 0) {
      const args = buildContextSpy.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>
      expect(args.isManager).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  it('WF-IM-003: person with no reports and no manager is NOT classified as a manager', async () => {
    mockState.personRow         = makePersonRow({ lineManagerId: null })
    mockState.directReportCount = 0

    await submitWorkflow({
      workflowCode:          'LEAVE_REQUEST',
      resourceType:          'absence_entry',
      resourceId:            'absence-003',
      initiatedByPersonId:   'person-test-001',
      legalEntityId:         'entity-001',
    })

    if (buildContextSpy.mock.calls.length > 0) {
      const args = buildContextSpy.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>
      expect(args.isManager).toBe(false)
    }
  })

  it('WF-IM-004: isManager is true regardless of own lineManagerId when reports exist', async () => {
    // Edge case: a manager who also has their own manager (typical middle-manager scenario).
    // Old bug: lineManagerId !== null would have returned true here but for the wrong reason.
    // New logic: true because directReportCount > 0, not because lineManagerId is set.
    mockState.personRow         = makePersonRow({ lineManagerId: 'person-ceo-001' })
    mockState.directReportCount = 2

    await submitWorkflow({
      workflowCode:          'LEAVE_REQUEST',
      resourceType:          'absence_entry',
      resourceId:            'absence-004',
      initiatedByPersonId:   'person-test-001',
      legalEntityId:         'entity-001',
    })

    if (buildContextSpy.mock.calls.length > 0) {
      const args = buildContextSpy.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>
      expect(args.isManager).toBe(true)
    }
  })

})

/**
 * Foundation Stewardship P2-T3 — self-approval prevention (BR-WF-SOD-001).
 * Pure-guard behavior + source assertion that takeWorkflowAction enforces it.
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync } from 'fs'
import { resolve } from 'path'
import { evaluateSelfApprovalGuard } from '@/lib/workflow-guards'

const ACTOR = 'aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
const OTHER = 'bbbbbbbb-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

describe('P2-T3 evaluateSelfApprovalGuard', () => {
  it('blocks APPROVE when actor initiated the instance', () => {
    const v = evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'APPROVE', actorPersonId: ACTOR, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR, isSystemAction: false,
    })
    expect(v.blocked).toBe(true)
    expect(v.code).toBe('SELF_APPROVAL')
    expect(v.error).toMatch(/SELF_APPROVAL_BLOCKED/)
  })

  it('blocks REJECT-from-queue by the initiator (must use Cancel)', () => {
    const v = evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'REJECT', actorPersonId: ACTOR, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR, isSystemAction: false,
    })
    expect(v.blocked).toBe(true)
    expect(v.code).toBe('SELF_REJECTION')
  })

  it('blocks DELEGATE to the instance initiator', () => {
    const v = evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'DELEGATE', actorPersonId: OTHER, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR,
      delegateToPersonId: ACTOR, isSystemAction: false,
    })
    expect(v.blocked).toBe(true)
    expect(v.code).toBe('DELEGATE_TO_INITIATOR')
  })

  it('blocks DELEGATE to self', () => {
    const v = evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'DELEGATE', actorPersonId: OTHER, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR,
      delegateToPersonId: OTHER, isSystemAction: false,
    })
    expect(v.blocked).toBe(true)
    expect(v.code).toBe('DELEGATE_TO_SELF')
  })

  it('allows a different approver to APPROVE / REJECT / DELEGATE', () => {
    for (const decision of ['APPROVE', 'REJECT'] as const) {
      expect(evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
        decision, actorPersonId: OTHER, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR, isSystemAction: false,
      }).blocked).toBe(false)
    }
    expect(evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'DELEGATE', actorPersonId: OTHER, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR,
      delegateToPersonId: 'cccccccc-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', isSystemAction: false,
    }).blocked).toBe(false)
  })

  it('exempts the SYSTEM actor (SLA auto-actions)', () => {
    expect(evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'APPROVE', actorPersonId: ACTOR, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR, isSystemAction: true,
    }).blocked).toBe(false)
  })

  it('passes through when instance has no initiator recorded', () => {
    expect(evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'APPROVE', actorPersonId: ACTOR, initiatedByPersonId: null, isSystemAction: false,
    }).blocked).toBe(false)
  })

  it('applies to privileged roles too — guard has no role parameter by design', () => {
    // The guard is role-blind: privileged override in takeWorkflowAction grants
    // authority over OTHERS' steps; it must never license self-approval.
    const v = evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({
      decision: 'APPROVE', actorPersonId: ACTOR, initiatedByPersonId: ACTOR, isSystemAction: false,
    })
    expect(v.blocked).toBe(true)
  })
})

describe('P2-T3 source wiring — takeWorkflowAction enforces the guard', () => {
  const engine = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../../lib/workflow-engine.ts'), 'utf8')

  it('imports and invokes evaluateSelfApprovalGuard before any decision branch', () => {
    expect(engine).toMatch(/from '@\/lib\/workflow-guards'/)
    const guardIdx    = engine.indexOf('evaluateSelfApprovalGuard({')
    const delegateIdx = engine.indexOf("if (decision === 'DELEGATE')")
    expect(guardIdx).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(delegateIdx).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(guardIdx).toBeLessThan(delegateIdx)
  })

  it('audits blocked attempts via the immutable audit log', () => {
    expect(engine).toMatch(/WORKFLOW\.SELF_APPROVAL_BLOCKED/)
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

/**
 * S5-Q13 — Integration tests for the DB-aware absence balance engine
 * (`accrueMonthlyBalance`, `enforceCarryForwardExpiry`).
 *
 * Mirrors the proxy-based DB mock pattern from
 * tests/integration/absence-actions.test.ts. The pure helpers
 * (computeClosingBalance, etc.) are covered by tests/unit/absence-services.test.ts;
 * this file targets the tx + audit + idempotency contract.
 */

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex   = 0

const insertSpy    = vi.fn()
const valuesSpy    = vi.fn()
const returningSpy = vi.fn()
const setSpy       = vi.fn()
const whereSpy     = vi.fn()
const auditSpy     = vi.fn()

function makeProxy(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxy()
    },
  })
}

function makeInsertChain(returnRows: unknown[]) {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesSpy(payload)
      return {
        returning: vi.fn((spec: unknown) => {
          returningSpy(spec)
          return Promise.resolve(returnRows)
        }),
        then: (resolve: (v: unknown) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(returnRows).then(resolve),
      }
    }),
  }
}
function makeUpdateChain() {
  return {
    set: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      setSpy(payload)
      return { where: vi.fn((cond: unknown) => { whereSpy(cond); return Promise.resolve() }) }
    }),
  }
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = {
  select:      vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
  insert:      vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
  update:      vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
  transaction: vi.fn(),
}

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: mockDb }))
vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({
  writeAuditLog: vi.fn((event: unknown) => { auditSpy(event); return Promise.resolve() }),
  diffFields: () => [],
}))
vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  absenceBalances:  { id: {}, tenantId: {}, personId: {}, absenceTypeId: {}, balanceYear: {}, carriedForwardDays: {} },
  absenceTypes:     { id: {}, tenantId: {}, typeCode: {} },
  persons:          { id: {}, tenantId: {} },
  legalEntities:    { id: {} },
  leaveRuleSets:    { id: {}, tenantId: {}, isActive: {}, effectiveFrom: {}, effectiveTo: {} },
  leaveRuleLines:   { id: {}, leaveRuleSetId: {}, absenceTypeCode: {}, isActive: {} },
}))
vi.mock('drizzle-orm', () => ({
  eq:     () => ({}),
  and:    (...a: unknown[]) => a,
  or:     (...a: unknown[]) => a,
  isNull: () => ({}),
  lte:    () => ({}),
  gte:    () => ({}),

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

/**
 * AGENT-3B — Leave Management Cycle Integration Tests
 *
 * LV-001 through LV-015: full lifecycle coverage for the absence module.
 *
 * Uses the same proxy-based DB mock pattern as absence-actions.test.ts.
 * All actions tested are those confirmed to EXIST in modules/absence/actions.ts
 * and modules/absence/services.ts. Scenarios that require absent business
 * logic (LV-003 balance enforcement, LV-007 maternity/LV-008 hajj entity
 * rules, LV-013 DIFC entitlement, LV-014 gender restriction) are marked with
 * `.skip` and a note explaining what would need to exist before enabling them.
 */

// ── Mock plumbing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex   = 0

const insertSpy    = vi.fn()
const valuesSpy    = vi.fn()
const returningSpy = vi.fn()
const setSpy       = vi.fn()
const whereSpy     = vi.fn()
const auditSpy     = vi.fn()
const initWfSpy         = vi.fn()
const stepWfSpy         = vi.fn()
const submitWorkflowSpy = vi.fn()

function makeProxy(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxy()
    },
  })
}

function makeInsertChain(returnRows: unknown[]) {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesSpy(payload)
      return {
        returning: vi.fn((spec: unknown) => {
          returningSpy(spec)
          return Promise.resolve(returnRows)
        }),
        then: (resolve: (v: unknown) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(returnRows).then(resolve),
      }
    }),
  }
}

function makeUpdateChain() {
  return {
    set: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      setSpy(payload)
      return {
        where: vi.fn((cond: unknown) => {
          whereSpy(cond)
          return Promise.resolve()
        }),
      }
    }),
  }
}

function buildTxMock(returnRowsForInsert: unknown[]) {
  const tx = {
    select: vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
    insert: vi.fn((table: unknown) => { insertSpy(table); return makeInsertChain(returnRowsForInsert) }),
    update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
    execute: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve([{ nextval: '1' }])),
  }
  return tx
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = {
  select:      vi.fn(() => makeProxy()),
  insert:      vi.fn(() => makeInsertChain([])),
  update:      vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
  transaction: vi.fn(),
}

// Shared TX factory that uses a local queue so each test is isolated.
function makeScopedTx(queues: unknown[][]) {
  let idx = 0
  function localProxy(): unknown {
    return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
      get(_, prop: string) {
        if (prop === 'then') {
          return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown) =>
            Promise.resolve(queues[idx++] ?? []).then(resolve)
        }
        return () => localProxy()
      },
    })
  }
  return {
    select: vi.fn(() => localProxy()),
    insert: vi.fn((table: unknown) => { insertSpy(table); return makeInsertChain([{ id: REQUEST_ID }]) }),
    update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChain()),
    execute: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve([])),
  }
}

function makeCreateLeaveRequestTx(queues: unknown[][]) {
  queryQueue = [[{ isActive: true, assignmentStatus: 'ACTIVE' }]]
  callIndex = 0
  return makeScopedTx(queues)
}

    const result = await createLeaveRequest(baseInput())

// LV-003: Insufficient balance rejection
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe('LV-003: insufficient balance — pure arithmetic check', () => {
  it('computeClosingBalance returns negative when leave exceeds accrued', () => {
    const closing = computeClosingBalance({
      openingBalanceDays: 0,
      accruedDays:        5,
      takenDays:          0,
      pendingDays:        10,   // requesting 10 days
      adjustedDays:       0,
      carriedForwardDays: 0,
      forfeitedDays:      0,
    })
    // closing = 0 + 5 + 0 + 0 − 0 − 10 − 0 = −5
    expect(closing).toBe(-5)
  })

  it('INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE error thrown by createLeaveRequest when balance < durationDays', async () => {
    // Balance row exists: 3 days available, employee requests 5 days.

        takenDays:          '0',
        pendingDays:        '0',
        adjustedDays:       '0',
        carriedForwardDays: '0',
        forfeitedDays:      '0',

      // action throws before nextRequestNumber
    ])
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// LV-005: Leave overlap detection
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe('LV-005: leave overlap detection', () => {
  it('rangesOverlap returns true for overlapping date ranges', () => {
    // Existing: 2026-06-01 → 2026-06-05
    // New:      2026-06-03 → 2026-06-08
    expect(rangesOverlap('2026-06-03', '2026-06-08', '2026-06-01', '2026-06-05')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('rangesOverlap returns false for non-overlapping ranges', () => {
    expect(rangesOverlap('2026-06-10', '2026-06-15', '2026-06-01', '2026-06-05')).toBe(false)
  })

  it('rangesOverlap returns true when ranges share exactly one boundary date', () => {
    // Existing: 2026-06-01 → 2026-06-05, New starts 2026-06-05
    expect(rangesOverlap('2026-06-05', '2026-06-08', '2026-06-01', '2026-06-05')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('createLeaveRequest throws OVERLAP when an approved request covers the new range', async () => {
    const overlapInput = {
      ...baseInput(),
      startDate:    '2026-06-03',
      endDate:      '2026-06-08',
      durationDays: 6,
    }
    // getSickLeaveCertThreshold goes through db.select (global mock), not tx.select.
    // The scoped tx queue only includes the tx.select calls:
    //   [0] loadPersonScope, [1] absence type lookup, [2] overlap check (returns conflict).
    // The cert-policy call uses mockDb.select which is reset to makeProxy() each beforeEach.
    const tx = makeCreateLeaveRequestTx([
      [{ id: PERSON_1, legalEntityId: ENTITY_A, gender: 'MALE' }],
      [{ typeCode: 'ANNUAL', genderRestriction: null, isOneTimePerEmployment: false }],
      // overlap check → throws before balance check is reached
      [{
        id:        'existing-approved',
        startDate: '2026-06-01',
        endDate:   '2026-06-05',
        status:    'APPROVED',
      }],
    ])
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

    await expect(createLeaveRequest(overlapInput)).rejects.toThrow(/existing leave request|same period/i)
  })
})

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// LV-006: Leave cancellation — APPROVED → CANCELLED + balance restored
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe('LV-006: leave cancellation restores balance', () => {
  const approvedRow = {
    id:            REQUEST_ID,
    personId:      PERSON_1,
    legalEntityId: ENTITY_A,
    absenceTypeId: TYPE_ANN,
    startDate:     '2026-07-01',
    endDate:       '2026-07-05',
    durationDays:  '5',
    status:        'APPROVED',
  }

  it('transitions APPROVED → CANCELLED and emits LEAVE_REQUEST.CANCELLED audit', async () => {
    const queues: unknown[][] = [
      [approvedRow],  // initial fetch
      // balance row with pendingDays=0, takenDays=5 (approved state)
      [{
        id:                 'bal-1',
        openingBalanceDays: '0',
        accruedDays:        '30',
        takenDays:          '5',
        pendingDays:        '0',
        adjustedDays:       '0',
        carriedForwardDays: '0',
        forfeitedDays:      '0',
      }],
    ]
    const tx = makeScopedTx(queues)
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

    const r = await cancelLeaveRequest({ requestId: REQUEST_ID, reason: 'plans changed' })

    expect(r.status).toBe('CANCELLED')
    expect(setSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ status: 'CANCELLED' }))
    expect(auditSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      eventType:  'LEAVE_REQUEST.CANCELLED',
      resourceId: REQUEST_ID,
    }))
  })

  it('cannot cancel an already-CANCELLED request', async () => {
    const queues: unknown[][] = [[{ ...approvedRow, status: 'CANCELLED' }]]
    const tx = makeScopedTx(queues)
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

    await expect(
      cancelLeaveRequest({ requestId: REQUEST_ID, reason: 'oops' }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/already.*cancel|cannot be cancelled/i)
  })

  it('pending cancellation releases pendingDays on the balance ledger', async () => {
    const pendingRow = { ...approvedRow, status: 'PENDING' }
    const queues: unknown[][] = [
      [pendingRow],
      [{
        id:                 'bal-2',
        openingBalanceDays: '0',
        accruedDays:        '30',
        takenDays:          '0',
        pendingDays:        '5',
        adjustedDays:       '0',
        carriedForwardDays: '0',
        forfeitedDays:      '0',
      }],
    ]
    const tx = makeScopedTx(queues)
    mockDb.transaction.mockImplementation(async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx))

    await cancelLeaveRequest({ requestId: REQUEST_ID, reason: 'no longer needed' })

    // The second setSpy call should update pendingDays to 0 (5 − 5)
    const calls = setSpy.mock.calls.map(c => c[0])
    const balanceUpdate = calls.find((c: Record<string, unknown>) => 'pendingDays' in c)
    expect(balanceUpdate).toBeDefined()
    expect(balanceUpdate?.pendingDays).toBe('0')
  })
})

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// LV-009: Leave balance accrual calculation — pure helpers
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe('LV-009: leave balance accrual calculation', () => {
  it('12 months at 2.5 days/month accumulates to 30 days annual entitlement', () => {
    let total = 0
    for (let month = 1; month <= 12; month++) {
      total += computeMonthlyAccrualDays(
        { accrualFrequency: 'MONTHLY', isProRated: true, minServiceMonths: 0 },
        30,      // daysEntitled = 30 (UAE standard annual leave)
        month,   // serviceMonths
      )
    }
    // 12 × 2.5 = 30.00 — floating point rounded to 2 dp by the helper.
    expect(Math.round(total * 100) / 100).toBe(30)
  })

  it('computeMonthlyAccrualDays returns 0 when below minServiceMonths floor', () => {
    const days = computeMonthlyAccrualDays(
      { accrualFrequency: 'MONTHLY', isProRated: true, minServiceMonths: 6 },
      30,
      3,  // only 3 months served, below the 6-month floor
    )
    expect(days).toBe(0)
  })

  it('computeMonthlyAccrualDays returns 0 for ANNUALLY frequency (monthly path only)', () => {
    const days = computeMonthlyAccrualDays(
      { accrualFrequency: 'ANNUALLY', isProRated: true, minServiceMonths: 0 },
      30,
      12,
    )
    expect(days).toBe(0)
  })

  it('computeClosingBalance: opening + accrued − taken = correct closing', () => {
    const closing = computeClosingBalance({
      openingBalanceDays: 5,
      accruedDays:        30,
      takenDays:          10,
      pendingDays:        3,
      adjustedDays:       0,
      carriedForwardDays: 2,
      forfeitedDays:      0,
    })
    // 5 + 30 + 2 + 0 − 10 − 3 − 0 = 24
    expect(closing).toBe(24)
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import {
  computePlanExpiryISO,
  isExpiringSoon,
  deriveBalanceStatus,
  deriveCarryForwardStatus,
  BalancesSearchSchema,
  buildBalanceConditions,
  EXPIRING_SOON_DAYS,
} from '@/app/(hr-admin)/absence/balances/filters'

describe('computePlanExpiryISO (Phase 1 plan-level approximation)', () => {
  it('returns null when the plan never expires (months <= 0)', () => {
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(2026, 0)).toBeNull()
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(2026, -3)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('returns null for out-of-range years', () => {
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(1999, 12)).toBeNull()
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(2101, 12)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('anchors to Jan 1 of the balance year + N months (UTC)', () => {
    // 12 months from 2026-01-01 → 2027-01-01
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(2026, 12)).toBe('2027-01-01')
    // 24 months (BR-AL-003 default) → 2028-01-01
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(2026, 24)).toBe('2028-01-01')
    // 6 months → 2026-07-01
    expect(computePlanExpiryISO(2026, 6)).toBe('2026-07-01')
  })
})

describe('isExpiringSoon (90-day window)', () => {
  const today = '2026-06-05'

  it('is false when nothing is carried', () => {
    expect(isExpiringSoon(0, 0, '2026-07-01', today)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('is false when already forfeited', () => {
    expect(isExpiringSoon(5, 3, '2026-07-01', today)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('is false when there is no expiry (never expires)', () => {
    expect(isExpiringSoon(5, 0, null, today)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('is true when expiry is within 90 days', () => {
    expect(isExpiringSoon(5, 0, '2026-07-01', today)).toBe(true) // ~26 days out
  })

  it('is false when expiry is beyond 90 days', () => {
    expect(isExpiringSoon(5, 0, '2026-12-01', today)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('is false when expiry is already in the past', () => {
    expect(isExpiringSoon(5, 0, '2026-01-01', today)).toBe(false)
  })

  it('boundary: exactly 90 days out is still expiring', () => {
    const horizon = new Date(`${today}T00:00:00Z`)
    horizon.setUTCDate(horizon.getUTCDate() + EXPIRING_SOON_DAYS)
    expect(isExpiringSoon(5, 0, horizon.toISOString().slice(0, 10), today)).toBe(true)
  })
})

describe('deriveBalanceStatus', () => {
  const today = '2026-06-05'

  it('returns null for not-yet-computed closing', () => {
    expect(deriveBalanceStatus({ closingBalanceDays: null, carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBeNull()
  })

  it('classifies positive / negative / zero', () => {
    expect(deriveBalanceStatus({ closingBalanceDays: 12, carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBe('positive')
    expect(deriveBalanceStatus({ closingBalanceDays: -2, carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBe('negative')
    expect(deriveBalanceStatus({ closingBalanceDays: 0, carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBe('zero')
  })

  it('prefers Expiring Soon over Positive', () => {
    expect(deriveBalanceStatus({ closingBalanceDays: 12, carriedForwardDays: 5, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: '2026-07-01', todayISO: today })).toBe('expiring')
  })
})

describe('deriveCarryForwardStatus', () => {
  const today = '2026-06-05'

  it('Expired when forfeited', () => {
    expect(deriveCarryForwardStatus({ carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 4, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBe('expired')
  })

  it('Not Eligible when nothing carried', () => {
    expect(deriveCarryForwardStatus({ carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBe('not_eligible')
  })

  it('Eligible when carried and never expires', () => {
    expect(deriveCarryForwardStatus({ carriedForwardDays: 5, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: null, todayISO: today })).toBe('eligible')
  })

  it('Eligible when carried and expiry is still future', () => {
    expect(deriveCarryForwardStatus({ carriedForwardDays: 5, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: '2026-12-01', todayISO: today })).toBe('eligible')
  })

  it('Not Eligible when carried but expiry already passed', () => {
    expect(deriveCarryForwardStatus({ carriedForwardDays: 5, forfeitedDays: 0, expiryISO: '2026-01-01', todayISO: today })).toBe('not_eligible')
  })
})

describe('BalancesSearchSchema', () => {
  it('parses a full valid filter set', () => {
    const r = BalancesSearchSchema.safeParse({
      year: '2026',
      entityId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
      typeId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
      departmentId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
      projectId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004',
      q: 'ahmed',
      startDate: '2026-01-01',
      endDate: '2026-12-31',
      status: 'expiring',
      cf: 'eligible',
    })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
    if (r.success) {
      expect(r.data.year).toBe(2026)
      expect(r.data.departmentId).toBe('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003')
      expect(r.data.projectId).toBe('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004')
      expect(r.data.status).toBe('expiring')
      expect(r.data.cf).toBe('eligible')
    }
  })

  it('drops a non-uuid departmentId/projectId via catch', () => {
    const r = BalancesSearchSchema.safeParse({ departmentId: 'not-a-uuid', projectId: '123' })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
    if (r.success) {
      expect(r.data.departmentId).toBeUndefined()
      expect(r.data.projectId).toBeUndefined()
    }
  })

  it('drops invalid enum values via catch (does not throw)', () => {
    const r = BalancesSearchSchema.safeParse({ status: 'bogus', cf: 'nope', year: 'abc' })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
    if (r.success) {
      expect(r.data.status).toBeUndefined()
      expect(r.data.cf).toBeUndefined()
      expect(r.data.year).toBeUndefined()
    }
  })

  it('rejects malformed dates by dropping them', () => {
    const r = BalancesSearchSchema.safeParse({ startDate: '06/05/2026' })
    expect(r.success).toBe(true)
    if (r.success) expect(r.data.startDate).toBeUndefined()
  })
})

describe('buildBalanceConditions — Department/Project + RBAC', () => {
  const ENT = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111'
  const DEPT = '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222'
  const PROJ = '33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333'

  it('adds an EXISTS(worker_assignments) condition when a department is set', () => {
    const before = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026 }, null).length
    const after = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026, departmentId: DEPT }, null).length
    expect(after).toBe(before + 1)
  })

  it('adds exactly one EXISTS condition when BOTH department and project are set (single subquery, de-dup)', () => {
    const base = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026 }, null).length
    const both = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026, departmentId: DEPT, projectId: PROJ }, null).length
    expect(both).toBe(base + 1)
  })

  it('pins to scopedEntityId and ignores a supplied entityId for non-SUPER_ADMIN', () => {
    // With a scoped (non-super) entity, the entity condition count must be the
    // same whether or not a rogue entityId is supplied — proving it is ignored.
    const pinned = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026 }, ENT).length
    const withRogue = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026, entityId: 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa' }, ENT).length
    expect(withRogue).toBe(pinned)
  })

  it('SUPER_ADMIN (null scope) honors a supplied entityId', () => {
    const none = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026 }, null).length
    const withEntity = buildBalanceConditions({ year: 2026, entityId: ENT }, null).length
    expect(withEntity).toBe(none + 1)
  })
})

/**
 * GAP-M01 FIX (FIX-S9-01) — sick-leave medical-cert policy unit tests.
 *
 * Pure-helper coverage for `isMedicalCertRequired` across the three
 * configurable thresholds (0 / 2 / 3) plus non-sick leave types.
 *
 * BR-SL-002: Article 31, FDL 33/2021 — UAE minimum is Day 1 (threshold=0).
 */
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: {} }))

const { isMedicalCertRequired } = await import('@/lib/absence-cert-policy')

describe('isMedicalCertRequired — configurable threshold (GAP-M01)', () => {
  describe('threshold = 0 (Day 1 — UAE Labour Law minimum)', () => {
    it('1 day sick leave requires cert', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 1, 0)).toBe(true)
    })
    it('3 days sick leave requires cert', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 3, 0)).toBe(true)
    })
  })

  describe('threshold = 2 (Avaniis policy)', () => {
    it('1 day sick leave: cert NOT required', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 1, 2)).toBe(false)
    })
    it('2 days sick leave: cert NOT required (at threshold, not exceeding)', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 2, 2)).toBe(false)
    })
    it('3 days sick leave: cert required (exceeds threshold of 2)', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 3, 2)).toBe(true)
    })
  })

  describe('threshold = 3', () => {
    it('3 days sick leave: cert NOT required (at threshold)', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 3, 3)).toBe(false)
    })
    it('4 days sick leave: cert required', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('SICK', 4, 3)).toBe(true)
    })
  })

  describe('non-sick leave types', () => {
    it('annual leave never requires cert regardless of threshold', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('ANNUAL', 10, 0)).toBe(false)
    })
    it('maternity leave never requires cert', () => {
      expect(isMedicalCertRequired('MATERNITY', 60, 0)).toBe(false)
    })
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'

/**
 * S5-02 / S5-07 — Pure-helper unit tests for the absence balance engine.
 * These exercise pure functions in modules/absence/services.ts — but the
 * module imports lib/db transitively, so we stub the DB to avoid the
 * connection check at import time.
 */

// Chainable mock builder used by the comp-leave tests below. Each `from()`
// call records the table reference so the test can assert on read paths.
type DbResult = unknown[]
const mockState: {
  fromQueue:    DbResult[]
  insertReturn: DbResult
  insertCalls:  Array<{ table: unknown; values: unknown }>
  updateCalls:  Array<{ table: unknown; values: unknown }>
} = { fromQueue: [], insertReturn: [], insertCalls: [], updateCalls: [] }

const buildSelect = () => ({
  from:    () => buildSelect(),
  leftJoin: () => buildSelect(),
  where:   () => buildSelect(),
  orderBy: () => buildSelect(),
  limit:   () => Promise.resolve(mockState.fromQueue.shift() ?? []),
})

const buildInsert = (table: unknown) => ({
  values: (vals: unknown) => {
    mockState.insertCalls.push({ table, values: vals })
    return {
      returning: () => Promise.resolve(mockState.insertReturn),
      onConflictDoNothing: () => Promise.resolve(undefined),
    }
  },
})

const buildUpdate = (table: unknown) => ({
  set: (vals: unknown) => {
    mockState.updateCalls.push({ table, values: vals })
    return { where: () => Promise.resolve(undefined) }
  },
})

const mockDb = {
  select:      () => buildSelect(),
  insert:      (table: unknown) => buildInsert(table),
  update:      (table: unknown) => buildUpdate(table),
  transaction: async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<void>) => {
    await fn(mockDb)
  },
  query: {},
}

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: mockDb }))
vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({ writeAuditLog: vi.fn(), diffFields: () => [] }))

const {
  computeClosingBalance,
  monthsBetween,
  computeMonthlyAccrualDays,
  computeCarryForwardExpiry,
  computeRequestDurationDays,
  rangesOverlap,
  firstOfNextMonth,
  grantCompensatoryLeaveCredit,
} = await import('@/modules/absence/services')

describe('computeClosingBalance — BR-AL-002 ledger arithmetic', () => {
  it('opening + accrued + carryForward + adjusted - taken - pending - forfeited', () => {
    const closing = computeClosingBalance({
      openingBalanceDays: 5,
      accruedDays:        2.5,
      takenDays:          1,
      pendingDays:        1.5,
      adjustedDays:       0.5,
      carriedForwardDays: 7,
      forfeitedDays:      0,
    })
    // 5 + 2.5 + 7 + 0.5 - 1 - 1.5 - 0 = 12.5
    expect(closing).toBe(12.5)
  })

  it('rounds to 2 decimal places', () => {
    const closing = computeClosingBalance({
      openingBalanceDays: 1 / 3,
      accruedDays: 0,
      takenDays: 0,
      pendingDays: 0,
      adjustedDays: 0,
      carriedForwardDays: 0,
      forfeitedDays: 0,
    })
    expect(closing).toBe(0.33)
  })

  it('pendingDays is subtracted (no double-spend)', () => {
    const a = computeClosingBalance({
      openingBalanceDays: 22, accruedDays: 0, takenDays: 0,
      pendingDays: 5, adjustedDays: 0, carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0,
    })
    const b = computeClosingBalance({
      openingBalanceDays: 22, accruedDays: 0, takenDays: 5,
      pendingDays: 0, adjustedDays: 0, carriedForwardDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0,
    })
    expect(a).toBe(b)
  })
})

describe('monthsBetween — BR-AL-002 (calendar month = 30 days)', () => {
  it('30 days = 1 month', () => {
    expect(monthsBetween('2026-01-01', '2026-01-31')).toBe(1)
  })
  it('365 days ≈ 12 months', () => {
    expect(monthsBetween('2026-01-01', '2027-01-01')).toBe(12)
  })
  it('zero days = 0 months', () => {
    expect(monthsBetween('2026-04-01', '2026-04-01')).toBe(0)
  })
  it('flooring: 29 days = 0 months', () => {
    expect(monthsBetween('2026-01-01', '2026-01-29')).toBe(0)
  })
})

describe('computeMonthlyAccrualDays — BR-AL-001', () => {
  const baseRule = { accrualFrequency: 'MONTHLY' as const, isProRated: true, minServiceMonths: 6 }

  it('30 day annual entitlement → 2.5 days/month', () => {
    expect(computeMonthlyAccrualDays(baseRule, 30, 12)).toBe(2.5)
  })

  it('returns 0 below minServiceMonths floor', () => {

  })
})

describe('firstOfNextMonth', () => {
  it('returns the 1st of the next calendar month', () => {
    expect(firstOfNextMonth('2026-04-15')).toBe('2026-05-01')
  })
  it('handles Dec → Jan', () => {

  })

    resetMock()
    // 1st select = person lookup → person found
    // 2nd select = publicHolidays lookup → empty (not a holiday)
    mockState.fromQueue = [PERSON_ROW, []]
    await expect(
      grantCompensatoryLeaveCredit(PERSON_ID, '2026-04-15', 8, ACTOR_ID),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/not a confirmed public holiday/)
  })

  it('throws when person not found', async () => {
    resetMock()
    mockState.fromQueue = [[]] // empty person lookup
    await expect(
      grantCompensatoryLeaveCredit(PERSON_ID, '2026-12-02', 8, ACTOR_ID),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/person not found/)
  })

  it('throws when COMP absence type is not seeded', async () => {
    resetMock()
    // person → holiday (confirmed) → COMP type missing
    mockState.fromQueue = [PERSON_ROW, HOLIDAY_ROW, []]
    await expect(
      grantCompensatoryLeaveCredit(PERSON_ID, '2026-12-02', 8, ACTOR_ID),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/COMP absence type not seeded/)
  })

  it('grants 1 comp leave day with COMP type + audit row inserts (BR-PH-003)', async () => {
    resetMock()
    // person → holiday → COMP type → existing balance (empty = INSERT path)
    mockState.fromQueue = [PERSON_ROW, HOLIDAY_ROW, COMP_TYPE_ROW, []]
    mockState.insertReturn = NEW_BALANCE_ROW

    const result = await grantCompensatoryLeaveCredit(
      PERSON_ID, '2026-12-02', 8, ACTOR_ID,
    )

    expect(result.daysGranted).toBe(1)
    expect(result.holidayCode).toBe('UAE-2026-ND1')
    expect(result.balanceId).toBe('99999999-9999-9999-9999-999999999999')

    // Verify the inserted balance row has adjustedDays = 1 (BR-PH-003 grant).
    const balanceInsert = mockState.insertCalls[0]
    expect(balanceInsert).toBeDefined()
    const inserted = balanceInsert.values as { adjustedDays: string; balanceYear: number }
    expect(inserted.adjustedDays).toBe('1')
    expect(inserted.balanceYear).toBe(2026)
  })

  it('updates the existing balance row when one is already present for the year', async () => {
    resetMock()
    const EXISTING_BALANCE = [{
      id: 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb',
      openingBalanceDays: '0', accruedDays: '0', takenDays: '0',
      pendingDays: '0', adjustedDays: '2', carriedForwardDays: '0', forfeitedDays: '0',
    }]
    // person → holiday → COMP type → existing balance present (UPDATE path)
    mockState.fromQueue = [PERSON_ROW, HOLIDAY_ROW, COMP_TYPE_ROW, EXISTING_BALANCE]

    await grantCompensatoryLeaveCredit(PERSON_ID, '2026-12-02', 8, ACTOR_ID)

    expect(mockState.updateCalls.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
    const updated = mockState.updateCalls[0].values as { adjustedDays: string }
    // 2 (existing) + 1 (granted) = 3
    expect(updated.adjustedDays).toBe('3')
  })
})

/**
 * Unit tests — modules/aria/leave-recommendation.ts
 *
 * Strategy: mock the DB and the Anthropic SDK so no network or DB is needed.
 * Tests verify:
 *   1. generateLeaveRecommendation writes correct fields to absence_entries
 *   2. Returns without crashing when Claude API is unavailable (ARIA_NOT_CONFIGURED)
 *   3. AriaLeaveRecommendation type validates correctly (shape checks)
 *   4. Recommendation code maps correctly to expected badge configuration
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest'
import type {
  AriaLeaveRecommendation,
  AriaLeaveRecommendationCode,
} from '@/modules/aria/types'

// ── Shared fixtures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const VALID_RECOMMENDATION: AriaLeaveRecommendation = {
  recommendation: 'APPROVE',
  confidence:     0.92,
  summaryEn:      'Balance sufficient, no team conflicts, notice period met.',
  summaryAr:      'الرصيد كافٍ، لا تعارضات في الفريق، تم استيفاء مهلة الإخطار.',
  factors: [
    { factor: 'Balance',       status: 'OK',   detailEn: '14 days remaining after leave', detailAr: '١٤ يوماً متبقية بعد الإجازة' },
    { factor: 'Team Coverage', status: 'OK',   detailEn: 'No colleagues on leave',        detailAr: 'لا زملاء في إجازة' },
    { factor: 'Notice Period', status: 'WARN', detailEn: 'Only 2 days notice given',       detailAr: 'تم إخطار يومين فقط' },
    { factor: 'History',       status: 'OK',   detailEn: '5 requests in last 12 months',  detailAr: '٥ طلبات في آخر ١٢ شهراً' },
    { factor: 'Compliance',    status: 'OK',   detailEn: 'Article 29, FDL 33/2021',       detailAr: 'المادة ٢٩ من المرسوم الاتحادي ٣٣ لعام ٢٠٢١' },
  ],
  generatedAt: '2026-05-08T09:00:00.000Z',
  model:        'claude-sonnet-4-6',
}

// ── Type shape tests (no mocks needed) ────────────────────────────────────────

describe('AriaLeaveRecommendation type shape', () => {
  it('accepts all three recommendation codes', () => {
    const codes: AriaLeaveRecommendationCode[] = ['APPROVE', 'REJECT', 'REVIEW']
    for (const code of codes) {
      const rec: AriaLeaveRecommendation = { ...VALID_RECOMMENDATION, recommendation: code }
      expect(rec.recommendation).toBe(code)
    }
  })

  it('confidence is 0.0 – 1.0', () => {
    const rec: AriaLeaveRecommendation = { ...VALID_RECOMMENDATION, confidence: 0.75 }
    expect(rec.confidence).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
    expect(rec.confidence).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1)
  })

  it('factors array is present', () => {
    expect(Array.isArray(VALID_RECOMMENDATION.factors)).toBe(true)
    expect(VALID_RECOMMENDATION.factors.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

  it('factor status values are OK | WARN | FAIL', () => {
    const valid = ['OK', 'WARN', 'FAIL'] as const
    for (const f of VALID_RECOMMENDATION.factors) {
      expect(valid).toContain(f.status)
    }
  })

  it('has bilingual fields', () => {
    expect(typeof VALID_RECOMMENDATION.summaryEn).toBe('string')
    expect(typeof VALID_RECOMMENDATION.summaryAr).toBe('string')
    for (const f of VALID_RECOMMENDATION.factors) {
      expect(typeof f.detailEn).toBe('string')
      expect(typeof f.detailAr).toBe('string')
    }
  })

  it('has generatedAt and model fields', () => {
    expect(typeof VALID_RECOMMENDATION.generatedAt).toBe('string')
    expect(typeof VALID_RECOMMENDATION.model).toBe('string')
  })
})

// ── Badge colour mapping ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('recommendation code → badge config', () => {
  const BADGE_MAP: Record<AriaLeaveRecommendationCode, { fg: string; bg: string }> = {
    APPROVE: { bg: 'var(--status-approved-bg, #dcfce7)', fg: 'var(--status-approved-fg, #166534)' },
    REJECT:  { bg: 'var(--status-rejected-bg, #fee2e2)', fg: 'var(--status-rejected-fg, #991b1b)' },
    REVIEW:  { bg: 'var(--status-warning-bg, #fef3c7)',  fg: 'var(--status-warning-fg, #b45309)'  },
  }

  it('APPROVE maps to approved colour token', () => {
    expect(BADGE_MAP.APPROVE.bg).toContain('approved-bg')
    expect(BADGE_MAP.APPROVE.fg).toContain('approved-fg')
  })

  it('REJECT maps to rejected colour token', () => {
    expect(BADGE_MAP.REJECT.bg).toContain('rejected-bg')
    expect(BADGE_MAP.REJECT.fg).toContain('rejected-fg')
  })

  it('REVIEW maps to warning colour token', () => {
    expect(BADGE_MAP.REVIEW.bg).toContain('warning-bg')
    expect(BADGE_MAP.REVIEW.fg).toContain('warning-fg')
  })
})

// ── generateLeaveRecommendation with mocked DB + Anthropic ────────────────────

/**
 * Queue-based DB mock.
 *
 * leave-recommendation.ts makes a mix of:
 *   - .select().from().where().limit() — 4 queries (leave request, person, balance, dept)
 *   - .select().from().where()         — 3 queries (count queries: team total, overlap, history)
 *
 * The chain needs `.then()` so `await chain` works as a thenable for the
 * count() queries that omit `.limit()`.
 */
const MOCK_DB_RESPONSES = {
  queue:     [] as unknown[][],
  callIndex: 0,
}

// Transaction mock — defined as a reference so vi.mock factory can close over it
let mockTransactionImpl: (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>

const MOCK_TX = {
  update: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({
    set:   function(this: unknown) { return this },
    where: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  }),
  insert: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({
    values: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  }),
}

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => {
  // Build a Drizzle-like chain that is also a thenable.
  // .limit() and awaiting the chain directly both pop the next queue entry.
  function makeChain(): unknown {
    const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {}
    const popQueue = () => {
      const result = MOCK_DB_RESPONSES.queue[MOCK_DB_RESPONSES.callIndex] ?? []
      MOCK_DB_RESPONSES.callIndex++
      return result
    }
    chain.from     = () => chain
    chain.leftJoin = () => chain
    chain.where    = () => chain
    chain.limit    = () => Promise.resolve(popQueue())
    // Make the chain thenable so `await chain` works without .limit()
    chain.then = (
      resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown,
      reject:  (e: unknown) => unknown,
    ) => Promise.resolve(popQueue()).then(resolve, reject)
    return chain
  }

  return {
    db: {
      select:      () => makeChain(),
      transaction: (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<void>) => mockTransactionImpl(fn),
    },
  }
})

vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({
  writeAuditLog: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/constants', () => ({
  TENANT_ID: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
}))

vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  absenceEntries:    { id: 'id', tenantId: 'tenantId', personId: 'personId', legalEntityId: 'legalEntityId', absenceTypeId: 'absenceTypeId', startDate: 'startDate', endDate: 'endDate', durationDays: 'durationDays', status: 'status', submittedVia: 'submittedVia', notes: 'notes', ariaRecommendation: 'ariaRecommendation', ariaConfidenceScore: 'ariaConfidenceScore', ariaRecommendationJson: 'ariaRecommendationJson', updatedBy: 'updatedBy', updatedByName: 'updatedByName', updatedDate: 'updatedDate', lastUpdatedDate: 'lastUpdatedDate' },
  absenceTypes:      { id: 'id', tenantId: 'tenantId', typeNameEn: 'typeNameEn', typeNameAr: 'typeNameAr', typeCode: 'typeCode', minNoticeDays: 'minNoticeDays', maxDaysPerYear: 'maxDaysPerYear' },
  absenceBalances:   { id: 'id', tenantId: 'tenantId', personId: 'personId', absenceTypeId: 'absenceTypeId', balanceYear: 'balanceYear', openingBalanceDays: 'openingBalanceDays', accruedDays: 'accruedDays', takenDays: 'takenDays', closingBalanceDays: 'closingBalanceDays' },
  persons:           { id: 'id', tenantId: 'tenantId', fullNameEn: 'fullNameEn', hireDate: 'hireDate', gender: 'gender', employmentType: 'employmentType', currentDepartmentId: 'currentDepartmentId' },
  departments:       { id: 'id', tenantId: 'tenantId', nameEn: 'nameEn' },
  workerAssignments: { id: 'id', tenantId: 'tenantId', personId: 'personId', legalEntityId: 'legalEntityId', isCurrent: 'isCurrent' },
}))

// Mock the runtime config loader (provider layer) so it doesn't consume the
// DB queue. Provider 'anthropic' routes through the mocked Anthropic SDK below.
vi.mock('@/lib/aria/config-loader', () => ({
  loadAriaRuntimeConfig: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
    provider: 'anthropic', modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', apiKey: 'test-key', apiEndpoint: null,
  }),
}))

// Mock Anthropic SDK
vi.mock('@anthropic-ai/sdk', () => ({
  default: vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({
    messages: {
      create: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        content: [{
          type: 'text',
          text: JSON.stringify(VALID_RECOMMENDATION),
        }],
      }),
    },
  })),
}))

let transactionCallCount = 0

describe('generateLeaveRecommendation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    MOCK_DB_RESPONSES.queue = []
    MOCK_DB_RESPONSES.callIndex = 0

    mockTransactionImpl = async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<void>) => {
      transactionCallCount++

      })

  it('returns without throwing when ARIA_NOT_CONFIGURED', async () => {

    MOCK_DB_RESPONSES.queue = [

      [{ id: 'person-001', fullNameEn: 'Ahmed Al Mansoori', hireDate: '2023-01-01', gender: 'MALE', employmentType: 'FULL_TIME', deptId: 'dept-001' }],

      [{ nameEn: 'Operations' }],

      [{ onLeave: 0 }],

    const { generateLeaveRecommendation } = await import('@/modules/aria/leave-recommendation')

/**
 * ISSUE-012 — ARIA leave-status handler integration tests
 *
 * Tests for handleLeaveRequestStatus via handleIntent().
 * Proves the full data path: listLeaveRequests → resolvePendingApprover → rawData → Claude prompt.
 * The Claude SDK is mocked; assertions inspect what rawData was sent to Claude.
 *
 * Tests:
 *   ALS-001: PENDING leave row → formatting prompt includes pending_approver and pending_step
 *   ALS-002: APPROVED leave row → formatting prompt has NO pending_approver field
 *   ALS-003: REJECTED leave row → formatting prompt has NO pending_approver field
 *   ALS-004: CONFIG_WARNING approver → formatting prompt contains the warning message text
 *   ALS-005: Multiple pending rows → formatting prompt includes approver for each
 *   ALS-006: resolvePendingApprover throws → handler does not crash, returns valid AriaResponse
 *   ALS-007: handleLeaveRequestStatus passes ctx.personId to listLeaveRequests (scope not elevated)
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import type { AriaIntentResult, AriaSessionContext } from '@/modules/aria/types'

// ── Mock factories (must be at top level — vitest hoists vi.mock calls) ───────

const mockListLeaveRequests   = vi.fn()
const mockResolvePendingApprover = vi.fn()
const mockMessagesCreate      = vi.fn()

vi.mock('@/modules/absence', () => ({
  listLeaveRequests: mockListLeaveRequests,
}))

vi.mock('@/modules/workflow', () => ({
  resolvePendingApprover: mockResolvePendingApprover,
}))

vi.mock('@anthropic-ai/sdk', () => ({
  default: vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({
    messages: { create: mockMessagesCreate },
  })),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/aria/system-prompt', () => ({
  ARIA_SYSTEM_PROMPT: 'test-system-prompt',
}))

// Provider layer reads provider/model/key from config — mock it so the
// formatting call routes through the mocked Anthropic SDK (provider 'anthropic')
// without touching the real DB.
vi.mock('@/lib/aria/config-loader', () => ({
  loadAriaRuntimeConfig: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
    provider: 'anthropic', modelId: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', apiKey: 'test-key', apiEndpoint: null,
  }),
}))

// ── Test helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT: AriaIntentResult = {
  intent:     'LEAVE_REQUEST_STATUS',
  language:   'en',
  confidence: 0.95,
  entities:   {},
}

const EMPLOYEE_CTX: AriaSessionContext = {
  personId:      'person-emp-001',
  role:          'EMPLOYEE',
  legalEntityId: 'entity-001',
  language:      'en',
}

const MANAGER_CTX: AriaSessionContext = {
  personId:      'person-mgr-001',
  role:          'MANAGER',
  legalEntityId: 'entity-001',
  language:      'en',
}

function makeLeaveRow(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    id:                 'leave-001',
    requestNumber:      'LR-2026-0001',
    personId:           'person-emp-001',
    absenceTypeCode:    'ANNUAL',
    startDate:          '2026-06-01',
    endDate:            '2026-06-10',
    durationDays:       10,
    status:             'PENDING',
    workflowInstanceId: 'instance-001',
    createdDate:        '2026-05-15',
    ...overrides,
  }
}

function makeLeaveResult(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]) {
  return { rows, total: rows.length, page: 1, pageSize: 5, totalPages: 1 }
}

/** Returns the full content of the last user message sent to Claude's messages.create. */
function capturedFormattingPrompt(): string {
  expect(mockMessagesCreate).toHaveBeenCalled()
  const callParams = mockMessagesCreate.mock.calls[0][0] as {
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>
  }
  const userMessages = callParams.messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user')
  return userMessages[userMessages.length - 1].content
}

/**
 * Returns only the Data section of the formatting prompt (the rawData lines).
 * Assertions that check whether specific data fields are present/absent use
 * this to avoid matching on the formatting instruction text in the Rules section,
 * which itself mentions field names like "pending_approver" as documentation.
 */
function capturedDataSection(): string {
  const full = capturedFormattingPrompt()
  // The formatting prompt ends with "\nData:\n<rawData>".
  // Split on "\nData:\n" and take the part after it.
  return full.split('\nData:\n')[1] ?? ''
}

// ── Setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  process.env.ARIA_API_KEY = 'test-key-mocked'
  // Default Claude mock response — tests that need specific behaviour override this
  mockMessagesCreate.mockResolvedValue({
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Formatted leave status' }],
  })
})

// ── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('ISSUE-012 — ARIA leave-status handler integration', () => {

  it('ALS-001: PENDING leave row → data section includes pending_approver and pending_step', async () => {
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(makeLeaveResult([makeLeaveRow()]))
    mockResolvePendingApprover.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      approverType:  'PERSON',
      approverLabel: 'Ahmed Al Rashidi',
      stepName:      'Line Manager Approval',
    })

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    const response = await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'My leave request status', [], EMPLOYEE_CTX, null)

    const data = capturedDataSection()
    expect(data).toContain('pending_approver="Ahmed Al Rashidi"')
    expect(data).toContain('pending_step="Line Manager Approval"')
    expect(response.intentCode).toBe('LEAVE_REQUEST_STATUS')
    expect(response.dataSource).toBe('absence_entries')
  })

  it('ALS-002: APPROVED leave row → data section has NO pending_approver field', async () => {
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(
      makeLeaveResult([makeLeaveRow({ status: 'APPROVED', workflowInstanceId: null })]),
    )

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'My leave request status', [], EMPLOYEE_CTX, null)

    const data = capturedDataSection()
    expect(data).not.toContain('pending_approver=')
    expect(data).not.toContain('pending_step=')
    expect(data).toContain('status=APPROVED')
    // Resolver must NOT have been called for non-PENDING rows
    expect(mockResolvePendingApprover).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('ALS-003: REJECTED leave row → data section has NO pending_approver field', async () => {
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(
      makeLeaveResult([makeLeaveRow({ status: 'REJECTED', workflowInstanceId: null })]),
    )

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'My leave request status', [], EMPLOYEE_CTX, null)

    const data = capturedDataSection()
    expect(data).not.toContain('pending_approver=')
    expect(data).toContain('status=REJECTED')
    expect(mockResolvePendingApprover).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('ALS-004: CONFIG_WARNING approver → data section contains the actionable HR warning label', async () => {
    // approverType='CONFIG_WARNING' is NOT written to rawData — only approverLabel is.
    // The label text is what Claude sees and should communicate to the user.
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(makeLeaveResult([makeLeaveRow()]))
    mockResolvePendingApprover.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      approverType:  'CONFIG_WARNING',
      approverLabel: 'Approver not configured — HR should review the workflow configuration',
      stepName:      'Pending Step',
    })

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'pending with whom?', [], EMPLOYEE_CTX, null)

    const data = capturedDataSection()
    expect(data).toContain('pending_approver="Approver not configured')
    expect(data).toContain('HR should review the workflow configuration')
  })

  it('ALS-005: multiple pending rows → formatting prompt includes approver for each', async () => {
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(makeLeaveResult([
      makeLeaveRow({ id: 'leave-001', workflowInstanceId: 'instance-001', startDate: '2026-06-01' }),
      makeLeaveRow({ id: 'leave-002', workflowInstanceId: 'instance-002', startDate: '2026-07-01' }),
    ]))
    // Two resolver calls — one per pending row
    mockResolvePendingApprover
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ approverType: 'PERSON', approverLabel: 'Ahmed Al Rashidi', stepName: 'LM Approval' })
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ approverType: 'GROUP',  approverLabel: 'HR Approvals Team (approval group)', stepName: 'HR Review' })

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'My leave request status', [], EMPLOYEE_CTX, null)

    const data = capturedDataSection()
    expect(data).toContain('pending_approver="Ahmed Al Rashidi"')
    expect(data).toContain('pending_approver="HR Approvals Team (approval group)"')
    expect(mockResolvePendingApprover).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
  })

  it('ALS-006: resolvePendingApprover throws → ARIA still returns valid response, does not crash', async () => {
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(makeLeaveResult([makeLeaveRow()]))
    mockResolvePendingApprover.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('DB connection lost'))

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    // Must not throw — Promise.allSettled swallows individual resolver failures
    const response = await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'My leave request status', [], EMPLOYEE_CTX, null)

    expect(response.intentCode).toBe('LEAVE_REQUEST_STATUS')
    expect(response.dataSource).toBe('absence_entries')
    expect(typeof response.message).toBe('string')
    expect(response.message.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    // rawData still includes the leave row but WITHOUT pending_approver (resolver failed)
    const data = capturedDataSection()
    expect(data).toContain('status=PENDING')
    expect(data).not.toContain('pending_approver=')
  })

  it('ALS-007: handleLeaveRequestStatus passes ctx.personId to listLeaveRequests (scope not elevated)', async () => {
    mockListLeaveRequests.mockResolvedValueOnce(makeLeaveResult([]))

    const { handleIntent } = await import('@/modules/aria/services')
    // Should return isError (no rows) → direct return before Claude call
    await handleIntent(LEAVE_STATUS_INTENT, 'My leave request status', [], MANAGER_CTX, null)

    expect(mockListLeaveRequests).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    const callArg = mockListLeaveRequests.mock.calls[0][0] as { personId: string }
    // Must pass the manager's own personId — not a different person's ID
    expect(callArg.personId).toBe(MANAGER_CTX.personId)
    // resolvePendingApprover must NOT be called (no rows)
    expect(mockResolvePendingApprover).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

/**
 * ESS-LH — ESS Leave History Panel unit tests.
 *
 * Tests the server action `getLeaveHistoryForEmployee` and the supporting
 * UI logic (pending-duration calculation) without touching the DB.
 * All DB calls are mocked at the drizzle layer.
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

// ── Helpers copied from component layer (pure functions) ──────────────────

function pendingDuration(since: Date | string | null, locale: string): string {
  if (!since) return ''
  const sinceMs = since instanceof Date ? since.getTime() : new Date(since).getTime()
  if (isNaN(sinceMs)) return ''
  const diffMs   = Date.now() - sinceMs
  const diffHrs  = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60))
  const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHrs / 24)
  if (diffDays >= 1) {
    return locale === 'ar'
      ? `منذ ${diffDays} ${diffDays === 1 ? 'يوم' : 'أيام'}`
      : `${diffDays} ${diffDays === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} ago`
  }
  return locale === 'ar' ? `منذ ${diffHrs} ساعة` : `${diffHrs} ${diffHrs === 1 ? 'hour' : 'hours'} ago`
}

// ── Mock setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vi.mock('@/lib/auth', () => ({
  requireRole: vi.fn(),
  getCurrentUser: vi.fn(),
  auth: vi.fn(),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/db', async () => {
  const select  = vi.fn()
  const mockDb  = { select, transaction: vi.fn() }
  return { db: mockDb, default: mockDb }
})

vi.mock('@/lib/constants', () => ({ TENANT_ID: 'test-tenant-id' }))

// ── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('ESS-LH: pending duration calculation', () => {
  it('ESS-LH-001 — returns empty string for null since', () => {
    expect(pendingDuration(null, 'en')).toBe('')
  })

  it('ESS-LH-002 — returns hours when < 24h pending', () => {
    const twoHoursAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    const result = pendingDuration(twoHoursAgo, 'en')
    expect(result).toMatch(/2 hours ago/)
  })

  it('ESS-LH-003 — returns days when >= 24h pending', () => {
    const threeDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    const result = pendingDuration(threeDaysAgo, 'en')
    expect(result).toBe('3 days ago')
  })

  it('ESS-LH-004 — singular "day" for exactly 1 day', () => {
    const oneDayAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 25 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    const result = pendingDuration(oneDayAgo, 'en')
    expect(result).toBe('1 day ago')
  })

  it('ESS-LH-005 — returns Arabic text when locale=ar', () => {
    const threeDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
    const result = pendingDuration(threeDaysAgo, 'ar')
    expect(result).toMatch(/منذ/)
    expect(result).toMatch(/أيام/)
  })

  it('ESS-LH-006 — handles ISO string input', () => {
    const twoHoursAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
    const result = pendingDuration(twoHoursAgo, 'en')
    expect(result).toMatch(/hours ago/)
  })

  it('ESS-LH-007 — returns empty for invalid date string', () => {
    expect(pendingDuration('not-a-date', 'en')).toBe('')
  })
})
