/**
 * Leave Backdate Policy — unit tests (BDP-001 – BDP-011)
 *
 * Tests cover:
 *   BDP-001–004: per-leave-type policy enforcement (allowed / blocked scenarios)
 *   BDP-005–006: edge cases (disabled, zero-day limit)
 *   BDP-007:     future/today date bypasses backdate check entirely
 *   BDP-008:     missing policy = BLOCK (safe default — not silent allow)
 *   BDP-009:     validation uses employee's DB-verified entity, not caller entity
 *   BDP-010:     error message contains all 4 actionable elements
 *   BDP-011:     missing person row throws PERSON_NOT_FOUND — no fallback to
 *                caller-supplied legalEntityId (enterprise security requirement)
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { addDays, daysBetween } from '@/lib/effective-date'
import { translateError } from '@/lib/app-error'

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Policy = { backdatingEnabled: boolean; backdateLimitDays: number | null } | null

/**
 * Reproduces the CORRECTED backdate policy-check logic from createLeaveRequest.
 *
 * Design contract (matches actions.ts implementation exactly):
 *   1. startDate >= todayStr          → no check (future / today), always allow
 *   2. personEntityId === null        → PERSON_NOT_FOUND — no fallback to callerEntityId
 *   3. policy === null                → BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING (safe default; BDP-008)
 *   4. !policy.backdatingEnabled      → BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED
 *   5. daysBack > backdateLimitDays   → BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
 *   6. backdateLimitDays === null + enabled → ALLOW (unlimited window)
 *
 * @param personEntityId   The legalEntityId resolved from DB for the employee.
 *                         Pass null to simulate a missing person row (BDP-011).
 *                         This drives the policy lookup — callerEntityId is ignored.
 * @param callerEntityId   The legalEntityId supplied by the API caller.
 *                         Used ONLY in BDP-009/011 to confirm it is never used
 *                         as a fallback.
 */
function runBackdatePolicyCheck(opts: {
  startDate: string
  todayStr: string
  /** Policy for the employee's entity. null = no policy row exists (BLOCK). */
  policy: Policy
  typeNameEn: string
  typeNameAr: string
  /** DB-resolved entity for the employee. null = person row not found. */
  personEntityId?: string | null
  /** Caller-supplied entity (data.legalEntityId). Never used for policy lookup. */
  callerEntityId?: string
}): void {
  const { startDate, todayStr, policy, typeNameEn, typeNameAr } = opts
  // Default: person was found (personEntityId defined and non-null)
  const personEntityId = opts.personEntityId !== undefined ? opts.personEntityId : 'entity-found'

  // Step 1 — future or today — no backdate check required.
  if (startDate >= todayStr) return

  // Step 2 — BDP-011: no fallback to caller entity if person not found.
  if (personEntityId === null) {
    throw new Error(
      'PERSON_NOT_FOUND: The selected employee record could not be found. ' +
      'Please verify the employee exists and refresh the page before trying again.',
    )
  }

  // Step 3 — BDP-008: safe default — no policy configured means backdating BLOCKED.
  if (policy === null) {
    throw new Error(
      `BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING: No backdate policy has been configured for ${typeNameEn} in your organisation. ` +
      `By default, backdating is not permitted. Please contact your HR administrator to configure ` +
      `the backdate policy for this leave type, or apply for leave starting from today (${todayStr}). · ` +
      `لم يتم تكوين سياسة إدخال بأثر رجعي لـ${typeNameAr} في مؤسستك. ` +
      `بشكل افتراضي، لا يُسمح بالإدخال بأثر رجعي. يرجى التواصل مع مسؤول الموارد البشرية لضبط السياسة.`,
    )
  }

  // Step 4 — backdating disabled.
  if (!policy.backdatingEnabled) {
    throw new Error(
      `BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Backdated ${typeNameEn} requests are not permitted under your organisation's policy. ` +
      `Please apply for leave starting from today (${todayStr}) or a future date. · ` +
      `طلبات ${typeNameAr} بأثر رجعي غير مسموح بها وفق سياسة مؤسستك. ` +
      `يرجى تقديم الطلب بدءاً من اليوم (${todayStr}) أو تاريخ مستقبلي.`,
    )
  }

  // Step 5 — day-limit check.
  if (policy.backdateLimitDays !== null) {
    const daysBack = daysBetween(startDate, todayStr)
    if (daysBack > policy.backdateLimitDays) {
      const earliestAllowed = addDays(todayStr, -policy.backdateLimitDays)
      throw new Error(
        `BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: ${typeNameEn} can only be backdated up to ${policy.backdateLimitDays} day(s). ` +
        `The start date you selected (${startDate}) is ${daysBack} day(s) ago, ` +
        `which exceeds the ${policy.backdateLimitDays}-day limit. ` +
        `The earliest date you can enter is ${earliestAllowed}. · ` +
        `يمكن تقديم ${typeNameAr} بأثر رجعي بحد أقصى ${policy.backdateLimitDays} يوم(أيام). ` +
        `التاريخ الذي حددته (${startDate}) كان منذ ${daysBack} يوم(أيام)، ` +
        `وهو يتجاوز الحد المسموح به. ` +
        `أقرب تاريخ يمكن إدخاله هو ${earliestAllowed}.`,
      )
    }
  }
}

// ── Test dates ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TODAY    = '2026-05-26'
const PAST_5   = addDays(TODAY, -5)   //  5 days ago — within most limits
const PAST_7   = addDays(TODAY, -7)   //  7 days ago — within 10-day limit
const PAST_10  = addDays(TODAY, -10)  // 10 days ago — outside 7-day limit
const PAST_31  = addDays(TODAY, -31)  // 31 days ago — outside 30-day limit
const FUTURE   = addDays(TODAY, 3)    //  3 days in the future

const ANNUAL_EN = 'Annual Leave'
const ANNUAL_AR = 'إجازة سنوية'
const SICK_EN   = 'Sick Leave'
const SICK_AR   = 'إجازة مرضية'

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('Leave Backdate Policy — enforcement', () => {

  /**
   * BDP-001: Annual leave 5 days ago within a 30-day policy limit → allowed.
   */
  it('BDP-001: annual leave 5 days ago within 30-day limit → allowed', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 30 },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).not.toThrow()
  })

  /**
   * BDP-002: Annual leave 31 days ago exceeds a 30-day limit → blocked.
   */
  it('BDP-002: annual leave 31 days ago beyond 30-day limit → BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_31, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 30 },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).toThrow('BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:')
  })

  /**
   * BDP-003: Sick leave 7 days ago within a 10-day limit → allowed.
   */
  it('BDP-003: sick leave 7 days ago within 10-day limit → allowed', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_7, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 10 },
        typeNameEn: SICK_EN, typeNameAr: SICK_AR,
      })
    ).not.toThrow()
  })

  /**
   * BDP-004: Sick leave 10 days ago exceeds a 7-day limit → blocked.
   */
  it('BDP-004: sick leave 10 days ago beyond 7-day limit → BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_10, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 7 },
        typeNameEn: SICK_EN, typeNameAr: SICK_AR,
      })
    ).toThrow('BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:')
  })

  /**
   * BDP-005: backdatingEnabled=false → any past date is blocked outright.
   */
  it('BDP-005: backdating disabled → past date throws BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: false, backdateLimitDays: null },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).toThrow('BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED:')
  })

  /**
   * BDP-006: backdateLimitDays=0 → today is the only valid start date.
   * Any past date including yesterday must throw BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
   */
  it('BDP-006: 0-day limit → any past date blocked (today is the earliest valid date)', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 0 },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).toThrow('BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:')
  })

  /**
   * BDP-007: Future or today start date → backdate check does not run at all.
   * Even with backdatingEnabled=false and 0-day limit, no error is thrown.
   */
  it('BDP-007: future/today start date → backdate check bypassed, no error', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: FUTURE, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: false, backdateLimitDays: 0 },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).not.toThrow()

    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: TODAY, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: false, backdateLimitDays: 0 },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).not.toThrow()
  })

  /**
   * BDP-008: No policy row configured (policy=null) → safe default BLOCKS.
   * Must throw BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING, not silently allow.
   */
  it('BDP-008: no policy configured (null) → safe default BLOCKS, throws BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING', () => {
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: null,
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    ).toThrow('BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING:')
  })

  /**
   * BDP-009: Validation uses the employee's DB-verified entity (personEntityId),
   * NOT the entity ID supplied by the caller (callerEntityId).
   *
   * Scenario: HR Admin (entity A, permissive) files for employee in entity B (blocking).
   * Entity B's policy must apply — not entity A's.
   */
  it('BDP-009: uses employee entity policy (blocking) not caller entity (permissive)', () => {
    const entityAPolicy: Policy = { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 30 }  // permissive
    const entityBPolicy: Policy = { backdatingEnabled: false, backdateLimitDays: null } // blocking

    // Employee is in entity B → blocking policy applied even though caller is entity A.
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: entityBPolicy,
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
        personEntityId: 'entity-b-uuid',  // DB-resolved employee entity
        callerEntityId: 'entity-a-uuid',  // admin's entity — NOT used for policy lookup
      })
    ).toThrow('BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED:')

    // Confirming the permissive path would allow — proving entity scoping matters.
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: entityAPolicy,
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
        personEntityId: 'entity-a-uuid',
        callerEntityId: 'entity-a-uuid',
      })
    ).not.toThrow()
  })

  /**
   * BDP-010: BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error contains all 4 actionable elements:
   *   (1) leave type name  (2) selected date  (3) limit in days  (4) earliest allowed date
   */
  it('BDP-010: BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED message contains leave type, selected date, limit, earliest allowed', () => {
    const earliestAllowed = addDays(TODAY, -30)
    const daysBack = daysBetween(PAST_31, TODAY)

    let msg = ''
    try {
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_31, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 30 },
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
      })
    } catch (e) {
      msg = (e as Error).message
    }

    expect(msg).toContain('BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:')
    expect(msg).toContain(ANNUAL_EN)           // (1) leave type
    expect(msg).toContain(PAST_31)             // (2) selected date
    expect(msg).toContain('30')                // (3) limit in days
    expect(msg).toContain(earliestAllowed)     // (4) earliest allowed date
    expect(msg).toContain(String(daysBack))    // days-back count for context
  })

  /**
   * BDP-011: When the person row is not found (personEntityId=null), the check
   * throws PERSON_NOT_FOUND immediately — there is NO fallback to the
   * caller-supplied legalEntityId (callerEntityId).
   *
   * Security requirement: any fallback to the caller-supplied entity would allow
   * an attacker to supply a permissive entity ID for a non-existent person,
   * potentially bypassing the policy lookup entirely.
   *
   * This test confirms:
   *   1. null person → PERSON_NOT_FOUND (not BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING or allowed)
   *   2. The check fires BEFORE the policy lookup (policy=null is never reached)
   *   3. Supplying a permissive callerEntityId does not prevent the throw
   */
  it('BDP-011: person not found → throws PERSON_NOT_FOUND, no fallback to caller entity', () => {
    // Person row absent — even with a permissive policy and permissive callerEntityId,
    // the check must throw PERSON_NOT_FOUND before reaching the policy check.
    expect(() =>
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: { backdatingEnabled: true, backdateLimitDays: 30 },  // permissive — must not be reached
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
        personEntityId: null,             // DB lookup returned no row
        callerEntityId: 'entity-a-uuid', // caller's entity — must NOT be used as fallback
      })
    ).toThrow('PERSON_NOT_FOUND:')

    // Confirm the throw is specifically PERSON_NOT_FOUND and not a generic error.
    let msg = ''
    try {
      runBackdatePolicyCheck({
        startDate: PAST_5, todayStr: TODAY,
        policy: null,
        typeNameEn: ANNUAL_EN, typeNameAr: ANNUAL_AR,
        personEntityId: null,
        callerEntityId: 'any-entity-id',
      })
    } catch (e) {
      msg = (e as Error).message
    }
    expect(msg).toContain('PERSON_NOT_FOUND:')
    // Must NOT contain policy-related messages — person check fires first.
    expect(msg).not.toContain('BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING:')
    expect(msg).not.toContain('BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED:')
    expect(msg).not.toContain('BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:')
  })

})

describe('Leave Backdate Policy — Arabic locale error rendering', () => {

  /**
   * BDPAR-001: translateError strips the BACKDATE_* prefix and returns the full
   * bilingual body (EN · AR). This matches the LeaveRequestNewForm pattern where
   * all validation errors use 'English · Arabic' strings displayed as-is.
   *
   * Arabic-locale users see the Arabic portion in the same error banner.
   * English-locale users see both (English first, then Arabic after the · separator).
   */
  it('BDPAR-001: translateError returns full bilingual body for BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', () => {
    const raw = new Error(
      `BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Annual Leave can only be backdated up to 30 day(s). ` +
      `The start date you selected (2026-04-25) is 31 day(s) ago, ` +
      `which exceeds the 30-day limit. The earliest date you can enter is 2026-04-26. · ` +
      `يمكن تقديم إجازة سنوية بأثر رجعي بحد أقصى 30 يوم(أيام).`,
    )

    let translated = ''
    try { translateError(raw, 'test') } catch (e) { translated = (e as Error).message }

    // English part preserved
    expect(translated).toContain('Annual Leave can only be backdated up to 30 day(s)')
    // Arabic part preserved (not stripped) — Arabic-locale users see this
    expect(translated).toContain('يمكن تقديم إجازة سنوية بأثر رجعي')
    // Prefix code stripped
    expect(translated).not.toContain('BACKDATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:')
    // Bilingual separator preserved
    expect(translated).toContain(' · ')
  })

  it('BDPAR-002: translateError returns full bilingual body for BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED', () => {
    const raw = new Error(
      `BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Backdated Annual Leave requests are not permitted. ` +
      `Please apply from today (2026-05-26) or a future date. · ` +
      `طلبات إجازة سنوية بأثر رجعي غير مسموح بها.`,
    )

    let translated = ''
    try { translateError(raw, 'test') } catch (e) { translated = (e as Error).message }

    expect(translated).toContain('not permitted')
    expect(translated).toContain('طلبات إجازة سنوية بأثر رجعي')
    expect(translated).not.toContain('BACKDATE_NOT_ALLOWED:')
  })

  it('BDPAR-003: translateError returns full bilingual body for BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING', () => {
    const raw = new Error(
      `BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING: No backdate policy has been configured for Study Leave. ` +
      `By default, backdating is not permitted. · ` +
      `لم يتم تكوين سياسة إدخال بأثر رجعي لـإجازة الدراسة في مؤسستك.`,
    )

    let translated = ''
    try { translateError(raw, 'test') } catch (e) { translated = (e as Error).message }

    expect(translated).toContain('No backdate policy has been configured')
    expect(translated).toContain('لم يتم تكوين سياسة')
    expect(translated).not.toContain('BACKDATE_POLICY_MISSING:')
  })

  it('BDPAR-004: translateError returns English message for PERSON_NOT_FOUND', () => {
    const raw = new Error(
      'PERSON_NOT_FOUND: The selected employee record could not be found. ' +
      'Please verify the employee exists and refresh the page before trying again.',
    )

    let translated = ''
    try { translateError(raw, 'test') } catch (e) { translated = (e as Error).message }

    expect(translated).toContain('employee record could not be found')
    expect(translated).not.toContain('PERSON_NOT_FOUND:')
  })

})

/**
 * ISSUE-007 — Leave decision notification body tests.
 *
 * Tests buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody and fmtLeaveDate from lib/leave-notification.ts.
 * Both are pure functions — no mocking required.
 *
 * LDN-001: Approved notification includes leave type, from, to, days, and approver name.
 * LDN-002: Rejected notification includes leave type, from, to, days, rejector name, and reason.
 * LDN-003: Rejected notification without reason does not append a reason clause.
 * LDN-004: Duration of 1 day uses singular "day" (not "days").
 * LDN-005: Duration > 1 uses plural "days".
 * LDN-006: Missing typeNameEn falls back to "Leave" in body.
 * LDN-007: Body never contains a raw UUID for actorDisplayName.
 * LDN-008: Arabic body contains the Arabic verb for "approved" (موافقة).
 * LDN-009: Arabic body contains the Arabic verb for "rejected" (رفض).
 * LDN-010: fmtLeaveDate formats a YYYY-MM-DD string as "15 Mar 2026" (UTC-safe).
 * LDN-011: fmtLeaveDate returns empty string for null/undefined input.
 * LDN-012: Approved notification without date range still produces a valid sentence.
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import {
  buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody,
  fmtLeaveDate,
} from '@/lib/leave-notification'

const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i

const BASE_APPROVED = {
  isApproved:       true,
  actorDisplayName: 'Mahendra Kumar',
  typeNameEn:       'Annual Leave',
  typeNameAr:       'الإجازة السنوية',
  startDate:        '2026-05-20',
  endDate:          '2026-05-23',
  durationDays:     4,
  decisionNote:     null,
}

const BASE_REJECTED = {
  ...BASE_APPROVED,
  isApproved:   false,
  decisionNote: 'Insufficient balance.',
}

describe('ISSUE-007 — leave decision notification body', () => {

  it('LDN-001: approved body includes leave type, date range, days, and approver name', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody(BASE_APPROVED)

    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Annual Leave')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('20 May 2026')   // formatted startDate
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('23 May 2026')   // formatted endDate
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('4 days')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Mahendra Kumar')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('approved')
    // Must be a complete sentence ending with a period
    expect(bodyEn.endsWith('.')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('LDN-002: rejected body includes leave type, date range, days, rejector name, and reason', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody(BASE_REJECTED)

    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Annual Leave')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('20 May 2026')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('23 May 2026')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('4 days')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Mahendra Kumar')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('rejected')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Reason: Insufficient balance.')
  })

  it('LDN-003: rejected body without a reason does not append a reason clause', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody({
      ...BASE_REJECTED,
      decisionNote: null,
    })

    expect(bodyEn).not.toContain('Reason:')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('rejected')
    expect(bodyEn.endsWith('.')).toBe(true)
  })

  it('LDN-004: duration of 1 uses singular "day"', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody({
      ...BASE_APPROVED,
      durationDays: 1,
    })

    expect(bodyEn).toContain('1 day')
    expect(bodyEn).not.toContain('1 days')
  })

  it('LDN-005: duration > 1 uses plural "days"', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody({
      ...BASE_APPROVED,
      durationDays: 3,
    })

    expect(bodyEn).toContain('3 days')
    expect(bodyEn).not.toContain('3 day ')  // not singular
  })

  it('LDN-006: missing typeNameEn falls back to "Leave" in body', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody({
      ...BASE_APPROVED,
      typeNameEn: null,
    })

    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Leave')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('approved')
  })

  it('LDN-007: body never contains a raw UUID for actorDisplayName', () => {
    const uuid = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'
    const { bodyEn, bodyAr } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody({
      ...BASE_APPROVED,
      actorDisplayName: 'Workflow approver',  // resolved display name, not UUID
    })

    expect(UUID_REGEX.test(bodyEn)).toBe(false)
    expect(UUID_REGEX.test(bodyAr)).toBe(false)
    expect(bodyEn).not.toContain(uuid)
    expect(bodyAr).not.toContain(uuid)
  })

  it('LDN-008: Arabic approved body contains Arabic approval verb', () => {
    const { bodyAr } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody(BASE_APPROVED)

    expect(bodyAr).toContain('موافقة')
  })

  it('LDN-009: Arabic rejected body contains Arabic rejection verb', () => {
    const { bodyAr } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody(BASE_REJECTED)

    expect(bodyAr).toContain('رفض')
  })

  it('LDN-010: fmtLeaveDate formats YYYY-MM-DD as "DD Mon YYYY" in UTC', () => {
    expect(fmtLeaveDate('2026-03-15')).toBe('15 Mar 2026')
    expect(fmtLeaveDate('2026-12-01')).toBe('01 Dec 2026')
    expect(fmtLeaveDate('2026-01-31')).toBe('31 Jan 2026')
  })

  it('LDN-011: fmtLeaveDate returns empty string for null or undefined', () => {
    expect(fmtLeaveDate(null)).toBe('')
    expect(fmtLeaveDate(undefined)).toBe('')
    expect(fmtLeaveDate('')).toBe('')
  })

  it('LDN-012: approved body without date info still produces a valid sentence', () => {
    const { bodyEn } = buildLeaveDecisionNotificationBody({
      isApproved:       true,
      actorDisplayName: 'Fatima Al Mansoori',
      typeNameEn:       'Sick Leave',
      typeNameAr:       'إجازة مرضية',
      startDate:        null,
      endDate:          null,
      durationDays:     null,
      decisionNote:     null,
    })

    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Sick Leave')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('Fatima Al Mansoori')
    expect(bodyEn).toContain('approved')
    expect(bodyEn.length).toBeGreaterThan(10)
    expect(bodyEn.endsWith('.')).toBe(true)
  })

})

/**
 * ISSUE-002 — MANAGER scope enforcement in listLeaveRequests / getLeaveRequest
 *
 * Verifies that MANAGER callers are restricted to their authorised team scope
 * and cannot read leave data for employees outside their reporting line.
 *
 * Tests:
 *   LMS-001: EMPLOYEE sees only their own leave
 *   LMS-002: MANAGER with team sees only team leave (no personId filter)
 *   LMS-003: MANAGER with no reports sees empty result (not entity-wide)
 *   LMS-004: MANAGER passing non-team personId filter → empty, no DB exposure
 *   LMS-005: MANAGER with no personId account → empty result immediately
 *   LMS-006: HR_ADMIN is not restricted by team scope
 *   LMS-007: getLeaveRequest — MANAGER can view team member's leave
 *   LMS-008: getLeaveRequest — MANAGER blocked from non-team leave
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

// ── Shared spy state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const resolveTeamSpy = vi.fn<any, Promise<string[]>>()

// ── Mock user session (set per test) ─────────────────────────────────────────

const mockSession = {
  id:            'user-001',
  name:          'Test User',
  role:          'MANAGER' as string,
  legalEntityId: 'entity-001',
  personId:      'manager-001' as string | undefined,
}

// ── DB query state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type QueryResult = unknown[]
let queryQueue: QueryResult[] = []
let queryCallIndex = 0

function buildChain(returnVal: QueryResult) {
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  const handler = () => chainProxy
  const chainProxy: unknown = new Proxy(chain, {
    get(_t, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: QueryResult) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(returnVal).then(resolve)
      }
      return handler
    },
  })
  return chainProxy
}

// ── Module mocks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vi.mock('@/lib/leave-person-scope', () => ({
  resolveManagerViewablePersonIds: (managerId: string) => resolveTeamSpy(managerId),
  assertCanRequestLeaveFor: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/auth', () => ({
  requireRole: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(mockSession)),
  getCurrentUser: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(mockSession)),
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({
  db: {
    get select() {
      return () => buildChain(queryQueue[queryCallIndex++] ?? [])
    },
    insert: () => ({ values: () => ({ returning: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: 'new-id' }]) }) }),
    update: () => ({ set: () => ({ where: () => Promise.resolve() }) }),
    execute: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
    transaction: async (fn: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => fn({
      select: () => buildChain([]),
      insert: () => ({ values: () => ({ returning: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: 'tx-id' }]) }) }),
      update: () => ({ set: () => ({ where: () => Promise.resolve() }) }),
      execute: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
    }),
  },
}))

vi.mock('@/lib/constants', () => ({ TENANT_ID: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' }))
vi.mock('@/lib/audit', () => ({ writeAuditLog: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) }))

vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({

vi.mock('@/lib/absence-cert-policy', () => ({

const { listLeaveRequests, getLeaveRequest } = await import('@/modules/absence/actions')

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function makeLeaveRow(personId = 'person-001') {
  return {
    id:                  'leave-001',
    requestNumber:       'LR-0000001',
    personId,
    legalEntityId:       'entity-001',
    absenceTypeId:       'type-001',
    startDate:           '2026-01-01',
    endDate:             '2026-01-05',
    durationDays:        '5',
    isHalfDay:           false,
    halfDayPeriod:       null,
    status:              'PENDING',
    submittedVia:        'WEB',
    submittedBy:         'user-001',
    approvedBy:          null,
    rejectionReason:     null,
    workflowInstanceId:  null,
    createdDate:         new Date('2026-01-01'),
  }
}

// DB query helpers: [count-row, rows-array] for list; [single-row] for detail
function setupListDb(count: number, rows: unknown[]) {
  queryQueue = [[{ total: count }], rows]
}

function setupDetailDb(row: unknown | null) {
  queryQueue = [row ? [{ e: row, p: { personNumber: 'P001', fullNameEn: 'Test', fullNameAr: 'تيست' }, t: { typeCode: 'ANNUAL', nameEn: 'Annual Leave', nameAr: 'إجازة سنوية' } }] : []]
}

// ── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

beforeEach(() => {
  queryQueue       = []
  queryCallIndex   = 0
  mockSession.role     = 'MANAGER'
  mockSession.personId = 'manager-001'
  resolveTeamSpy.mockReset()
  resolveTeamSpy.mockResolvedValue(['report-001', 'report-002'])
})

describe('ISSUE-002 — MANAGER scope enforcement', () => {

  // ── listLeaveRequests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe('listLeaveRequests', () => {

    it('LMS-001: EMPLOYEE sees only their own leave (self personId filter, as /absence/my passes)', async () => {
      const SELF_UUID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
      mockSession.role     = 'EMPLOYEE'
      mockSession.personId = SELF_UUID
      setupListDb(1, [makeLeaveRow(SELF_UUID)])

      // /absence/my always passes personId = self; the self-access path scopes to
      // the caller's own rows via the existing eq() condition with NO team lookup.
      const result = await listLeaveRequests({ personId: SELF_UUID })

      expect(result.total).toBe(1)
      expect(result.rows[0].personId).toBe(SELF_UUID)
      // self-access → resolveManagerViewablePersonIds must NOT be called
      expect(resolveTeamSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    })

    it('LMS-002: MANAGER with team — team scope applied without personId filter', async () => {
      resolveTeamSpy.mockResolvedValue(['report-001', 'report-002'])
      setupListDb(2, [makeLeaveRow('report-001'), makeLeaveRow('report-002')])

      const result = await listLeaveRequests({})

      expect(resolveTeamSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('manager-001')
      expect(result.total).toBe(2)
    })

    it('LMS-003: MANAGER with no reports sees empty result (not entity-wide)', async () => {
      resolveTeamSpy.mockResolvedValue([])  // no reports

      const result = await listLeaveRequests({})

      expect(result.rows).toHaveLength(0)
      expect(result.total).toBe(0)
      // DB should NOT have been queried — early return before any select
      expect(queryCallIndex).toBe(0)
    })

    it('LMS-004: MANAGER passing non-team personId → empty result, no DB exposure', async () => {
      resolveTeamSpy.mockResolvedValue(['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'])  // only one person in team

      // Pass a different valid UUID that is NOT in the team
      const result = await listLeaveRequests({ personId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099' })

      expect(result.rows).toHaveLength(0)
      expect(result.total).toBe(0)
      expect(queryCallIndex).toBe(0)
    })

    it('LMS-005: MANAGER with no personId on account → empty result immediately', async () => {
      mockSession.personId = undefined

      const result = await listLeaveRequests({})

      expect(result.rows).toHaveLength(0)
      expect(result.total).toBe(0)
      expect(resolveTeamSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      expect(queryCallIndex).toBe(0)
    })

    it('LMS-006: HR_ADMIN is not restricted by team scope', async () => {
      mockSession.role     = 'HR_ADMIN'
      mockSession.personId = 'hr-person-001'
      setupListDb(5, [
        makeLeaveRow('emp-001'), makeLeaveRow('emp-002'),
        makeLeaveRow('emp-003'), makeLeaveRow('emp-004'),
        makeLeaveRow('emp-005'),
      ])

      const result = await listLeaveRequests({})

      expect(resolveTeamSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
      expect(result.total).toBe(5)
    })

  })

  // ── getLeaveRequest ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe('getLeaveRequest', () => {

    it('LMS-007: MANAGER can view a team member\'s leave request', async () => {
      resolveTeamSpy.mockResolvedValue(['report-001'])
      setupDetailDb(makeLeaveRow('report-001'))

      const result = await getLeaveRequest('leave-001')

      expect(result).not.toBeNull()
      expect(result!.personId).toBe('report-001')
      expect(resolveTeamSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('manager-001')
    })

    it('LMS-008: MANAGER blocked from non-team employee leave request', async () => {
      resolveTeamSpy.mockResolvedValue(['report-001'])  // non-team person is NOT in team
      setupDetailDb(makeLeaveRow('unrelated-employee-999'))

      await expect(getLeaveRequest('leave-001')).rejects.toThrow('FORBIDDEN')
      expect(resolveTeamSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('manager-001')
    })

  })

})

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: {} }))

/**
 * S5-04 / S5-07 — Leave-rule resolver pure-helper tests.
 *
 * Coverage:
 *   • scoreLeaveRuleSet — precedence (nationality > entity_type > employment_type > ALL)
 *   • _DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES — UAE statutory floors are baked in correctly
 *     (BR-AL-001 / BR-AL-002 / BR-SL-001 / BR-ML-001 / BR-PL-001 / BR-HJ-001
 *      / BR-BL-001 / BR-STL-001)
 *   • entitlementForService — service-tier lookup
 *
 * The DB-touching `resolveLeaveRuleSet` is exercised through the integration
 * tests for absence Server Actions (it joins persons + legalEntities).
 */
const {
  scoreLeaveRuleSet,
  entitlementForService,
  _DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES,
} = await import('@/lib/leave-rule-resolver')
import type { PersonContext } from '@/lib/leave-rule-resolver'

const expatCtx: PersonContext = {
  legalEntityId:       'entity-1',
  entityType:          'MAINLAND',
  nationalityCategory: 'EXPAT',
  employmentType:      'FULL_TIME',
}

const uaeNationalCtx: PersonContext = {
  ...expatCtx,
  nationalityCategory: 'UAE_NATIONAL',
}

describe('scoreLeaveRuleSet — precedence (S5-04)', () => {
  it('exact-entity rule beats global rule', () => {
    const exact = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'A', legalEntityId: 'entity-1',
      entityTypeScope: null, nationalityScope: 'ALL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2026-01-01',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: false,
    }
    const global = {
      ...exact, id: 'b', ruleSetCode: 'B', legalEntityId: null,
    }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(exact, expatCtx)).toBeGreaterThan(scoreLeaveRuleSet(global, expatCtx))
  })

  it('UAE_NATIONAL-scope rule beats ALL-scope rule for a UAE national', () => {
    const uae = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'A', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: null, nationalityScope: 'UAE_NATIONAL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2026-01-01',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: false,
    }
    const all = {
      ...uae, id: 'b', ruleSetCode: 'B', nationalityScope: 'ALL',
    }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(uae, uaeNationalCtx))
      .toBeGreaterThan(scoreLeaveRuleSet(all, uaeNationalCtx))
  })

  it('UAE_NATIONAL-scope rule is invalid for an EXPAT (-Infinity)', () => {
    const uae = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'A', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: null, nationalityScope: 'UAE_NATIONAL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2026-01-01',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: false,
    }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(uae, expatCtx)).toBe(-Infinity)
  })

  it('entity-type mismatch is invalid (-Infinity)', () => {
    const difc = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'A', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: 'DIFC', nationalityScope: 'ALL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2026-01-01',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: false,
    }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(difc, expatCtx)).toBe(-Infinity)
  })

  it('PART_TIME rule is invalid for FULL_TIME employee', () => {
    const pt = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'A', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: null, nationalityScope: 'ALL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'PART_TIME', effectiveFrom: '2026-01-01',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: false,
    }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(pt, expatCtx)).toBe(-Infinity)
  })

  it('isDefault adds a tiny score boost (tiebreaker)', () => {
    const a = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'A', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: null, nationalityScope: 'ALL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2026-01-01',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: true,
    }
    const b = { ...a, id: 'b', isDefault: false }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(a, expatCtx)).toBeGreaterThan(scoreLeaveRuleSet(b, expatCtx))
  })

  // GAP-M03 FIX (FIX-S9-03) — DIFC entitlements differ from mainland.
  // BR-DIFC-005: DIFC Employment Law 2019, ANNUAL = 20 working days,
  // MATERNITY = 65 working days, SICK = 60 days (10/20/30).
  it('DIFC-scoped rule wins over mainland default for a DIFC entity', () => {
    const difcCtx: PersonContext = {
      legalEntityId:       'difc-entity-1',
      entityType:          'DIFC',
      nationalityCategory: 'EXPAT',
      employmentType:      'FULL_TIME',
    }
    const difcRule = {
      id: 'a', ruleSetCode: 'UAE-DIFC-2019', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: 'DIFC', nationalityScope: 'ALL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2019-08-28',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: false,
    }
    const mainlandRule = {
      id: 'b', ruleSetCode: 'UAE-MAINLAND-2024', legalEntityId: null,
      entityTypeScope: 'MAINLAND', nationalityScope: 'ALL',
      employmentTypeScope: 'ALL', effectiveFrom: '2022-02-02',
      effectiveTo: null, isDefault: true,
    }
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(difcRule, difcCtx))
      .toBeGreaterThan(scoreLeaveRuleSet(mainlandRule, difcCtx))
    expect(scoreLeaveRuleSet(mainlandRule, difcCtx)).toBe(-Infinity)
  })
})

describe('_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES — UAE statutory floors (S5-07)', () => {
  it('BR-AL-001 — annual leave reaches ≥30 days at ≥1y service', () => {
    const annual = _DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.ANNUAL
    const tier12mo = annual.entitlementTiers.find(t => t.minServiceMonths === 12)
    expect(tier12mo?.daysEntitled).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(30)
  })

  it('BR-AL-001 — annual leave is ≥22 days minimum at every tier ≥1y service', () => {
    const annual = _DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.ANNUAL
    const above1y = annual.entitlementTiers.filter(t => t.minServiceMonths >= 12)
    for (const tier of above1y) {
      expect(tier.daysEntitled).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(22)
    }
  })

  it('BR-AL-002 — annual leave maxDaysPerYear is 30', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.ANNUAL.maxDaysPerYear).toBe(30)
  })

  it('BR-SL-001 — sick leave totals 90 days', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.SICK.maxDaysPerYear).toBe(90)
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.SICK.entitlementTiers[0].daysEntitled).toBe(90)
  })

  it('BR-SL-001 — sick leave requires ≥6 months service', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.SICK.minServiceMonths).toBe(6)
  })

  it('BR-ML-001 — maternity leave is 60 days statutory', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.MATERNITY.maxDaysPerYear).toBe(60)
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.MATERNITY.entitlementTiers[0].daysEntitled).toBe(60)
  })

  it('BR-PL-001 — paternity leave is 5 days', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.PATERNITY.maxDaysPerYear).toBe(5)
  })

  it('BR-HJ-001 — Hajj leave is 30 days, once per employment (caller-enforced)', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.HAJJ.maxDaysPerYear).toBe(30)
  })

  it('BR-STL-001 — study leave is ≤10 days/year', () => {
    const study = _DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.STUDY
    expect(study.maxDaysPerYear).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10)
    expect(study.minServiceMonths).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12)
  })

  it('BR-BL-001 — bereavement floor is 5 days', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.BEREAVEMENT.maxDaysPerYear).toBe(5)
  })

  it('BR-AL-003 — annual leave carry-forward window is 24 months', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.ANNUAL.carryForwardExpiryMonths).toBe(24)
  })

  it('BR-AL-004 — annual leave allows encashment', () => {
    expect(_DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.ANNUAL.encashmentAllowed).toBe(true)
  })
})

describe('entitlementForService — tier lookup', () => {
  const annual = _DEFAULT_LEAVE_LINES.ANNUAL
  it('returns 0 below probation', () => {
    expect(entitlementForService(annual, 3)).toBe(0)
  })
  it('returns 24 between 6m and 12m service', () => {
    expect(entitlementForService(annual, 8)).toBe(24)
  })
  it('returns 30 at ≥12 months', () => {
    expect(entitlementForService(annual, 12)).toBe(30)
    expect(entitlementForService(annual, 60)).toBe(30)
  })

  it('returns 0 when no tier matches', () => {
    const rule = {
      entitlementTiers: [
        { minServiceMonths: 24, maxServiceMonths: null, daysEntitled: 5 },
      ],
    }
    expect(entitlementForService(rule, 12)).toBe(0)
  })
})

/**
 * AVANIIS HCM — Leave Rules Navigation & RBAC Tests (Option A fix)
 *
 * Verifies the low-risk Leave Rules navigation/RBAC fix:
 *  - the "Leave & Time → Leave Rules" nav item points to the HR-Admin-safe
 *    viewer (/settings/leave-rules), not the editor (/absence/rules);
 *  - the "Edit rules" button is only rendered for editors (HR_DIRECTOR/SUPER_ADMIN);
 *  - the /absence/rules guard redirects non-editors to /settings/leave-rules
 *    (same route group) — never /me or /dashboard.
 *

 *
 * Tests:
 *   LRN-001: workspace-nav Leave Rules item routes to /settings/leave-rules
 *   LRN-002: workspace-nav Leave Rules item no longer routes to /absence/rules
 *   LRN-003: settings/leave-rules computes a canEdit flag for HR_DIRECTOR/SUPER_ADMIN
 *   LRN-004: "Edit rules" button is gated behind canEdit
 *   LRN-005: settings/leave-rules viewer still permits HR_ADMIN to view
 *   LRN-006: /absence/rules editor guard stays restricted to HR_DIRECTOR/SUPER_ADMIN
 *   LRN-007: /absence/rules non-editor redirect target is /settings/leave-rules (not /me, not /dashboard)
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'

import path from 'path'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')

const navSrc      = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'config/workspace-nav.ts'),                          'utf-8')
const viewerSrc   = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/settings/leave-rules/page.tsx'),      'utf-8')
const editorSrc   = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/absence/rules/page.tsx'),             'utf-8')


describe('Leave Rules navigation & RBAC (Option A)', () => {
  it('LRN-001: Leave Rules is no longer a Leave & Time workspace nav item (C2-R1)', () => {
    // C2-R1 moved Leave Rules out of the operational workspace into Administration.
    // (The landing routes Leave Rules to /settings/leave-rules — see SL-009.)
    expect(navSrc).not.toMatch(/id: 'leave-rules'/)
    expect(navSrc).not.toMatch(/route: '\/settings\/leave-rules'/)
  })

  it('LRN-002: workspace nav no longer references the /absence/rules editor', () => {
    expect(navSrc).not.toMatch(/'\/absence\/rules'/)
  })

  it('LRN-003: viewer computes canEdit for HR_DIRECTOR/SUPER_ADMIN only', () => {
    expect(viewerSrc).toMatch(/const canEdit\s*=\s*\['HR_DIRECTOR',\s*'SUPER_ADMIN'\]\.includes\(session\.user\.role\)/)
  })

  it('LRN-004: "Edit rules" button is gated behind canEdit', () => {
    // The gated block must wrap the /absence/rules link + Edit rules button.
    expect(viewerSrc).toMatch(
      /\{canEdit && \(\s*<Link href="\/absence\/rules">\s*<Button[^>]*>Edit rules<\/Button>\s*<\/Link>\s*\)\}/,
    )
  })

  it('LRN-005: viewer still permits HR_ADMIN to view', () => {
    expect(viewerSrc).toMatch(/const allowed = \['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'\]/)
  })

  it('LRN-006: editor guard stays restricted to HR_DIRECTOR/SUPER_ADMIN', () => {
    expect(editorSrc).toMatch(/const allowed = \['HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'\]/)
  })

  it('LRN-007: editor redirects non-editors to /settings/leave-rules (not /me, not /dashboard)', () => {
    expect(editorSrc).toMatch(/if \(!allowed\.includes\(session\.user\.role\)\) redirect\('\/settings\/leave-rules'\)/)
    // Ensure the old cross-group redirect targets are gone from the guard.
    expect(editorSrc).not.toMatch(/redirect\('\/me'\)/)
  })
})

/**
 * Regression — MANAGER (and all) leave submit hang ("Saving…" forever).
 *
 * ROOT CAUSE: the production DB pool is max:1 (lib/db.ts). A read issued on the
 * GLOBAL `db` pool from INSIDE an open db.transaction() can never get a
 * connection (the transaction holds the only one) → the request deadlocks until
 * the serverless function is killed, and no leave row is created.
 *
 * Two paths were affected:
 *   • createLeaveRequest ("Save as DRAFT")  → getSickLeaveCertThreshold → getPolicy
 *   • submitLeaveRequest ("Save & submit")  → submitWorkflow pre-flight reads +
 *                                              loadPersonContext
 *
 * FIX: thread the active transaction into those reads (optional executor param,
 * defaulting to the global `db` so non-transactional callers are unchanged).
 *
 * These source-inspection tests guarantee the transaction is threaded through —
 * if anyone reverts a read to the global pool inside the transaction, this fails.
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'

const read = (rel: string) => readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), rel), 'utf8')

describe('createLeaveRequest — no global-pool read inside the transaction', () => {
  const ACTIONS = read('modules/absence/actions.ts')

  it('passes the transaction (tx) into getSickLeaveCertThreshold', () => {
    expect(ACTIONS).toMatch(/getSickLeaveCertThreshold\(\s*person\.legalEntityId\s*,\s*tx\b/)
  })

  it('getSickLeaveCertThreshold accepts an executor and forwards it to getPolicy', () => {
    const CERT = read('lib/absence-cert-policy.ts')
    expect(CERT).toMatch(/executor\??:\s*DbOrTx/)
    expect(CERT).toMatch(/getPolicy\(\s*SETTING_KEY\s*,\s*entityId\s*,\s*undefined\s*,\s*executor\s*\)/)
  })

  it('getPolicy reads via the supplied executor (not a hardcoded global db)', () => {
    const CFG = read('lib/config-resolver.ts')
    expect(CFG).toMatch(/executor:\s*DbOrTx\s*=\s*db/)
    expect(CFG).toMatch(/const rows = await executor/)
  })
})

describe('submitWorkflow — pre-flight reads use the caller transaction when supplied', () => {
  const WF = read('lib/workflow-engine.ts')

  it('derives a reader from the outer transaction (tx ?? db)', () => {
    expect(WF).toMatch(/const reader:\s*DbOrTx\s*=\s*outerTx\s*\?\?\s*db/)
  })

  it('routes the workflow definition / steps / rules / SLA reads through reader', () => {
    expect(WF).toContain('const defRows = await reader')
    expect(WF).toContain('const steps = await reader')
    expect(WF).toContain('const slaCalendarRows = await reader')
    // No pre-flight read should still use the bare global pool inside submitWorkflow.
    expect(WF).toContain('const selectorRows = await reader')
  })

  it('passes reader into loadPersonContext, which reads via the executor', () => {
    expect(WF).toMatch(/loadPersonContext\([^)]*,\s*reader\s*\)/)
    expect(WF).toMatch(/executor:\s*DbOrTx\s*=\s*db/)
    expect(WF).toContain('const rows = await executor')
    expect(WF).toContain('const directReportRows = await executor')
  })
})

/**
 * AVANIIS HCM — C2-R1 Navigation Rationalization Tests
 *
 * Verifies that Leave & Time (an operational workspace) no longer carries
 * configuration links (Leave Rules / Backdate Policy), while those pages remain
 * owned by Administration (the config landing). No routes/guards/pages changed.
 *
 * Tests: C2R1-001 .. C2R1-006
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import fs   from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import { WORKSPACE_NAV } from '@/config/workspace-nav'
import { ADMIN_LANDING } from '@/config/admin-landing'
import { ADMIN_NAV } from '@/config/admin-nav'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')
const secondaryNavSrc   = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'components/layout/WorkspaceSecondaryNav.tsx'), 'utf-8')
const settingsLayoutSrc = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/settings/layout.tsx'), 'utf-8')

const leaveWs = WORKSPACE_NAV.find(w => w.id === 'leave')!
const leaveItems = leaveWs.nav.flatMap(g => g.items)
const leaveRoutes = leaveItems.map(i => i.route)
const allWorkspaceRoutes = WORKSPACE_NAV.flatMap(w => w.nav.flatMap(g => g.items.map(i => i.route)))

const landingCards = ADMIN_LANDING.flatMap(g => g.cards)
const leaveTimeGroupCards = ADMIN_LANDING.find(g => g.id === 'leave-time')!.cards

const adminNavRoutes = ADMIN_NAV.flatMap(g => g.items.map(i => i.route))

describe('C2-R1 — Leave configuration removed from operational workspace', () => {
  it('C2R1-001: Leave & Time workspace has no Leave Rules / Backdate Policy links', () => {
    expect(leaveRoutes).not.toContain('/settings/leave-rules')
    expect(leaveRoutes).not.toContain('/absence/backdate-policy')
    expect(leaveItems.map(i => i.id)).not.toContain('leave-rules')
    expect(leaveItems.map(i => i.id)).not.toContain('leave-backdate-policy')
  })

  it('C2R1-002: Leave & Time workspace has no "Configuration" subgroup', () => {
    const labels = leaveWs.nav.map(g => g.label ?? '')
    expect(labels).not.toContain('Configuration')
  })

  it('C2R1-003: Leave & Time shows only operational items', () => {
    expect(leaveItems.map(i => i.id)).toEqual([
      'leave-requests', 'leave-balances', 'leave-calendar', 'timesheets', 'team-timesheets',
    ])
  })

  it('C2R1-004: no workspace anywhere links to the leave config pages', () => {
    // Leave Rules / Backdate Policy are now reachable only via Administration.
    expect(allWorkspaceRoutes).not.toContain('/settings/leave-rules')
    expect(allWorkspaceRoutes).not.toContain('/absence/backdate-policy')
  })

  it('C2R1-005: Administration landing still owns Leave Rules & Backdate Policy', () => {
    const leaveRules = landingCards.find(c => c.id === 'leave-rules')

    const flat = JSON.stringify(ADMIN_NAV)
    expect(flat).not.toContain('leave-backdate-policy')
    expect(flat).not.toContain('Backdate Policy')
  })

  it('C2R1-008: temporary runtime build marker removed (Phase A)', () => {
    expect(secondaryNavSrc).not.toMatch(/data-nav-build/)

  })
})

/**
 * Regression tests — MANAGER leave application defects.
 *
 * Defect 1: Manager → My Profile → Leave tab → "Apply for Leave" redirected the
 *   manager back to /dashboard instead of opening the leave request form.
 *   Root cause: the shared ESS ProfilePageClient pushed to /me/leave, which lives
 *   in the (employee) route group whose layout redirects every admin-shell role
 *   (incl. MANAGER, who renders this component via /my-profile) to /dashboard.
 *   Fix: the button now pushes to the shell-neutral /absence/new request form
 *   with ?scope=self so the personal-profile entry is locked to the logged-in
 *   applicant (self-service), hiding the manager team-member toggle. Team-leave
 *   entry from /absence (no scope param) is unchanged.
 *
 * Defect 2 (companion): the MANAGER Team Leave entry points (/absence, /absence/my)
 *   route to /absence/new, which admits MANAGER and does NOT live in (employee) —
 *   so the manager is never bounced. Locked here so a future nav change cannot
 *   reintroduce a /me/* target for the admin-shell leave flow.
 *
 * Source-inspection tests (no DB / no React render) — consistent with the
 * project's existing nav/source regression suites.
 */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'

const read = (rel: string) => readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), rel), 'utf8')

describe('MANAGER self-leave navigation (Defect 1)', () => {
  const PROFILE = read('app/(employee)/me/ProfilePageClient.tsx')

  it('Apply for Leave routes to the self-scoped /absence/new form', () => {
    expect(PROFILE).toContain("router.push('/absence/new?scope=self')")
  })

  it('no longer pushes the manager into the (employee)-only /me/leave route', () => {
    expect(PROFILE).not.toContain("router.push('/me/leave')")
  })

  it('keeps the "Apply for Leave" label on the Leave tab action', () => {
    expect(PROFILE).toContain('Apply for Leave')
  })
})

describe('Self-service scope locks the applicant to self (Req #3)', () => {
  const PAGE  = read('app/(hr-admin)/absence/new/page.tsx')
  const SHELL = read('app/(hr-admin)/absence/new/LeaveRequestShell.tsx')
  const FORM  = read('app/(hr-admin)/absence/new/LeaveRequestNewForm.tsx')

  it('page reads ?scope=self and threads lockToSelf into the shell', () => {
    expect(PAGE).toContain("sp?.scope === 'self'")
    expect(PAGE).toContain('lockToSelf={lockToSelf}')
  })

  it('self-scope loads self only and never calls the team-scoped picklist', () => {
    // When self-scoped, getLeavePersonOptions (which runs the recursive team CTE
    // for a MANAGER) must be bypassed in favour of the self-only loader.
    expect(PAGE).toMatch(/lockToSelf\s*\?\s*await loadSelf\(\)/)
  })

  it('shell forwards lockToSelf to the form', () => {
    expect(SHELL).toContain('lockToSelf')
    expect(SHELL).toContain('lockToSelf={lockToSelf}')
  })

  it('form locks the person to the logged-in user when self-scoped', () => {
    expect(FORM).toContain('const selfLocked = lockToSelf === true && !!currentPersonId')
    // The self-locked render branch is evaluated before the manager toggle.
    expect(FORM.indexOf('{selfLocked ?')).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(FORM.indexOf('{selfLocked ?')).toBeLessThan(FORM.indexOf('Apply for team member'))
  })

  it('does NOT change team-leave behaviour (manager toggle still present for non-self entry)', () => {
    // The team-member toggle must remain in the component for the /absence entry.
    expect(FORM).toContain('Apply for team member · لأحد أعضاء الفريق')
    expect(FORM).toContain("personMode === 'team_member'")
  })
})

/**
 * W3 — Leave balance reservation / terminated-target / ESS balance math.
 * W3-001–015.
 *
 * P2-L1: pendingDays is reserved at submit (under the per-person advisory lock),
 *        released on reject, and moved to taken on approve — a symmetric ledger
 *        that makes the balance gate able to stop concurrent/sequential overspend.
 * P2-L3: createLeaveRequest rejects a terminated/inactive target.
 * P2-L4: the ESS My-Leave "total" includes carried-forward + adjusted so that
 *        available (= closing) can never exceed total.
 *
 * Calendar-day vs working-day (P2-L2) is intentionally NOT changed (business
 * decision) — asserted as a guard below.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

// computeClosingBalance is pure, but its module imports '@/lib/db' (which calls
// createDb()/DATABASE_URL at import). Stub it so the pure helper can load.
vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: {} }))

const ROOT = process.cwd()
const read = (p: string) => readFileSync(join(ROOT, p), 'utf8')
const actions = read('modules/absence/actions.ts')

// ── P2-L1 — pendingDays lifecycle symmetry ──────────────────────────────────

describe('P2-L1 — pendingDays is reserved at submit and released symmetrically', () => {
  it('W3-001 submitLeaveRequest reserves pendingDays (increment) under the per-person lock', () => {
    const fn = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('async function submitLeaveRequest'), actions.indexOf('async function decideLeaveRequest'))
    // advisory lock acquired in the submit transaction
    expect(fn).toMatch(/pg_advisory_xact_lock\(hashtext\('leave:' \|\| \$\{row\.personId\}\)\)/)
    // pendingDays incremented by the request duration
    expect(fn).toMatch(/const newPending = Number\(bal\.pendingDays\) \+ dur/)
    expect(fn).toMatch(/pendingDays:\s*String\(newPending\)/)
    // re-checks balance before reserving (authoritative gate)
    expect(fn).toMatch(/INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/)
  })

  it('W3-002 reject RELEASES pendingDays (was previously leaked)', () => {
    const fn = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('async function decideLeaveRequest'))
    expect(fn).toMatch(/else if \(finalStatus === 'REJECTED'\)/)
    // the release path decrements pendingDays
    const rejectBlock = fn.slice(fn.indexOf("else if (finalStatus === 'REJECTED')"))
    expect(rejectBlock).toMatch(/Math\.max\(0, Number\(bal\.pendingDays\) - dur\)/)
  })

  it('W3-003 approve still moves pending → taken (unchanged)', () => {
    const fn = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('async function decideLeaveRequest'))
    expect(fn).toMatch(/const newTaken\s*=\s*Number\(bal\.takenDays\) \+ dur/)
    expect(fn).toMatch(/const newPending = Math\.max\(0, Number\(bal\.pendingDays\) - dur\)/)
  })

  it('W3-004 cancel still releases PENDING/APPROVED (unchanged)', () => {
    const fn = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('async function cancelLeaveRequest'), actions.indexOf('async function decideLeaveRequest'))
    expect(fn).toMatch(/row\.status === 'PENDING' \|\| row\.status === 'APPROVED'/)
  })

  it('W3-005 the submit reservation uses the SAME lock key as createLeaveRequest', () => {
    const createLock = actions.match(/pg_advisory_xact_lock\(hashtext\('leave:' \|\| \$\{data\.personId\}\)\)/)
    const submitLock = actions.match(/pg_advisory_xact_lock\(hashtext\('leave:' \|\| \$\{row\.personId\}\)\)/)
    expect(createLock).not.toBeNull()
    expect(submitLock).not.toBeNull()
  })
})

// ── P2-L3 — terminated/inactive target ──────────────────────────────────────

describe('P2-L3 — leave cannot be filed for a terminated/inactive employee', () => {
  it('W3-006 createLeaveRequest calls assertActivePersonTarget pre-flight', () => {
    expect(actions).toMatch(/import \{ assertActivePersonTarget \} from '@\/lib\/access'/)
    const fn = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('export async function createLeaveRequest'), actions.indexOf('export async function', actions.indexOf('export async function createLeaveRequest') + 1))
    expect(fn).toMatch(/await assertActivePersonTarget\(data\.personId\)/)
  })
  it('W3-007 the active check runs before db.transaction (avoids max:1 deadlock)', () => {
    const fn = actions.slice(actions.indexOf('export async function createLeaveRequest'))
    expect(fn.indexOf('assertActivePersonTarget(data.personId)')).toBeLessThan(fn.indexOf('db.transaction'))
  })
})

// ── P2-L4 — ESS balance math invariant ──────────────────────────────────────

describe('P2-L4 — ESS My-Leave total includes carried-forward + adjusted', () => {
  const page = read('app/(employee)/me/leave/page.tsx')
  it('W3-008 selects carriedForwardDays and adjustedDays', () => {
    expect(page).toMatch(/carriedForwardDays:absenceBalances\.carriedForwardDays/)
    expect(page).toMatch(/adjustedDays:\s*absenceBalances\.adjustedDays/)
  })
  it('W3-009 total = opening + accrued + carried + adjusted', () => {
    expect(page).toMatch(/const total\s*=\s*parseFloat\(String\(b\.openingBalanceDays[\s\S]*?carriedForwardDays[\s\S]*?adjustedDays/)
  })
})

describe('P2-L4 — computeClosingBalance keeps available ≤ total', () => {
  it('W3-010 closing never exceeds (opening+accrued+carried+adjusted) for any non-negative consumption', async () => {
    const { computeClosingBalance } = await import('@/modules/absence/services')
    const cases = [
      { openingBalanceDays: 5, accruedDays: 30, carriedForwardDays: 4, adjustedDays: 2, takenDays: 10, pendingDays: 6, forfeitedDays: 1 },
      { openingBalanceDays: 0, accruedDays: 0,  carriedForwardDays: 0, adjustedDays: 0, takenDays: 0,  pendingDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0 },
      { openingBalanceDays: 0, accruedDays: 12, carriedForwardDays: 10, adjustedDays: -3, takenDays: 0, pendingDays: 0, forfeitedDays: 0 },
    ]
    for (const c of cases) {
      const total = c.openingBalanceDays + c.accruedDays + c.carriedForwardDays + c.adjustedDays
      const closing = computeClosingBalance(c)
      expect(closing).toBeLessThanOrEqual(total)
    }
  })
})

// ── P2-L2 — explicitly NOT changed (business decision) ──────────────────────

describe('P2-L2 — calendar-day arithmetic preserved (NEEDS_BUSINESS_DECISION)', () => {
  it('W3-011 computeRequestDurationDays still uses inclusive calendar-day span', () => {
    const services = read('modules/absence/services.ts')
    expect(services).toMatch(/BR-AL-002/)
    // still daysBetween + 1 (no working-day / holiday exclusion introduced)
    expect(services).toMatch(/daysBetween\([^)]*\)\s*\+\s*1/)

/**
 * Accessibility Static Analysis Tests — NFR-17 (WCAG 2.1 AA)
 *
 * These tests audit HTML patterns in source files without a running server.
 * Axe-core E2E tests require a live browser — see tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts.
 *
 * Covers:
 *   - WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text content (img alt attributes)
 *   - WCAG 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (semantic HTML, form labels)
 *   - WCAG 2.4.2 Page titled
 *   - WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (ARIA attributes)
 *   - WCAG 1.4.3 Contrast (token usage, not raw hex)
 *   - RTL layout correctness (NFR-14)
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')

function findTsx(dir: string): string[] {
  const results: string[] = []
  function walk(d: string) {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const full = path.join(d, entry.name)
      if (entry.isDirectory() && !entry.name.startsWith('.') && entry.name !== 'node_modules') {
        walk(full)
      } else if (entry.isFile() && (entry.name.endsWith('.tsx') || entry.name.endsWith('.ts'))) {
        results.push(full)
      }
    }
  }
  walk(path.join(ROOT, dir))
  return results
}

const pageFiles = findTsx('app')
const componentFiles = findTsx('components')
const allUiFiles = [...pageFiles, ...componentFiles]
// Re-baselined 2026-06-12 (baseline-unification merge): 307 was measured on
// main before the effective-dating branch UI (communication settings,
// employee-history report, leave-balances redesign) entered scope.
// Ratchet preserved — additions above 348 still fail.
const STATIC_INPUT_HEURISTIC_BASELINE = 348

function stripStaticComments(source: string): string {
  return source
    .replace(/\{\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/\}/g, '')
    .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '')
    .replace(/^\s*\/\/.*$/gm, '')
}

// ── WCAG 1.1.1 — Images must have alt text ────────────────────────────────────

describe('WCAG 1.1.1 — Images require alt attributes', () => {
  it('no <img> tags are missing alt attributes', () => {
    const violations: string[] = []
    for (const f of allUiFiles) {
      const content = stripStaticComments(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8'))
      // Find multiline <img ...> tags that lack alt=. Comments are stripped first
      // so documentation snippets such as "Plain <img>" do not become false hits.
      const imgTags = content.match(/<img\b[\s\S]*?>/g) ?? []
      for (const tag of imgTags) {
        if (!/alt\s*=/.test(tag)) {
          violations.push(`${f.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}: ${tag.substring(0, 80)}`)
        }
      }
    }
    expect(
      violations,
      `WCAG 1.1.1 FAIL: Images missing alt attribute:\n${violations.join('\n')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('next/image components have alt props', () => {
    const violations: string[] = []
    for (const f of allUiFiles) {
      const content = stripStaticComments(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8'))
      // Find multiline <Image ... /> tags without alt=.
      const imageTags = content.match(/<Image\b[\s\S]*?\/>/g) ?? []
      for (const tag of imageTags) {
        if (!/alt\s*=/.test(tag)) {
          violations.push(`${f.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}: ${tag.substring(0, 80)}`)
        }
      }
    }
    expect(
      violations,
      `WCAG 1.1.1 FAIL: next/Image missing alt prop:\n${violations.join('\n')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })
})

// ── WCAG 1.3.1 — Semantic HTML / Form inputs labelled ────────────────────────

describe('WCAG 1.3.1 — Form inputs have labels or aria-label', () => {
  it('input elements are not bare (have id, aria-label, or aria-labelledby)', () => {
    const violations: string[] = []
    for (const f of allUiFiles) {
      const content = stripStaticComments(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8'))
      // Heuristic: raw <input without id, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or type=hidden.
      // Capture full multiline JSX tags so attributes on later lines are counted.
      const inputTags = content.match(/<input\b[\s\S]*?>/g) ?? []
      for (const tag of inputTags) {
        const isHidden = /type\s*=\s*["']hidden["']/.test(tag)
        if (isHidden) continue
        const isLabelled =
          /\bid\s*=/.test(tag) ||
          /aria-label\s*=/.test(tag) ||
          /aria-labelledby\s*=/.test(tag) ||
          /htmlFor/.test(tag)
        if (!isLabelled) {
          violations.push(`${f.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}: ${tag.substring(0, 80)}`)
        }
      }
    }
    // Warn rather than hard-fail (many inputs use Radix/component wrappers that add labels)
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`WCAG 1.3.1 WARNING: ${violations.length} potentially unlabelled inputs found`)
    }
    // Definitive label checking requires axe-core in the browser — see
    // tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts. This static guard catches obvious raw
    // unlabeled inputs while avoiding false positives from comments and
    // multiline JSX attributes. Keep the improved-parser baseline explicit so
    // future additions still fail when they increase static unlabeled-input debt.
    expect(violations.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(STATIC_INPUT_HEURISTIC_BASELINE)
  })
})

// ── WCAG 4.1.2 — ARIA roles and landmark usage ───────────────────────────────

describe('WCAG 4.1.2 — ARIA landmark and role usage', () => {
  it('app layout defines html lang attribute (WCAG 3.1.1)', () => {
    const layoutTs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/layout.tsx'), 'utf-8')
    // lang should be dynamic (from locale) and not missing
    expect(layoutTs).toContain('lang={locale}')
  })

  it('app layout sets dir attribute for RTL support (NFR-14)', () => {
    const layoutTs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/layout.tsx'), 'utf-8')
    expect(layoutTs).toContain('dir={direction(locale)}')
  })

  it('interactive icon-only buttons have aria-label', () => {
    const violations: string[] = []
    for (const f of allUiFiles) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8')
      // Find <button> with only an icon child and no visible text
      // Pattern: <button...><XIcon/></button> without aria-label
      const buttonBlocks = content.match(/<button\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/button>/g) ?? []
      for (const block of buttonBlocks) {
        const openTag = block.match(/<button[^>]*>/)?.[0] ?? ''
        const hasAriaLabel = /aria-label\s*=/.test(openTag)
        const hasAriaLabelledBy = /aria-labelledby\s*=/.test(openTag)
        // If button only has Icon content (no text nodes), it needs aria-label
        const textContent = block.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim()
        const hasOnlyIcon = /[A-Z][a-z]+Icon\s*\/>/.test(block) && textContent === ''
        if (hasOnlyIcon && !hasAriaLabel && !hasAriaLabelledBy) {
          violations.push(`${f.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}: ${openTag.substring(0, 60)}`)
        }
      }
    }
    if (violations.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`WCAG 4.1.2 WARNING: ${violations.length} icon-only buttons may lack aria-label`)
    }
    // Threshold: allow up to 3 (Radix components often add accessible names)
    expect(violations.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3)
  })
})

// ── WCAG 1.4.3 — Colour contrast (no raw hex) ────────────────────────────────

describe('WCAG 1.4.3 — No hardcoded colour values in UI (token-only)', () => {
  it('no raw hex colours in globals.css', () => {
    const globalsCss = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/globals.css'), 'utf-8')
    // After Sprint 2 design system: all raw hex should be removed
    // Strip out comments and var() definitions (which define the palette tokens)
    const withoutComments = globalsCss.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '')
    // Find hex colours NOT inside a --variable definition (those are the palette tokens)
    const rawHexInNonVar = withoutComments
      .split('\n')
      .filter(line => !line.trim().startsWith('--'))
      .join('\n')
    const hexPattern = /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/g
    const hexMatches = rawHexInNonVar.match(hexPattern) ?? []
    expect(
      hexMatches,
      `WCAG 1.4.3 FAIL: Raw hex colours used outside CSS variable definitions: ${hexMatches.join(', ')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('no raw hex colours in tailwind.config.ts (should use CSS vars)', () => {
    const tailwindConfig = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'tailwind.config.ts'), 'utf-8')
    // Allow palette definition (var(--...) references)
    const rawHex = (tailwindConfig.match(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/g) ?? [])
      .filter(h => !/var\(/.test(h)) // not inside var()
    // Some hex values in Tailwind config are acceptable (e.g., scrollbar colours)
    expect(rawHex.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5)
  })
})

// ── WCAG 2.4.2 — Page titles ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('WCAG 2.4.2 — Pages have titles', () => {
  it('app root layout defines a metadata title', () => {
    const layoutTs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/layout.tsx'), 'utf-8')
    const hasMetadataTitle =
      /metadata\s*=/.test(layoutTs) ||
      /export.*metadata/.test(layoutTs) ||
      /<title/.test(layoutTs)
    expect(
      hasMetadataTitle,
      'WCAG 2.4.2 FAIL: Root layout does not export metadata with a title'
    ).toBe(true)
  })
})

// ── WCAG 2.4.7 — Focus visible ───────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('WCAG 2.4.7 — Focus visible', () => {
  it('globals.css does not globally suppress focus outlines (must have replacement indicator)', () => {
    const globalsCss = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/globals.css'), 'utf-8')
    // Find blocks that use outline:none but must provide a replacement focus indicator
    // via box-shadow, border, or background change on :focus / :focus-visible
    const blocks = globalsCss.split(/(?=\n[^\s])/)
    const dangerousBlocks: string[] = []
    for (const block of blocks) {
      const hasOutlineNone =
        /outline\s*:\s*none/i.test(block) ||
        /outline\s*:\s*0/i.test(block)
      if (!hasOutlineNone) continue
      // Safe if the block or adjacent rule provides a :focus replacement
      const hasFocusReplacement =
        /:focus/i.test(block) ||
        /box-shadow/.test(block) ||
        // Check if the class name appears in the rest of the CSS with a :focus rule
        false
      if (!hasFocusReplacement) {
        const blockSummary = block.trim().substring(0, 60)
        dangerousBlocks.push(blockSummary)
      }
    }
    expect(
      dangerousBlocks,
      `WCAG 2.4.7 FAIL: outline:none without replacement focus indicator:\n${dangerousBlocks.join('\n')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })
})

// ── NFR-14 — Bilingual completeness ──────────────────────────────────────────

describe('NFR-14 — Arabic + English i18n completeness', () => {
  it('messages/ar.json exists', () => {
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/ar.json'))).toBe(true)
  })

  it('messages/en.json exists', () => {

  })

  it('Arabic translation has same top-level sections as English', () => {
    const en = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/en.json'), 'utf-8'))
    const ar = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/ar.json'), 'utf-8'))
    const enKeys = Object.keys(en).sort()
    const arKeys = Object.keys(ar).sort()
    expect(arKeys).toEqual(enKeys)
  })

  it('Arabic translation key count matches English (no missing keys)', () => {
    function flatten(d: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): string[] {
      const out: string[] = []
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) {
        const key = prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k
        if (v && typeof v === 'object') out.push(...flatten(v as Record<string, unknown>, key))
        else out.push(key)
      }
      return out
    }
    const en = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/en.json'), 'utf-8'))
    const ar = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/ar.json'), 'utf-8'))
    const enFlat = flatten(en)
    const arFlat = flatten(ar)
    const missing = enFlat.filter(k => !arFlat.includes(k))
    expect(missing, `NFR-14: These EN keys are missing from AR: ${missing.join(', ')}`).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('Arabic translation values are not identical to English (actually translated)', () => {
    function flatten(d: Record<string, unknown>, prefix = ''): Record<string, string> {
      const out: Record<string, string> = {}
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) {
        const key = prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k
        if (v && typeof v === 'object') Object.assign(out, flatten(v as Record<string, unknown>, key))
        else out[key] = String(v)
      }
      return out
    }
    const en = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/en.json'), 'utf-8'))
    const ar = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'messages/ar.json'), 'utf-8'))
    const enFlat = flatten(en)
    const arFlat = flatten(ar)
    const fallbacks = Object.keys(enFlat).filter(k => arFlat[k] === enFlat[k])
    // Allow up to 10% identical (numbers, proper nouns, etc. may be same)
    const fallbackPct = fallbacks.length / Object.keys(enFlat).length
    expect(
      fallbackPct,
      `NFR-14: ${Math.round(fallbackPct * 100)}% of AR keys are identical to EN — likely untranslated fallbacks`
    ).toBeLessThan(0.1)
  })

  it('HTML direction attribute is set for RTL (dir attribute on <html>)', () => {
    const layoutTs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/layout.tsx'), 'utf-8')
    expect(layoutTs).toContain('dir={direction(locale)}')

    const i18nTs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/i18n.ts'), 'utf-8')
    expect(i18nTs).toMatch(/direction|rtl|ltr/)
    expect(i18nTs).toContain("'rtl'")
  })
})

/**
 * Accessibility E2E Tests — NFR-17 (WCAG 2.1 AA)
 *
 * Runs axe-core against live pages via Playwright.
 * Requires a running dev server: pnpm dev
 *
 * Run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
 *
 * NOTE: These tests require authentication. The dev server must be running
 * and the DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL credentials provider must be active (NODE_ENV=development).
 * In CI, set up the test database and run with a seeded test user.
 */

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright'

// ── Auth helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function signInAsAdmin(page: import('@playwright/test').Page) {
  await page.goto('/sign-in')
  // Use dev credentials provider
  await page.fill('[name="email"]', 'hr.admin@avaniis.dev')
  await page.fill('[name="password"]', 'demo')
  await page.click('[type="submit"]')
  await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 10_000 })
}

// ── WCAG 2.1 AA tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test.describe('NFR-17 — WCAG 2.1 AA compliance', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await signInAsAdmin(page)
  })

  test('Dashboard page: no WCAG AA violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/dashboard')
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle')
    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
      .analyze()
    expect(results.violations).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  test('Persons list page: no WCAG AA violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/persons')
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle')
    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
      .analyze()
    expect(results.violations).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  test('Absence page: no WCAG AA violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/absence')
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle')
    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
      .analyze()
    expect(results.violations).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  test('Workflows page: no WCAG AA violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/workflows')
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle')
    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])
      .analyze()
    expect(results.violations).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  test('Settings page: no WCAG AA violations', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/settings')
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle')
    const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
      .withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'])

/**
 * Auth setup fixture — saves browser storage state for each dev role.
 * Consumed by the 4 role-based Playwright projects in playwright.config.ts.
 *
 * Dev credentials are the hardcoded demo accounts in lib/auth.ts.
 * Override via TEST_* env vars if needed.
 */
import { test as setup } from '@playwright/test'
import path from 'path'

// ── Storage state output paths ────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const AUTH_STATES = {
  SUPER_ADMIN: path.join('tests/e2e/auth/super-admin.json'),
  HR_ADMIN:    path.join('tests/e2e/auth/hr-admin.json'),
  MANAGER:     path.join('tests/e2e/auth/manager.json'),
  EMPLOYEE:    path.join('tests/e2e/auth/employee.json'),
} as const

// ── Credentials (env-overridable, falls back to dev defaults) ─────────────────

const CREDS = {
  SUPER_ADMIN: {
    email:    process.env.TEST_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL    ?? 'super.admin@avaniis.dev',
    password: process.env.TEST_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD ?? 'demo',
  },
  HR_ADMIN: {
    email:    process.env.TEST_HR_ADMIN_EMAIL    ?? 'hr.admin@avaniis.dev',
    password: process.env.TEST_HR_ADMIN_PASSWORD ?? 'demo',
  },
  MANAGER: {
    email:    process.env.TEST_MANAGER_EMAIL    ?? 'manager@avaniis.dev',
    password: process.env.TEST_MANAGER_PASSWORD ?? 'demo',
  },
  EMPLOYEE: {
    email:    process.env.TEST_EMPLOYEE_EMAIL    ?? 'employee@avaniis.dev',
    password: process.env.TEST_EMPLOYEE_PASSWORD ?? 'demo',
  },
}

// ── Shared sign-in helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function loginAs(
  page: import('@playwright/test').Page,
  email: string,
  password: string,
  role: string,
  statePath: string,
): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto('/sign-in')

  const emailInput = page.getByPlaceholder(/you@avaniis.example/i)
  await emailInput.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15_000 })
  await emailInput.fill(email)
  await page.getByPlaceholder(/password/i).fill(password)

  const navPromise = page.waitForURL(
    url => !url.toString().includes('/sign-in'),
    { timeout: 25_000 },
  )
  await page.locator('form').getByRole('button', { name: /sign in/i }).click()
  await navPromise

  if (page.url().includes('/sign-in')) {
    throw new Error(
      `Login failed for ${role}: ${email} — check DB seed and dev server`,
    )
  }

  await page.context().storageState({ path: statePath })
}

// ── One setup test per role (not a loop) ─────────────────────────────────────

setup('authenticate as super-admin', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAs(
    page,
    CREDS.SUPER_ADMIN.email,
    CREDS.SUPER_ADMIN.password,
    'SUPER_ADMIN',
    AUTH_STATES.SUPER_ADMIN,
  )
})

setup('authenticate as hr-admin', async ({ page }) => {

    page,
    CREDS.HR_ADMIN.email,
    CREDS.HR_ADMIN.password,
    'HR_ADMIN',
    AUTH_STATES.HR_ADMIN,
  )
})

setup('authenticate as manager', async ({ page }) => {

    page,
    CREDS.MANAGER.email,
    CREDS.MANAGER.password,
    'MANAGER',
    AUTH_STATES.MANAGER,
  )
})

setup('authenticate as employee', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAs(
    page,
    CREDS.EMPLOYEE.email,
    CREDS.EMPLOYEE.password,
    'EMPLOYEE',
    AUTH_STATES.EMPLOYEE,
  )
})
