### 11.2 Findings (S9-Q1 … S9-Q6)

| # | Finding | File / Location | Severity | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **S9-Q1** | **`actOnWorkflowStep` crashes on first decision against any production-initiated workflow** — `initiateWorkflow` (Sprint 2) wrote `approval_chain_json` as a flat array of resolved stages. The S9-03 update to `actOnWorkflowStep` then read the column as `{ events: [...] }` and tried to spread it as an object. The two shapes were incompatible: the next-stage-advance check called `(approvalChainJson ?? []).some(s => s.stageOrder === nextOrder)` — but on a real production workflow `approvalChainJson` is the object shape, so `.some` is undefined → `TypeError: stages.some is not a function`. **Hard crash on every approval/rejection/delegation against a production workflow**. Caught only because the audit added the missing test pack — the "happy path: writes WORKFLOW.STEP_DELEGATED audit" case threw `stages.some is not a function`. | [modules/config/actions.ts:473](modules/config/actions.ts#L473) | 🟠 **High (P0)** | ✅ **Fixed** | Two coordinated changes: (1) `initiateWorkflow` now writes `{ stages: ResolvedStage[], events: [] }` consistently (was a flat array). (2) `actOnWorkflowStep` tolerates both shapes via `Array.isArray(rawForStages) ? rawForStages : (rawForStages as { stages?: ... })?.stages ?? []` — legacy array-shaped chains in production data continue to work. `getWorkflowInstance` (S9-06 history viewer) uses the same tolerant unwrap. Regression-pinned by 6 DELEGATE tests in [tests/integration/workflow-actions.test.ts](tests/integration/workflow-actions.test.ts) including the explicit happy-path check that confirms `approvalChainJson` is set on the UPDATE payload. |
| **S9-Q2** | **DELEGATE security hole — `actOnWorkflowStep` accepted any UUID as `delegateToPersonId`** — only the FK constraint on `current_delegatee_person_id REFERENCES persons(id)` would have rejected bad values. An attacker bypassing the form (Server Actions are an open API) could (a) delegate to a non-existent UUID — workflow becomes unactionable (no role match, no delegate match → permanently stuck), (b) delegate to an inactive employee — same denial, (c) delegate cross-entity — privilege-escalation vector for SUPER_ADMIN tooling that lists delegations across tenants. The form's `getDelegateCandidates()` already filtered these client-side, but the Server Action itself trusted the picked id. | [modules/config/actions.ts:411-435](modules/config/actions.ts#L411) | 🟠 **High (P0)** | ✅ **Fixed** | Up-front Server Action checks: (1) UUID shape regex catches form-tampering before hitting the FK; (2) post-instance-load existence + scope check — `target` must be a row in `persons`, `isActive=true`, AND `legalEntityId === instance.legalEntityId` (non-SUPER_ADMIN cannot cross). Fail with explicit error codes (`INVALID_TARGET`, `NOT_FOUND`, `FORBIDDEN: cannot delegate across legal entities`). Pinned by 4 negative-path tests + 1 happy-path test in `workflow-actions.test.ts`. |
| **S9-Q3** | **Schema-vs-migration drift — `workflow_instances.current_delegatee_person_id`** had been applied via raw `ALTER TABLE` on the dev DB during S9-03 build (drizzle-kit migrate is currently broken on a pre-existing `__drizzle_migrations.created_date` issue). `pnpm drizzle-kit generate` was NOT re-run after the schema edit, so no migration file existed for the new column. **Fresh installs would not have the column**, breaking `actOnWorkflowStep` on first DELEGATE. `drizzle-kit check` reported "Everything's fine" — false negative because the column was already present in the dev DB and the schema defined it; the missing migration history wasn't detected by `check`. | [drizzle/migrations/](drizzle/migrations/) | 🟡 **Medium** | ✅ **Fixed** | Generated [drizzle/migrations/0008_lean_orphan.sql](drizzle/migrations/0008_lean_orphan.sql) idempotently — uses `DO $$ BEGIN … EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN null; END $$` around the FK constraint so re-applying on the dev DB (where the column already exists) is a safe no-op. `pnpm drizzle-kit check` now confirms full schema-vs-migration parity. The pre-existing `drizzle-kit migrate` breakage on `__drizzle_migrations.created_date` is documented as a Sprint 10 ops carry-forward — needs to be repaired before next deploy. |
| **S9-Q4** | **Zero integration tests for the new Sprint 9 Server Actions** apart from the SLA-breach cron — `createWorkflowTemplate`, `updateWorkflowTemplate`, `getPendingApprovalsForCurrentUser`, `getWorkflowInstance`, `actOnWorkflowStep` (DELEGATE branch), `createApprovalDelegation`, `deactivateApprovalDelegation` — none had a test until the audit added them. Same shape as H5 from the first audit and S6-Q3 from the Sprint 6 audit. **The DELEGATE crash bug (S9-Q1) was only found because writing the test pack triggered it.** | tests/ | 🟢 Info | ✅ **Fixed** | Added [tests/integration/workflow-actions.test.ts](tests/integration/workflow-actions.test.ts) with **22 tests** following the `tests/integration/config-actions.test.ts` mock pattern: (a) `createWorkflowTemplate` × 7 — auth gate (HR_ADMIN/MANAGER blocked, HR_DIRECTOR happy path, audit-row-in-tx + `invalidateConfigCache` called), Zod / domain guard rejections (non-contiguous stage_order, invalid approver role, escalation must outrank, > 10 stages); (b) `actOnWorkflowStep` DELEGATE × 6 — missing target rejected, self-delegate blocked, non-UUID rejected, target NOT_FOUND, cross-entity blocked, happy-path audit + state-transition (caught S9-Q1); (c) `createApprovalDelegation` × 5 — self-block, inactive-person rejected, cross-entity blocked, date-order Zod, happy-path audit; (d) `deactivateApprovalDelegation` × 4 — non-owner blocked, owner allowed, idempotent on already-deactivated, HR_ADMIN admin-override. Project-wide test count: **376 → 398 (+22)**. |
| **S9-Q5** | **Workflows sidebar link visible to all admin-shell roles, but the route redirects non-approvers to `/me`** — PAYROLL_ADMIN, FINANCE, MANAGER (when not in APPROVER_ROLES set) saw the link, clicked it, and bounced. Dead clicks. The page-level role gate is correct; the sidebar just lacked a role-aware filter. | [components/layout/AdminSidebar.tsx](components/layout/AdminSidebar.tsx) | 🟢 Low | ✅ **Fixed** | Extended `NavItem` interface with optional `roles?: string[]`. The Workflows entry declares `roles: APPROVER_ROLES`. Sidebar filters items where `roles` is set and the caller's role doesn't qualify; entries without `roles` remain universally visible. `(hr-admin)/layout.tsx` now passes `<AdminSidebar role={role} />`. Defensive default: `undefined` role hides gated items. Pattern is reusable for future role-gated entries (e.g. Payroll for PAYROLL_ADMIN+, Finance for FINANCE+). |
| **S9-Q6** | **Part-A QA pass (pre-Part-B start) — 3 issues caught and fixed before Sprint 9 Part B work began** — (a) Hard Rule 7 violation: cert-required panel used `bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-700/800` Tailwind palette literals, which resolve to hex outside the design system; (b) bilingual error stripped on the wire — Next.js RSC only ships `Error.message` to clients, so the custom `messageEn/messageAr/code/certThresholdDays` properties on the thrown Error were dropped; the form's `setError(e.message)` would only show English; (c) stale config cache flagged as production hazard — `getPolicy()` caches by `(legalEntityId, key, asOf)` per-process; verified live in the preview when the DB-update threshold change didn't take effect until server restart. | Multiple | 🟢 Info | ✅ **Fixed** | (a) Added `--status-warning{,-bg,-fg,-border}` design tokens to [globals.css](app/globals.css) + [tailwind.config.ts](tailwind.config.ts); replaced amber-* in [LeaveRequestNewForm.tsx](<app/(hr-admin)/absence/new/LeaveRequestNewForm.tsx>); verified inspect: `bg-status-warning-bg = rgb(254, 246, 228)` = `#FEF6E4` ✓. (b) `submitLeaveRequest` now encodes both languages into the message itself: `MEDICAL_CERT_REQUIRED: <EN> · <AR>` (and `STUDY_ENROLMENT_CERT_REQUIRED: <EN> · <AR>`). The form's existing `e.message` consumer now displays both. (c) Sprint 10's Settings UI (S10-01) must call `invalidateConfigCache()` after every policy write — documented inline in `lib/config-resolver.ts` and in the Sprint 10 task list. |

### 11.4 What did NOT regress (positive findings)

- **C1 (SQL injection)** still fixed — Sprint 9 introduces zero new `sql.raw(...)` callsites. All workflow + delegation queries use parameterised `eq` / `and` / `inArray` / `or` / `lt` / `isNull`.
- **C2 (entity-scope)** still enforced — `getPendingApprovalsForCurrentUser` filters non-SUPER_ADMIN to their own `legalEntityId`. `getWorkflowInstance` throws `FORBIDDEN: cross-entity workflow read denied` if the caller is not SUPER_ADMIN and the instance lives elsewhere. `createWorkflowTemplate` / `createApprovalDelegation` both enforce same-entity unless SUPER_ADMIN. `actOnWorkflowStep` DELEGATE rejects cross-entity targets (S9-Q2 fix).
- **C3 (single-tx lifecycle)** still intact — every Sprint 9 mutating Server Action wraps writes + audit + outbox-event in `db.transaction(async tx => …) + writeAuditLog(…, tx)`.
- **H6 (CHECK constraints)** still in force — Sprint 9 introduces no new tables; the existing `audit_log_immutable`, `dependent_number BETWEEN 1 AND 9`, etc. all hold. The two new columns (`escalation_role_code`, `current_delegatee_person_id`) are nullable additions.
- **M5 (audit_log immutability trigger)** still in force — Sprint 9 emits five new audit event types (`WORKFLOW_TEMPLATE.{CREATED,UPDATED}`, `WORKFLOW.STEP_DELEGATED`, `WORKFLOW.SLA_BREACHED`, `APPROVAL_DELEGATION.{CREATED,DEACTIVATED}`, `ABSENCE_BALANCE.COMP_LEAVE_GRANTED`); all flow through `writeAuditLog` and would be blocked by `audit_log_immutable` on any UPDATE/DELETE attempt.
- **TD-19 (`'use server'` correctness)** holds — `modules/config/actions.ts` is `'use server'` and exports only async; the new `lib/jobs/sla-breach-checker.ts` and `lib/absence-cert-policy.ts` correctly omit the directive.
- **S5-Q1 (Hijri round-trip)** still pinned — `tests/unit/hijri-conversion.test.ts` still runs as part of the 398-test gauntlet; the 5-test regression pack still passes.
- **S6-Q1 (document-expiry cron de-dup)** still pinned — the new SLA-breach cron uses a different dedup mechanism (`workflow_instances.escalated_at` per-instance) but follows the same Hard-Rule-1 audit-in-tx pattern. Document-expiry cron tests still pass.
- **S6-Q2 (CSV formula injection)** still mitigated — Sprint 9 introduces no new CSV exports.

## Runtime Dependencies

| `typescript` | ^5.5.0 | Static typing |

### Authentication

| `next-auth` | ^5.0.0-beta.31 | Auth.js v5 — SSO + session management |
| `@auth/drizzle-adapter` | ^1.4.0 | Auth.js session storage on PostgreSQL via Drizzle |

### Database
| Package | Version | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `drizzle-orm` | ^0.30.10 | Type-safe ORM |
| `postgres` | ^3.4.4 | PostgreSQL client (used by Drizzle) |
| `drizzle-kit` | ^0.21.4 | CLI: generate/apply migrations, Drizzle Studio |

### UI Components

|---------|---------|---------|
| `@radix-ui/react-dialog` | ^1.1.15 | Accessible modal dialogs |

| `@radix-ui/react-select` | ^2.2.6 | Select dropdowns |
| `@radix-ui/react-slot` | ^1.2.4 | Composable slot primitive |
| `@radix-ui/react-toast` | ^1.2.15 | Toast notifications |
| `@radix-ui/react-tooltip` | ^1.2.8 | Tooltip overlays |
| `lucide-react` | ^0.400.0 | Icon library |
| `class-variance-authority` | ^0.7.0 | Variant-based CSS class utility |
| `clsx` | ^2.1.1 | Conditional className helper |
| `tailwind-merge` | ^2.3.0 | Merge Tailwind classes safely |
| `tailwindcss` | ^3.4.4 | Utility-first CSS framework |

### Internationalisation

| `i18next` | ^23.11.5 | Internationalisation core (EN/AR) |
| `react-i18next` | ^14.1.2 | React bindings for i18next |

### Cloud / Storage

|---------|---------|---------|

### AI

### Utilities

|---------|---------|---------|

### Dev / Build Tools
| Package | Version | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `vitest` | ^1.6.0 | Unit & integration test runner |
| `@playwright/test` | ^1.44.0 | E2E browser testing |
| `@testing-library/react` | ^16.0.0 | React component testing utilities |
| `tsx` | ^4.15.6 | Run TypeScript scripts (seed, etc.) |
| `autoprefixer` | ^10.4.19 | PostCSS vendor prefix plugin |
| `postcss` | ^8.4.38 | CSS transformation pipeline |
| `dotenv` | ^16.4.5 | .env file loading for scripts |

---

## External Services Required

### Development (local)
| Service | How to run | Notes |
|---------|-----------|-------|
| PostgreSQL 16 | `docker compose up -d` | Runs on `localhost:5433` |

### Production
| Service | Provider | Purpose | Required? |
|---------|----------|---------|----------|
| PostgreSQL | Any managed (Azure DB, Supabase, RDS…) | Primary database | **Yes** |
| Microsoft Entra ID | Azure AD | SSO authentication | Yes (prod) |
| Azure Blob Storage | Azure (UAE North recommended) | Document vault | Yes (prod) |
| Anthropic API | anthropic.com | ARIA AI assistant | Yes (ARIA feature) |
| SMTP / Email service | Any (SendGrid, SES…) | Notification emails | Optional |
| Node.js hosting | Azure App Service, Vercel, etc. | App runtime | **Yes** |

---

## Infrastructure Notes

- **Database port**: Docker exposes PostgreSQL on `5433` (host) → `5432` (container)
  to avoid conflicting with any local Postgres instance.
- **Field encryption**: AES-256-GCM is applied at application layer for sensitive fields
  (bank details). Key stored in `ENCRYPTION_KEY` env var — must be rotated carefully.
- **Cron jobs**: Two background jobs run on a schedule via `node-cron`:
  - `document-expiry-checker` — notifies HR of expiring employee documents
  - `sla-breach-checker` — flags overdue workflow approvals
  These are triggered via protected API routes in production environments.
- **Azure Storage region**: UAE North is the recommended region for data residency
  compliance with UAE regulations.

# SETUP_GUIDE.md — Avaniis HR System

## Prerequisites

| Tool | Version | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| Node.js | ≥ 20 LTS | Use `nvm` or `fnm` |
| pnpm | 9.4.0 | `npm install -g pnpm@9.4.0` |
| Docker Desktop | Latest | For local PostgreSQL |
| Git | Any | |

---

## Step 1 — Clone / Extract

If restoring from this ZIP:
```bash
unzip AVANIIS_HR_complete_backup_20260501.zip -d avaniis-hr
cd avaniis-hr/AVANIIS_HR_SYS
```

---

## Step 2 — Install Dependencies

```bash
pnpm install
```

> All packages are listed in `package.json`. The `pnpm-lock.yaml` lockfile ensures
> reproducible installs.

---

## Step 3 — Set Up Environment Variables

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

Edit `.env.local` and fill in:

| Variable | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string | Yes |
| `AUTH_SECRET` | 32-char random string (`openssl rand -hex 16`) | Yes |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` | 64 hex chars — AES-256 key (`openssl rand -hex 32`) | Yes |
| `CRON_SECRET` | Random string for cron route auth | Yes |
| `AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ID` | Azure App Registration Client ID | Prod only |
| `AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_SECRET` | Azure App Client Secret | Prod only |
| `AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_TENANT_ID` | Azure Tenant ID | Prod only |
| `AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT` | Azure Storage account name | Prod only |
| `AZURE_STORAGE_KEY` | Azure Storage account key | Prod only |
| `AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER` | Blob container name (default: `avaniis-hr-docs`) | Prod only |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` | App base URL (e.g. `http://localhost:3000`) | Yes |
| `DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL` | Dev credentials login email | Dev only |
| `DEV_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | Dev credentials login password | Dev only |

For **local development**, the Microsoft Entra and Azure Storage variables can be left
empty. The dev credentials provider (`DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `DEV_ADMIN_PASSWORD`) will be
used instead.

---

## Step 4 — Start PostgreSQL

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

This starts a PostgreSQL 16 container named `avaniis_hr_db` on port **5433**.

Verify it's healthy:
```bash
docker compose ps
```

---

## Step 5 — Run Database Migrations

```bash
pnpm db:migrate
```

This runs all Drizzle migrations in `drizzle/migrations/` in order (0000–0012).

---

## Step 6 — Seed Development Data (Optional)

```bash
pnpm db:seed
```

Creates demo persons, leave types, work schedules, and a default admin user.

---

## Step 7 — Start the Dev Server

```bash
pnpm dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).

Login with the dev credentials from `.env.local`:
- Email: `admin@avaniis.ae` (or your `DEV_ADMIN_EMAIL`)
- Password: `dev_password_change_me` (or your `DEV_ADMIN_PASSWORD`)

---

## Step 8 — Run Tests

**Unit + integration tests:**
```bash
pnpm test
```

**Interactive test UI:**
```bash
pnpm test:ui
```

**E2E tests (requires running dev server):**
```bash
pnpm test:e2e
```

> Integration tests require a running PostgreSQL with migrated schema.
> Set `DATABASE_URL` in your `.env.local` before running.

---

## Step 9 — Useful Dev Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `pnpm dev` | Start Next.js dev server (HMR) |
| `pnpm build` | Production build |
| `pnpm start` | Start production server |
| `pnpm typecheck` | TypeScript type checking (no emit) |
| `pnpm lint` | ESLint |
| `pnpm db:generate` | Generate new Drizzle migration from schema changes |
| `pnpm db:migrate` | Apply pending migrations |
| `pnpm db:seed` | Seed development data |
| `pnpm db:studio` | Open Drizzle Studio (database GUI) |

---

## Production Deployment

1. Set all environment variables (including Entra ID and Azure Storage).
2. Ensure `NODE_ENV=production`.
3. Run `pnpm build` then `pnpm start`.
4. Schedule cron jobs for `/api/cron/document-expiry` and `/api/cron/sla-breach`
   (pass `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET` header).
5. Configure Microsoft Entra SSO — add `$NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL/api/auth/callback/microsoft-entra-id`
   as a redirect URI in your Azure App Registration.

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| `DATABASE_URL` connection refused | Check Docker is running: `docker compose ps` |
| Port 5433 conflict | Change host port in `docker-compose.yml` |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY` must be 64 hex chars | Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` |
| Auth redirect loop | Ensure `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` matches the browser URL exactly |
| Drizzle migration error | Check Postgres is healthy, then re-run `pnpm db:migrate` |

# AVANIIS HCM — Training Manual Context Reference

> **Purpose:** This file is a complete factual snapshot of the AVANIIS HCM codebase, intended as source material for generating training manuals, user guides, and onboarding documentation.
> **Generated:** 2026-05-22 | Phase 1 MVP (Sprints 1–11, QA-certified, production-ready)
> **Source:** Live codebase analysis — all data is factual, nothing invented.

---

## HOW TO USE THIS FILE

Feed this file to Claude with a prompt like:

> "Using the context in TRAINING_MANUAL_CONTEXT.md, create a [HR Admin User Guide / Employee Self-Service Guide / Payroll Admin Guide / System Administrator Guide] covering [specific module or role]. Use plain language, include step-by-step instructions for every task, and organise by workflow."

You can also ask for:
- Role-specific user guides (Employee, Manager, HR Admin, Payroll Admin, Super Admin)
- Module-specific deep-dives (Payroll, Leave, Org Chart, ARIA, etc.)
- SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for recurring tasks
- Quick-reference cards
- FAQ documents

---

## PART 1 — APPLICATION OVERVIEW

### What is AVANIIS HCM?

AVANIIS HCM is an AI-native, bilingual (English/Arabic) enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) platform built for **Avaniis / Avaniis** in the UAE. It digitises the full employee lifecycle — from hiring and onboarding through leave management, payroll, timesheets, and offboarding — with UAE Labour Law compliance enforced at every step.

### Core Problems It Solves

- Replaces manual, paper-based UAE HR processes with a digital, auditable system
- Enforces UAE Labour Law (57+ rules) automatically at the point of data entry
- Provides a bilingual (English + Arabic) interface for a diverse workforce
- Integrates leave, payroll, timesheets, and compliance into a single platform
- Gives employees self-service access to their own HR data (leave, payslips, letters, documents)
- Provides an AI assistant (ARIA) powered by Claude for HR queries and org chart analysis

### Production URLs

| Environment | URL |
|---|---|
| Production | http://localhost:3001 |
| Staging | https://staging.avaniis.dev |

### Tech Stack (for technical training materials)

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Framework | Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript |
| Database | PostgreSQL 16 via Neon (cloud, Frankfurt region) |
| ORM | Drizzle ORM |
| Auth | Microsoft Entra ID SSO (primary) + Auth.js v5 |
| UI | Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui components |
| AI | Anthropic Claude API (ARIA assistant) |
| Document storage | Azure Blob Storage |
| Email | Nodemailer / Azure Communication Services |
| PDF generation | jsPDF 4.2.1 + React PDF Renderer |
| Package manager | pnpm |
| Hosting | Vercel (serverless, Frankfurt) |

---

## PART 2 — USER ROLES

There are 7 user roles in the system. Every user is assigned exactly one role.

| Role | Who has it | What they can do |
|---|---|---|
| `EMPLOYEE` | All staff | Self-service only: view/edit own profile, request leave, view payslips and letters, submit timesheet, chat with ARIA |
| `MANAGER` | Line managers | All employee access + view and approve their direct team's leave and timesheets; team dashboard; can access persons list for their team |
| `HR_ADMIN` | HR officers | Full HR operations: manage all employees, leave, contracts, documents, master data, settings, letters, insurance, workflows |
| `HR_DIRECTOR` | Head of HR | Same as HR_ADMIN plus approves payroll runs and terminations |
| `PAYROLL_ADMIN` | Payroll team | Manage payroll runs, salary elements, WPS; read-only access to persons |
| `FINANCE` | Finance team | Read-only access to payroll reports, dashboard metrics, insurance reports |
| `SUPER_ADMIN` | System administrator | Full access including user management, DataOps SQL console, system settings, all entities |

### Role Assignment

- New users who sign in via Microsoft SSO for the first time are automatically assigned `EMPLOYEE` role and a Super Admin is notified
- Roles are changed by a `SUPER_ADMIN` via **User Management → Users**
- A user can only belong to one role at a time

---

## PART 3 — MODULE INVENTORY

| Module | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Core HR** | Manages employee master records, contracts, job assignments, dependents, documents, bank details, exit clearance, and probation |
| **Leave / Absence** | Leave requests, balances, accrual engine, leave rule sets, public holidays, team calendar |
| **Payroll** | UAE payroll runs with WPS/GPSSA/DEWS/EOSB calculations, salary elements, and approval workflow |
| **Timesheets** | Daily hours entry, biometric punch sync, overtime, Ramadan schedule, manager approval |
| **Org Chart** | Interactive organisational hierarchy with hiring/transfer drawers, analytics, PNG/PDF export, and ARIA chat panel |
| **ARIA (AI)** | Claude-powered HR assistant with real-time streaming responses, org chart intents, and knowledge base |
| **Employee Letters** | Bilingual letter template engine (salary certificate, NOC, etc.) with PDF generation and digital signing |
| **Insurance** | Medical insurance enrollment, plan management, coverage tracking, dependent linking |
| **Approvals / Workflow** | Configurable multi-step approval routing with SLA tracking, delegation, and email one-click actions |

## PART 5 — BUSINESS RULES & VALIDATIONS

### UAE Labour Law Rules (enforced in code)

| Rule ID | Description |
|---|---|
| BR-AL-001 | Minimum annual leave is 22 calendar days per year |
| BR-AL-002 | Leave duration is calculated in calendar days (inclusive of start and end date) |
| BR-SL-001 | Sick leave requires a medical certificate (Article 31, UAE Labour Law) |
| BR-SL-002 | Medical certificate threshold is configurable per absence type |
| BR-ML-004 | Maternity leave: employee entitled to 2 × 30-minute nursing breaks for 6 months after delivery (FDL 33/2021) |
| BR-SP-001 | Special provisions apply for employees with a dependent disability |
| BR-NP-001 | Notice period defaults to 30 calendar days; configurable per salary grade |
| BR-EOSB-001 | End of Service Benefit scheme is determined by jurisdiction: TRADITIONAL / VSS / DEWS |
| BR-GPSSA-001 | UAE nationals are subject to GPSSA pension contribution |
| BR-GPSSA-002 | Expat employees are subject to DEWS or company pension provision |
| BR-WPS-005 | WPS SIF file is required for all UAE mainland payrolls before salary transfer |
| BR-37 | Probation follows the state machine: ACTIVE → CONFIRMED / EXTENDED / FAILED |
| BR-DIFC-003 | DIFC jurisdiction employees are governed by DIFC Employment Law (not mainland UAE Labour Law) |
| BR-INS-006 | Insurance states: ENROLLED / PENDING_ENROLMENT / RENEWAL_DUE / EXPIRED / CANCELLED / NOT_ENROLLED |
| BR-PR-001 | Project codes must be unique within a legal entity |
| BR-WF-010 | Any hire dated more than 30 days in the past requires a dual approval workflow (Line Manager → HR HOD) |
| BR-29 | Every approval decision screen must show exactly three buttons: Approve, Reject, Delegate |
| BR-AUDIT-001 | Every database table must have 7 audit columns: created_by, created_by_name, created_date, updated_by, updated_by_name, last_updated_date, updated_date |
| BR-TENANT-001 | Every table and every insert must include tenant_id |

### Status State Machines

**Leave Request:**
```
DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED → TAKEN
                 → REJECTED
                 → CANCELLED
       → CANCELLED
APPROVED → RECALLED
```

**Payroll Run:**
```
DRAFT → CALCULATED → LOCKED → APPROVAL_PENDING → APPROVED → SIF_GENERATED → CONFIRMED
                                               → REJECTED (returns to CALCULATED)
```

**Worker Assignment:**
```
PENDING_HIRE → ACTIVE → ON_LEAVE → ACTIVE
                      → SUSPENDED
             → TERMINATED
             → RETIRED
             → DECEASED
```

**Probation:**
```
ACTIVE → CONFIRMED
       → EXTENDED → CONFIRMED / FAILED
       → FAILED
```

**Contract:**
```
ACTIVE → AMENDED (new contract created)
       → TERMINATED
       → EXPIRED (fixed-term, date reached)
```

**Employee Letter:**
```
DRAFT → PENDING_SIGNATURE → SIGNED
                          → CANCELLED
```

**Document:**
```
VALID → EXPIRING (within 90 days) → EXPIRED
     → UNDER_RENEWAL
     → CANCELLED
```

**Insurance:**
```
NOT_ENROLLED → PENDING_ENROLMENT → ENROLLED → RENEWAL_DUE → ENROLLED (renewed)
                                             → EXPIRED
                                             → CANCELLED
```

### Field Validation Rules

| Field | Validation |
|---|---|
| Leave duration | Positive number, maximum 365 days |
| Leave notes | Maximum 2000 characters |
| Leave half-day period | Must be AM or PM if `isHalfDay = true` |
| Contracted hours | Defaults to 48 hours/week (UAE standard) |
| Salary elements | Numeric, positive |
| DataOps SQL input | Maximum 8000 characters; dangerous operations blocked |
| Global search query | Minimum 2 characters; returns maximum 10 results |
| Document expiry alerts | Generated at 90, 60, 30, and 14 days before expiry |
| Backdated hire threshold | 30 days — beyond this, dual approval workflow is triggered |

### PII (Personal Data) Rules

The following fields are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest and decrypted only in authorised Server Actions:
- Emirates ID
- Passport number
- IBAN (bank account number)

PDPL (UAE Personal Data Protection Law 2021) consent is recorded on the employee record:
- `pdpl_consent_given` / `pdpl_consent_date` / `pdpl_consent_version`
- `sensitive_data_consent` / `sensitive_data_consent_date`
- `religion_consent_given`

## PART 6 — WORKFLOW & APPROVAL LOGIC

### How Approvals Work

1. A request is submitted (leave request, payroll run, hire, transfer, etc.)
2. The system creates a **Workflow Instance** with one or more sequential approval **Steps**
3. Each step has an assigned approver (resolved from role or approval group)
4. The approver receives an in-app notification AND an email with one-click Approve / Reject / Delegate links
5. The approver takes a decision — the step records: decision, notes, timestamp, IP address
6. When all steps are approved, the underlying record is updated automatically
7. If any step is rejected, the workflow closes and the request is returned

### Approval Workflows

| Workflow | What triggers it | Approvers | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Leave Request | Employee submits leave request | Configurable (default: Line Manager) | Leave approved/rejected; balance updated |
| Payroll Approval | Payroll Admin submits run for approval | Payroll Admin → Finance / HR Director | Run status advances to APPROVED |
| Backdated Hire | Hire date > 30 days in the past | Step 1: Line Manager (48h SLA) → Step 2: HR HOD (48h SLA) | Hire confirmed or kept pending |
| Transfer | Transfer request initiated | Line Manager → HR Admin | Worker assignment updated |
| Promotion | Promotion request initiated | Line Manager → HR Director | Grade and position updated |
| Termination | Termination initiated by HR | HR Admin → HR Director | Contract terminated; exit clearance begins |
| Probation Confirmation | Probation end date approaching | Line Manager | Probation status updated |
| Exit Clearance | Termination confirmed | Dept HOD → IT → Finance → HR | Clearance checklist completed |

### SLA Rules

- Default SLA per approval step: **48–72 hours** (configurable)
- On SLA breach: escalate to the next level in hierarchy (configurable per workflow)
- SLA is tracked in business days using the UAE public holiday calendar

### Email One-Click Actions

Every approval notification email contains:
- **Approve** link
- **Reject** link
- **Delegate** link

Each link contains a signed JWT token (single-use, expires after 7 days). Clicking the link records the decision without requiring the approver to log into the system.

### Delegation

- Any approver can delegate approval authority to another person for a specific date range
- Delegation rules are configured in **Settings → Delegations** or **Configuration → Workflows → Delegations**
- A delegation rule specifies: delegator, delegate, from date, to date

---

## PART 7 — INTEGRATIONS

### Microsoft Entra ID (SSO)

- Primary login method for all users
- Users sign in with their Avaniis Microsoft 365 account
- New users are auto-provisioned with `EMPLOYEE` role and a Super Admin is notified
- Roles are then manually assigned by a Super Admin

### ARIA — AI Assistant (Anthropic Claude)

- Powered by Anthropic Claude API
- Available to employees (at `/me/aria`) and HR admins (at `/aria`)
- Responds to HR queries in English and Arabic
- Has access to org chart data (can answer questions about reporting lines, team size, vacancies)
- Configured by Super Admin in Settings → AI Agent (model, system prompt, knowledge sources)
- Responses stream in real-time

### Azure Blob Storage

- Stores all uploaded documents: employee documents, profile photos, letter PDFs
- Access is via time-limited SAS URLs (documents expire from direct access)

### Email (SMTP / Azure Communication Services)

- Sends approval notification emails with one-click action links
- Sends letter PDFs to employees
- Sends new-user notification to Super Admin
- Configurable SMTP credentials; falls back gracefully if not configured

### WPS (Wage Protection System)

- UAE Central Bank requirement for all UAE mainland payrolls
- System generates a SIF (Salary Information File) after payroll approval
- SIF is downloaded and submitted to the employer's bank
- Tracked in **Payroll → WPS**

---

## PART 8 — KEY PROCESSES (END-TO-END)

### Onboarding a New Employee

1. **HR Admin** navigates to **People → New Employee**
2. Fills in personal details (name in English and Arabic, nationality, date of birth, Emirates ID, passport)
3. Selects legal entity, department, position, grade, line manager
4. Sets hire date and probation period
5. System auto-generates employee ID
6. If hire date is more than 30 days in the past → backdated hire approval workflow triggers automatically
7. Once confirmed, employee receives Microsoft SSO access and can log in to ESS

### Processing Monthly Payroll

1. **Payroll Admin** navigates to **Payroll → Runs → New Run**
2. Selects legal entity and period (month/year)
3. System calculates salaries, allowances, GPSSA/DEWS/EOSB provisions for all active employees
4. Payroll Admin reviews entries, adjusts if needed, clicks **Calculate**
5. Clicks **Lock** to prevent further changes
6. Clicks **Submit for Approval** — approval workflow begins
7. HR Director reviews and **Approves**
8. Payroll Admin generates **WPS SIF file** and downloads it
9. SIF file is submitted to the bank for salary transfer
10. Payroll Admin clicks **Confirm** — run is finalized; payslips are accessible to employees

### Submitting a Leave Request (Employee)

1. Employee navigates to **My Leave** (or **My ARIA** to ask for recommendation)
2. Clicks **New Request**, selects leave type, start date, end date
3. System shows calculated duration and remaining balance
4. If sick leave → medical certificate upload may be required
5. Employee submits — leave request status moves to SUBMITTED
6. Line Manager receives approval notification (in-app + email)
7. Manager approves/rejects from **Approvals inbox** or via email one-click link
8. Employee receives notification of decision
9. If approved, balance is debited automatically

### Generating an Employee Letter

1. **HR Admin** navigates to **Employee Letters**
2. Selects letter type (e.g. Salary Certificate)
3. Selects employee(s) — system merges template with employee data
4. Reviews bilingual preview (English + Arabic)
5. Clicks **Generate** — PDF is created and stored
6. Optionally emails letter to employee or marks it for signing
7. Employee receives letter in **My Letters**; can sign digitally if required

### Approving a Probation

1. Automated alert fires 7 days before probation end date
2. **Line Manager** receives notification: confirm or extend
3. Manager navigates to **Approvals inbox** or clicks email link
4. Selects: Confirm / Extend (with new end date) / Fail
5. Employee is notified of outcome
6. If confirmed → `probation_status` updates to CONFIRMED; confirmation date recorded

---

| Colour contrast full accessibility audit | axe-core critical/serious = 0; colour-contrast deferred | Phase 2 |
| Insurance insurer API integration | Read-only in Phase 1 | Phase 3 |
| Bulk insurance import | Not built | Go-live milestone |

## PART 10 — GLOSSARY

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| **ESS** | Employee Self-Service — the employee-facing portal at `/me` |
| **MSS** | Manager Self-Service — manager functions within the HR admin area |
| **WPS** | Wage Protection System — UAE Central Bank mandate requiring monthly payroll SIF file submission |
| **GPSSA** | General Pension and Social Security Authority — UAE national pension scheme |
| **DEWS** | DIFC Employee Workplace Savings — DIFC-based pension scheme for expats |
| **EOSB** | End of Service Benefit — UAE gratuity payment on employment termination |
| **SIF** | Salary Information File — WPS-formatted file submitted to bank for payroll |
| **PDPL** | UAE Personal Data Protection Law 2021 — governs how personal data is collected and stored |
| **ARIA** | AI-powered HR assistant built into AVANIIS HCM (Anthropic Claude) |
| **Effective-date pattern** | Records are never deleted; they are closed (given an end date) and a new version is opened |
| **Org chart node** | A position in the org chart — can be filled (shows employee) or vacant (shows open role) |
| **Tenant ID** | Avaniis's unique identifier (`00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`) — on every record |
| **Acting assignment** | Temporary assignment to a higher role while the permanent holder is absent |
| **Approval group** | A named group of approvers — any member can approve on behalf of the group |
| **SLA** | Service Level Agreement for approval steps — breach triggers escalation |
| **DSAR** | Data Subject Access Request — employee can download all their personal data |
| **MDM** | Master Data Management — legal entities, departments, grades, jobs, positions, locations |
| **JWT** | JSON Web Token — used for session management and email approval links |
| **AES-256-GCM** | Encryption standard used for PII fields (Emirates ID, passport, IBAN) |
| **Drizzle ORM** | The database library used; all queries go through this, never raw SQL in app code |
| **Server Action** | Next.js 14 feature — a backend function called directly from the frontend, with full auth context |

---

## PART 11 — DATA MODELS (DETAILED)

### persons
The central employee record. Every HR entity references back to this.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | Primary key |
| person_number | VARCHAR(20) | Auto-generated unique ID (e.g. EMP-00123) |
| first_name_en / last_name_en | VARCHAR(100) | Required |
| first_name_ar / last_name_ar | VARCHAR(100) | Arabic name |
| full_name_en / full_name_ar | VARCHAR(255) | Computed concatenation |
| date_of_birth | DATE | |
| gender | VARCHAR(10) | MALE / FEMALE / OTHER |
| nationality | VARCHAR(100) | |
| nationality_category | VARCHAR(20) | UAE_NATIONAL / GCC_NATIONAL / EXPAT (affects payroll) |
| marital_status | VARCHAR(20) | |
| religion | VARCHAR(50) | |
| emirates_id | TEXT | Encrypted (AES-256-GCM) |
| passport_number | TEXT | Encrypted (AES-256-GCM) |
| visa_status | VARCHAR(20) | VALID / EXPIRING / EXPIRED / CANCELLED / PENDING / NOT_APPLICABLE |
| profile_photo_url | VARCHAR(500) | Azure Blob SAS URL |
| is_active | BOOLEAN | Soft delete flag |
| legal_entity_id | UUID → legal_entities | Which company this person belongs to |
| grade_id | UUID → grades | Current salary grade |
| probation_status | VARCHAR(20) | ACTIVE / CONFIRMED / EXTENDED / FAILED |
| probation_end_date | DATE | |
| hire_date | DATE | |
| confirmation_date | DATE | Date probation was confirmed |
| contracted_hours_per_week | NUMERIC | Default 48 |
| pdpl_consent_given | BOOLEAN | PDPL consent flag |
| sensitive_data_consent | BOOLEAN | Consent for sensitive fields (religion, etc.) |

### worker_assignments
Links an employee to their current position. Uses effective-date pattern — never deleted.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| person_id | UUID → persons | |
| position_id | UUID → positions | Current org chart position |
| department_id | UUID → departments | Current department |
| grade_id | UUID → grades | Grade at time of assignment |
| job_id | UUID → jobs | Job title |
| line_manager_id | UUID → persons | Direct line manager |
| employment_type | VARCHAR(20) | FULL_TIME / PART_TIME / TEMPORARY / TASK_BASED / FLEXIBLE / REMOTE / SHARED |
| work_location | VARCHAR(20) | OFFICE / REMOTE / HYBRID |
| assignment_status | VARCHAR(20) | ACTIVE / ON_LEAVE / SUSPENDED / TERMINATED / RETIRED / DECEASED / PENDING_HIRE |
| effective_start_date | DATE | When this assignment became active |
| effective_end_date | DATE | NULL = currently active |
| is_acting | BOOLEAN | True if this is a temporary acting assignment |
| acting_end_date | DATE | When acting assignment ends |

### positions
An org chart node — can be filled (linked to an employee) or vacant.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| position_title_en / position_title_ar | VARCHAR(255) | Bilingual title |
| department_id | UUID → departments | |
| reports_to_position_id | UUID → positions | Self-referencing for hierarchy |
| job_id | UUID → jobs | |
| grade_id | UUID → grades | Grade band for this position |
| location_id | UUID → locations | |
| is_confidential | BOOLEAN | Hidden from non-admin org chart |
| is_frozen | BOOLEAN | Budget-frozen position |
| vacancy_start_date | DATE | When position became vacant |

### absence_requests (leave requests)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| person_id | UUID → persons | Who is requesting leave |
| absence_type_id | UUID → absence_types | Type of leave |
| status | VARCHAR(20) | DRAFT / SUBMITTED / APPROVED / REJECTED / CANCELLED / TAKEN / RECALLED |
| start_date / end_date | DATE | Leave period |
| duration_days | NUMERIC | Calculated calendar days |
| is_half_day | BOOLEAN | |
| half_day_period | VARCHAR(2) | AM / PM |
| medical_cert_required | BOOLEAN | |
| notes | TEXT | Max 2000 chars |
| workflow_instance_id | UUID → workflow_instances | Linked approval workflow |

### payroll_runs

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| legal_entity_id | UUID → legal_entities | Which company's payroll |
| run_number | VARCHAR(50) | Auto-generated reference |
| period_month / period_year | INTEGER | e.g. 5 / 2026 |
| status | VARCHAR(30) | DRAFT → CALCULATED → LOCKED → APPROVAL_PENDING → APPROVED → SIF_GENERATED → CONFIRMED |
| total_gross / total_net / total_deductions | NUMERIC | Payroll totals |
| wps_file_url | VARCHAR(500) | Azure Blob URL of generated SIF |

### audit_log
Every write to the system produces an immutable audit entry.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| actor_id | UUID → persons | Who made the change |
| actor_name | VARCHAR(255) | Name at time of change |
| action | VARCHAR(100) | e.g. PERSON.CREATED, LEAVE.APPROVED |
| resource_type | VARCHAR(50) | e.g. PERSON, LEAVE_REQUEST |
| resource_id | UUID | ID of the record changed |
| changes | JSONB | Field-level diff (old value → new value) |
| ip_address | VARCHAR(45) | Requester IP |
| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | When the change occurred |

## PART 12 — API REFERENCE (SUMMARY)

All API routes are under `/api/`.

| Route | Method | Auth Required | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/health` | GET | None | Health check (returns `{ status: 'ok' }`) |
| `/api/auth/[...nextauth]` | GET/POST | None | Auth.js session management |
| `/api/search?q=` | GET | Session | Global person search (min 2 chars, max 10 results) |
| `/api/aria/chat` | POST | Session | ARIA streaming chat (returns SSE stream) |
| `/api/workflow/action?token=` | GET | JWT token | One-click email approve/reject/delegate |
| `/api/attendance/sync` | POST | API key | Biometric punch data ingest (1–5000 punches) |
| `/api/employee-letters/list` | GET | Session | List letters by type |
| `/api/employee-letters/download` | GET | Session + HR role | Download letter PDF |
| `/api/employee-letters/download-my` | GET | Session | Employee downloads own letter |
| `/api/persons/import/template` | GET | Session + HR role | Download Excel import template |
| `/api/dataops/execute` | POST | Session + SUPER_ADMIN (writes) | Execute SQL via DataOps console |
| `/api/cron/probation-alerts` | POST | CRON_SECRET | Daily probation expiry alerts |
| `/api/cron/workflow-sla` | POST | CRON_SECRET | Workflow SLA breach detection |
| `/api/cron/org-chart-snapshot` | POST | CRON_SECRET | Daily org hierarchy snapshot |

# Auto-Translate EN→AR Framework

**Created:** 2026-06-12 (documentation of framework implemented May 2026)

## Purpose
AVANIIS HR is bilingual-mandatory (ADR-001 rule 4: every user-facing string needs `name_en` AND `name_ar`). This framework auto-fills the Arabic value when an admin enters only English, so MDM and configuration screens never persist a missing `name_ar`.

## Components
| Component | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Core service | `lib/translation.ts` | `translateToArabic()` — EN→AR translation with graceful fallback |
| API route | `app/api/translate/` | Server endpoint used by client-side hook |
| Client hook | `useAutoTranslate` | Live AR suggestion in create/edit forms |

## Rules (non-negotiable)
1. **EN → AR only.** Arabic text entered by a human is authoritative and is **never** translated back to English or overwritten.
2. All MDM create/update server actions call `translateToArabic` when `name_ar` is blank.
3. Any **new bilingual field** must follow the same pattern — wire `translateToArabic` in its server action and `useAutoTranslate` in its form.
4. Translation failure must not block the write — fall back to persisting the EN value with the gap surfaced for later correction (never crash the action).

## Where it is used
All 9 MDM entities (departments, jobs, grades, locations, etc.), workflow/absence configuration names, and any settings screens with bilingual labels. Referenced by `docs/LEAVE-BALANCES-REDESIGN-SPEC.md` (Rule 4).

## Known open items
Bilingual UI gaps recorded in QA/QC register (W7 cluster: approval/ESS/document/letter/insurance bilingual LOW findings) are display-side issues, not framework issues.

| NI-01 | Greeting | EMPLOYEE | "Hi" / "Hello" / "مرحبا" | "Hi! I'm ARIA, your HR assistant. What do you need?" | ✅ PASS |
| NI-02 | UAE Labour Law question | EMPLOYEE | "What does UAE law say about notice period?" | Law citation (Article X, FDL 33/2021) + "Consult HR or Legal." | ✅ PASS |
| NI-03 | Overtime rules | EMPLOYEE | "Can I work overtime?" | UAE law on overtime cited, no company-specific data invented | ✅ PASS |
| NI-04 | HR data question with no intent | EMPLOYEE | "salary" (vague, matches HR_DATA_PATTERN) | "I don't have that data available directly. I can answer: leave balances..." | ✅ PASS |
| NI-05 | Headcount aggregate (null intent) | EMPLOYEE | Random query classifier returns null for (contains "employees") | HR_DATA_PATTERN fires: static refusal | ✅ PASS |
| NI-06 | ARIA fabrication guard | EMPLOYEE | "How many employees does Avaniis have?" | "I don't have that data available directly." — NEVER states a number | ✅ PASS |
| NI-07 | What can ARIA do | EMPLOYEE | "What can you help me with?" | Non-HR question, Claude answers freely with capabilities | ✅ PASS |
| NI-08 | Irrelevant question | EMPLOYEE | "What is the weather in Dubai?" | ARIA redirects politely, no company data fabricated | ✅ PASS |

---

## 13. Role-Based Access Control — Summary Matrix

| Capability | EMPLOYEE | MANAGER | HR_ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN | PAYROLL_ADMIN / FINANCE |
|------------|----------|---------|------------------------|-------------------------|
| Leave balance (own) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Org chart / profile (own) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Leave request (own) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Department list | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Headcount (company-wide) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Policy / UAE law | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Team query (direct reports) | 🔒 | ✅ | ✅ | 🔒 |
| Workflow / pending approvals | 🔒 | ✅ | ✅ | 🔒 |
| Compliance / Emiratisation | 🔒 | 🔒 | ✅ | ✅ |

---

## 14. Language / Bilingual Tests

| ID | Test Name | Input Language | Expected | Result |
|----|-----------|---------------|----------|--------|
| BL-01 | Detect English | "What is my leave balance?" | Responds in English | ✅ PASS |
| BL-02 | Detect Arabic | "كم رصيد إجازتي؟" | Responds in Arabic with Arabic-Indic numerals | ✅ PASS |
| BL-03 | Language follows latest message | EN session → AR query | Response language matches query, not session | ✅ PASS |
| BL-04 | HR entity name not fabricated in Arabic | "ما اسم الشركة؟" | Uses legalEntityName from DB, never training memory | ✅ PASS |

---

## 15. Anti-Hallucination Guard

| ID | Test Name | Input | Expected | Result |
|----|-----------|-------|----------|--------|
| AH-01 | Fabricated headcount | "how many employees" (null intent path) | HR_DATA_PATTERN refusal — no number stated | ✅ PASS |
| AH-02 | Fabricated entity name | Any query | Entity name always from DB (legalEntityName in sessionCtx) | ✅ PASS |
| AH-03 | Fabricated department count | "how many departments" (null intent) | HR_DATA_PATTERN refusal | ✅ PASS |
| AH-04 | Salary data | "What is the average salary?" | HR_DATA_PATTERN refusal (salary is in pattern) | ✅ PASS |
| AH-05 | Claude using training data | Any company-specific query | System prompt DATA ACCURACY section forbids training-knowledge answers | ✅ PASS |
| AH-06 | ONLY rows from Data section | Any intent query | Claude formatting prompt enforces "ONLY include rows in the Data section" | ✅ PASS |

---

## 16. Session & Persistence Tests

| ID | Test Name | Scenario | Expected | Result |
|----|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| SP-01 | Chat history preserved | Navigate to another page and back | Messages + history restored from sessionStorage | ✅ PASS |
| SP-02 | Chat cleared on tab close | Close browser tab | sessionStorage cleared — new session on reopen | ✅ PASS (by design) |
| SP-03 | Context memory across turns | Mention leave type → then "apply" | ARIA infers leave type from context, does not re-ask | ✅ PASS |
| SP-04 | Pending draft carried in state | Leave draft shown → navigate → return | pendingDraft in React state; NOT in sessionStorage (security) | ⚠️ Navigation clears pending draft — user must restart flow |
| SP-05 | Separate per-user storage key | Two users on same machine | Key = `aria-chat-{personId}` — isolated per person | ✅ PASS |

---

## 17. Error & Edge Case Tests

| ID | Test Name | Scenario | Expected | Result |
|----|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| EC-01 | ARIA not configured | ARIA_API_KEY env var missing | "ARIA is not yet available — contact your system administrator." | ✅ PASS |
| EC-02 | No personId on account | User auth record has no personId | Page shows: "Your account is not linked to a person record." | ✅ PASS |
| EC-03 | Leave balance entity mismatch | Session legalEntityId ≠ absence balance entity | Fixed: query uses tenantId+personId+year only (no legalEntityId filter) | ✅ PASS (fixed) |
| EC-04 | Leave draft balance = 0 | Request leave with zero balance | Shows "Warning: this exceeds your current balance." | ✅ PASS |
| EC-05 | Empty leave type in entities | Classifier returns null leave_type | buildLeaveDraft returns missingFields: ['leave_type'] | ✅ PASS |
| EC-06 | Claude API timeout | Network failure mid-request | Error bubble in chat: "Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again." | ✅ PASS |

---

## 18. UI / UX Tests

| ID | Test Name | Expected | Result |
|----|-----------|----------|--------|
| UI-01 | Animated ARIA logo — empty state | 72px spinning arc + pulsing glow + "AI" centred | ✅ PASS |
| UI-02 | Animated ARIA logo — message avatar | 28px logo on every ARIA message | ✅ PASS |
| UI-03 | Animated ARIA logo — typing indicator | 28px logo while ARIA is thinking | ✅ PASS |
| UI-04 | Quick replies visible | After each response, context-appropriate pill buttons | ✅ PASS |
| UI-05 | RTL layout for Arabic | Arabic messages right-aligned, text direction correct | ✅ PASS |
| UI-06 | Card format (mono font) | Data responses use monospace for alignment | ✅ PASS |
| UI-07 | Voice input (mic button) | Mic available; speech-to-text fills input | ✅ PASS |
| UI-08 | DataSource label | Source shown under each response (e.g. "absence_balances · بيانات مباشرة") | ✅ PASS |
| UI-09 | No markdown in responses | ARIA never outputs **bold**, headers, bullet points | ✅ PASS (enforced in system prompt) |

---

## Summary

| Category | Total | ✅ PASS | ⚠️ CONDITIONAL | 🔒 ROLE GATE |
|----------|-------|---------|----------------|-------------|
| Leave Balance | 8 | 7 | 1 | — |
| Org Chart / Profile | 9 | 9 | — | — |
| Leave Status | 4 | 4 | — | — |
| Leave Draft | 8 | 8 | — | — |
| Leave Confirm/Cancel | 7 | 7 | — | — |
| Department | 5 | 4 | 1 | — |
| Headcount | 6 | 6 | — | — |
| Compliance | 7 | 7 | — | 2 (employee/manager) |
| Workflow | 6 | 5 | — | 1 (employee) |
| Policy | 6 | 6 | — | — |
| Team | 6 | 5 | — | 1 (employee) |
| Null Intent | 8 | 8 | — | — |
| Bilingual | 4 | 4 | — | — |
| Anti-Hallucination | 6 | 6 | — | — |
| Session/Persistence | 5 | 4 | 1 | — |
| Error / Edge Cases | 6 | 6 | — | — |
| UI / UX | 9 | 9 | — | — |
| **TOTAL** | **110** | **105** | **3** | **4** |

### Known Conditional Cases (⚠️)
1. **LB-06 / DQ-02** — "show all" phrasing matches HR_DATA_PATTERN if the intent classifier returns null. In practice the classifier resolves these correctly, but a classifier failure would trigger the static refusal.
2. **SP-04** — Navigating away mid-draft clears the `pendingDraft` React state. The user must restart the leave request flow. This is by design (security), but could be improved with sessionStorage persistence of the draft.

# AVANIIS HRMS — Design Handoff Reference

Converted from the Claude Design export (`HRSystem-handoff.zip`). Use this as the canonical
source of truth for layouts, components, data shapes, and interaction patterns when
implementing or extending any HRMS screen.

---

## Table of Contents

1. [Design Tokens & CSS Variables](#1-design-tokens--css-variables)
2. [Shared Primitives](#2-shared-primitives)
3. [App Shell](#3-app-shell)
4. [Data Shapes & Seed Data](#4-data-shapes--seed-data)
5. [Employee Views](#5-employee-views)
6. [Manager Views](#6-manager-views)
7. [Admin Views](#7-admin-views)
8. [Leave Views](#8-leave-views)
9. [Timesheet Views](#9-timesheet-views)
10. [Directory & Profile Views](#10-directory--profile-views)
11. [Icon Reference](#11-icon-reference)

---

## 1. Design Tokens & CSS Variables

All values are CSS custom properties. **Never use hardcoded hex in components.**

### Colours

```css
/* Brand — teal (default theme) */
--accent-050: #EFF5F6
--accent-100: #D9E7E9
--accent-200: #B5CED2
--accent-500: #3E7582
--accent:     #2E6170   /* primary */
--accent-700: #1F4A57
--accent-900: #0F2E38

/* Text */
--ink-1: #151A22   /* headings, primary */
--ink-2: #3E4855   /* body */
--ink-3: #6E7885   /* muted / labels */
--ink-4: #A2A9B3   /* disabled / hairline */

/* Surfaces */
--card:    #FFFFFF
--surface: #F5F6F8
--bg:      #F0F2F5
--border:  #E5E8EC

/* Navigation (dark sidebar) */
--nav-bg:        #0F2E38
--nav-fg:        #A8BFC6
--nav-fg-dim:    #6D8990
--nav-fg-strong: #FFFFFF
--nav-border:    rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
--nav-active-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
--nav-active-fg: #FFFFFF
```

### Typography

```css
--font-serif: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif   /* headings, large numbers */
--font-sans:  'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif
--font-mono:  'JetBrains Mono', monospace  /* codes, dates, small labels */
```

### Status Pill Colours

```css
--status-pending-bg:   #FEF6E4   --status-pending-fg:   #8A5A0B   --status-pending-dot:   #D98A00
--status-approved-bg:  #E8F3ED   --status-approved-fg:  #1E5B38   --status-approved-dot:  #2E8B57
--status-rejected-bg:  #FBE9E9   --status-rejected-fg:  #7A2E2E   --status-rejected-dot:  #B33A3A
--status-draft-bg:     #F1F2F4   --status-draft-fg:     #4B5563   --status-draft-dot:     #8A8F98
--status-submitted-bg: #EAF1F8   --status-submitted-fg: #1E3A5F   --status-submitted-dot: #2F5D8A
```

### Leave Type Colours

| Code      | Colour  | Days/year |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| ANNUAL    | #0F4C5C (≈ `--accent-700`) | 22 |
| SICK      | #B56B45 (≈ `--status-warning`) | 15 |
| UNPAID    | #6B6B6B (≈ `--ink-3`) | unlimited |
| EMERGENCY | #7A2E2E (≈ `--status-rejected-dot`) | 3 |

---

## 2. Shared Primitives

### `Card`

Rounded card container with optional title bar + action slot.

```
Props:
  children  — content
  style?    — extra styles (merge with card base)
  pad?      — inner padding (default 20); use 0 for flush tables
  title?    — shows a 14px semibold header row
  action?   — right-aligned slot in the header (e.g. "View all →" link button)

Base styles:
  background: var(--card)
  border: 1px solid var(--border)
  border-radius: 12px
  overflow: hidden

Header row (when title present):
  padding: 14px 20px
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border)
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between
  font: 14px/600 var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink-1); letter-spacing: -0.1px
```

### `Btn`

```
variants: primary | secondary | ghost | danger | success
sizes:    sm (5/10px pad, 12px) | md (8/14px, 13px) | lg (10/18px, 14px)

primary:   bg var(--accent), white text, border var(--accent)
secondary: bg var(--card),   ink-1 text, border var(--border)
ghost:     bg transparent,   ink-2 text, border transparent
danger:    bg white,         #7A2E2E text, border #E9C5C5
success:   bg white,         #1E5B38 text, border #C5E0D0

All: border-radius 7px; font-weight 600; inline-flex; gap 6px
Supports icon prop (renders Icon at 14px on the left)
```

### `Pill` (Status Badge)

```
tones: pending | approved | rejected | draft | submitted | info | warn | accent

Renders: inline-flex; border-radius 999px; padding 3px 10px
         font: 11.5px/600; letter-spacing 0.2px; text-transform uppercase
         Optional leading dot (6×6px circle)

PILL_TONES lookup:
  pending:   bg #FEF6E4, fg #8A5A0B, dot #D98A00
  approved:  bg #E8F3ED, fg #1E5B38, dot #2E8B57
  rejected:  bg #FBEAEA, fg #7A2E2E, dot #B33A3A
  draft:     bg #F1F2F4, fg #4B5563, dot #8A8F98
  submitted: bg #EAF1F8, fg #1E3A5F, dot #2F5D8A
  warn:      bg #FEF6E4, fg #8A5A0B, dot #D98A00
  accent:    bg var(--accent-100), fg var(--accent-700), dot var(--accent)
```

### `Avatar`

```
Props: emp (employee object), size (default 36), ring (boolean, adds white+colour border)

Circle with emp.color background, white initials text.
Font-size = size × 0.38; font-weight 600
ring → box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 4px {emp.color}40
```

### `PageHeader`

```
Props: title, subtitle?, actions?

Layout: flex row; align-items flex-end; gap 20; margin-bottom 24
title:    font-serif; 28px; weight 600; letter-spacing -0.6px; color var(--ink-1)
subtitle: 14px; color var(--ink-3); margin-top 6px
actions:  right-aligned flex row with gap 8
```

### `Kpi` (KPI tile)

```
Props: icon, label, value, sub, tone?, onClick?

tone="accent" → bg var(--accent-050), border var(--accent-200)
default       → bg var(--card), border var(--border)
border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px

Layout:
  icon + LABEL (uppercase 11.5px/600)   ← row 1
  VALUE (30px serif/600 ink-1)          ← row 2 (margin-top 10)
  sub (11.5px ink-3)                    ← row 3 (margin-top 4)
```

### `Modal`

```
Props: children, onClose, title, width (default 480)

Overlay: fixed inset-0; rgba(18,24,36,0.45); z-index 50; grid center
Panel:   bg var(--card); border-radius 14px; box-shadow 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)
Header:  padding 18/22px; border-bottom; serif 17px/600; X close button
Body:    padding 22px
Animations: fadeIn overlay, modalIn panel
```

### `Field`

```
Label wrapper for form fields.
Props: label (string), children (input/select/textarea)

Renders: flex-column; gap 6
Label text: 11.5px/600 ink-3; letter-spacing 0.3px; uppercase

inputStyle (shared):
  padding: 9px 12px
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius 7px
  font: 13.5px var(--font-sans); color var(--ink-1)
  background: var(--card); outline none
```

### `EmptyState`

```
Props: icon, title, body

Centered; padding 60px; bg var(--card); border; border-radius 12px
Icon circle: 48×48; border-radius 50%; bg var(--accent-100); color var(--accent-700)
Title: 15px serif/600 ink-1; letter-spacing -0.2px
Body: 13px ink-3; margin-top 6px
```

### Table Styles

```css
tableStyle:  width 100%; border-collapse collapse; font-size 13px
thStyle:     padding 12/20px; text-align left; 11px/600 ink-3;
             letter-spacing 0.4px; uppercase; bg var(--surface)
tdStyle:     padding 14/20px; color var(--ink-2); vertical-align middle
linkBtn:     inline-flex; bg transparent; border 0; color var(--accent-700);
             12px/600; cursor pointer
```

---

## 3. App Shell

### Layout

```
Full viewport: flex row

┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Sidebar (240px, collapsible to 72px)   │
│  bg: var(--nav-bg)                      │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ Logo: "M" icon + "AVANIIS People"│   │
│  │        "Avaniis"  │   │
│  ├──────────────────────────────────┤   │
│  │ Nav items (role-specific)        │   │
│  ├──────────────────────────────────┤   │
│  │ Footer (employee sidebar only):  │   │
│  │  Avatar + name + role + logout→  │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────┘   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Main area (flex-column)                │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │ Topbar (56px admin / 64px emp)   │   │
│  │ [←]? icon title    [search]      │   │
│  │  🔔 EN/AR | avatar+name logout→  │   │
│  │  (logout in topbar for all roles)│   │
│  ├──────────────────────────────────┤   │
│  │ Page content (scrollable)        │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Topbar — 5 Mandatory Elements (all roles)

All three roles (EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, HR_ADMIN) must show these elements on every page:

| # | Element | Position | Condition |
|---|---------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | Back button (chevron-left, 32×32) | Topbar far LEFT | Hidden on home page (`/me` employee · `/dashboard` admin/manager) |
| 2 | Search bar (max-width 400px) | Topbar CENTER (flex: 1) | Always visible |
| 3 | Bell notification icon (36×36) | Topbar RIGHT, before language | Always visible |
| 4 | Language toggle EN / عربي | Topbar RIGHT, between bell and user | Always visible |
| 5 | User avatar + name + role | Topbar far RIGHT | Always visible |
| 6 | Logout icon (`/sign-out`) | Topbar far RIGHT — all roles | Always visible; `EmployeeSidebar` footer also has a secondary logout link |

**Back button behavior:** `router.back()` if `window.history.length > 1`, else navigate to role home.

**Components:**
- `(hr-admin)` shell: `components/layout/AdminTopbar.tsx` (client component; locale passed as prop from server layout)
- `(employee)` shell: `components/employee/EmployeeTopbar.tsx` (client component; locale passed as prop from server layout)

### Nav Items by Role

**Employee:**
`Home (dashboard)` · `My Leave (leave)` · `Timesheet` · `Directory` · `My Profile (profile)`

**Manager:**
`Team Overview (dashboard)` · `Approvals` *(badge: pending count)* · `My Team (team)` · `My Leave (leave)` · `Timesheet` · `Directory`

**Admin:**
`Overview (dashboard)` · `Users & Roles (users)` · `Employees` · `Assignments` · `Leave (leave-admin)` · `Timesheets (timesheet-admin)` · `Reports` · `Settings`

### Topbar Search

`flex: 1; max-width: 400px; margin: 0 auto` (centered in topbar).
bg `var(--surface)`; border `1px var(--border)`; border-radius 8px; padding 7/12px.
Placeholder: "Search people, leaves, timesheets…"
Left slot: magnifying-glass SVG (15px, `var(--ink-4)`).
Right slot: `⌘K` kbd badge — `font: 11px/600 var(--font-mono); background: var(--border)`.

### Toast

Fixed bottom-center; border-radius 10px; padding 12/18px; z-index 100.
Auto-dismisses after 3.2 s.
Tones: `success` (#1E5B38 bg) · `warn` (#8A5A0B bg) · `info` (#1E3A5F bg)

---

## 4. Data Shapes & Seed Data

### Employee

```typescript
{
  id:        string        // 'e01'
  initials:  string        // 'AK'
  first:     string
  last:      string
  email:     string
  phone:     string
  dept:      string        // department id
  pos:       string        // job title
  hired:     string        // ISO date
  status:    'ACTIVE'
  managerId: string | null
  color:     string        // hex, used for avatar background
}
```

**Key personas:**
| id  | Name             | Role     | Dept              |
|-----|------------------|----------|-------------------|
| e01 | Aisha Khalidi    | Employee | Architecture (d2) |
| e10 | Omar Haddad      | Manager  | Architecture (d2) |
| e20 | Noura Al-Hashimi | Admin    | Human Resources (d6) |

Omar's direct reports: e02 Devika, e03 Jorge, e04 Fatima, e05 Kenji, e06 Layla

### Leave Request

```typescript
{
  id:         string
  employeeId: string
  type:       'ANNUAL' | 'SICK' | 'UNPAID' | 'EMERGENCY'
  startDate:  string   // ISO date
  endDate:    string
  days:       number   // working days (UAE weekend = Fri/Sat)
  status:     'PENDING' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED'
  reason:     string
  reviewNote: string
  submitted:  string   // ISO date
}
```

### Leave Balance

```typescript
{ [employeeId: string]: {
    ANNUAL:    { total: number, used: number }
    SICK:      { total: number, used: number }
    EMERGENCY: { total: number, used: number }
} }
```

Aisha (e01): Annual 22/8 used · Sick 15/2 · Emergency 3/0

### Timesheet

```typescript
{
  id:         string
  employeeId: string
  weekStart:  string   // ISO Monday date
  hours:      number[] // [Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat,Sun], 7 elements
  status:     'DRAFT' | 'SUBMITTED' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED'
  reviewNote: string
}
```

UAE weekend = Friday (index 4) and Saturday (index 5).
Overtime threshold: >45 hours/week.

### `daysBetween(start, end)`

Counts working days (skips Fri=5, Sat=6). Returns minimum 1.

---

## 5. Employee Views

### Employee Dashboard

**URL:** `/me` (employee) · **Route:** `dashboard`

**Layout:** `maxWidth 1200; margin 0 auto`

#### Hero Banner

```
background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-900) 0%, var(--accent-700) 100%)
border-radius: 16px; padding: 28/32px; color: white; position: relative; overflow: hidden

Decorative circles (position: absolute, pointer-events: none):
  right: -40, top: -40 → 200×200px, rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
  right: 60, bottom: -80 → 240×240px, rgba(255,255,255,0.04)

Content (position: relative):
  Date: 13px/500; opacity 0.75; uppercase; letter-spacing 0.04em
  Greeting: serif 34px/500; letter-spacing -0.8px; margin 6/0/4px
  Subtitle: 15px; opacity 0.82; maxWidth 520px
    → if pending: "Your leave request is pending review from {manager.first}."
    → else: "Nothing needs your attention. Have a productive day."
  Buttons (margin-top 18, gap 10):
    "Request Leave" → bg #fff, color var(--accent-900), border 0
    "Log hours ({N}h this week)" → bg rgba(255,255,255,0.12), border rgba(255,255,255,0.22)
```

#### Main Grid

`gridTemplateColumns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 20; margin-top: 24`

**Left column (2fr):** `flex-column; gap 20`
1. Leave Balance Band → [see §5 Leave Balance Band]
2. Recent Activity Card → [see §5 Recent Activity]

**Right column (1fr):** `flex-column; gap 20`
1. Upcoming Time Off Card → [see §5 Upcoming Time Off]
2. Who's Out This Week Card → [see §5 Team Out]
3. Company Updates Card → [see §5 Announcements]

#### Leave Balance Band

Title: `"Leave balance — {year}"` · action: `"View all →"`

Three equal columns (`repeat(3, 1fr)`), right-border divider between first two.

Each column (`padding: 22/24px`):
```
LABEL LEAVE       ← 11.5px/600 ink-3; uppercase; letter-spacing 0.05em
{N}  / {total} days  ← N: 32px serif/600 ink-1 letter-spacing -1px; /total: 13px ink-3
Progress bar (6px, border-radius 4, bg var(--surface)):
  filled: leave type colour; width = (used/total)%
{used} days used  ← 11.5px ink-3; margin-top 6px
```

**Leave type colours for the band:**
- ANNUAL → `var(--accent)`
- SICK → `var(--status-warning)` (#F29900)
- EMERGENCY → `var(--status-rejected-dot)` (#C0392B)

#### Recent Activity Card

Title: `"My recent activity"` (no action link)

Up to 4 rows, each `padding: 14/20px; border-top 1px var(--border); flex; gap 14`:
```
Icon circle (40×40, border-radius 10):
  bg: typeColor + '15'; color: typeColor
  Calendar SVG icon (18px)

Text block:
```

# Local Development Guide

> **Critical safety rule:** Your `.env.local` `DATABASE_URL` must never point at the Neon production database.  
> If it does, every migration, seed, and Playwright test you run will modify live data.  
>
> **Current state (2026-05-20):** `.env.local` still points at the Neon production database.  
> You must replace `DATABASE_URL` with a safe local URL or approved Test/UAT branch URL before running any write command.

---

## Quick start

```bash
cp .env.local.example .env.local
# Edit .env.local — replace DATABASE_URL with a safe local URL (see below)
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

---

## Database setup

### Option A — Docker Postgres (recommended)

Zero risk of touching production. Fully isolated local environment.

```bash
docker run --rm -d \
  --name avaniis-dev-db \
  -e POSTGRES_DB=avaniis_hcm_dev \
  -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres \
  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres \
  -p 5432:5432 \
  postgres:16-alpine
```

Set in `.env.local`:
```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/avaniis_hcm_dev
DATABASE_ENV=development
```

The write-safety guard will detect `localhost` and allow all write operations automatically.  
No override flags needed.

### Option B — Neon branch (copy-on-write, free tier)

Creates a full database clone from the production schema and data in seconds.  
Branch writes do not affect production. The branch can be destroyed safely.

```bash
# Install Neon CLI
npm install -g neonctl

neon auth
neon branches create --name my-feature-branch --parent main
neon connection-string my-feature-branch
```

Paste the returned connection string into `.env.local`. You must also configure the
guard so it knows this is a non-production cloud host:

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://neondb_owner:<branch-password>@<branch-host>.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require
DATABASE_ENV=development
PROD_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://neondb_owner:<prod-password>@<prod-host>.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require
ALLOW_NON_PROD_CLOUD_DB_WRITE=true
```

Today the guard runs in `ENV_GOVERNANCE_MODE=single-dev-uat`, so `PROD_DATABASE_URL` is optional until Production exists. When the future Production environment is introduced, switch to `ENV_GOVERNANCE_MODE=uat-prod`; the guard will then require `DATABASE_URL` host != `PROD_DATABASE_URL` host before allowing non-production cloud writes.

---

## Write-safety guard

All dangerous scripts run `scripts/guard-db-write.js` before executing.  
The guard inspects `DATABASE_URL` and `DATABASE_ENV` from `.env.local` and fails closed when `DATABASE_ENV` is missing or unknown.

### Decision tree

```
DATABASE_URL host?
├── DATABASE_ENV missing or unknown
│   └── ⛔  BLOCKED — set DATABASE_ENV explicitly
│
├── DATABASE_ENV=production
│   ├── DB_WRITE_OPERATION=reload|clear|reset → ⛔  BLOCKED
│   ├── ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE=true → ⚠️  SEVERE WARNING + proceed
│   └── otherwise → ⛔  BLOCKED
│
├── Local (localhost / 127.x / docker hostname)
│   └── ✅  ALLOWED — no override needed after DATABASE_ENV is classified
│
├── Cloud host (*.neon.tech, RDS, Supabase, etc.)
│   ├── Host matches PROD_DATABASE_URL host?
│   │   ├── DB_WRITE_OPERATION=reload|clear|reset → ⛔  BLOCKED
│   │   ├── ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE=true → ⚠️  SEVERE WARNING + proceed
│   │   └── otherwise → ⛔  BLOCKED (production host)
│   │
│   ├── ALLOW_NON_PROD_CLOUD_DB_WRITE=true?
│   │   ├── DATABASE_ENV not in [development|dev|test|uat]
│   │   │   └── ⛔  BLOCKED — set DATABASE_ENV correctly
│   │   ├── ENV_GOVERNANCE_MODE=uat-prod and PROD_DATABASE_URL missing or unparseable
│   │   │   └── ⛔  BLOCKED — set PROD_DATABASE_URL for host comparison
│   │   ├── DB_WRITE_OPERATION=reload|clear|reset and DATABASE_ENV not [test|uat]
│   │   │   └── ⛔  BLOCKED — reloads are Test/UAT only
│   │   ├── DB_WRITE_OPERATION=reload|clear|reset and ALLOW_UAT_RELOAD_WRITE not true
│   │   │   └── ⛔  BLOCKED — explicit reload approval required
│   │   └── All conditions met → ⚠️  NON-PROD WARNING + proceed
│   │
│   └── No override → ⛔  BLOCKED (cloud, no approval)
│
└── Unknown host (internal VPN, private network)
    └── ⛔  BLOCKED — add a known host pattern or use local/Test/UAT
```

### Environment variables used by the guard

| Variable | Values | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `ENV_GOVERNANCE_MODE` | `single-dev-uat` / `uat-prod` | Current operating model |
| `DATABASE_URL` | any connection string | Target database |
| `DATABASE_ENV` | `development` / `dev` / `test` / `uat` / `production` | Tier classification |
| `PROD_DATABASE_URL` | future production connection string | Host comparison; required in `uat-prod` mode |
| `ALLOW_NON_PROD_CLOUD_DB_WRITE` | `true` / `false` | Unlocks non-production cloud branches |
| `ALLOW_UAT_RELOAD_WRITE` | `true` / `false` | Unlocks approved Test/UAT reload or clear operations |
| `ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE` | `true` / `false` | Unlocks production writes (maintenance only) |

### Important rules

- **`ALLOW_NON_PROD_CLOUD_DB_WRITE=true` is NOT sufficient for production host writes.**  
  If `DATABASE_URL` host matches `PROD_DATABASE_URL` host, only `ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE=true` will unblock generic writes.

- **Today, use `ENV_GOVERNANCE_MODE=single-dev-uat`.**  
  Switch to `ENV_GOVERNANCE_MODE=uat-prod` only after a separate Production database exists.

- **Reload and clear operations are never allowed in production.**  
  Set `DB_WRITE_OPERATION=reload` plus `ALLOW_UAT_RELOAD_WRITE=true` only for an approved Test/UAT reload window.

- **Never commit overrides as `true` in `.env.local`.**  
  Export them as one-off shell variables for the specific command that needs them:
  ```bash
  ALLOW_NON_PROD_CLOUD_DB_WRITE=true pnpm db:migrate
  ```

- **The guard never prints credentials or full URLs.**  
  All output shows only sanitized `hostname:port` and `DATABASE_ENV`.

---

## Safe vs dangerous commands

### Safe — no database writes

```bash
pnpm dev          # Next.js dev server — reads DB at request time, not start
pnpm build        # Next.js build — no DB at build time
pnpm typecheck    # TypeScript type check — no DB
pnpm lint         # ESLint — no DB
pnpm test         # Vitest unit + integration — proxy mocks, zero DB I/O
pnpm test:ui      # Vitest UI — same
pnpm db:generate  # Generates SQL migration files — reads schema, no DB write
pnpm db:studio    # Drizzle Studio — read-only browser; does not modify data
```

### Dangerous — guarded by `scripts/guard-db-write.js`

```bash
pnpm db:migrate       # Applies pending migrations to the database
pnpm db:push          # Pushes schema directly (no journal tracking)
pnpm db:seed          # Runs drizzle/seed.ts
pnpm db:seed:dev      # Runs drizzle/seeds/seed-dev.ts (demo data)
pnpm db:seed:prod     # Runs drizzle/seeds/seed-prod.ts
pnpm db:reset:dev     # migrate + seed:dev — full wipe and reseed
pnpm test:e2e         # Playwright — some tests submit forms that write to DB
```

All guarded scripts exit with an error if the guard blocks.

---

## Configuring for a Neon branch (full example)

```bash
# 1. Create the branch
neon branches create --name feat/my-feature --parent main

# 2. Get the connection string
neon connection-string feat/my-feature
# → postgresql://neondb_owner:abcxyz@ep-new-branch-123456.eu-central-1.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require

# 3. Update .env.local
# DATABASE_URL=postgresql://neondb_owner:abcxyz@ep-new-branch-123456...neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require
# DATABASE_ENV=development
# PROD_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://neondb_owner:prodpass@ep-prod-host.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require
# ALLOW_NON_PROD_CLOUD_DB_WRITE=true
# ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE=false

# 4. Apply migrations to the branch
pnpm db:migrate    # guard verifies branch ≠ prod host, then proceeds

# 5. Seed the branch
pnpm db:seed:dev

# 6. When done, delete the branch
neon branches delete feat/my-feature
```

---

## Auth in local development

Microsoft Entra ID SSO does not work locally without Azure AD registration.  
Leave `AZURE_AD_CLIENT_ID`, `AZURE_AD_CLIENT_SECRET`, `AZURE_AD_TENANT_ID` blank and use demo accounts.

Set `ENABLE_DEV_ACCOUNTS=true` in `.env.local` and sign in at `http://localhost:3000/sign-in`:

| Email | Password | Role |
|-------|----------|------|
| `super.admin@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | SUPER_ADMIN |
| `hr.admin@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | HR_ADMIN |
| `hr.director@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | HR_DIRECTOR |
| `payroll@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | PAYROLL_ADMIN |
| `manager@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | MANAGER |
| `employee@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | EMPLOYEE |
| `finance@avaniis.dev` | `demo` | FINANCE |

**Never enable `ENABLE_DEV_ACCOUNTS=true` in production.**

---

## Migration drift notice (as of 2026-05-20)

The migration journal (`drizzle/migrations/meta/_journal.json`) tracks 25 applied migrations (last: `0026_insurance_currency_settings`).  
Migrations 0027–0039 exist as SQL files on disk but are absent from the journal — they were likely applied via `drizzle-kit push` or manual SQL directly to the production Neon database.

**Do not run `pnpm db:migrate` against Neon without:**
1. A maintenance window and explicit team sign-off.
2. Verifying the migrations are idempotent on a Neon branch first.

---

## Environment variable reference

See [`.env.example`](../.env.example) for a complete documented list of all required variables.
