// ── Validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const UpdateComplianceRuleSchema = z.object({
  ruleId:        z.string().uuid('must be a UUID (compliance_rules.id)'),
  // At least one updatable field must be present
  descriptionEn: z.string().trim().min(1).max(2000).optional(),
  descriptionAr: z.string().trim().max(2000).optional(),
  formula:       z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
  isActive:      z.boolean().optional(),
  sunsetDate:    hrDateString().optional().nullable(),
  notes:         z.string().trim().max(2000).optional(),
  // GAP-N08: change reason is MANDATORY — no silent governance changes.
  changeReason:  z.string().trim().min(10, 'changeReason must be at least 10 characters'),
})

export type UpdateComplianceRuleInput = z.infer<typeof UpdateComplianceRuleSchema>

// ── Action ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * GAP-N08 — SUPER_ADMIN-only governance action for updating compliance rules.
 *
 * Requires:
 *   • Caller must have SUPER_ADMIN role (no HR_ADMIN escalation path — these
 *     are system-level governance records tied to UAE law citations).
 *   • `isOverridable` must be true on the target row; non-overridable rules
 *     are immutable system constants (e.g. BR-AL-001 annual leave minimum).
 *   • `changeReason` is mandatory (min 10 chars) and is stored in the audit
 *     metadata for every change — required for regulatory audit trail.
 */
export async function updateComplianceRule(
  input: UpdateComplianceRuleInput,
): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  try {
    // Hard Rule 8: SUPER_ADMIN only — compliance rules are law-tied constants.
    const user = await requireRole(['SUPER_ADMIN'])

    const data = UpdateComplianceRuleSchema.parse(input)

    await db.transaction(async tx => {
    const [current] = await tx
      .select()
      .from(complianceRules)
      .where(and(
        eq(complianceRules.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(complianceRules.id, data.ruleId),
      ))
      .limit(1)
    if (!current) throw new Error('NOT_FOUND: compliance rule not found')

    // GAP-N08 guard: non-overridable rules are managed by Anthropic/legal
    // and can only be changed via a migration, not via the UI.
    if (!current.isOverridable) {
      throw new Error(
        `GOVERNANCE_LOCK: rule ${current.ruleId} is marked isOverridable=false — `
        + 'update requires a migration with law-change justification.',
      )
    }

    const patch: Partial<typeof complianceRules.$inferInsert> = {
      updatedBy:       user.id,
      updatedByName:   user.name,
      updatedDate:     new Date(),
      lastUpdatedDate: new Date(),
    }
    if (data.descriptionEn !== undefined) patch.descriptionEn = data.descriptionEn
    if (data.descriptionAr !== undefined) patch.descriptionAr = data.descriptionAr
    if (data.formula       !== undefined) patch.formula       = data.formula
    if (data.isActive      !== undefined) patch.isActive      = data.isActive
    if ('sunsetDate' in data)             patch.sunsetDate    = data.sunsetDate ?? null
    if (data.notes         !== undefined) patch.notes         = data.notes

    await tx
      .update(complianceRules)
      .set(patch)
      .where(eq(complianceRules.id, data.ruleId))

    await writeAuditLog({
      actorId:      user.id,
      actorName:    user.name,
      actorRole:    user.role,
      channel:      'WEB',
      eventType:    'COMPLIANCE_RULE.UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'compliance_rules',
      resourceId:   data.ruleId,
      entityId:     current.legalEntityId ?? undefined,
      oldValues: {
        descriptionEn: current.descriptionEn,
        formula:       current.formula,
        isActive:      current.isActive,
        sunsetDate:    current.sunsetDate,
        notes:         current.notes,
      },
      newValues:    { ...patch, changeReason: data.changeReason },
      metadata:     { ruleCode: current.ruleId, changeReason: data.changeReason },
    }, tx)
    })

    return { id: data.ruleId }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'updateComplianceRule') }
}

'use server'

/**
 * notification Server Actions.
 *
 * S6-07 — `markNotificationRead`: flips notification_log.status → READ
 * and stamps `read_at` for the bell dropdown. Auth-gated to the
 * notification's recipient (or SUPER_ADMIN for diagnostics).
 *
 * Hard Rule 1 — every write is in a Drizzle tx with a paired audit row.
 */
import { translateError } from '@/lib/app-error'
import { and, eq, isNull } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { auth } from '@/lib/auth'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'
import { notificationLog } from '@/drizzle/schema'
import { writeAuditLog } from '@/lib/audit'
import { TENANT_ID } from '@/lib/constants'

const MarkReadInput = z.object({
  notificationId: z.string().uuid(),
})

export async function markNotificationRead(
  input: z.infer<typeof MarkReadInput>,
): Promise<{ id: string; alreadyRead: boolean }> {
  try {
    const session = await auth()
    if (!session?.user) throw new Error('unauthenticated')

  const { notificationId } = MarkReadInput.parse(input)

  // Pull row first so we can entity-scope and fail fast.
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      id:                notificationLog.id,
      recipientPersonId: notificationLog.recipientPersonId,
      status:            notificationLog.status,
      legalEntityId:     notificationLog.legalEntityId,
    })
    .from(notificationLog)
    .where(and(
      eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
      eq(notificationLog.id,       notificationId),
    ))
    .limit(1)
  if (!row) throw new Error('notification not found')

  // Recipient-only (or SUPER_ADMIN) per privacy rules.
  if (
    session.user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN'
    && row.recipientPersonId !== session.user.personId
  ) {
    throw new Error('forbidden')
  }

  if (row.status === 'READ') {
    return { id: row.id, alreadyRead: true }
  }

  await db.transaction(async tx => {
    await tx
      .update(notificationLog)
      .set({
        status:           'READ',
        readAt:           new Date(),
        lastUpdatedDate:  new Date(),
        updatedBy:        session.user.id,
        updatedByName:    session.user.name ?? session.user.email ?? 'unknown',
      })
      .where(and(
        eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(notificationLog.id,       row.id),
        isNull(notificationLog.readAt),
      ))

    await writeAuditLog({
      actorId:       session.user.id,
      actorName:     session.user.name ?? session.user.email ?? 'unknown',
      actorRole:     session.user.role,
      actorEntityId: session.user.legalEntityId ?? undefined,
      channel:       'WEB',
      eventType:     'NOTIFICATION.MARKED_READ',
      resourceType:  'notification_log',
      resourceId:    row.id,
      entityId:      row.legalEntityId ?? undefined,
    }, tx)
  })

    return { id: row.id, alreadyRead: false }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'markNotificationRead') }
}

'use server'

import { translateError, getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/app-error'
import { and, count, desc, eq, inArray, isNull, ne, notInArray, or } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'
import { writeAuditLog } from '@/lib/audit'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import { evaluateViewerAccess } from '@/modules/workflow-intelligence/access'
import { TENANT_ID } from '@/lib/constants'
import {
  notificationLog,
  events,
  userAccounts,
} from '@/drizzle/schema'
import { absenceEntries, absenceTypes, persons } from '@/drizzle/schema'
import {
  workflowInstancesV2,
  workflowStepInstances,
} from '@/drizzle/schema/workflow-engine'
import { takeWorkflowAction } from '@/lib/workflow-engine'

// Workflow-instance statuses that still genuinely await an approver's action.
// Anything else (APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED/RECALLED) is terminal — an approval
// notification pointing at such an instance must NOT count as unread/actionable,
// even if its own status column was never flipped to ACTIONED. This is the single
// source of truth so the bell can never disagree with the Approvals inbox,
// regardless of who decided the request, how (UI / bell / delegate / SLA cron),
// or whether the decision pre-dates the notification-clearing logic.
const ACTIONABLE_INSTANCE_STATUSES = ['PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'ESCALATED', 'ON_HOLD'] as const

export async function getMyNotifications(personId: string, _tenantId: string) {
  try {
    const rows = await db
      .select({
        id:             notificationLog.id,
        type:           notificationLog.notificationType,
        title:          notificationLog.subjectEn,
        message:        notificationLog.bodyEn,
        status:         notificationLog.status,
        createdAt:      notificationLog.createdDate,
        referenceId:    notificationLog.referenceId,
        referenceType:  notificationLog.referenceType,
        instanceStatus: workflowInstancesV2.status,
      })
      .from(notificationLog)
      // Reconcile each approval notification against its workflow instance's live
      // status. Join only fires for WORKFLOW_INSTANCE refs, so other notification
      // types (letters, absence entries) leave instanceStatus null and are untouched.
      .leftJoin(workflowInstancesV2, and(
        eq(notificationLog.referenceType, 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE'),
        eq(workflowInstancesV2.id, notificationLog.referenceId),
      ))
      .where(and(
        eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(notificationLog.recipientPersonId, personId),
      ))
      .orderBy(desc(notificationLog.createdDate))
      .limit(50)

    return rows.map(r => {
      // A workflow-linked notification whose instance is no longer actionable is
      // treated as actioned — moves it to the "Actioned/Done" list and hides the
      // Approve/Reject buttons, matching what the Approvals inbox already shows.
      const wfTerminal =
        r.referenceType === 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE' &&
        r.instanceStatus != null &&
        !ACTIONABLE_INSTANCE_STATUSES.includes(r.instanceStatus as typeof ACTIONABLE_INSTANCE_STATUSES[number])
      const isActioned = r.status === 'ACTIONED' || wfTerminal
      return {
        id:                 r.id,
        type:               r.type,
        title:              r.title ?? '',
        message:            r.message ?? '',
        isRead:             r.status === 'READ' || isActioned,
        isActioned,
        createdAt:          r.createdAt instanceof Date ? r.createdAt.toISOString() : String(r.createdAt),
        workflowInstanceId: r.referenceType === 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE' ? r.referenceId : null,
        referenceId:        r.referenceId ?? null,
        referenceType:      r.referenceType ?? null,
      }
    })
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getMyNotifications') }
}

export async function getUnreadCount(personId: string, _tenantId: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const [{ total }] = await db
      .select({ total: count() })
      .from(notificationLog)
      // Same reconciliation as getMyNotifications — keep the bell badge and the
      // panel list in lockstep with the workflow's real state.
      .leftJoin(workflowInstancesV2, and(
        eq(notificationLog.referenceType, 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE'),
        eq(workflowInstancesV2.id, notificationLog.referenceId),
      ))
      .where(and(
        eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(notificationLog.recipientPersonId, personId),
        notInArray(notificationLog.status, ['READ', 'ACTIONED']),
        // Exclude approval notifications whose instance is already terminal.
        or(
          ne(notificationLog.referenceType, 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE'),
          isNull(workflowInstancesV2.id),
          inArray(workflowInstancesV2.status, [...ACTIONABLE_INSTANCE_STATUSES]),
        ),
      ))
    return total
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getUnreadCount') }
}

export async function markAllRead(
  personId: string,
  _tenantId: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    try {
      await db
        .update(notificationLog)
        .set({ status: 'READ', readAt: new Date() })
        .where(and(
          eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(notificationLog.recipientPersonId, personId),
          ne(notificationLog.status, 'READ'),
        ))
      return { success: true }
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: String(err) }
    }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'markAllRead') }
}

export async function getApprovalDetail(workflowInstanceId: string) {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser()

    const [instance] = await db
      .select({
        id:                  workflowInstancesV2.id,
        status:              workflowInstancesV2.status,
        resourceType:        workflowInstancesV2.resourceType,
        resourceId:          workflowInstancesV2.resourceId,
        initiatedByPersonId: workflowInstancesV2.initiatedByPersonId,
        legalEntityId:       workflowInstancesV2.legalEntityId,
        contextSnapshot:     workflowInstancesV2.contextSnapshot,
      })
      .from(workflowInstancesV2)
      .where(and(
        eq(workflowInstancesV2.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(workflowInstancesV2.id, workflowInstanceId),
      ))
      .limit(1)

    if (!instance) throw new Error('NOT_FOUND: workflow instance')

    // Access gate — aligned with Phase B getWorkflowTimeline (evaluateViewerAccess):
    //   SUPER_ADMIN global · HR_ADMIN/HR_DIRECTOR entity-scoped · others must be a
    //   stakeholder (initiator / in-chain assignee / decider / delegate). Plus the
    //   bell's legitimate signal: a notification recipient for this instance.
    // Fails closed: unauthorized → throw (handled by the panel as "no access").
    const pid = user.personId ?? null

    const stepRows = await db
      .select({ assignee: workflowStepInstances.assignedToPersonId })
      .from(workflowStepInstances)
      .where(eq(workflowStepInstances.instanceId, workflowInstanceId))
    const stepAssigneePersonIds = stepRows.map(r => r.assignee)

    let isDeciderOrDelegate = false
    if (pid) {
      const probe = await db
        .select({ id: workflowStepInstances.id })
        .from(workflowStepInstances)
        .where(and(
          eq(workflowStepInstances.instanceId, workflowInstanceId),
          or(
            eq(workflowStepInstances.decidedByPersonId, pid),
            eq(workflowStepInstances.delegatedToPersonId, pid),
          ),
        ))
        .limit(1)
      isDeciderOrDelegate = probe.length > 0
    }

    let allowed = evaluateViewerAccess({
      role:                  user.role,
      personId:              pid,
      viewerLegalEntityId:   user.legalEntityId,
      initiatedByPersonId:   instance.initiatedByPersonId,
      instanceLegalEntityId: instance.legalEntityId,
      stepAssigneePersonIds,
      isDeciderOrDelegate,
    })

    // Bell-specific stakeholder signal: recipient of a notification for this instance.
    if (!allowed && pid) {
      const [notifRow] = await db
        .select({ id: notificationLog.id })
        .from(notificationLog)
        .where(and(
          eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(notificationLog.recipientPersonId, pid),
          eq(notificationLog.referenceId, workflowInstanceId),
        ))
        .limit(1)
      allowed = !!notifRow
    }

    if (!allowed) {
      throw new Error('FORBIDDEN: you do not have access to this approval')
    }

    // Leave request — look up by resourceId (v2 stores absence entry UUID)
    if (instance.resourceType === 'absence_entries') {
      const rows = await db
        .select({
          entry: absenceEntries,
          person: {
            id:           persons.id,
            fullNameEn:   persons.fullNameEn,
            personNumber: persons.personNumber,
          },
          absenceType: {
            typeNameEn: absenceTypes.typeNameEn,
            typeNameAr: absenceTypes.typeNameAr,
          },
        })
        .from(absenceEntries)
        .leftJoin(persons, eq(absenceEntries.personId, persons.id))
        .leftJoin(absenceTypes, eq(absenceEntries.absenceTypeId, absenceTypes.id))
        .where(and(
          eq(absenceEntries.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(absenceEntries.id, instance.resourceId),
        ))
        .limit(1)

      if (!rows.length) return { instance, entry: null, person: null, absenceType: null, hireContext: null }
      return { instance, ...rows[0], hireContext: null }
    }

    // Backdated hire approval — resourceType = 'persons', resourceId = personId
    if (instance.resourceType === 'persons' && instance.resourceId) {
      const [personRow] = await db
        .select({
          id:           persons.id,
          fullNameEn:   persons.fullNameEn,
          personNumber: persons.personNumber,
          hireDate:     persons.hireDate,
        })
        .from(persons)
        .where(and(
          eq(persons.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(persons.id, instance.resourceId),
        ))
        .limit(1)

      // Read backdatingDays and reason from the submission-time context snapshot.
      // These values were stored when the workflow was triggered and must not drift
      // as calendar days pass — the approver sees what was requested, not today's count.
      // Fall back to a live calculation only for legacy instances that pre-date this field.
      const ctxFields            = (instance.contextSnapshot as { fields?: Record<string, unknown> } | null)?.fields ?? {}
      const storedBackdatingDays = typeof ctxFields.backdatingDays === 'number' ? ctxFields.backdatingDays : null
      const storedReason         = typeof ctxFields.reason === 'string' ? ctxFields.reason : null

      return {
        instance,
        entry:       null,
        absenceType: null,
        person:      personRow
          ? { id: personRow.id, fullNameEn: personRow.fullNameEn, personNumber: personRow.personNumber }
          : null,
        hireContext: personRow?.hireDate
          ? {
              hireDate:      personRow.hireDate,
              backdatingDays: storedBackdatingDays ??
                Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(personRow.hireDate).getTime()) / 86_400_000),
              reason: storedReason,
            }
          : null,
      }
    }

    return { instance, entry: null, person: null, absenceType: null, hireContext: null as { hireDate: Date | string; backdatingDays: number | null; reason: string | null } | null }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getApprovalDetail') }
}

export async function approveRequest(
  workflowInstanceId: string,
  _actorId: string,
  _actorName: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    try {
      const user = await getCurrentUser()

      // Find the pending v2 step for this instance
      const [pendingStep] = await db
        .select({ id: workflowStepInstances.id })
        .from(workflowStepInstances)
        .where(and(
          eq(workflowStepInstances.instanceId, workflowInstanceId),
          eq(workflowStepInstances.status, 'PENDING'),
        ))
        .limit(1)

      if (!pendingStep) return { success: false, error: 'No pending step found for this workflow.' }

      const result = await takeWorkflowAction({
        stepInstanceId: pendingStep.id,
        actorPersonId:  'CURRENT_USER',
        decision:       'APPROVE',
      })

      if (!result.success) return { success: false, error: result.error }

      await db.transaction(async tx => {
        await writeAuditLog(
          {
            actorId:       user.personId ?? user.id,
            actorName:     user.name ?? '',
            actorRole:     user.role ?? '',
            actorEntityId: user.legalEntityId,
            channel:       'WEB',
            eventType:     'WORKFLOW.APPROVED',
            resourceType:  'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE',
            resourceId:    workflowInstanceId,
            metadata:      { instanceStatus: result.instanceStatus },
          },
          tx,
        )
        if (user.personId) {
          await tx
            .update(notificationLog)
            .set({ status: 'ACTIONED', readAt: new Date() })
            .where(and(
              eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
              eq(notificationLog.recipientPersonId, user.personId),
              eq(notificationLog.referenceId, workflowInstanceId),
            ))
        }
      })
      return { success: true }
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: getErrorMessage(err, 'approveRequest') }
    }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'approveRequest') }
}

export async function rejectRequest(
  workflowInstanceId: string,
  reason: string,
  _actorId: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    if (!reason || !reason.trim()) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Rejection reason is required.' }
    }
    try {
      const user = await getCurrentUser()

      const [pendingStep] = await db
        .select({ id: workflowStepInstances.id })
        .from(workflowStepInstances)
        .where(and(
          eq(workflowStepInstances.instanceId, workflowInstanceId),
          eq(workflowStepInstances.status, 'PENDING'),
        ))
        .limit(1)

      if (!pendingStep) return { success: false, error: 'No pending step found for this workflow.' }

      const result = await takeWorkflowAction({
        stepInstanceId: pendingStep.id,
        actorPersonId:  'CURRENT_USER',
        decision:       'REJECT',
        decisionNote:   reason,
      })

      if (!result.success) return { success: false, error: result.error }

      await db.transaction(async tx => {
        await writeAuditLog(
          {
            actorId:       user.personId ?? user.id,
            actorName:     user.name ?? '',
            actorRole:     user.role ?? '',
            actorEntityId: user.legalEntityId,
            channel:       'WEB',
            eventType:     'WORKFLOW.REJECTED',
            resourceType:  'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE',
            resourceId:    workflowInstanceId,
            metadata:      { reason, instanceStatus: result.instanceStatus },
          },
          tx,
        )
        if (user.personId) {
          await tx
            .update(notificationLog)
            .set({ status: 'ACTIONED', readAt: new Date() })
            .where(and(
              eq(notificationLog.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
              eq(notificationLog.recipientPersonId, user.personId),
              eq(notificationLog.referenceId, workflowInstanceId),
            ))
        }
      })
      return { success: true }
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: getErrorMessage(err, 'rejectRequest') }
    }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'rejectRequest') }
}

export async function requestInfo(
  workflowInstanceId: string,
  question: string,
  _actorId: string,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    if (!question || !question.trim()) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Question is required.' }
    }
    try {
      const user = await getCurrentUser()
      await db.transaction(async tx => {
        await tx.insert(events).values({
          tenantId:  TENANT_ID,
          eventType: 'workflow.info_requested',
          payload:   {
            workflowInstanceId,
            question:  question.trim(),
            askedBy:   user.name,
            askedById: user.personId,
          },
        })
        await writeAuditLog(
          {
            actorId:       user.personId ?? user.id,
            actorName:     user.name ?? '',
            actorRole:     user.role ?? '',
            actorEntityId: user.legalEntityId,
            channel:       'WEB',
            eventType:     'WORKFLOW.INFO_REQUESTED',
            resourceType:  'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE',
            resourceId:    workflowInstanceId,
            metadata:      { question: question.trim() },
          },
          tx,
        )
      })
      return { success: true }
    } catch (err) {
      return { success: false, error: String(err) }
    }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'requestInfo') }
}

export async function getPreferences(): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  try {
    const user = await getCurrentUser()
    if (!user.personId) return {}
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ preferences: userAccounts.preferences })
      .from(userAccounts)
      .where(and(
        eq(userAccounts.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(userAccounts.personId, user.personId),
      ))
      .limit(1)
    return (row?.preferences ?? {}) as Record<string, string>
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getPreferences') }
}

export async function updatePreferences(
  _userId: string,
  prefs: Record<string, string>,
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    try {
      const user = await getCurrentUser()
      if (!user.personId) return { success: false, error: 'No person linked to account. Contact HR Admin.' }

      // Use .returning() so we can detect if the WHERE clause matched any row.
      // If 0 rows returned, the preferences column may not exist in the DB yet.
      const updated = await db
        .update(userAccounts)
        .set({ preferences: prefs })
        .where(and(
          eq(userAccounts.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(userAccounts.personId, user.personId),
        ))
        .returning({ id: userAccounts.id })

      if (updated.length === 0) {
        // Fallback: no user_accounts row found for this personId — log and return informative error
        console.warn('[updatePreferences] 0 rows updated for personId', user.personId)
        return { success: false, error: 'User account record not found. Please contact IT support.' }
      }

      return { success: true }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[updatePreferences]', err)
      return { success: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save preferences.' }
    }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'updatePreferences') }
}

'use server'

/**
 * Medical Insurance Server Actions.
 *
 * Business rules enforced here:
 *   BR-INS-001 — employer must provide insurance; at least one active plan required
 *   BR-INS-002 — dependent visa document mandatory before dependent enrolment
 *   BR-INS-003 — insurance must cover notice period on termination
 *   BR-INS-004 — max 9 dependents (enforced in dependents/actions.ts; checked here too)
 *   BR-INS-005 — child age cap 18 / 25 student (enforced in eligibility.ts)
 *   BR-INS-006 — expiry extension beyond notice period supported
 *   BR-INS-007 — contractors excluded unless exception granted
 *
 * No approval workflow is required for insurance actions (UAE law mandate).
 * Hard Rule 1: every write is in a Drizzle tx with audit log.
 */
import { translateError } from '@/lib/app-error'
import { and, eq, desc, asc } from 'drizzle-orm'
import {
  medicalInsurancePlans,
  medicalInsuranceEnrolments,
  medicalInsurancePolicySettings,
  workerAssignments,
  persons,
} from '@/drizzle/schema'
import type {
  MedicalInsurancePlan,
  MedicalInsuranceEnrolment,
  MedicalInsurancePolicySetting,
} from '@/drizzle/schema'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'
import { writeAuditLog } from '@/lib/audit'
import { requireRole } from '@/lib/auth'
import { assertSameEntity, assertSelfOrTeam } from '@/lib/access'
import { TENANT_ID } from '@/lib/constants'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import {
  CreateInsurancePlanSchema,
  UpdateInsurancePlanSchema,
  UpsertPolicySettingsSchema,
  EnrolEmployeeSchema,
  EnrolDependentSchema,
  UpdateEnrolmentCardSchema,
  CancelEnrolmentSchema,
  GrantContractorExceptionSchema,
  ExtendExpirySchema,
  type CreateInsurancePlanInput,
  type UpdateInsurancePlanInput,
  type UpsertPolicySettingsInput,
  type EnrolEmployeeInput,
  type EnrolDependentInput,
  type UpdateEnrolmentCardInput,
  type CancelEnrolmentInput,
  type GrantContractorExceptionInput,
  type ExtendExpiryInput,
} from './validations'
import {
  enrolEmployeeTx,
  enrolDependentTx,
  cancelEnrolmentTx,
  getPolicySettingsTx,
} from './lifecycle'

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PLAN MANAGEMENT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export async function getInsurancePlans(
  legalEntityId: string,
): Promise<MedicalInsurancePlan[]> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN'])
    // Non-SUPER_ADMIN may only query their own entity's plans
    if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && legalEntityId !== user.legalEntityId) {
      throw new Error('FORBIDDEN: cross-entity plan access denied')
    }
    const entityId = user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? legalEntityId : user.legalEntityId

    return await db
      .select()
      .from(medicalInsurancePlans)
      .where(and(
        eq(medicalInsurancePlans.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(medicalInsurancePlans.legalEntityId, entityId),
      ))
      .orderBy(asc(medicalInsurancePlans.planCode))
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getInsurancePlans') }
}

export async function getInsurancePlan(
  planId: string,
): Promise<MedicalInsurancePlan | null> {
  try {
    await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN'])
    const [row] = await db
      .select()
      .from(medicalInsurancePlans)
      .where(and(
        eq(medicalInsurancePlans.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(medicalInsurancePlans.id, planId),
      ))
      .limit(1)
    return row ?? null
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getInsurancePlan') }
}

export async function createInsurancePlan(
  input: CreateInsurancePlanInput,
): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = CreateInsurancePlanSchema.parse(input)
    const legalEntityId = user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? data.legalEntityId : user.legalEntityId

    let planId = ''
    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      const [row] = await tx
        .insert(medicalInsurancePlans)
        .values({
          tenantId:               TENANT_ID,
          legalEntityId,
          planCode:               data.planCode,
          planNameEn:             data.planNameEn,
          planNameAr:             data.planNameAr,
          providerName:           data.providerName,
          tpaName:                data.tpaName,
          policyNumber:           data.policyNumber,
          networkName:            data.networkName,
          planCategory:           data.planCategory,
          inpatientLimitAed:      data.inpatientLimitAed,
          outpatientLimitAed:     data.outpatientLimitAed,
          dentalCovered:          data.dentalCovered,
          opticalCovered:         data.opticalCovered,
          maternityCovered:       data.maternityCovered,
          preExistingCovered:     data.preExistingCovered,
          repatriationCovered:    data.repatriationCovered,
          gradeIds:               data.gradeIds,
          employmentTypes:        data.employmentTypes,
          minServiceMonths:       data.minServiceMonths,
          dependentsCovered:      data.dependentsCovered,
          maxDependents:          data.maxDependents,
          employeePremiumAed:     data.employeePremiumAed,
          spousePremiumAed:       data.spousePremiumAed,
          childPremiumAed:        data.childPremiumAed,
          parentPremiumAed:       data.parentPremiumAed,
          policyStartDate:        data.policyStartDate,
          policyEndDate:          data.policyEndDate,
          renewalDate:            data.renewalDate,
          isDefaultPlan:          data.isDefaultPlan,
          regulatoryScheme:       data.regulatoryScheme,
          employerContributionPct: data.employerContributionPct,
          createdBy:              user.id,
          createdByName:          user.name,
        })
        .returning({ id: medicalInsurancePlans.id })
      planId = row.id

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: 'INSURANCE_PLAN.CREATED',
        resourceType: 'medical_insurance_plans', resourceId: planId,
        entityId: legalEntityId,
        newValues: { planCode: data.planCode, planCategory: data.planCategory, providerName: data.providerName },
      }, tx)
    })

    revalidatePath('/settings/insurance-plans')
    return { id: planId }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'createInsurancePlan') }
}

export async function updateInsurancePlan(
  input: UpdateInsurancePlanInput,
): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = UpdateInsurancePlanSchema.parse(input)

    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      const [existing] = await tx
        .select({ id: medicalInsurancePlans.id, legalEntityId: medicalInsurancePlans.legalEntityId })
        .from(medicalInsurancePlans)
        .where(and(
          eq(medicalInsurancePlans.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(medicalInsurancePlans.id, data.id),
        ))
        .limit(1)
      if (!existing) throw new Error(`NOT_FOUND: insurance plan ${data.id}`)
      if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && existing.legalEntityId !== user.legalEntityId) {
        throw new Error('FORBIDDEN: cross-entity plan update denied')
      }

      await tx
        .update(medicalInsurancePlans)
        .set({
          ...(data.planNameEn        !== undefined && { planNameEn:             data.planNameEn }),
          ...(data.planNameAr        !== undefined && { planNameAr:             data.planNameAr }),
          ...(data.providerName      !== undefined && { providerName:           data.providerName }),
          ...(data.tpaName           !== undefined && { tpaName:                data.tpaName }),
          ...(data.policyNumber      !== undefined && { policyNumber:           data.policyNumber }),
          ...(data.networkName       !== undefined && { networkName:            data.networkName }),
          ...(data.planCategory      !== undefined && { planCategory:           data.planCategory }),
          ...(data.inpatientLimitAed !== undefined && { inpatientLimitAed:      data.inpatientLimitAed }),
          ...(data.outpatientLimitAed !== undefined && { outpatientLimitAed:    data.outpatientLimitAed }),
          ...(data.dentalCovered     !== undefined && { dentalCovered:          data.dentalCovered }),
          ...(data.opticalCovered    !== undefined && { opticalCovered:         data.opticalCovered }),
          ...(data.maternityCovered  !== undefined && { maternityCovered:       data.maternityCovered }),
          ...(data.preExistingCovered !== undefined && { preExistingCovered:    data.preExistingCovered }),
          ...(data.repatriationCovered !== undefined && { repatriationCovered:  data.repatriationCovered }),
          ...(data.gradeIds          !== undefined && { gradeIds:               data.gradeIds }),
          ...(data.employmentTypes   !== undefined && { employmentTypes:        data.employmentTypes }),
          ...(data.minServiceMonths  !== undefined && { minServiceMonths:       data.minServiceMonths }),
          ...(data.dependentsCovered !== undefined && { dependentsCovered:      data.dependentsCovered }),
          ...(data.maxDependents     !== undefined && { maxDependents:          data.maxDependents }),
          ...(data.employeePremiumAed !== undefined && { employeePremiumAed:    data.employeePremiumAed }),
          ...(data.spousePremiumAed  !== undefined && { spousePremiumAed:       data.spousePremiumAed }),
          ...(data.childPremiumAed   !== undefined && { childPremiumAed:        data.childPremiumAed }),
          ...(data.parentPremiumAed  !== undefined && { parentPremiumAed:       data.parentPremiumAed }),
          ...(data.policyStartDate   !== undefined && { policyStartDate:        data.policyStartDate }),
          ...(data.policyEndDate     !== undefined && { policyEndDate:          data.policyEndDate }),
          ...(data.renewalDate       !== undefined && { renewalDate:            data.renewalDate }),
          ...(data.isDefaultPlan     !== undefined && { isDefaultPlan:          data.isDefaultPlan }),
          ...(data.regulatoryScheme  !== undefined && { regulatoryScheme:       data.regulatoryScheme }),
          ...(data.employerContributionPct !== undefined && { employerContributionPct: data.employerContributionPct }),
          updatedBy:       user.id,
          updatedByName:   user.name,
          updatedDate:     new Date(),
          lastUpdatedDate: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(medicalInsurancePlans.id, data.id))

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: existing.legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: 'INSURANCE_PLAN.UPDATED',
        resourceType: 'medical_insurance_plans', resourceId: data.id,
        entityId: existing.legalEntityId,
      }, tx)
    })

    revalidatePath('/settings/insurance-plans')
    return { id: data.id }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'updateInsurancePlan') }
}

export async function toggleInsurancePlanActive(
  planId: string,
  isActive: boolean,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      const [existing] = await tx
        .select({ id: medicalInsurancePlans.id, legalEntityId: medicalInsurancePlans.legalEntityId })
        .from(medicalInsurancePlans)
        .where(and(eq(medicalInsurancePlans.tenantId, TENANT_ID), eq(medicalInsurancePlans.id, planId)))
        .limit(1)
      if (!existing) throw new Error(`NOT_FOUND: insurance plan ${planId}`)
      if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && existing.legalEntityId !== user.legalEntityId) {
        throw new Error('FORBIDDEN')
      }
      await tx.update(medicalInsurancePlans).set({
        isActive, updatedBy: user.id, updatedByName: user.name,
        updatedDate: new Date(), lastUpdatedDate: new Date(),
      }).where(eq(medicalInsurancePlans.id, planId))

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: existing.legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: isActive ? 'INSURANCE_PLAN.ACTIVATED' : 'INSURANCE_PLAN.DEACTIVATED',
        resourceType: 'medical_insurance_plans', resourceId: planId,
        entityId: existing.legalEntityId,
      }, tx)
    })
    revalidatePath('/settings/insurance-plans')
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'toggleInsurancePlanActive') }
}

export async function upsertInsurancePolicySettings(
  input: UpsertPolicySettingsInput,
): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = UpsertPolicySettingsSchema.parse(input)
    const legalEntityId = user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? data.legalEntityId : user.legalEntityId

    let settingsId = ''
    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      const existing = await getPolicySettingsTx(tx, legalEntityId)

      if (existing) {
        await tx
          .update(medicalInsurancePolicySettings)
          .set({
            maxDependentsPerEmployee: data.maxDependentsPerEmployee,
            maxSpouses:               data.maxSpouses,
            maxChildren:              data.maxChildren,
            parentsCovered:           data.parentsCovered,
            parentsInLawCovered:      data.parentsInLawCovered,
            childMaxAge:              data.childMaxAge,
            childStudentExtensionAge: data.childStudentExtensionAge,
            employerPaysSpouse:       data.employerPaysSpouse,
            employerPaysChildren:     data.employerPaysChildren,
            employerPaysParents:      data.employerPaysParents,
            employeeDependentCostPct: data.employeeDependentCostPct,
            autoEnrolOnHire:          data.autoEnrolOnHire,
            enrolmentGraceDays:       data.enrolmentGraceDays,
            dependentAddGraceDays:    data.dependentAddGraceDays,
            renewalAlertDays:         data.renewalAlertDays,
            updatedBy:                user.id,
            updatedByName:            user.name,
            updatedDate:              new Date(),
            lastUpdatedDate:          new Date(),
          })
          .where(eq(medicalInsurancePolicySettings.id, existing.id))
        settingsId = existing.id
      } else {
        const [row] = await tx
          .insert(medicalInsurancePolicySettings)
          .values({
            tenantId:                 TENANT_ID,
            legalEntityId,
            maxDependentsPerEmployee: data.maxDependentsPerEmployee,
            maxSpouses:               data.maxSpouses,
            maxChildren:              data.maxChildren,
            parentsCovered:           data.parentsCovered,
            parentsInLawCovered:      data.parentsInLawCovered,
            childMaxAge:              data.childMaxAge,
            childStudentExtensionAge: data.childStudentExtensionAge,
            employerPaysSpouse:       data.employerPaysSpouse,
            employerPaysChildren:     data.employerPaysChildren,
            employerPaysParents:      data.employerPaysParents,
            employeeDependentCostPct: data.employeeDependentCostPct,
            autoEnrolOnHire:          data.autoEnrolOnHire,
            enrolmentGraceDays:       data.enrolmentGraceDays,
            dependentAddGraceDays:    data.dependentAddGraceDays,
            renewalAlertDays:         data.renewalAlertDays,
            createdBy:                user.id,
            createdByName:            user.name,
          })
          .returning({ id: medicalInsurancePolicySettings.id })
        settingsId = row.id
      }

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: 'INSURANCE_POLICY_SETTINGS.UPSERTED',
        resourceType: 'medical_insurance_policy_settings', resourceId: settingsId,
        entityId: legalEntityId,
      }, tx)
    })

    revalidatePath('/settings/insurance-policy')
    return { id: settingsId }
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'upsertInsurancePolicySettings') }
}

export async function enrolEmployee(
  input: EnrolEmployeeInput,
): Promise<{ enrolmentId: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = EnrolEmployeeSchema.parse(input)
    // P3-A7 — block cross-entity enrolment: a non-SUPER_ADMIN may only enrol
    // against their own legal entity (the value is persisted and drives plan
    // resolution, so a forged data.legalEntityId must be rejected).
    assertSameEntity(user, data.legalEntityId)

    return await db.transaction(async tx =>
      enrolEmployeeTx(tx, {
        id: user.id, name: user.name, role: user.role, legalEntityId: user.legalEntityId,
      }, data)
    )
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'enrolEmployee') }
}

export async function enrolDependent(
  input: EnrolDependentInput,
): Promise<{ enrolmentId: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = EnrolDependentSchema.parse(input)
    // P3-A7 — block cross-entity dependent enrolment.
    assertSameEntity(user, data.legalEntityId)

    return await db.transaction(async tx =>
      enrolDependentTx(tx, {
        id: user.id, name: user.name, role: user.role, legalEntityId: user.legalEntityId,
      }, data)
    )
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'enrolDependent') }
}

export async function updateEnrolmentCard(
  input: UpdateEnrolmentCardInput,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = UpdateEnrolmentCardSchema.parse(input)

    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      const [enrolment] = await tx
        .select({ id: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, legalEntityId: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.legalEntityId, personId: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.personId })
        .from(medicalInsuranceEnrolments)
        .where(and(
          eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, data.enrolmentId),
        ))
        .limit(1)
      if (!enrolment) throw new Error(`NOT_FOUND: enrolment ${data.enrolmentId}`)
      // P3-A7 — block cross-entity card update.
      assertSameEntity(user, enrolment.legalEntityId)

      await tx
        .update(medicalInsuranceEnrolments)
        .set({
          ...(data.insuranceCardNumber  !== undefined && { insuranceCardNumber:      data.insuranceCardNumber }),
          ...(data.insuranceMemberId    !== undefined && { insuranceMemberId:        data.insuranceMemberId }),
          ...(data.cardDocumentId       !== undefined && { cardDocumentId:           data.cardDocumentId }),
          ...(data.submittedToInsurerDate !== undefined && { submittedToInsurerDate: data.submittedToInsurerDate }),
          ...(data.insurerReference     !== undefined && { insurerReference:         data.insurerReference }),
          ...(data.notes                !== undefined && { notes:                    data.notes }),
          updatedBy:       user.id,
          updatedByName:   user.name,
          updatedDate:     new Date(),
          lastUpdatedDate: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, data.enrolmentId))

      // Sync card number snapshot onto persons row if it's an employee enrolment
      if (data.insuranceCardNumber) {
        await tx.update(persons).set({
          insuranceCardNumber: data.insuranceCardNumber,
          lastUpdatedDate:     new Date(),
        }).where(and(eq(persons.tenantId, TENANT_ID), eq(persons.id, enrolment.personId)))
      }

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: enrolment.legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: 'INSURANCE.CARD_UPDATED',
        resourceType: 'medical_insurance_enrolments', resourceId: data.enrolmentId,
        entityId: enrolment.legalEntityId,
      }, tx)
    })
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'updateEnrolmentCard') }
}

export async function cancelEnrolment(
  input: CancelEnrolmentInput,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = CancelEnrolmentSchema.parse(input)

    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      // P3-A7 — block cross-entity cancellation: load the enrolment and verify
      // it belongs to the actor's entity before cancelling.
      const [enrolment] = await tx
        .select({ legalEntityId: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.legalEntityId })
        .from(medicalInsuranceEnrolments)
        .where(and(eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.tenantId, TENANT_ID), eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, data.enrolmentId)))
        .limit(1)
      if (!enrolment) throw new Error(`NOT_FOUND: enrolment ${data.enrolmentId}`)
      assertSameEntity(user, enrolment.legalEntityId)

      return cancelEnrolmentTx(tx, {
        id: user.id, name: user.name, role: user.role, legalEntityId: user.legalEntityId,
      }, data)
    })
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'cancelEnrolment') }
}

export async function extendEnrolmentExpiry(
  input: ExtendExpiryInput,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = ExtendExpirySchema.parse(input)

    await db.transaction(async tx => {
      const [enrolment] = await tx
        .select({ id: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, legalEntityId: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.legalEntityId, personId: medicalInsuranceEnrolments.personId })
        .from(medicalInsuranceEnrolments)
        .where(and(eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.tenantId, TENANT_ID), eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, data.enrolmentId)))
        .limit(1)
      if (!enrolment) throw new Error(`NOT_FOUND: enrolment ${data.enrolmentId}`)
      // P3-A7 — block cross-entity expiry extension.
      assertSameEntity(user, enrolment.legalEntityId)

      await tx.update(medicalInsuranceEnrolments).set({
        insuranceExpiryExtensionDate:   data.extensionDate,
        insuranceExpiryExtensionReason: data.extensionReason,
        expiryDate:                     data.extensionDate,
        updatedBy:       user.id,
        updatedByName:   user.name,
        updatedDate:     new Date(),
        lastUpdatedDate: new Date(),
      }).where(eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.id, data.enrolmentId))

      await tx.update(persons).set({
        insuranceExpiryDate: data.extensionDate,
        lastUpdatedDate:     new Date(),
      }).where(and(eq(persons.tenantId, TENANT_ID), eq(persons.id, enrolment.personId)))

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: enrolment.legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: 'INSURANCE.EXPIRY_EXTENDED',
        resourceType: 'medical_insurance_enrolments', resourceId: data.enrolmentId,
        entityId: enrolment.legalEntityId,
        metadata: { extensionDate: data.extensionDate, extensionReason: data.extensionReason },
      }, tx)
    })
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'extendEnrolmentExpiry') }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CONTRACTOR EXCEPTION
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export async function grantContractorInsuranceException(
  input: GrantContractorExceptionInput,
): Promise<{ enrolmentId: string }> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN'])
    const data = GrantContractorExceptionSchema.parse(input)
    // P3-A7 — block cross-entity contractor exception + enrolment.
    assertSameEntity(user, data.legalEntityId)

    return await db.transaction(async tx => {
      // BR-INS-007: verify the assignment is actually a CONTRACTOR before granting exception
      const [assignment] = await tx
        .select({ employmentType: workerAssignments.employmentType })
        .from(workerAssignments)
        .where(and(
          eq(workerAssignments.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(workerAssignments.id, data.workerAssignmentId),
        ))
        .limit(1)
      if (!assignment) throw new Error(`NOT_FOUND: worker assignment ${data.workerAssignmentId}`)
      if (assignment.employmentType !== 'CONTRACTOR') {
        throw new Error(
          'BR-INS-007: contractor insurance exception can only be granted to employees ' +
          `with employmentType = CONTRACTOR (actual: ${assignment.employmentType ?? 'unknown'}).`,
        )
      }

      // Flip exception flag on the assignment
      await tx
        .update(workerAssignments)
        .set({
          insuranceExceptionGranted: true,
          updatedBy:       user.id,
          updatedByName:   user.name,
          updatedDate:     new Date(),
          lastUpdatedDate: new Date(),
        })
        .where(and(
          eq(workerAssignments.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
          eq(workerAssignments.id, data.workerAssignmentId),
        ))

      await writeAuditLog({
        actorId: user.id, actorName: user.name, actorRole: user.role,
        actorEntityId: data.legalEntityId, channel: 'WEB',
        eventType: 'INSURANCE.CONTRACTOR_EXCEPTION_GRANTED',
        resourceType: 'worker_assignments', resourceId: data.workerAssignmentId,
        entityId: data.legalEntityId,
        metadata: { personId: data.personId },
      }, tx)

      // Now enrol the contractor
      return enrolEmployeeTx(tx, {
        id: user.id, name: user.name, role: user.role, legalEntityId: data.legalEntityId,
      }, {
        personId:      data.personId,
        legalEntityId: data.legalEntityId,
        planId:        data.planId,
        effectiveDate: data.effectiveDate,
      })
    })
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'grantContractorInsuranceException') }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// QUERIES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export async function getPersonEnrolments(
  personId: string,
): Promise<MedicalInsuranceEnrolment[]> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'MANAGER'])
    // P3-A6 — IDOR guard: EMPLOYEE/MANAGER are relationship-scoped (self + reports);
    // HR / PAYROLL_ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN are trusted broad-read for premium/admin work.
    if (user.role === 'EMPLOYEE' || user.role === 'MANAGER') {
      await assertSelfOrTeam({ role: user.role, personId: user.personId }, personId)
    }
    return await db
      .select()
      .from(medicalInsuranceEnrolments)
      .where(and(
        eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.personId, personId),
      ))
      .orderBy(desc(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.effectiveDate))
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getPersonEnrolments') }
}

export async function getActiveEnrolment(
  personId: string,
): Promise<MedicalInsuranceEnrolment | null> {
  try {
    const user = await requireRole(['HR_ADMIN', 'HR_DIRECTOR', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'PAYROLL_ADMIN', 'EMPLOYEE', 'MANAGER'])
    // P3-A6 — IDOR guard (see getPersonEnrolments).
    if (user.role === 'EMPLOYEE' || user.role === 'MANAGER') {
      await assertSelfOrTeam({ role: user.role, personId: user.personId }, personId)
    }
    const [row] = await db
      .select()
      .from(medicalInsuranceEnrolments)
      .where(and(
        eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
        eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.personId, personId),
        eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.enrolmentType, 'EMPLOYEE'),
        eq(medicalInsuranceEnrolments.enrolmentStatus, 'ACTIVE'),
      ))
      .limit(1)
    return row ?? null
  } catch (e) { translateError(e, 'getActiveEnrolment') }
}

/**
 * Insurance eligibility resolution.
 *
 * Resolves which plan an employee is eligible for based on:
 *   • gradeIds[]        — plan's allowed grades (NULL = all)
 *   • employmentTypes[] — plan's allowed employment types (NULL = all)
 *   • minServiceMonths  — waiting period from hire date
 *   • isActive          — plan must be active
 *
 * BR-INS-007: contractors are excluded unless insuranceExceptionGranted.
 * BR-INS-005: dependent child age cap enforced here.
 * BR-INS-004: max 9 active dependents enforced in actions.ts.
 */
import { and, eq, or, isNull } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { medicalInsurancePlans } from '@/drizzle/schema'
import type { MedicalInsurancePlan } from '@/drizzle/schema'
import { TENANT_ID } from '@/lib/constants'

type Tx = {
  select: typeof import('@/lib/db').db.select
}

export interface EligibilityContext {
  legalEntityId:    string
  gradeId?:         string | null
  employmentType:   string
  hireDateOrStart:  string   // ISO date — used for minServiceMonths check
  /** BR-INS-007: set to true when a contractor exception has been granted */
  insuranceExceptionGranted?: boolean
}

/**
 * Returns the first eligible active plan for the employee.
 * Preference order: isDefaultPlan first, then by policyStartDate desc.
 */
export async function resolveEligiblePlan(
  tx: Tx,
  ctx: EligibilityContext,
): Promise<MedicalInsurancePlan | null> {
  // BR-INS-007: contractors excluded unless exception granted
  if (
    ctx.employmentType === 'CONTRACTOR' &&
    !ctx.insuranceExceptionGranted
  ) {
    return null
  }

  const plans = await tx
    .select()
    .from(medicalInsurancePlans)
    .where(and(
      eq(medicalInsurancePlans.tenantId, TENANT_ID),
      eq(medicalInsurancePlans.legalEntityId, ctx.legalEntityId),
      eq(medicalInsurancePlans.isActive, true),
    ))

  if (!plans.length) return null

  const now = new Date()
  const serviceMonths = ctx.hireDateOrStart
    ? monthsBetween(new Date(ctx.hireDateOrStart), now)
    : 0

  const eligible = plans.filter(plan => {
    // Waiting period
    if (plan.minServiceMonths && serviceMonths < plan.minServiceMonths) return false

    // Employment type filter (null = all allowed)
    if (plan.employmentTypes && plan.employmentTypes.length > 0) {
      if (!plan.employmentTypes.includes(ctx.employmentType)) return false
    }

    // Grade filter (null = all allowed)
    if (plan.gradeIds && plan.gradeIds.length > 0) {
      if (!ctx.gradeId) return false
      if (!plan.gradeIds.includes(ctx.gradeId)) return false
    }

    return true
  })

  if (!eligible.length) return null

  // Prefer default plan; otherwise pick highest-tier by employee premium desc
  const sorted = eligible.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.isDefaultPlan && !b.isDefaultPlan) return -1
    if (!a.isDefaultPlan && b.isDefaultPlan) return 1
    const aP = parseFloat(a.employeePremiumAed ?? '0')
    const bP = parseFloat(b.employeePremiumAed ?? '0')
    return bP - aP
  })

  return sorted[0] ?? null
}

/**
 * BR-INS-005: child/student age check for dependent enrolment.
 * Returns null if eligible, or an error message string if not.
 */
export function checkDependentAgeEligibility(
  relationship: string,
  dateOfBirth:  string | null | undefined,
  isStudent:    boolean | null | undefined,
  childMaxAge:  number,
  childStudentExtensionAge: number,
): string | null {
  if (!['CHILD', 'SON', 'DAUGHTER'].includes(relationship.toUpperCase())) {
    return null // not a child relationship — age cap doesn't apply
  }
  if (!dateOfBirth) return null

  const ageYears = yearsBetween(new Date(dateOfBirth), new Date())
  const maxAge = isStudent ? childStudentExtensionAge : childMaxAge

  if (ageYears > maxAge) {
    return `BR-INS-005: dependent age ${ageYears} exceeds maximum ${maxAge} years (${isStudent ? 'student extension' : 'standard'})`
  }
  return null
}

// ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function monthsBetween(from: Date, to: Date): number {
  return (to.getFullYear() - from.getFullYear()) * 12
       + (to.getMonth() - from.getMonth())
}

function yearsBetween(from: Date, to: Date): number {
  let years = to.getFullYear() - from.getFullYear()
  const m = to.getMonth() - from.getMonth()
  if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && to.getDate() < from.getDate())) years--
  return years
}
